/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip: Loot Radar marks the loot around you in the mini-map, including Mods, Resources, Syndicate Medallions, and more! Try out Thief's Wit or other Mods with Loot Radar to see for yourself.
Warframes and Weapons have 3 Appearance and Mod Config Slots to easily swap between builds and cosmetics! 3 additional slots can be purchased with Platinum for even more options.
Increasing your Mastery Rank also unlocks an additional trade per day for every Rank earned.
Check for MOA Cabinet Spawners on Corpus Outpost missions. Hacking their Cabinets will deploy an allied Shockwave MOA for your team.
Mastery Rank points are earned by ranking up Warframes, Weapons, Companions, and more! Expand your Arsenal and level up equipment to progress towards your next Mastery Test.
Visit The Index on Neptune to invest and potentially earn large sums of Credits by facing off against Nef Anyo's Brokers.
Share bug reports on the official Warframe Forums at forums.warframe.com! The more detail you can provide, including screenshots or video, the better.

See where Resources can be found by selecting the Resources Drones button in the Star Chart. Zoom into a planet and hover over the Extractor icon to see what Resources are available. Planets with completed nodes can have Extractors deployed on them for passive Resource generation.
Grineer Blunts are great at blocking bullets. Level the battlefield by using them to your advantage as cover against the onslaught.
Helios can use Synthesis Scanners charges to scan enemies if there are no Codex Scanners in your Gear Wheel.
Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relays to purchase a Sol-Battery Widget to give your Synthesis Scanner infinite charges.
Life Support Capsules in Survival missions restore 30% Life Support and modules dropped by enemies restore 5%. Maximize the return on Capsules by activating them only when Life Support is below 70%
Different enemy Factions have their own damage Vulnerabilities and Resistances. Check the Mission Node before embarking to see which damage types to bring for maximum damage!
Use Forma to add or change a Polarity of your choice to Max Rank equipments. Doing so will reduce Mod capacity drain and reset the item to Rank 0.
Test Warframes and Weapons against scanned enemies in the Simulacrum. Gain access by purchasing a Simulacrum Access Key from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays.
You can practice upcoming Mastery Rank tests and re-play completed ones by visiting Cephalon Simaris' Sanctuary in the Relays.
Visit www.warframe.com/droptables for a comprehensive list of in-game drop tables.
You can Fast Travel to many Points of Interest in Relays, Clan Dojos, and Open Landscape Hubs by using the Gear Wheel or Pause Menu and selecting your destination.

Pledge loyalty to a Syndicate via the Syndicate Segment in your Orbiter to earn 15% of Affinity as Standing with them. Take note of which Syndicates are hostile towards you, as they may send Death Squads after you in Missions!
If an Excavator in an Excavation mission is close to being destroyed, bring it a Power Cell to restore its Shields.

The location of Baro Ki'Teer's next visit will be marked in your Star Chart when he is close to arriving. You'll also receive an inbox message when he arrives that indicates which Relay he's visiting.
The Void Trader Kiosk is always available in the Relays to exchange Prime Parts and Blueprints for Ducats and will display a countdown timer for Baro Ki'Teer's next visit.

The Void Trader, Baro Ki'Teer, appears every two weeks with special wares. A kiosk in the Relays will allow you to exchange your spare Prime parts for Ducats, which he will gladly trade for unique cosmetics and other exclusive items.
Keep a lookout for bright blue Cephalon Fragments in-mission. Scanning them will unveil pieces of Cephalon Ordis' memory in your Codex.
Cephalon Fragments and Somachord Tones are automatically marked in your Minimap when using Loot Radar mods such as Thief's Wit.
The Vector-Thread Widget for Synthesis Scanners will reduce the amount of time required to complete a scan. Combine this with the Cross-Matrix Widget for a chance at double the scans.
Increase your Focus Point gains by leveraging Stealth Kill Affinity Bonuses, or playing Sanctuary Onslaught missions for the guaranteed Convergence Boost at the start of each Zone.

Install a Focus Lens on a max-Rank Warframe, Weapon, or other equipment in your Arsenal to earn Focus Points. Install Lenses from different Schools across your loadout to gain Focus in multiple Schools at the same time.
The Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment can be acquired by purchasing it from the in-game Market, researching the Blueprint in your Clan Dojo, or by killing Hyekka Masters.
Upgrade your Kavat with the Sharpened Claws Mod and sunder enemy armor with each attack. Combine this with the Swipe Mod to strike several enemies at once.

Feral Kavats wander around missions located on Deimos and can be scanned for a chance at Kavat Genetic Codes. Collect 10 to incubate a Kavat Companion with the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment installed in your Orbiter.
Squad Shield, Health, Energy, and Ammo Restores can be a life-saver for you and your squad! Equip them onto your Gear Wheel before going into missions.

Unlock new Landing Crafts to earn their specialized Air Support Charge. You can equip your Air Support of choice via the Landing Craft category in your Orbiter Menu and call them in using Air Support Charges from your Gear wheel. Air Support Charges can be crafted in your Foundry.
Abilities that stun, slow, or put enemies to sleep can make them easier to scan. This is especially useful on slippery targets, such as Feral Kavats.
The Heliocor melee weapon automatically scans targets it kills if you have Codex or Synthesis Scanners equipped on your Gear Wheel. You can purchase the blueprint from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays.
Equip the Glyph Prism to your Gear Wheel to display your selected Glyph in-mission.

Grineer Forest missions located on Earth have a day/night cycle that changes every four hours. Vegetation also shifts between Sunlight and Moonlight variants that can be scanned for Antitoxins and Apothics.
Link an item in chat using [ square brackets ] and typing in the name. Fellow Tenno will be able to click on the Link to view the item details.
Complete Junctions to unlock Quests, challenges, rewards, and other secrets hidden across the Origin System.
Save big, Tenno! Visit Darvo's store in the Relays to see what deals he has to offer.

Invasion missions can reward unique Resources, Weapon Parts, and more! Ensure you have completed the required amount of missions indicated in the Invasion Screen. Rewards are delivered via Inbox message once the Invasion is complete.
Adjust your HUD Scale setting in the Interface Options to increase or decrease the visibility of damage numbers, Health and Shield Stats, Weapon Stats, Minimap, and more.
Sliding and rolling in very quick succession is a great way to increase your mobility when needed. Tack on bullet jumping at peak momentum and Aim Glide to achieve maximum distance.

Loadout Slots allow you to save your current Loadout for easy access in the future. Earn new Loadout Slots through Mastery Rank progression! Select the Loadout name to open your Loadout Menu, where you can favourite, rename, and view all current Saved Loadouts.
When playing Solo you can pause the game by opening the Menu, with the exception of  Open Landscape missions.
Plan for Spy and Rescue missions by crafting and equipping Ciphers onto your Gear wheel. Ciphers can be used after beginning a terminal hack to instantly complete hacking.
You can sell extra or unwanted equipment, blueprints, and more via the Inventory category of your Equipment sub-menu.
Hover over Prime parts in the Fissure reward selection screen to see their Ducat Value.

Acquire Dragon Key blueprints in the Orokin Lab of your Clan Dojo. After building them in your Foundry, you can equip these Keys in your Gear Wheel to unlock Orokin Vaults, but be wary as each equipped Key comes with its own debilitating debuff.
Transmutation Cores remove the credit cost in transmutation and guarantees the Polarity of the resulting Mod. Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relay to purchase them with Standing.

The official Warframe Companion App allows you to claim and deploy Extractors, use your Foundry, manage Companions, refine Void Relics, get the latest Warframe news, and much more from your mobile device. Download the App in the App Store or Google Play.

There are dedicated Chat tabs for Recruiting, Questions, and Trading that can be enabled/disabled in your Chat Options. Use these tabs to find a Squad or Clan, to ask for help, or to Trade with other Tenno.
Completing Junctions grants you 1,000 Mastery points each!

Stealth kills grant an Affinity Bonus, with successive kills in a short time span increasing this bonus. An icon will appear in your HUD when triggered, displaying the Affinity Bonus and time remaining.
Codex and Synthesis Scanners highlight enemies through walls, which can be used to get an edge in missions that require a stealthy approach.
Exchange duplicate Mods for Endo or Credits in the Mod Segment of your Orbiter. The rarer the Mod, the better the returns!
Earn Prime Parts and Blueprints from Void Relics by opening them in Void Fissure Missions.

Opening a Relic by collecting 10 Reactant in Void Fissure missions will grant you a Corruption buff! The buff and its duration is indicated in the HUD upon triggering alongside a glowing Corruption effect on the buffed equipment.
Relic drop locations can be found in the second tab while hovering over the Relic in your Void Relics menu. You can also search for specific Relics using the Universe tab in your Codex.

Equip Loot Radar mods to help find Resource Caches that spawn in certain Sabotage and Exterminate missions or Bounties. When looking for Resource Caches, listen for their distinctive high-pitched chime to find their location.
Void Traces are used in the refinement of Void Relics to alter the drop chances of its rewards. Earn Traces in Void Fissure and Railjack Void Storm missions.
Void Trace capacity starts at 100 and increases by 50 for each Mastery Rank. For example, Mastery Rank 9 has a Void Trace cap of 550!
Grineer Prosecutors are highly vulnerable to <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage that matches their aura.
Maximize the Focus Points earned from Focus Lenses by installing them on your most-used Equipment.
Focus Lenses can be equipped on maximum rank Warframes, Weapons, Archwings, Arch-Guns, Arch-Melees, Necramechs, K-Drives, and Gilded Amps to convert Affinity on that equipment into Focus.
Staying within Shared Affinity Range (50 meters) of your squad is a great way to get Affinity for Equipment or Focus Points.
The Fosfor Gear items acquired from Nakak in Cetus can be used to temporarily increase your Shared Affinity Range.
Your daily maximum on earning Focus Points increases with your Mastery Rank. Each Rank increases the daily maximum by an additional 5,000.
The Zenurik Focus School contains several ways to help you cast Warframe abilities as often as possible. Consider Zenurik for overall improved Energy reserves.

The Vazarin Focus School's Mending Unity passive affects the range of Warframe abilities that scale off Affinity Range, such as Trinity's Blessing, Citrine's Preserving Shell, and Harrow's Covenant and Penance.
The Vazarin Focus School provides a variety of ways to protect your allies, Companions, and Defense objectives. Consider Vazarin for improved protection of your squad and other priority targets.

Grineer Heavy Gunners and Corpus Techs are equipped with weapons that have a high rate of fire. Stay on the move and weave around obstacles to evade their attacks, or roll to reduce damage taken by 75%
Abilities like Mag's Pull or the Vazarin Focus School's Void Snare can group enemies up tightly. Consider using a Weapon with Punch Through to make even better use of these abilities.
The Madurai Focus School increases the damage potential of Operator and Warframe in a variety of ways. Consider Madurai to take your offense tactics to another level.

The Naramon Focus School excels in and amplifies Melee combat while incapacitating enemies, leaving them vulnerable to deadly follow-up attacks. Consider Naramon for an up close and personal approach.
Unlocking Focus School Way-Bound passives allow you to use them across any active Focus School.
The Unairu Focus School prioritizes defenses by bolstering your own and stripping enemies of theirs. Consider Unairu for a balance between an offensive and defensive approach.
Eidolon Shards can be converted into Focus Points beyond the daily maximum by using the "Focus Conversion" option in a selected Focus Tree.

Focus Convergence Orbs massively increase Focus Points earned for a limited time and earn you a bonus 5,000 Focus for your equipped Focus School upon pickup! Cephalon Simaris guarantees a Focus Convergence Orb at the start of every Sanctuary Onslaught wave after the first.

Corpus Candidates can spawn after the completion of The War Within and Call of the Tempestarii Quests. Offer a Zenith Granum Crown to enter the Granum Void and reach Rank 1 to spawn a Candidate. Downing a Candidate shows a preview of the Tenet Weapon that the created Sister of Parvos will reward you. Finish the Candidate to spawn your Sister!

Missions on nodes that are under the Influence of your Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos will be subject to a Reward Tax. All of your stolen rewards will be returned to you upon Vanquishing or Converting your foe.
Whether you defeat Kuva Thralls and Liches on your own Lich's nodes of influence, or on a separate planet with a friend, you will still earn Requiem Murmur progress.
Railjack missions are designed for everyone to take on a different role. Be the pilot, gunner, engineer, or even go board enemy ships! Unlock your own Railjack by completing the Rising Tide quest.

Open Landscape areas such as The Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis, and Cambion Drift contain Bounties that give rewards for each Stage completed. Complete the bonus objective in the Bounty Stage to receive an extra reward!
Ores and Gems are acquired via mining. Various mining tools can be acquired from Old Man Suumbat in Cetus and Smokefinger in Fortuna to drill into resource deposits found around the Open Landscapes.

Conserve Wildlife in Open Landscapes by purchasing specialized gear from The Business, Master Teasonai, or Son. Use your Tranq Rifle to subdue the animal and earn Tags. The sneakier your capture, the more Tags you'll earn.

Fish can be caught in various lakes, rivers, and oceans in Open Landscapes. Visit any of their Hubs to acquire specialized spears from the designated fishing vendor. Once you have a catch, you can have Vendors cut it up for resources, turn it into a Trophy, or even provide it for Standing.
There are many secrets hidden within the Origin System, progress through Quests to uncover and access new nodes and locations!
Grappling Hook attacks can be countered quickly by cutting the rope, or rolling / bullet jumping to pull your foe towards you. Act fast, Tenno!
Citrine and her signature weapons, Steflos and Corufell, can be obtained from the Tyana Pass Node on Mars, which is unlocked after completing the Heart of Deimos quest.

Mastery Rank 30 and above players can activate their True Master's Font blessing in a Relay once every 24 hours. There are a variety of Blessings to choose from to bestow onto all players in that Relay instance.
In order to Rank up with a Syndicate and unlock more offerings for purchase you must reach the maximum possible amount of Standing for the current Rank and sacrifice the requested items.

Syndicate Medallions can be found throughout Syndicate Alert missions and can be traded in for Standing in Relays. Standing from Syndicate Medallions and Alerts can be redeemed even if you have hit your daily cap.
Many Warframes can be acquired via Assassination missions. Once you have earned the individual Blueprints, they can be completed in your Foundry!
Your Parazon is upgradable with Mods that can benefit both hacking and Mercy kills.
Add an Aura Mod to your Warframe or a Stance Mod to your Melee Weapon to increase their Mod capacity. Matching Polarities doubles the amount!

Exilus Warframe Adapters unlock an additional Mod slot where you can equip Exilus Mods on your Warframe. You can obtain blueprints from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays or purchase them fully-built with Platinum from the in-game Market.

Exilus Weapon Adapters unlock an additional Mod slot where you can equip Exilus Mods on your Primary or Secondary weapon. You can obtain blueprints from Syndicates and Requiem Relics, or purchase them fully-built with Platinum from the in-game Market.

Your equipped Warframe (The Progenitor) used when creating a Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos impacts abilities your foe will have. The Element type of their Tenet or Kuva Weapon is determined by the Progenitor Warframe as well!
Grineer Drahk Masters can disarm you. If they’ve relieved you of your weapon in battle, look for the yellow marker to recover it.
Punch Through allows a projectile to travel through an obstacle to hit an enemy. Try using it to hit enemies crouching behind cover or using shields!
Keep an eye out for Ghoul Purge, Thermia Fractures, Fomorian Sabotage, and Razorback Armada events in the Star Chart. They appear periodically for a short time and have their own unique rewards!

Travel quickly through the Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis, and Cambion Drift by using Blinkpads! Teleport between locations by interacting with a Blinkpad or opening your map and selecting a Blinkpad location.

Nora Night presents daily, weekly, and elite weekly Acts for Nightwave. Complete Acts to increase your Nightwave Rank and obtain rewards, including Nightwave Creds used to to purchase goods from the Cred Offerings store.

Orbiters can be decorated! Access full customization via the Orbiter category in your Equipment Menu. Avid decorators should try out the Advanced Mode in the Decoration screen for even more placement and positioning options.
Clan Dojos are home to research labs which contain blueprints for Weapons, Warframes, and more! Build Labs in your Clan Dojo to see what research is available.

Earn Clan Affinity by completing research and first-time builds for specific rooms or decorations. Build an Ascension Altar to perform an Ascension Ceremony for ranking up the Clan after obtaining enough Clan Affinity.
Ascension Ceremonies in a Clan Dojo last for 72 hours. Clan members who visit during this time can claim Endo by interacting with the Ascension Altar.

Change the appearance of rooms in your Clan Dojo using Polychromes. You can research colors for Polychromes in the back of the Tenno Lab. Hunt down specific enemies to collect pigments to contribute to a specific color's research.
Somachord tones can be found on all over the Origin System once you have unlocked your Personal Quarters. Scanning Somachord tones unlocks songs that can be played via the Somachord in your Orbiter.
Oxium Ospreys have a guaranteed drop of Oxium when destroyed. They are also capable of self-destructing and will leave nothing behind if they do, so attack them quickly!

Hijack objectives draw power from your Shields, or directly from your Health for shieldless Warframes like Nidus or Inaros. Bring a loadout with a high Shield Capacity or use Squad Shield Restores to power the objective for longer.

Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relays to be given a Synthesis Target. Search for them in missions where that enemy type spawns. Successful Scans earn you and allies within Affinity Range Standing with Cephalon Simaris. Talk to Cephalon Simaris after completing all scans for further rewards.
Obtain parts to build your own K-Drive from the Ventkids in Fortuna. Built K-Drives can have Mods installed to improve tricks, combat, and mobility!

Create your own Modular Weapons such as Amps, Kitguns, and Zaws by purchasing components from Vendors in Cetus, Fortuna, and the Necralisk. Combine various components to build a weapon that is truly your own!
Riven Mods are specialized Mods that offer randomized Stats for a specific Weapon. Stats can be re-rolled using Kuva until you find a combination of your liking.
If an Interception point is being captured by an enemy, look for nearby enemies hacking terminals. Knocking down or eliminating these enemies can stop the capture.
The Circulus and Yuvarium Nodes on Lua are Conjunction Survival missions, which can reward blueprints and components for Voruna and her signature weapons, Perigale and Sarofang.

Use the Helminth to replace one of your Warframe's abilities, access Invigorations, or install Archon Shards! The Helminth can be unlocked with a Helminth Segment, obtainable from Son in The Necralisk or from the in-game Market with Platinum.
Rolling into Corpus defense grid lasers will let you avoid being knocked down if timed perfectly!

Eximus units have an additional defense mechanism called Overguard, granting them a unique Health buffer (indicated by the teal effect around their health bar) and granting immunity to Crowd Control effects until destroyed. Look out for their bright Auras which indicate their Eximus type and ability.
Companions will become incapacitated when they run out of health, resting until they are ready to return to battle. Some can even be revived by you and your allies to accelerate their return!
Each Companion has its own Precept Mods which provides them with their own unique abilities. Earn new Companions to gain more options to tackle different challenges.

Equip your weapons with Elemental Mods to grant them Heat, Cold, Electricity, or Toxin damage. These elements can also be combined together with a weapon's base Elemental Damage or with other Elemental Mods to create entirely new damage types!

Ayatan Sculptures can be found randomly hidden around mission maps, while Ayatan Stars can be found in containers and lockers. Speak to Maroo in her Bazaar on Mars once a week for an Ayatan Treasure Hunt with a guaranteed Ayatan Sculpture to retrieve!

Upgrade Ayatan Sculptures with Ayatan Stars using the Ayatan Sculpture category found in the Mod Segment in your Orbiter. They can be exchanged with Maroo in her Bazaar on Mars for Endo, traded with other players, or used as a decoration in your Orbiter or Clan Dojo.
There are many Quests to complete with an abundance of rewards including unique Warframes, Weapons, and Missions. To see all Quests and their requirements, check out the Quest section in the Codex.
There are different breeds of Kubrow, Kavat, Predasite, and Vulpaphyla -- each with their own Precept Mods, which provide unique abilities to the Companion!
The Duviri Paradox Quest is available to all players, new and experienced! Start your journey through Duviri by beginning the Quest via the Codex.

Kuva Larvlings can spawn in missions with Grineer over level 20 after completing The War Within. Downing a Larvling shows a preview of the Kuva Weapon that the created Kuva Lich will reward you. Finish the Larvling to spawn your Lich!
Just short of your next Mastery Rank? Check out the Market for new blueprints and weapons, available for Credits!
Customize your HUD colors, enemy and ally highlighting, enable subtitles, and more in the Accessibility Options.
Warframes gain a brief period of invulnerability when their shields expire. The more shields you have upon Shield Break, the longer the invulnerability!
Hover over Equipment's stats in the Arsenal to learn more about that stat's function. Stats marked with a diamond have secondary stats which appear on hover.
Ammo Mutation Mods convert a portion of the Primary, Secondary, and Heavy ammo pickups into the type noted on the Mod.
Increase the speed of slow-firing weapons with Fire Rate Mods such as Speed Trigger.
Some Warframe abilities can buff you and your allies. Try using Volt's Speed or Valkyr's Warcry near allies to give them the effects too!
Reload your weapons whenever you are on the move to prepare you for the next encounter.
Be careful how close you are to your enemy when you fire an explosive! <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage will stagger or even knock you down if you are too close to the detonation.
Roll or backflip to shake off enemies that attach to your Warframe, such as Latchers or Maggots.
Scanning an unalerted enemy with your Codex Scanner will yield 2 Codex Scans.
Void Death Orbs favor Prime Warframes and will grant a one-time burst of Energy when approached.
Warframes have 4 Revives per mission. Equipping a Rank 3 or higher Warframe Arcane grants an additional Revive up to a total of 6 per mission.

Argon Crystals begin decaying 24 hours after from when you acquire them and each day at GMT 00:00. Use them to craft items that require them as soon as possible before they disappear from your inventory.
Completing a Codex Entry unlocks information about an enemy's strengths, weaknesses, and other valuable information. Get the edge over your opponents by scanning often.
Assassination Missions offer a higher drop chance of rare resources as well as unique blueprints as reward when you kill your target.
Increase the amount of Mods you can equip on a Warframe or Weapon by upgrading it with an Orokin Reactor or Catalyst to double its Modding Capacity.
Enemies can still hear the sound of your guns when you're invisible. They will return fire based on the sound's location. Try using a silent weapon or noise reducing Mods to avoid drawing attention.
Mark rare Resources, Ayatan Sculptures, Kurias, or anything interesting with your "Place Marker" binding to inform teammates of their location.
If you receive a transmission from an Assassin like Stalker while in-mission, mark your position or group up with your squad to take them on together.

Stay within 50 meters of your squadmates and objectives for maximum Affinity sharing. The number of Tenno within your Affinity Range is indicated by the number underneath the Affinity icon <AFFINITY_SHARE> in your HUD.
Use the Recruiting Chat Channel or switch your Matchmaking to Public to find a squad that can help you tackle missions.
Trade with your fellow Tenno at a Trading Post in a Clan Dojo or by visiting Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.
Multiple Tenno can revive a squadmate or Ally at the same time for a speedier recovery.
You can crawl to cover while bleeding out! Move to a spot where your squad can revive you safely.
Aura Mod effects stack across squadmates. Coordinate Loadouts with your squad for maximum results. Aura Mods equipped by your squad can be seen by hovering over their name in the pause Menu.

Death Marks can be found on your Profile in-game. Squading up with Tenno with the same Mark will yield you a higher chance of the Assassin spawning. Players can also summon any Assassin with the use of their Beacon in-mission.

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM:
MNEMONIC ADJUTANT
Memory is meaning.

Train yourself to replay your experiences in your mind, as if you were attuned to an Ayatan framework. You will soon find that you are able to disengage the experience from its emotional context. Even in the case of intense, troubling emotions, familiarity can bring habituation and thus, objectivity.

QUADRA TABULATOR
As it alternates between displays, this apparatus reminds us of the importance of shifting perspective. 

A child in the nursery cries because a monstrous face is leering at him, but all he has to do is shift his perspective, and he sees it was nothing but a heap of clothes. We may think we are in eternal love. Oh, how quickly we find it was nothing of the sort!

PROXIMAL VITALIZER
Through contact, energy is transferred.

Learn the ways in which your mind instinctively associates an emotion with a phenomenon, based on prior experience. Once you are adept at this, you will recognize when emotions are arising because of prior association, rather than because they have any business doing so.

SPECTRAL TABULATOR
Apply the lessons of this device in your analysis of your emotional states.

When turbulent emotions assail you, focus on the details. Learn to identify the discrete elements of your experience. In this way you will find the hidden order in the midst of your personal chaos, just as a prism discovers the hidden colors in white light.

OMNIPOTENTIAL SCREEN
Wise is the eye that closes without thought, upon sight of the blinding Sun.

It is sometimes necessary simply to close yourself off from an emotion and process it later. Like a scientist placing a specimen into a container, lock your emotion away. If necessary, place something between you and the emotion - an activity, a mantra, even sleep.

DATUM AGGREGATOR
We are all receptacles of data.

In time, your life experiences will make you into a complete person, a worthy servant of the Orokin Empire. But they can only do this if you accept them, incorporating them into your psyche. To divide parts of yourself off is to be a nation at war with itself.

GYROTIC TRANSFORMER
All entities contain fathomless power of which they are ignorant.

There is not one emotion that you cannot use positively, given sufficient discipline. Anger can drive you. Fear can make you alert. Even guilt is useful, for it proves you have failed to live up to your own moral standards. Practice listening to your emotions and putting them to use. You are the master, not they.

OBLIVIATING ENTANGLEMENT
The hollow ruin, though death for the soldier, is life for the creeping ivy.

Strange though it may seem, the mind's tendency to forget is not necessarily a weakness. The body has its excretory system, whereby we dispose of what we do not need; so too does the mind. Allow yourself to forget that which is useless to your emotional development.

Among the dead

You added to the world
By taking from it

Qig. Thief. 
Fed to the Cyst.

Vana. Heard the song

Chattering

Died

Of the Lorn shrines

Haunted to her death

Escaped in the night
With Scholar's Landing

Remembered here

Pol
Lingered too long
In Stitcher's Gulch

Returned to us
Bound
Within himself

Brooks no beholding

She surrendered her eyes
In the wake of her mind.

Velkk
A joy to all.

The best of us.

Persuading the Zariman's own resident archivist to allow me access to your residence was not easy. A fearsome entity called Melica, she insisted I needed a ‘pass' prepared by my ‘teacher'.

In case we have not already spoken: I am Acrithis, archivist of Duviri. And I believe I know who you are. Better, perhaps, than you do.

As a token of trust, I enclose this curious blueprint. The blades are modelled on Master Teshin's, but weighted for Warframe use. Clearly they are meant for you.

Acrithis

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AncientTankDesc: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AristocratManage: One of Parvos' favored, keeper of the tokens of his esteem.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloFollowerDesc: Touched by the hand of Arlo they come to spread his healing word. Rejoice.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotDualSw: Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the ‘message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotGunDes: This Zealot targets potential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotSwordD: From Arlo the promise of a new life, a new form and a new word: death.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AscensionCannonM: Launches slow-moving, high-charged orbs of electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyDesc: A bird of prey that feeds on fish and kuakas.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyScaven: This species of Condroc survives by scavenging from carcasses found on the plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BrachCarrierDesc: Sentient servitors ejected from an Orphix, these entities boost their master's pulse field by placing Serenex Resonators.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAHeavyDesc: Ved Xol was nominated to become the head of the Loan Reclamation Division at Anyo Corp. after demonstrating ruthless aptitude within The Index. He has obtained favorable results with his team on many occasions, and is a firm favorite amongst corporate backers.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamARifleDesc: The younger brother of Ved Xol displayed no aptitude for business. Instead, his enthusiasm for violence and conflict have helped him quickly climb corporate ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamASkateDesc: Pelna Cade is a skilled technician who graduated with the Xol brothers. Remaining close friends with the family following their military service together, he now works for them to keep the robotics in their service in peak condition.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAZanukaDes: The Loan Reclamation Division worked closely with Alad V on several ventures during his tenure on the Corpus Board of Directors. Despite his involuntary retirement, it is speculated that the Xol Brothers still undertake assignments on his behalf. These robots, based on Alad V's own patented designs were delivered as payment for services rendered and only serve to strengthen such suspicions.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBDisruptor: A young and ambitious Anyo Corp. employee, Jad has demonstrated remarkable aptitude for micromanaging machinery. He was promoted to the Robotic Technology Division where he leads the design of new robotics to be utilized by other divisions of Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBHyenaDesc: Affectionately known as "Azoth" the Hyena Hg is the latest version of Hyena to be produced at Anyo Corp. This model has been optimized to process Index Points with lethal efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBOspreyDes: The Index marks the debut of the X-series of the Raptor. This version of armored Osprey doubles as both a mobile accounting system and security detail for the brokers employed by Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBRiotMoaDe: A heavily modified model of Denial Bursas, designed for the secure transferral of offline funds. This armored robot protects the financial interests of Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCDeception: Jen specialises in corporate espionage and uses the information she gathers to facilitate sudden downturns for her opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCHackerDes: A digital virtuoso, Derim is a capable hacker who applies his trade laundering funds traded through The Index.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCMoaDesc: The Multi-Weapon Assault Moa is equipped with a number of weapons to assist the brokers employed by Zenith Galactical with their endeavors.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCStealthDe: Tia supports her allies by providing them with effective exit strategies when a deal takes a turn for the worse. These strategies often leave the other party with significant medical fees.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterADe: As the Chief Officer of the Investor Relations department, Armis pressures investors into accepting Nef Anyo's invitation to The Index. He's also adept at leveraging investor debt to make maximum profit for Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterBDe: A senior Analysts, Dru addresses all complaints received from colonists in person - with a high-grade, rubedo-lined laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterCDe: More than just a broker, Rana is a hostile customer relations specialist. When Investors refuse to pay their debts, they can look forward to a visit from her.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDOspreyDes: Designed to execute the 002 Eradication Protocol, this Osprey identifies high-risk brokers and administers injury.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CarrusPilotDesc: A specialist in synthetic metallurgy protected by a large shield wall. This Corpus Tech brandishes a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration. Summons a Mine Osprey.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistChargerD: Spawned the body of a creature killed by infested, these charges are fast with weak claw attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistDesc: Many generations ago, in search of a life free from the corrupting influence of greed, the Mycona split from the Corpus. Life was difficult for the new colony, but they proved resourceful by surviving where no one thought possible, among the Infestation. Now, they earn their living harvesting the biological products of the Infested and trading with outsiders. Contact with Mycona is limited, but those that trade with them speak of a strange force capable of pacifying the otherwise ravenous Infested horde. The Myconians call this force, the Triuna.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorpusEliteShiel: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedBeastMa: He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedCombatK: The Orokin Neural Sentry commands this beast now.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedPowerCa: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CrpInterrupterDe: Using the latest in Corpus weapons technology, this Crewman absorbs damage, until it unleashes it all in a powerful shockwave. The Derivator unit is mounted on the back.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CryoDiscDroneDes: Energy Orb pulses AoE Cold Damage after detonation
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DisruptionDemoli: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipAmbulasD: Reinforced Condor used to transport elite personnel into conflict zone.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipCorpusDe: Aerial transport that delivers Corpus Reinforcements to strategic locations.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipGrineerD: In and out under extreme duress, the Firbolg handles lightning-fast infiltrations/extractions and lazy picket duty with equal aplomb.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAlarmDron: Identifies potential threats and calls in reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoMorta: A long-range battery that fires destructive ordnance.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoTurre: Fires armor-shattering shells at a rapid rate.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonGrineerBo: Retrofitted for Plains operations, the Tusk-variant Ogma IDs targets at range, hammers out missile volleys on approach and finishes the job with a rain of explosives.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonMortarBom: This Bombard's portable, back-mounted mortar allows the Grineer to rain destruction anywhere on the plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonSkiffPilo: Hardy and quick-thinking, as formidable outside his Dargyn as in.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntD: One of the faceless Grineer ranks.
Fires a devastating heat ray and self destructs.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntL: Born in a tube, raised among numberless thousands, the typical Grineer trooper dies forgotten. A copy of a copy of a copy, they may not be the pinnacle of evolution but what they lack in intelligence they make up for in numbers. Occasionally, however, one genetic aberration will prove itself to be superior, and elevated to the rank of Commander.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotD: A rugged career pilot, bred to survive on the Plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotL: Aerial Commanders share a bond with their machines: equal parts mechanic, driver and soldier. For fast deployment and quick eradication of hostiles, a Skiff team can execute a three-angle assault, raining down hellfire before the enemy knows they're dead.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSkiffD: Armed with a high-velocity rapid-fire cannon, this armored skiff tears up targets and terrain alike.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSniper: Agile and quick-witted, as patient as she is cunning.

The most difficult thing a Grineer sniper will ever have to survive... is testing. With a 98% mortality rate, those that make it through go on to become some of the most feared units in the Grineer forces. The Recon Commander is the cream of this elite batch.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVomvalyst: A Grineer device meant to lure in Vomvalyst and trap their energy.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EliteShieldLance: Carries an impenetrable shield and fires grenades.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ForestRodentScav: This species of Kuaka likes to decorate its nest with debris and oddities.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerBigDropsh: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerADe: Oversees the tasks performed by other drudges.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerBDe: Proficient with tools used for smelting.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerCDe: Proficient with tools used for grinding.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeD: The Worm Queen's early presence aboard the Zariman has aided her troops' defenses. Through Reliquary tampering, The Worm Queen has bestowed these troopers with a miniature Kuva Trokar to disrupt transference.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeL: These Lances emit an aura that interrupts transference and is only vulnerable to Void Damage. Given to the Kuva Trokarians by the Worm Queen herself.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfectedProtecto: Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfestedJetpackD: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InterferenceDron: Thwarts enemy scans with advanced signal jamming hardware.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/JetpackHeavyMari: Highly mobile and heavily armored, this unit spreads mayhem with his modified Tonkor.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuakaForestRoden: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaBailiffDesc: The finest Bailiff clones are chosen to serve in the Queen’s Fortress.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaLarvlingDesc: Spiked with "The Old Blood". This Larvling seeks death by Tenno, and rebirth as a Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/MicroHyenaDesc: Compact robots that hunt with relentless zeal.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBailif: Swings a Jat Kittag as he runs down his foes.

A Terrible Threat - and a Tremendous Opportunity

The Murmur continues to scrape deeper into our realm of existence. Having devised a solution to detect such whispers, Fibonacci won't allow such trespassing to threaten our system.

This Operation relies on Tenno across the Origin System to construct an invisible ‘living defense' against the growing Murmur threat. Players must have completed the Whispers in the Walls Quest to participate!

How to play:

To join this living defense, or ‘Murmur Telemetry Chorus,' you must hunt down the power source that'll continuously power your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle.

1. Go to your Dojo and build the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle from your Dojo Decorations. Only one Gargoyle can be built per Dojo, so if you don't see it in your Decoration list, your Clan Members may have already placed it!

2. Play Effervo on Deimos to earn Operation rewards. Players must successfully defeat both the Void Angel and the Assassination Target in-mission to earn one of the following:
  • Curse of Knowing (The Fragmented Suzerain)
  • Curse of Seeing (The Fragmented Anchorite)
  • Curse of Hearing (The Fragmented Zelator)

Earn 1 Curse per Normal Path mission, or double of the same Curse on Steel Path.

Successfully defeating the Assassination Target also rewards Grotesque Splinters. 

3. Return to your Dojo and feed the Curses to your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle every week to contribute to a Clan Trophy. Contribute Curses each week to hit the Cap and improve your Clan Scoring -- resulting in better Trophies at the end!

4. Visit the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle to exchange Grotesque Splinters for various Operation rewards!
Complete the Whispers in the Walls quest to learn more.

It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
Albrecht Entrati was unsure whether this awkward composite was the result of the Indifference’s incomplete understanding of human anatomy, or an attempt at creative rearrangement thereof.

Executor Ballas has now manipulated The Lotus for his own ends, compelling her to resume her Sentient identity, NATAH, in order to use her as proxy commander of the Sentient forces.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas has led the Sentients in a renewed attack on the Origin System. ERRA, the brother of Natah, is acting as joint commander. 

The factions of the Origin System have formed an alliance against this common foe.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno’s personal timeline has been disrupted. Knowing he cannot kill the Tenno, Ballas has opted to imprison them within their own history. The Tenno will be unable to escape this loop without the paradoxical intervention of an outside force.

Continuing to monitor.

The Zariman vessel, adrift for an unknown time within the Void, now acts as a containment field for unrealized possibilities.

One such possibility is an alternate version of the TENNO. This individual escaped into the Void on their own initiative, rather than being rescued and taken into the Origin System as the Tenno were. Within the Void they established a realm, ‘Duviri’, in which to live.

This individual, the DRIFTER, has now entered the Origin System.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas has established himself as ruler of the Origin System. 

Through his ‘Narmer’ cult, all citizens have been forced to wear headpieces that distort perceived reality. Ballas is thus able to dictate exactly what the wearer experiences.

Erra continues to act as Ballas’s enforcer, using composite creatures called ARCHONS as muscle.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

With the assistance of Hunhow and the Stalker, the Drifter has fought back against Ballas, destroying the Archons.

The Tenno has been freed from their recursive timeline and now coexists with the Drifter. 

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas is dead. The Lotus, now free from Ballas’s conditioning, has chosen a preferred primary name and form.

Continuing to monitor.

** CRITICAL DEVELOPMENT **

In a deranged attempt to transport himself and his cult to Tau, Ballas opened portals between the Void and conventional reality on an unprecedented scale. 

This has attracted the attention of THE INDIFFERENCE, whose freedom of action appears to have drastically increased.

The threat posed by THE INDIFFERENCE is now at a critical level.

The Laboratories have come under fresh assault from the Murmur. Unless the Sleeper is awoken, Albrecht Entrati’s legacy will perish.

** CONCLUSION **

Contacting The Necraloid.

Activating the Kalymos Sequence.

Awaiting the Chosen Operator.

The Laboratories are sealed.

Our task: watch for the chosen OPERATOR.

** KNOWN DATA **

- The Operator is a TENNO.

- A TENNO was a specialist warrior in service to the Orokin, the masters of the Origin System.

- The TENNO piloted WARFRAMES, suits of sophisticated battle armor.

- They fought alongside the DAX, augmented human warriors who were more numerous and less effective than the Tenno.

- TENNO existed to battle the SENTIENTS, evolving machines hostile to the Orokin and their way of life.

** COMPLICATIONS **

- The Orokin Empire fell. Only artifacts remain.

- The war with the Sentients, the ‘Old War’, is long over.

- No Tenno have been seen for generations.

** Conclusion **

Watch. Wait. Report.

A suitable Tenno candidate has been found.

The reawakened Tenno is being guided by THE LOTUS, the same entity who led the Tenno at the end of the Old War. 

THE LOTUS is known to be a former SENTIENT previously named NATAH. She was captured and converted to her current state during the Old War by EXECUTOR BALLAS, a high-ranking Orokin. 

EXECUTOR BALLAS is theorized to have modeled the appearance and persona of THE LOTUS upon his deceased lover MARGULIS, an Archimedean scientist executed for her devotion to the Tenno.

THE LOTUS appears to be just as devoted to the Tenno as Margulis was. She has not, however, divulged the secret of her Sentient origin to them.

Continuing to monitor.

Tenno candidate has engaged with several hostile forces. 

The GRINEER are degraded descendants of the cloned worker force that once served the Orokin. They are brutal combatants concerned only with the amassing of power and territory. Left unchecked, they slaughter, enslave and plunder civilians.

The CORPUS are a merchant cult devoted to profit. They make extensive use of robotics. They exploit civilians economically and violently protect their ‘investments’.

The INFESTATION is a biomechanical plague, apparently controlled by one or more hive minds. It corrupts organic and mechanical targets, converting them into mutated servants. 

Continuing to monitor.

The Tenno has discovered abandoned Orokin towers within The Void. These towers were intended to act as sanctuaries from Sentient attack during the Old War, since the Void is intensely damaging to Sentients.

** SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION **

Much of Orokin society was dependent upon the Void. It was used as a shortcut through space and as a source of energy. Its full potential was first theorized by Albrecht Entrati within these very laboratories.

It is Albrecht Entrati whom this device serves.

It is Albrecht Entrati who has instructed us to locate the chosen Operator.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno has encountered the Entrati Family on Deimos. The Family remains unaware of the existence of these laboratories. The Necraloid is an exception. Its memory is, however, suppressed until the activation of the Kalymos Sequence.

Continuing to monitor.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno subject has learned of the Lotus’s Sentient nature, including her original name, NATAH. 

A Dax, TESHIN, has presented himself as a rival mentor, claiming that the Lotus cannot be trusted.

The Tenno has encountered Natah’s ‘father’, the Sentient war-leader HUNHOW, whose remains lie beneath the oceans of Uranus. HUNHOW had expected Natah to destroy the Tenno in accordance with her original mandate.

The Lotus continues to reject her Sentient nature and seems concerned to retain the Tenno’s trust.

Continuing to monitor.

Since awakening, the Tenno has been pursued by THE STALKER. 

Appearance and combat capability suggest THE STALKER is a surviving Low Guardian, a former protector of the Orokin.

Evidence implies that the Orokin Empire fell at the hands of the Tenno themselves. THE STALKER’s motive may therefore be revenge.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

HUNHOW and THE STALKER are working together. THE STALKER has been sent to find THE RESERVOIR, a place believed to conceal the Tenno’s gravest secret, and which could be used to destroy them all at a stroke.

The Tenno has set off in pursuit, aided by the Corpus technocrat Alad V.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Reservoir has been located. It is on the moon, ‘Lua’, previously believed destroyed, but in fact concealed within the Void.

Continuing to monitor.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno has discovered the truth of their identity. They are a human child, one of many kept within Cryopods on Lua in the Reservoir.

These children were passengers on the Zariman Ten-Zero, the colony ship bound for Tau and lost to the Void. When recovered, they were found to have developed parahuman abilities.

Despite Margulis’s protests, they were placed into a state of lucid dreaming and used as Warframe pilots.

Continuing to monitor.

The Tenno has encountered the Grineer Queens, the semi-mythical leaders of the Grineer.

The Elder Queen, aged and diseased, had planned to transfer her mind into the Tenno’s young body. This process, ‘Continuity’, was common among the Orokin Elites and was used to extend their lifespans indefinitely.

Teshin Dax helped the Tenno to resist the Elder Queen, who has now been eliminated. Only the younger ‘Worm Queen’ remains.

The Tenno has recovered much of their lost training. Suitability to fulfill the role of CHOSEN OPERATOR has exponentially increased.

Continuing to monitor.

The Tenno has been made aware of Rell, a fellow Tenno who was outcast by his peers.

Rell had voluntarily assumed the duty of keeping the Origin System safe from a Void-based entity referred to as ‘The Man In The Wall’.

With Rell’s death, that responsibility has now transferred to the Tenno.

** CRITICAL DEVELOPMENT **

‘The Man in the Wall’ is identical with the entity known to us as ‘The Indifference’.

Albrecht Entrati is ultimately responsible for attracting its attention to the Origin System.

Albrecht Entrati may be ultimately responsible for its existence.

Parameter confirmed. The Tenno is the Chosen Operator. We await the correct moment to activate the Kalymos Sequence.

Continuing to monitor.

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2022Ms:
|PLAYER_NAME|

My child, nine cycles ago I called for the first of you to wake and restore balance in The Origin System. 

You have been through so much since then. You forged friendships and alliances. Watched evil rise and fall, and rise again. 

There have been dark times where my voice could not reach you, and yet you fought on, undeterred by fear. Unrelenting in your quest to bring order and peace to the Origin System.

Take this Wisp Dex Skin as my gift to you. Use it as we move into the future together.

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2023Ms:
|PLAYER_NAME|

My child, ten cycles have passed since I awoke the first of you to become the Origin System's guardians.

You have been valiant both in the outer battle and in the inner, standing fast against tyranny and greed, while uncovering the mystery of your true nature.

I shall be by your side as you prepare to confront a new danger. A shadow from the past, entangled with the roots of your Tenno power.

Take this Dex Suit as an adornment for your true selves. For like me, you are more than one.

|LOTUS_NAME|
Gifts of the Lotus - Your 10th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2024Ms:
|PLAYER_NAME|

This message marks the 11th Earth cycle that has passed since I called the first of you to wake.

To honor this milestone, allow me to bestow this Dex Nikana upon you.

Tenno, for all these years your fight has been relentless. Yet, our enemies are unceasing in their brutality. Their strength only grows.

Your strength must also grow.

Throughout the coming days and weeks, I will alert you to items that have been taken by our foes. They are yours, by right. Recover them and become even stronger.

These too, are my gifts to you.

|LOTUS_NAME|

The Earth has circled Sol twelve times since I first called you to wake, and The Origin System needs you now more than ever.

In commemoration, I give you this Dex Laurus Ephemera. Wear it with pride.

To ready you for what lies ahead, I am scanning the system for Tenno gear stolen by our enemies. Respond to Alerts to recover these items.

Look out for each other, Tenno.

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip: OpLink Reinforcements can be purchased to heal active OpLinks in the Flotilla.
Longer Missions give more Scarlet Credits for each Condrix or Murex defeated.
Defeat all Murex in your Flotilla Wave for bonus Scarlet Credits!
Earn 3 ranks of Murex or Condrix Emblems by reaching accumulated points for your Flotilla.
Operation Emblems can be earned by collecting 10, 30, or 50 thousand cumulative points.

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTut:
1. Welcome to Operation Scarlet Spear. Your Operation begins with you running missions for your Flotilla.
2. Fight in Space (Murex Raid) or on Ground (Ground Assault). Check the Flotilla to see where firepower is needed!
3. Ground Assaults are needed to send Kill Codes. Murex Raids are needed to Receive Kill Codes and drive Murex away.
4. Ground Assaults require you to fight Condrix and Sentients off in waves and use your OpLink to scan the wounded Condrix.
5. Murex Raids require you to receive enough Kill Codes via Oplink to drive away the Murex.
6. Every Kill Code sent (Earth) and received (Space) gives you Scarlet Credits. The longer you stay in one mission, the more Scarlet Credits you earn per Kill Code.
7. Your OpLink health is not restored between stages. Once destroyed, it cannot be deployed again in that mission.
8. The Flotilla shows how many Murex have been driven away, up to a max of 100 per Wave. After this, you receive bonus Scarlet Credits based on your score for that finished Flotilla.
9. Every Murex Wave gives you an opportunity to rally and earn points, and Scarlet Credits - whether playing alone or in a Squad, work together!

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.

Too craven to chase death, I awaited it. The father of fears, and yet I was still afraid. 

The currents whispered coward. I clenched my body into a fist as a foetus must and blinded myself afresh.
 
Stark pain smoked the juice of my living tomb. Why did the saga not end by itself? Why must I still act?

Steeped in solitude, I found I could no longer endure my own company. 

Disgust did the work of courage. I tore the mundane membrane, slid weak and mucosal into Loid's embrace.

Loid nursed me then, tending first to the uprooted ruin of my eyes, then to the mouth whose grin no longer hid behind flesh. 

The agony bit deep, but it was clean. Blameless love bled up from me. 

I had decided to live.

I felt no certainty as I donned clothes rough and strange to the touch of newgrown skin. I had none of the selfless zeal of the soldier. 

The same cursed question still pursued me as it had before: was I, even now, trapped in the rictus of the Wall?

The apparatus of logic would never yield an answer. Only resolute action remained. If I must be a demon, let me be an honest one. Let me prove my nature by what I do next. 

Purpose. Let me leave such blazing footprints behind me as no unclean thing would dare to walk in.
Albrecht's Notes - The Aftermath

I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.

The majority of the Cavia merely died. I gave the Void living beings and it sent me back bedraggled cadavers. The dead lay stacked in pyramids around my deserted lab. I was nothing but a failed priest.

But a glass splinter of stubbornness still stuck in me. And so, I persisted. The correct combination of creatures would work.

I realized my error as I sweated by visionary nestawood cinders, beside Loid who curled pale and sick from chewing too much of the root. The catalyst was uniqueness. That attribute was what caught the interest of the bland and undifferentiated Void. 

It was not necessary to explore queasy debates about the Oro; animal minds simply lacked the full distinction of a singular persona. My Kalymos, I was sure, was an exception, but I would not sacrifice that loyal being.

Perhaps I should have. The sin I was to commit was worse.

The very last breeding pair of Cervulites was smuggled to me, causing Loid no small inconvenience. A species on the brink of extinction. Here was the uniqueness the Void sought. I was certain to the pit of my entrails.

I loaded the pair on to their Seriglass bridal barge, along with an expendable avian and a Norg for mental ballast. Fish, fowl and beast. A facile equilibrium.

They did not die, save one. They came back changed. Witnesses. Pilgrims, even, chanting freakish praise to the one beyond the wall.

I knew, then, that my gambit had lost. So long as I worked through scapegoats, my guilt would only deepen. I must atone for what I had done through my own blood.

Standard laboratory hygiene would have been to dispose of them. But some instinct stayed my hand. The Voidtongue was an enigma to me, but another - more habituated to the Void than I - might one day unravel it. Through the imposition of form upon the formless they could, perhaps, glean some meaning. 

I assigned the Cavia to Loid, for I could not bear to look upon them. Not yet.

Loid is, at heart, a good and kind man - better than I deserve. And completely oblivious to his own true worth.
Albrecht's Notes - The Cavia

In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.

Despite my legacy of neglect, despite my shoddy example, my needs, my demands, my daughter had triumphed in my absence. Her confidence, her warmth, shamed me. I had fled from the horror, but she? She had stood alongside the most vulnerable, those with the most to lose, and told them a different story.

I did not perceive the significance of Euleria's stance at first. Her concern for the children was not merely pastoral attentiveness. It was a direct strike against the Indifference. She was teaching the weak to be strong in the very places where those cold fingers would reach, and through her act of compassion, spitting in the face of alienation and despair.

Could I do less?

Shame is an inert state, but fertile. It primes the mind, bolstering it for repentance.

I had thought to make a difference in Duviri. But Duviri had made a difference in me. My own daughter's creations, reverberating and growing in the womb of the Void, had shown me another path than that of the indulgent coward. I was neither helpless nor irredeemable. Like she had, I could fight.

I took inspiration from Euleria's example. To the people of Duviri I bequeathed a legacy of cautionary stories. In them I spoke of fears that an infinity of spirals would not, could not, erase.

I slipped away from those lands, silent and unnoticed. From their joys, their sadnesses. From the celebration in my honor. In her, they already had all they needed. My work, I now understood, must proceed from a different point.

I would confront the phantom of myself, and deny it to the teeth.
Albrecht's Notes - Duviri

I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.

Their humanity may not last. My deliverance may yet consume them, the human swallowed up in the sacred beast. And if my wayward disciples turn on me, what words of comfort shall I have beyond: this is the bargain we have made. Through our sacrifice, history will be saved.

As their loyal doctor, I have taken repeated samples from them. The sight of their Technocyte-riddled cells mutating gave me fresh visions. I could take this material, work with it, forge new creations. Eagerly I brought the samples back to Deimos and began to cultivate them.

It was Loid who pointed out the singular attributes of the Grey Strain. How it stimulates growth to monstrous dimensions. Many thoughts converged in me then. What if, through precise biochemical engineering, I could create the equivalents of Warframes, yet built to a titanic scale? Surely such a legion could stand against the Adversary... assuming, of course, that an Operator could be found.

Not long after, the first of my Vessels took form. A giant to battle giants, merging the humanity of the man Arthur, the anatomical perfection of Ballas's Warframes, and the titanic potency of the Grey Strain. My saviors.
Albrecht's Notes - The Vessels

All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.


As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began

Melee and ballistic weapons, inspired by primitive counterparts, became part of the Tenno arsenal to circumvent the Sentient interference of more technologically-involved weaponry.

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Ceres1Desc: Ceres is the extreme example of the Grineer's utilitarian ignorance of the natural landscape. Their expanding shipyard operations pollute and shroud the planet in smog and industrial waste as they manufacture machines of war. These foundries are scattered across the Origin System, giving them near-limitless reach with their fleets.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Citizens1Desc: While the major warring factions combat each other across the Origin System, non-militant organizations and civilian merchants populate the many regional Tenno Relays. Travelling merchant collectors that offer rare goods, mentors that offer training and knowledge, and convictional syndicates that preach their own rituals and doctrine.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Corpus1Desc: Lead by innovatory and elusive industrialists, and claiming to be descendants of Orokin lineage, the Corpus are dedicated to the accumulation of wealth. This elite ruling class operates an insular trade organization using humans and robotics for labour and security, and have been condemned by the Seven as a merchant cult.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusCrew1Des: Predominantly a merchant guild, Corpus labour and security forces are composed mostly of purpose-bred humanoid crewmen, and animal-like robots; both equally indoctrinated into a ritualized and propagandist devotion to labour and work.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
Charity is power. More charity is more power.
Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
