Sprawled on the ground lay a pathetic figure. It was clearly dead, but seemed as if it might start whining again at any moment.

The Queen of Duviri laughed. “I had such a beautiful ending planned for that one. But he saved me the effort.”

“How?” demanded the Orphan.

“He died of a broken heart, waiting for a man who would never come back. A man who was secretly glad to be rid of his whining, clinging presence.”

“But love!” the Orphan cried, feeling their last hope shrivel and die within them. “Surely the power of love…”

The Queen rested her splendid claw on the Orphan's shoulder. A look that might have been pity crossed her face. 

“The forefathers of your forefathers looked into the shining heart of an atom, scribbled their clever equations, and ripped it apart. Did they spare a thought for the age-old love between proton and neutron? Or did they only think of the bountiful energy they could harvest?”

The woman was clearly dead. The Orphan thought at first that she was just another of the dead Duviri people. But she wore no mask, and her body had the usual dull human symmetry and proportions.

“What killed her?” the Orphan asked.

“I did, of course,” answered the Queen of Duviri.

“Why?”

“Why not?”

A strange idea came into the Orphan's mind. The Queen knew at once that the Glory was at work within them, just as it worked within her, but she held her peace.

“She was your mother, wasn't she?”

“As much of a mother as I ever had,” the Queen said. The Glory quickly swallowed down the human weakness that rose in her like bile. “She would be so proud.”

“So… why?”

The Queen shrugged. “Maybe I wanted to find out what it feels like to kill your parents? You kids made it look like fun.”

“Fun,” echoed the Orphan hollowly.

“Baby spiders always eat the mother,” said the Queen with an exquisite grin. “They need to. They wouldn't get strong otherwise. One day you'll learn the lesson, kiddo.”

“The adults turned on us. Did you do that?”

“The parents turned on you,” the Queen corrected them graciously, prompted by the Glory that enveloped her. “The rest of the adults were spared. At first.”

The Orphan snarled up at her. “You can't bear it, can you? Anything good, anything wholesome, even the bond between a parent and child! You corrupt it all!”

“Oh, you think so?”

The Queen led the Orphan to the lonely remains of a human male. The Orphan felt an instinctive pang of sorrow. This cold meat had been a father once. No doubt about it.

The Glory filled the Queen and she spoke. “No parent ever really believes they did a good enough job. Especially this lump. Every bad choice their kids make is a judgement on them. Their love holds them to a standard they can't meet.” 

“Stop.”

“I don't corrupt their love. I don't have to. It was broken when I found it.”

“STOP!”

The Queen took a deep, nostalgic drag on her Efervon inhaler. Lungs that were no longer lungs spasmed in austere delight. 

“The same crack runs through everything, kiddo,” she explained. “You want to deny it, that's on you.”

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty,

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra:
THE FIRST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An envious little girl, who watched as the whole world had more than she did. All the nice things, all the expensive things. And so she took what she didn't have.

And along came a spider who told her that everyone in the world would always have more than she did. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she clung to her favorite toy and filled her life with her family and told the spider to GO! AWAY!

THE SECOND THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A frightened little girl, who ran and hid and was so afraid of everything around her. But most of all, she was afraid to die. 

And along came a spider who told her that everything we love in this world withers and dies. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she hid her fear away in the arms of strangers and told the spider to GO! AWAY!

THE THIRD THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A sad little girl, who watched as the world went wrong. Watched as people fought. As people lied. A sad little girl who watched as her parents grew farther and farther apart.

And along came a spider who told her that everything in the world always ended in sadness. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her. 

But she turned away from the sadness and filled her life with faith and told the spider to GO! AWAY!

THE FOURTH THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A joyful little girl, whose life was filled with meaning and happiness. She filled her world with dolls on strings and made them dance.

And along came a spider who told her that everything was a lie, and all her happiness was a shallow pane of glass. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she turned away from the joy and filled her life with war and told the spider to GO! AWAY!

THE LAST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An angry little girl, whose life was filled with fury and rage. She hurt and maimed and was hurt and maimed in return.

And along came a spider who told her that everything in the world always ended in anger. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she turned away… and realized she had nothing else to fill her life with.

The spider smiled… and he ate her all up.
For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home.

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverQue:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

That profane monstrosity of which the Scholar spoke has sought to claim our throne. It wears a face and puppets a body that knows you.

We have confined it in the Apocrypha, the realm of Untold Stories, but you now have a duty to keep it there.

If it gains sufficient power, its story will supplant ours!

Seek its heretical tale, ‘The Triumph of Dust'. Sever it from the true tales of Duviri.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX

One life lost, for another life gained: life never before seen in the Origin System. An impossible life that, in turn, brought with it more questions than answers.

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadesPromise:
MEMORY FEATHER 01
BEDSIDE. LAIR. URANUS.

I will live, little one. We will live.


MEMORY FEATHER 02
CREVASSE. LUA.

The Executor smirked down at me. "What is a life but a mass of unfulfilled potential? Just like the life that would have grown within you. But you chose to spite Us. And for that sin, you will mother only ashes and oblivion. Jade."

I screamed defiance in his face, but my voice was razors and steel.

Did you hear me, my beloved child? Did you feel my promise? Whatever they have done to us, I SHALL bring you into the world. I WILL see your face shining down on me.

I will raise you to the skies over Lua as my mother lifted me and show you the first mother they desecrated, radiant in blue. When you cry, I will cry too.


MEMORY FEATHER 03
HIBERNATION POD. JADE LIGHT EXECUTION CHAMBER. LUA.

They keep me in what they imagine to be sleep in between the executions. I pass the time dreaming of us. The games we can still play.

I close my mask.

Mummy is gone!

I open my mask.

Here she is!

Over and over.

The Dax murmur behind their hands.


MEMORY FEATHER 04
RUINS. OROKIN MANSION. VENUS.

Your father blamed himself. As if love could ever be a crime! As if I had no say in the matter!

So now he repents. In his changed skin, he serves them, "like a devoted dog." Ballas gloats to me of how they dangle the promise of me - of us - over his head.

"He lives in hope of seeing you again, one day. I have promised him this. You should be proud."

He wants me to hate. I shall not. I own myself.


MEMORY FEATHER 05
BATTLEFIELD. THARSIS.

There is a child in my head. Not you, my love. Some battle-shattered thing, a ghost, a dream. She calls me by a name I do not choose.

What are you? I ask.

"Your Operator," the child says. "C'mon."

What did they DO to you?

"Let's go! We're being called up! Time to fight!"

My hand raises of its own volition. It is trembling. I hear the unvoiced tears in her thoughts.

"I can do this. I'm Tenno. I can do this."

I repeat, softly, firmly: What did they do to you?

I feel the child curl up, fetal. She whimpers.

"I… I want my mom."

With my mind, I embrace her. I sing her the old songs of Cathal-Rah and the riddle-verses of Lyrim of Haq. I tell her the winding, meandering story of Lankity Hopkin. I am a thing all clouds and feathers. I rock her to sleep.

And so I go to war, and none suspect. I am as much the warrior as I ever was. With bow and scythe, I fight for the people I despise against a foe that deserves their victory. Because I know the reckoning will come.


MEMORY FEATHER 06
WRECKAGE. PLUTO TERMINUS.

When the drums struck, I saw him. Changed, just as I was changed. But the medal was his. There is no other like it.

My Sorren. And he did not know me.

I took him. I flew. Through blood and storm and insanity, I flew.


MEMORY FEATHER 07
URANUS. TOMB. THE SENTIENT.

He could not have known it, but in taunting me, Ballas gave me hope.

"There is plentiful strength within you - but only to keep you preserved as you are now. Your child, alas, will never grow. Even if you fed it with all the strength in your body! Perhaps if you lay lifeless for a year, the child would twitch a little. A century and its heart might begin to beat. A thousand years, and who knows? Perhaps you might feel a kick."

And so, I lie here. Stubborn as the day is long, as my father used to say.

I promised that you would live, little one. I will keep that promise.

With your father watching over us, I will give you the gift of myself.

And one day, these metal fingers of mine will dip in slippery paint and draw a smiley sun and a house and a dog, and all of us together, and I will hear you laugh.

ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 1/4

The air in the atrium was soaked in scent, a drowsy, giddying lilac. 

Servants worked with panicky haste to deck the columns with feather-bursts; gold, purple, crimson, like festive wreaths. Little beaked skulls formed the centre of each. Sweat-pearled women ripped the plumage from Voscrix after Voscrix and tossed them, struggling and shrieking, into golden wirework bins.

"You are the Archimedean she sent for?"

The speaker was Orokin, a lean-smiling jackal of a man who strode across the mirrored flags as if he were floating above them. 

"I am, sir."

He looked me up and down. "Former Lorist aide, I believe. Extensive combat experience. Scraped our troops back together at significant personal risk. No stranger to carnage… well, that'll help you keep your head in this place. The Executor has a certain reputation."

"I'm aware."

He glanced over at the squirming, plucked birds. Eyes maddened by pain goggled back at him. 

"What do you think of today's whimsy? Be honest."

I hesitated. "It seems like a waste."

The Orokin cocked his head and pursed his lips, and at once I regretted my asinine comment.

"And I thought Archimedeans were schooled in aesthetics alongside cold science," he sighed. "Do you mean to tell me the delicious irony is lost on you?"

"Perhaps you could explain it," I answered, hoping my crude appeal to his vanity would pay off.

He gestured with a languid, taloned hand. "Birds are her current obsession. The tail of the cock-Voscrix is a mating display, one of the most spectacular in nature, and she has ripped them out and discarded the bird itself. Do you see?"

"I think so. They expect to mate and die, but live in agony instead."

He saw me, then, for the first time. 

He reached into the folds of his leminya and withdrew a blackly iridescent phial.

"Pinch of Ophilum? It eases the nerves."

I declined. My senses were swimming already. I did not dare face the Executor with my mind addled.

He shrugged. "As you wish. Await her by the pool and study what you find there. A word of advice? Whatever requests she makes of you, however impossible or repugnant they may seem, swear to grant them. She is not accustomed to being refused."

ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 2/4

The carving was an ancient one, held in a null-field to keep it from collapsing into sour dust. I studied the bulging eyes, the claws, the colourful paint on the wooden feathers still gleaming vividly after who knows how many centuries. It must have been a god, or a demon.

"Garuda."

A voice of milk and venom. She was behind me. Her hand settled on my shoulder and I fought the urge to shrug it off.

"A relic of old Earth," I guessed.

"A purer time. How imaginations must have soared, when we were still confined to that one orb. I sometimes wish I had lived then."

She gripped my shoulders and roughly turned me around to face her. I tensed involuntarily at the sight of those eyes, that mouth.

She must have felt my shoulders stiffen, for she let out a giggle and spun me around again and again on the spot until I was giddy and reeling. 

I fought to stay upright. Thank the Void, I did not lurch into her body. If I had accepted the Ophilum…

She clapped her mismatched hands together. "I want a Warframe," she said. "You are going to make one for me, Archimedean."

I swallowed. My throat seemed full of little dry bones. 

"The process… you must be aware, Executor, that Warframes are created from human subjects?"

"Well, of course I am aware of that," she said smoothly. "You are very rude."

"I… I meant no…"

"To call him, my own consort, a ‘subject'! I should have you flayed and tossed in splintered glass." She yawned. "Perhaps later."

Two expressionless Dax were striding towards me. I immediately braced myself to fight, thinking they were coming to drag me to the cells, but forced myself to stay calm. I was here for a purpose. I had a use. She would not discard me yet.

The Executor spread her arms out like wings. "Witness him! Garuda, king of birds, prey-ripping prince! My consort is to be my Garuda. I want him clawed, gore-thirsty, proud in his plumage! You can deliver him for me, lovely Archimedean. You can do this. Yes?"

"Yes," I croaked. I struggled to cough the words out and they came all at once, like a pellet. "But he will not be himself! The Warframes are beset by madness, all of them. Perhaps, if I deliberately impede the neuroptics, I may be able to temper it in the forge…"

She gripped me by the throat.

"You will do no such thing," she breathed, and I felt the hot stink of her, charnel and close. "The madness is the best part."

ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 3/4

The two Dax remained outside the laboratories, courteously guarding against any disturbance. 

Within, I brewed Helminth cultures and prepared technocyte infusions according to the Ainikki method. I had heard of Executor Ballas's subtle innovations, but since he had not shared them with the Collegium I had no access to them.

I had no visitors other than the Executor's consort, who would arrive, collect my reports, talk of unimportant issues, and leave. If he knew what I was working on, he gave no sign. Either he was indifferent, or ignorant, or a supreme play-actor.

My ghastly creation, ‘Garuda', took shape in the rendering solution. A few drops on the predictive lens, commingled with the samples of the consort's own blood that the Executor had provided, allowed the device to model what manner of entity would ultimately result. Tall, regal, hideous.

The Executor would be pleased. I had no doubt of that. Her consort would become a sleek, scarlet death-bird, clawed with repurposed ulna, a fit assassin for the gore-queen. 

And then? Did she mean to keep him as a freakish pet? Did she aspire to be butchered by him as the climax of some depraved courtship, before sliding her ego into a fresh and prepared Yuvan?

What use would I be to her, once the project was complete? 

I thought of her birds, plucked, ruined, struggling. Still alive.

ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 4/4

I am losing my voice. Soon I will be unable to utter more than a harsh scream. The transformation is well underway. It will be impossible to hide it for long.

The consort suspects. I know this. But he will not betray me. 

I have delivered him from a grotesque fate. He would have been like the birds, mutilated, undying. I cannot know if I have merely saved him for something worse. But this way, he has a chance.

When the day of my hatching comes, I pray he is far away. 

For nine days I have been injecting myself with the Garuda serum. The Dax guards believe I am engaged in especially dangerous work and must not be disturbed. 

I have sealed up the inner doors of the chamber with chymical burners. It is well. By the time they break in upon me, the transformation should be complete.

There is no regret. I was a condemned woman from the moment I arrived. My only freedom is to secure my own execution.

The agony is exquisite. Marching ants inch through my veins. My skin blisters and sloughs off in plasticated scrolls. 

The madness is not so bad. There is a fierce joy to it. I shed a humanity I never truly prized.

I have been used all my life. Caged by these proud golden birds. But in accepting this bitter blessing, I will finally fly free. What do I care if my freedom lasts no longer than the dawn? I shall know it, taste it, in all its fleeting reality.

I am no Orokin. I will not leave them tormented and twisting, beaks gaping, gasping and screaming. I will bring decisive death. Swift and sweet. Final.

The Executor will have her assassin, but not the one she imagined. They will break down the door, Garuda will unfurl her claws, and the crimson thirst, oh, it shall be legendary. I shall stride through her hall clotted with gore and feathers. 

I wonder how many I will slaughter before they take me down.

I wonder if one of them will be her.

The Executor wanted blood. And she shall have it.

When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.
Freed from the Grineer Queens, Jarka stands at the ready to join your crew.

Tenno,

I have prepared this missive to arrive after I have done what I must now do with the poison we all danced with, the void. Did you hear laughter? Do you feel lighter? 

My efforts may fail. The void might reject my sacrifice. But I know how it covets. It will want everything I was. And in turn, I will collapse its frayed mockery! ALL WILL BE TOGETHER! I only hope they feel this peace I offer. Their happiness is theirs to find. 

I place the essence of that which is  both Sirius and Orion into your hands, for safe keeping. You will understand the importance of keeping family together.

If we ever meet again, I will not know you. So I shall say only this: 

I do not sacrifice my memories of our acquaintance lightly, but I know you're taking care of her.

I remain a proud father,

Hunhow

/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv: The crystalized remains of the master foundry operator, Belric.

During the Old War, Belric, Rania and their guardian Warframe Citrine were the last line of defense against a Sentient onslaught upon a strategically important planetoid. In the absence of any eyewitnesses, what happened in those final moments is a matter of speculation and colorful myth. 

What is known? A bio-bomb released the Infestation upon the planetoid, halting the Sentient advance and creating a heavily mutated environment. As for Belric and Rania, the evidence suggests they were turned to crystal by Citrine. In her final moments, the Warframe chose not to flee but to use the last of her energy to preserve the pair, together, in one final embrace.
The crystalized remains of the celebrated Void engineer, Rania.

In an event that has become the stuff of legend, Rania, along with her former husband Belric, were transmuted into crystal by their sworn protector; the Warframe Citrine. A merciful end, that saved them from a much worse fate.

Their crystals remained together until the recent past. Smugglers discovered they exhibited some very curious properties; when separated, Rania's crystal remains connected to Belric's crystal via a Void tunnel. How? Perhaps in their final moments, intense emotions deformed the Void substrata, connecting them forever. 

Doomed lovers, connected forever. Citrine's last wish.

/Lotus/Language/Locations/CeresDesc: The Grineer have expanded their empire into this region.

/Lotus/Language/Locations/EarthDesc: A desolate, ruined world. Home of the oppressive Grineer Empire.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/ErisDesc: Rapid Corpus expansion has led them to build outposts in this far flung sector of the system.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/EuropaDesc: This deep space outpost is traditionally home to The Corpus.

/Lotus/Language/Locations/NeptuneDesc: Home of the Corpus and site of their indoctrination temples. Warframe and Robotics R&D hidden here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/PhobosDesc: The Grineer have occupied the abandoned settlements here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/PlutoDesc: The shattered Outer Terminus of the Solar Rail Network is located here. The Corpus work to rebuild it.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationDe: Join us in the relay at 2pm EST for a special community event!
/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe: Unite with fellow Tenno across the Origin System for TennoCon 2026! Visit Baro Ki'Teer and shop his entire inventory of goods for a limited time. Only TennoCon 2026 Digital Pack holders may enter.
The time has finally come! Join us for TennoLive 2026 as we unveil Warframe's next big chapter. Open to all Tenno.

/Lotus/Language/Locations/SednaDesc: The Grineer have expanded their empire into this region.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/UranusDesc: Remote Grineer bases focus on research and development of bio-modification and gene repair.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/VenusDesc: The Corpus have focused their manufacturing facilities in this area.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/VoidDesc: Ancient Orokin places are hidden here.

/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/PostQuestInb:
Tenno,

None of us could hear the Device that was calling from the abyss of history. The Daughter of Hunhow heard it, and almost succumbed to its call. She raised her voice in song to drown it out, and that we did hear.

I should have known she was waiting for you.

You answered a call and in a way, found an answer. For me. The time is almost right to finish the Kalymos Sequence. 

I will soon be able to send you to the city-state of Höllvania, in the plague year of 1999 - a most perilous time. Without your equipment, you would surely perish. 

Luckily, the Vessels have a connection to Albrecht's "volunteers" that I believe I can exploit. You will not arrive unarmed, nor unarmored. 

We won't be late! 

Loid

/Lotus/Language/Menu/MeleeUpdateChanges_:
Tenno - your favorite melee weapon probably feels a little different today. Today we bring you Phase 1 of 2019's melee upgrade - we hope you love all the gorgeous new visual effects, streamlined combat, and high fidelity hit reactions!

|OPEN_COLOR|Here's what you can expect:|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|Let The Gun & Blade Flow|CLOSE_COLOR|
Swap between your gun and melee at the press of a button, no holstering required! Combos can be executed and resumed between movement and more. Blocking is now automatic in melee mode when aiming at an attacking enemy. Your stance combos may have changed, check out the Stance interface!

|OPEN_COLOR|Death From Above|CLOSE_COLOR|
A Tenno is a master of aerial tactics - now you can better target enemies on the ground with deadly and responsive aimed ground slams. 

|OPEN_COLOR|Effects Upgrades|CLOSE_COLOR|
We've done a complete overhaul of all Melee Effects! Hit animations, elemental effects and slam attacks: making melee look as good as it feels!

|OPEN_COLOR|More to Come|CLOSE_COLOR|
Fundamentally, we aim to upgrade Melee. This is Phase 1.

No one knows the power of their Arsenal better than the Tenno - your adaptability and skill with the blade will be tested, and as we continue these changes, we rely on your feedback!

|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|UPDATE 24|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|
|OPEN_BOLD|FORTUNA IS HERE!|CLOSE_BOLD|

It's been one year since we added our first open world - |OPEN_COLOR|Plains of Eidolon.|CLOSE_COLOR| Our second world is ready: |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR|.

Entering |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR| requires you first to visit |OPEN_COLOR|Fortuna|CLOSE_COLOR| - a town full of new characters, new content, and new problems to solve! To do this - you'll first have to reach Venus!

Reach Venus!? Our veteran Tenno have had Venus unlocked for years - it's time to go back. Maybe you've played long enough to remember our first 'planet' procedural tileset on Venus and the excitement at the time.

New players might only be making their way there now - with determination and cooperation, you'll master the challenges of |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR| in no time.

Enjoy the efforts of all of us at Digital Extremes delivered here in Fortuna. Your patience, support, excitement, and feedback has made this update possible. We dedicate it to you.

Stay warm on your K-Drives, Tenno!

|OPEN_COLOR|We all lift together.|CLOSE_COLOR|
- DE and the Warframe Team

/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2:
Regret not, maggot. The galleon you raided was headed to an Ostron Floating Market near Earth. The Ghouls would have slaughtered every last one of those filthy peasants. And I know that would make you SAD.

More instigators hide in the shadows. Bring them to me before they become a problem for you. 

For motivation, take this blueprint. It uses parts you will recover while capturing Ghouls.

Your hunger for weapons is pathetically reliable. Have another blueprint, you ravenous worm.

The instigator Ghouls run, but they still scheme. Fill their rotting hearts with regret, and their flesh with shrapnel.

The last of the Ghoul galleons has been located. Your final chance to take what you need. After that our partnership is dust. 

So long, maggots.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe:
You're getting the hang of it. We just wanted to send you a little something by way of encouragement. Don't let up. 

- Eudico
VALLIS FRACTURES: A Token of Appreciation

You're doing good work, Sparky. At the current rate Smokefinger charts a plateau in seismic activity before long. That's good news for Fortuna. Keep it up. 

- Eudico
VALLIS FRACTURES: I Think It's Working

The Vallis is more stable these days, thanks to the work you're doing. But we've still got fractures erupting every day, and until Nef concedes the threat we have to take care of ourselves. Find them. Seal them. We're counting on you. 

- Eudico

I clock 75-plus fractures sealed. I shudder to think what state we'd be in if we didn't have you helping us out like this. Kids are shutting down sound in their racks, knowing you're out there. Thank you. 

- Eudico

Sparky, what can I say? You're doing singly what none of us could have done together. Fortuna still lives thanks to your efforts in sealing those fractures. But we're not resting. Not 'til Nef shuts down thermia extraction entirely. 

Thank you. From every rig jockey in the place. We owe you. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestHarr: With Rell at peace we will rebuild in his honor. We will do what we have always done: take the outcasts, the ones that don’t fit in, and prepare them. Thank you to you and your great Queen for setting Rell to rest. Take this offering, it’s the thing of greatest value I can give you.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestRive:

With the clarity that Rell’s passing has given me, I now see that you have already communed with the Warframe Rell called Harrow.

Faithfully yours,
Palladino

Install an Augment Mod on your Warframe.
Augment Mods can be obtained from Syndicate and Nightwave Offerings. Go to the Arsenal, select the Upgrade tab and equip an Augment Mod.
Claim an item from your Foundry.
After an item finishes building, visit your Foundry and select the completed item to claim it.
To Bullet Jump, hold down the <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch button, then tap <JUMP>Jump.
Take a screenshot in any Captura scene.
Captura is found in the Arsenal under the Warframe's Appearance tab. Select the camera icon to the right of the screen to open Captura.

Equip a scanner to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal, then activate it in a mission to equip it. While equipped, aim at enemies and hold <PRE_ATTACK> to scan them. You can buy Scanner charges from the Market or Cephalon Semaris.
Only credits dropped by enemies and containers count.
Collect resources by defeating enemies and completing missions. Be sure to also check storage containers and destructible objects to maximize your resource hunt.
Complete a Mission with only a Melee Weapon equipped
Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Primary and Secondary Weapons. With only your Melee Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
Complete a Mission with only a Primary Weapon equipped
Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Melee and Secondary Weapons. With only your Primary Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
Complete a Mission with only a Secondary Weapon equipped
Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Melee and Primary Weapons. With only your Secondary Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
Start or join missions from the Navigation console.
The final hit must be from a Melee ground slam.
Deploy an Air Support Charge in a Mission

Air Support Charges can be crafted after installing the Landing Craft Foundry Segment. This Segment can be Researched in the Clan Dojo, or found in the Market. Once Charges are crafted in the Foundry, equip them to the Gear Wheel via the Gear tab in the Arsenal. To deploy them, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Air Support Charge.
Deploy a Glyph while on a mission.
Equip a Glyph Prism to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal. To deploy it, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Glyph Prism.

Specter Blueprints can be obtained from Rescue missions, as well as various other sources. Craft a Specter in the Foundry, and then equip them to the Gear Wheel via the Gear tab in the Arsenal. To deploy them, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Specter.
Select a Leverian to visit via the Leverian tab in the Codex. Once inside, visit the donation box near the entrance to donate Credits.
Look for glowing circles near bodies of water while out exploring in The Duviri Experience. Catch at least 10 fish to satisfy the Maw's hunger.
Look for wild animals in need of rescue out in The Duviri Experience. Koral will announce if one is nearby. Try to sneak up on them, but if detected, be ready for a fight!
Hijack a Crewship from the enemy

Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Approach it with your Archwing and enter it to hijack it from the enemy. The front section of the ship has a pilot seat which gives you access to the ship’s controls and weaponry.
Interact with your Kubrow or Kavat
While onboard your Orbiter, approach your Kubrow or Kavat while it is walking around and press the interact button to pet it.
Kill |COUNT| enemies while riding a K-Drive, Kaithe, Velocipod, or Atomicycle.

You can equip your Secondary weapon while riding a K-Drive (or other vehicle) by pressing <SWITCH_GUN>. K-Drives are earned from the Vox Solaris Quest. Equip your K-Drive (or vehicle of choice) to the Gear Wheel, and then deploy it in Open Landscape missions.
Only enemies that you personally injured or killed with Abilities are counted.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage must be present. Blast Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_FREEZE>.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage must be present. Corrosive Damage is formed by combining <DT_ELECTRICITY> and <DT_POISON>.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage must be present.
Execute melee finishers on vulnerable enemies by sneaking upon them. Some Warframe abilities can also blind or stun enemies to enable finishers. Finishers on prone enemies do not count.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage must be present.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage must be present.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_GAS>Gas Damage must be present. Gas Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_POISON>.
The final hit must be on the head.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic Damage must be present. Magnetic Damage is formed by combining <DT_ELECTRICITY> and <DT_FREEZE>.
Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Melee Weapon.
Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Melee weapon count.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage must be present.
Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Primary Weapon.
Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Primary weapon count.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Damage must be present. Radiation Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_ELECTRICITY>.
Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Secondary Weapon.
Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Secondary weapon count.
You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage must be present. Viral Damage is formed by combining <DT_FREEZE> and <DT_POISON>.
Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
Kill a Kuva Thrall or Hound
While having an active Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos, start a mission on a planet that is controlled by them to defeat and Mercy Kill a Kuva Thrall or Hound of theirs respectively.
Clear a node influenced by a Kuva Lich or a Sister of Parvos
Start a mission on a planet that is controlled by a Kuva Lich or a Sister of Parvos and complete it to remove their influence.
Sell any item in your Inventory for Credits.
Open the pause menu and select Equipment > Inventory, from there you can pick the items you wish to sell for Credits.
Revive a fellow Tenno or a Companion.
Approach a downed ally and interact with the revive prompt.

When damaging Heavy Units such as Grineer Heavy Gunners, reduce their health to the threshold indicated on their HP bar to make them susceptible to a Mercy Kill. Inflicting the <DT_IMPACT>Impact Status Effect on them will increase the health threshold and make it easier to put them into the Mercy state.
Approach Lockers in missions and Interact with them.
Energy Orbs frequently drop from enemies and containers.
Find |COUNT| Syndicate Medallions. You can search by yourself or with a squad.

Start a mission from the Syndicate tab in Navigation once you have pledged to a Syndicate. Syndicate Medallions are manual pick-ups that can be found throughout the mission. Loot Radar Mods such as Animal Instinct and Thief's Wit can help locate them via the minimap
Mods frequently drop from enemies when they are killed.
Find and pilot a Fallen Necramech.
Fallen Necramechs are only found on the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
Point directly at a Mod or Resource and press your Place Marker key <SHOW_SECRET_1>.
Emotes can be assigned on the Gear Tab in the Arsenal. To play an Emote, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and then swap to the Emotes Wheel.
Play a game of Frame Fighter, Happy Zephyr, or Wyrmius
Activate a Requiem Obelisk on Deimos.
Broken Obelisks are found across the Cambion Drift. Charge an Obelisk by using your Operator's Void energy on its core.
Look for Acrithis' Cart out in The Duviri Experience. She is guaranteed to make an appearance in the King's Palace after defeating an Orowyrm.
To Slide, start moving, then hold <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch.
Interact with a console and then complete the hacking minigame. Using ciphers counts!
Kill |COUNT| enemies using a Necramech while hovering.
You can use your own Necramech, or you can temporarily commandeer a Necramech on the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
Suspend 5 or more enemies in the air at once with a Heavy Slam Melee Attack
Perform a Heavy Slam attack with your Melee weapon by jumping at pressing <MELEE_CHANNEL> while aiming at the ground when surrounded by a group of enemies.
Kill |COUNT| Drones or Ospreys with your Melee Weapon.
The final hit on Drones and Ospreys must be from your Melee weapon.

Open the Quick Access wheel and select Decorate, or navigate to the Decorate menu under Pause > Equipment > Orbiter enter Decoration Mode. Decorations can be found in the Market, or from various vendors across the Origin System.
Successfully defend an Excavator without allowing it to run out of power.
Select any Excavation mission in Navigation. Find a dig site and defend the Excavator. Keep it powered by bringing Power Cells to it dropped from killed Power Carrier enemies.
Transmuting is the act of merging four Mods at the Mod Segment in your Orbiter to receive a new random Mod.
Pierce and kill 2 or more enemies in a single Bow shot.
Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Bow weapon count.
At the bottom left of the Star Chart, players can visit their own or Featured Dojos. Featured Dojos are the winners of the quarterly Featured Dojo Contests.
Get a kill with your Primary, Secondary, and Melee weapons within 10 seconds.
Each weapon type (Primary, Secondary, and Melee) must have killed an enemy within that time limit. Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Primary, Secondary, and Melee will count.
Complete a game of Komi in Duviri
Look for Komi boards while out exploring in The Duviri Experience. Your opponent is crafty, so be sure to read the rules well!
The Orowyrm is the final encounter at the end of The Duviri Experience or The Lone Story missions in Duviri. Use a combination of Drifter and Warframe combat to triumph over the beast!
Clear a Railjack Boarding Party without your Warframe taking damage

Railjack Boarding Parties occur when a Ramsled successfully lands on your Railjack. To avoid taking damage, take cover and use long range or explosive weapons. You can also consider using a stealth Warframe to avoid enemy detection.
Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Bow.
Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Bow count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Bow/Crossbow category in the Arsenal.
Catch |COUNT| Rare Fish in the Plains of Eidolon.

Murkray, Norg, Cuthol, and Glappid are considered to be rare fish. Hai-Luk in Cetus can supply you with fishing equipment. Equip your purchased Fishing Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while on the Plains. Use Bait in the correct water sources to find Rare Fish. Time of day can change how often certain fish appear, and some only appear at day or night.
Catch |COUNT| Rare Servofish in the Orb Vallis.

Synathid, Tromyzon, and Charamote are considered to be rare fish. The Business in Fortuna can supply you with fishing equipment. Add a Shock Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while in the Orb Vallis. Use Bait in the correct water sources in the correct weather conditions to find Rare Fish.
Collect resources by defeating enemies and completing missions. Be sure to also check storage containers and destructible objects to maximize your resource hunt.
Earn resources in Duviri by destroying plants and containers, defeating enemies and completing objectives or optional Anecdotes.
Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Capture.
Help Clem with his weekly mission.
Darvo can be found in any Relay using the Fast Travel options in the pause menu. Select the "Does Clem need my help?" dialogue option after completing the A Man of Few Words quest.

Start a Disruption mission from Navigation, scavenge Conduit Keys (Dockets on Deimos) from elite enemies, (Amalgams on Jupiter, Eximus and Gruzzlings on Deimos, and heavy units or Eximus units elsewhere) then carry them to the matching Conduit to activate and defend it from an incoming Demolisher or Demolyst.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Extermination.
Complete |COUNT| Invasion missions of any type.
Active Invasion missions can be found in the Invasions Tab of the Navigation menu. Support a side in the chosen Invasion for 3 missions to earn the listed Battle Pay.

Kuva Siphon missions appear on planets near the Kuva Fortress. Once you have located the Kuva Siphon in the mission, destroy the Kuva Clouds heading for the Siphon. The Kuva Siphon will point towards active Clouds. Kuva Clouds are vulnerable to the Operator's attacks and Void Sling.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Mobile Defense.
Complete |COUNT| Nightmare missions of any type.
Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
Play Ollie's Crash Course and complete a race
Go to the Höllvania Central Mall and find the Atomicycle arcade machines to play Ollie's Crash Course.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Rescue.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Sabotage.
Select the Sortie from the World State panel in Navigation. You must finish all three missions.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Spy.

Syndicate missions become available once you haved Pledged to a Syndicate via the segment in your Base of Operations. Syndicate Pledging is unlocked upon reaching Mastery Rank 3. Use the Syndicate tab in the Navigation Menu to find active Syndicate missions.
Look for Ayatan Treasures for Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar.

Visit Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars. Ask her about Ayatan Treasures and she will send you on a mission to retrieve one. You can socket Ayatan Stars into Sculptures by clicking the Ayatan Treasures button in the Mods workbench. Stars are uncommon items found in containers, while Sculptures are hidden items to search out during missions.
Complete a K-Drive race in Orb Vallis on Venus or in Cambion Drift on Deimos.

Locate active K-Drive races in the Orb Vallis or Cambion Drift by jumping on your K-Drive and checking your Map to see their marked locations. Start a race by interacting with a Ventkid or Grandmother and driving through the first gate. Complete a race by successfully driving through each gate in the allotted time.
Destroy a Crewship with Forward Artillery
Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Head to the Forward Artillery located on the bridge behind the Navigation console.

This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Armageddon mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Oro Works node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.

Obtain the Helminth Segment Blueprint from Son in the Necralisk after reaching Rank 3 with the Entrati. Feed resources to fuel various Secretions, which are then consumed by engaging with the Helminth system. Reset the Helminth's appetite for certain resources by feeding it items from the Sentient Appetite category.
Play a Shawzin song activity in Duviri
Look for Shawzin music areas while out exploring the Duviri Paradox. Each location has a different song to play!
Open one of each era/tier of Relic (Lith, Meso, Neo, Axi) |COUNT|.
Open one of each era/tier of Relic (|Req_VoidT1|, |Req_VoidT2|, |Req_VoidT3|, |Req_VoidT4|, |Req_VoidT5|) |COUNT|.
Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped from killed enemies.
Complete The Perita Rebellion with |COUNT| or more orders completed.
Unlock The Perita Rebellion after completing The Old Peace quest. Gain access to this mission using The Dark Refractory sub-menu on the Navigation Console.
Activate the Incarnon Form of any Incarnon weapon in-mission |COUNT| times

Incarnon Weapons can be obtained via Cavalero in the Chyrsalith, or by installing Incarnon Genesis Adapters earned through Steel Path Circuit. Build progress by landing headshots with guns or building Combo Counter with melee, then use <SECONDARY_FIRE> to evolve the weapon into its Incarnon form.
Various Planets drop different resources. Use the "Resource Drones" toggle in the Navigation menu to view what resources drop on each Planet.

This game mode is accessed from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or by visiting Kahl's Garrison in the Drifter's Camp. Archon Hunts are a set of three missions with the following restrictions; no self-revives, no use of deployable allies, and Squad Restores have a long cooldown. To begin the Hunt, you need a Rank 30 Warframe or a Warframe that has been polarized at least once if you are Mastery Rank 30 (or higher). Prepare your Arsenal to take on challenging enemies (level 130 and higher).  Completing the first two missions will bring you to the third and final Assassination mission, where you will face the currently active Archon.
Complete a run of Deep Archimedea or Temporal Archimedea

Deep Archimedea can be accessed by speaking to the Necraloid in the Sanctum Anatomica after reaching Rank 5 with the Cavia. 
Temporal Archimedea can be accessed by speaking to Kaya in the Höllvania Central Mall after reaching Rank 5 with the Hex.
Complete |COUNT| Nightmare missions of any type.
Start new missions from the Navigation console. Each planet will have one active Nightmare once you unlock all mission nodes on that planet.
Select the Sortie from the World State panel in Navigation. You must finish all three missions, on three different days.
Complete a Spy mission using your Operator. Your Warframe cannot leave spawn room
Switch to Steel Path mode on the right side of the Navigation screen.
Complete |COUNT| successful Conversions in the Alchemy game mode.

Gain access to the Alchemy mission on Cambire, Deimos after completing The Whispers in the Walls quest. Kill enemies to drop Amphors. Throw Amphors with a matching element type on the Crucible. Once the Crucible is full, maintain correct pressure by shooting distressed pipes to keep the gauge in the ideal window.
Defeat the Orowyrm in Steel Path
The Orowyrm is the final encounter at the end of The Duviri Experience or The Lone Story missions in Duviri. Use a combination of Drifter and Warframe combat to triumph over the beast!
Complete |COUNT| Zones of Elite Sanctuary Onslaught.
Start Elite Sanctuary Onslaught from the World State panel in Navigation after completing The New Strange quest. The 8 zones do not need to be completed in a single session

This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Armageddon mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Oro Works node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
Complete an Extermination mission with only level 30 or higher enemies without triggering alarms.
Start new missions from Navigation. The mission type must be Exterminate, and the starting level must be higher than 30.
Defeat |COUNT| Void Angels in the Zariman.
Void Angels can be defeated in Void Armageddon missions after three waves of defending Exodampers or by waking dormant ones found throughout the other Zariman missions.
Finish a Capture mission in less than 90 seconds

Visit your Arsenal and equip a fast Warframe like Volt or Gauss, then go to the Navigation console and select a Capture node from the Star Chart. Chase and subdue your Capture target then complete the mission as fast as possible.
Complete a Defense mission reaching at least Wave 12.
Start new missions from Navigation. Complete at least 12 waves in a single session before extracting from the mission.
Defend both Mirror Defense objectives 3 times each in a single mission.
Mirror Defense missions are available at Tyana Pass on Mars and Munio on Deimos.

Take down the Profit-Taker via Heist missions in the Orb Vallis. Heists become unlocked once reaching Old Mate with the Solaris United. Venture to the backroom of Fortuna and speak to Eudico to start the briefing.
Complete a Survival mission reaching at least 20 minutes.
Start new missions from Navigation. 20 minutes must be survived in a single session before extracting from the mission.
Unlock The Descendia after completing The Old Peace quest. Gain access to this mission using The Dark Refractory sub-menu on the Navigation Console.

This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Flood mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Everview Arc node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.

Mushroom patches can be found in Deepmines Bounties, identified by their purple glow. Gain access to Deepmines Bounties by visiting Nightcap in the bowels of Fortuna after completing The New War quest.
Win 3 wagers in a row in one match of The Index.
The Index is found in the Neptune region of the Star Chart.
Kill |COUNT| Enemies on The Steel Path.
Only enemies that you personally injured or killed during missions played on Steel Path mode are counted.
Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
Identify Eximus enemies in missions by their names and glowing auras.

The Exploiter Orb is a Corpus Raknoid boss that roams the Orb Vallis. To fight her, you must first collect Diluted Thermia from the Orb Vallis Thermia Fractures Event. This monthly event requires you to close fractures on the Orb Vallis on Venus and can be accessed from your Navigation console on your Orbiter when active. A single Diluted Thermia is required to unlock Deck 12 to start the battle, which is located in the cave northeast of Harindi Crater.
Kill or Capture an Eidolon Hydrolyst.

Venture to the Plains of Eidolon during the night, and capture the Teralyst and Gantulyst to be able to summon the Hydrolyst. Capture Eidolons using charged Eidolon Lures. Place the rewarded Brilliant Eidolon Shards at the Gara Toht Lake shrine to summon the next Eidolon.

The Ropalolyst is a gigantic Sentient boss that resides on Jupiter. Start the Ropalolyst Assassination mission on Jupiter and use your Operator attacks and the environment to take the Ropalolyst down.
Craft Apothics in the Foundry and add them to your Gear Wheel. Play forest missions on Earth and offer your Apothic to the Silver Grove to summon a Specter.
The H-09 Efervon Tank can be found on the Victory Plaza node in Höllvania.
Kill a Tusk Thumper Doma in the Plains of Eidolon

Tusk Thumpers Doma are the Elite version of the Tusk Thumper field boss. They spawn in high level Bounties or on the Steel Path during daytime in the Plains of Eidolon. Defeat them by shooting their vulnerable leg plates and the weak points behind those.
Survive for over 20 minutes in Kuva Survival.
Must be completed at the location Taveuni on the Kuva Fortress in a single session.
Complete |COUNT| Halls of Ascension on Lua.
Halls of Ascension are puzzle rooms exclusive to missions on Lua. Complete them to earn Drift Mods.
Collect Enigma Gyrum by completing puzzles in The Duviri Experience. Look for pillars with blue letters for the code to each puzzle.
While in Navigation, use the Railjack button on the top right to switch to the Railjack Proximas. Complete the specified number of non-Free Flight Proxima missions.
Kill |COUNT| enemies using a Necramech without getting destroyed.

Summon your owned Necramech in eligible missions using the Necramech Summon on your Gear Wheel. If you do not own a Necramech, you can commandeer a Necramech using Transference (after The War Within quest) in the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
The Isleweaver mission can be found in the Duviri navigation menu after completing both The Duviri Paradox and The Hex quests.
Complete a Spy mission with 3 manual console hacks and no alarms
Visit Mother in the Necralisk on Deimos and select any Isolation Vault Bounty. Defeat the Necramechs that appear in Stage 3.
Exchange 10 Riven Slivers for a Riven Mod
Visit Palladino in Iron Wake on Earth to exchange Riven Slivers for a veiled Riven Mod. Riven Slivers can be earned from Requiem Relics, Railjack missions, and Eximus enemies in the Steel Path.
Free one Captured Solaris using a Granum Crown.
Enter any Corpus Ship node to find a Captured Solaris. Granum Crowns are dropped from Treasurers when defeated.
Enter the Anchorhold by talking to Tagfer in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos. Access to Netracells requires completion of The Whispers in the Walls quest.
Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped by slain enemies.
Arbitration Alerts become available upon completing the Pluto to Eris junction in the Star Chart.
Select and begin a Bounty by talking to Quinn in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.

This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Flood mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Everview Arc node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
Your Kaithe can be summoned in Duviri. With the Drifter Intrinsic "Equestrian Bond", Kaithes can also be summoned in any Landscape using the Gear Wheel!
Collect |COUNT| Decrees in a single Duviri session, or run of The Circuit.

Collect Decrees in Duviri Spirals by completing main objectives and optional Anecdotes in a single session. Collect Decrees in The Circuit by completing Stages and collecting Decree Fragments hidden throughout the mission.
Complete an Isolation Vault Bounty Mission in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
Begin the Bounty by either talking to Mother in the Necralisk or finding her in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.

Enter either an Archwing mission or equip one of your Archguns with a Gravimag to use it in normal missions. To access an Archgun during non-Archwing missions, equip the Archgun Deployer to your Gear Wheel to summon it.

Summon your owned Necramech in eligible missions using the Necramech Summon on your Gear Wheel. If you do not own a Necramech, you can commandeer a Necramech using Transference (after The War Within quest) in the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
The final hit must be on the head.
Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
Identify Eximus enemies in missions by their names and glowing auras.
Kill a Tusk Thumper in the Plains of Eidolon
Tusk Thumpers are field bosses that spawn during daytime in the Plains of Eidolon. Defeat them by shooting their vulnerable leg plates and the weak points behind those.
Gain a total of |COUNT| Standing across all Syndicate factions.

Gain Standing by completing Syndicate-specific missions or pledging your allegiance to a Faction Syndicate and playing regular missions. Complete Bounties and trade with Merchants to gain Standing with town hub Syndicates.
Plunder one of Alad V's secret laboratories on Jupiter.

Explore the Corpus Gas City tileset in a mission on Jupiter to find a locked orange door, behind it is one of Alad V's laboratories. A series of tasks must be performed to get inside the inner chamber. Once inside take everything you see!
Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Plains of Eidolon.

The vendor Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Plains. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Orb Vallis.

The vendor Smokefinger in Fortuna can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Orb Vallis. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
Collect |COUNT| Vome or Fass Residue in the Cambion Drift.

Enter the Cambion Drift on Deimos in Navigation. Scour the landscape for areas glowing in orange (Vome) or blue (Fass), there you will find Residue deposits. Destroy them to obtain Residue, and earn progress once you have safely extracted from the Cambion Drift.
Approach Lockers in missions and Interact with them.
Complete |COUNT| different Perfect Animal Captures in Orb Vallis.

Conservation requires the Tranq Rifle and Echo-Lures, which can be obtained from The Business in Fortuna. Equip these items to your Gear Wheel via the Arsenal. Once in the Orb Vallis, equip the Tranq Rifle or Echo-lure and check the Advanced Map for starting points to begin your hunt. Perfect Captures require the animal to be Tranquilized without it seeing you or being injured.

Collect Enigma Gyrum by completing puzzles in The Duviri Experience. Look for pillars with blue letters for the code to each puzzle.
Find |COUNT| Syndicate Medallions. You can search by yourself or with a squad.

Start a mission from the Syndicate tab in Navigation. Syndicate Medallions are manual pick-ups that can be found throughout the mission. Loot Radar Mods such as Animal Instinct, and Thief's Wit can help locate them via the minimap.
Mods frequently drop from killed enemies. Rare mods have a golden glow when dropped and a golden border when picked up.
Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon.
Start Bounties by either talking to Konzu in Cetus or going directly to the Plains of Eidolon and finding Bounty Source outposts.
While piloting a hijacked Crewship, destroy 3 enemy fighters

Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Approach with your Archwing and enter it to hijack it from the enemy. The front section of the ship has a pilot seat which gives you access to the ship’s controls and weaponry.
While in Navigation, use the Railjack button on the top right to switch to the Railjack Proximas. Complete the specified number of non-Free Flight Proxima missions.
Broken Requiem Obelisks are scattered across the Cambion Drift of Deimos. Focus your Operator or Drifter's Void energy on an Obelisk's core to charge it.
Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Rifle.
Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Rifle count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Rifle category in the Arsenal.

Resource Caches can appear as a secondary objective, meaning they will be listed as an optional objective if they spawned in the mission. Eligible missions include various types of Sabotage missions, but they can also be found in Lua Exterminate and Kuva Exterminate missions, and in certain Bounty objectives on Open Landscapes.
Start Sanctuary Onslaught from the World State panel in Navigation after completing The New Strange quest. The 8 zones do not need to be completed in a single session.
Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Shotgun.
Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Shotgun count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Shotgun category in the Arsenal.
Request a Synthesis assignment from Cephalon Simaris on a Relay and find the assigned enemy type. You can acquire Synthesis Scanner charges from his Offerings.
Dax enemies can be found in The Lone Story, The Duviri Experience, and The Circuit missions after completing The Duviri Paradox quest.
Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Sniper Rifle.
Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Sniper count.
Interact with a console and then complete the hacking minigame. Using ciphers counts!
Complete 1 mission with only a single pistol and a glaive equipped.
Equip only a Pistol as your Secondary and Glaive as your Melee weapon before entering a mission.

Dissolve Arcanes via Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos after completing The Whispers in the Walls quest. Use the "Dissolve Arcanes" option to dissolve Arcanes into Vosfor, which can then be used to purchase Arcane packs.
Unlock |COUNT| Dragon Key vaults on Deimos.

Orokin Vaults are found in Orokin Derelict tileset missions on Deimos. There are four different Dragon Keys, of which one random kind is used to unlock the Vault. The correct Dragon Key must be equipped on your Gear Wheel during the mission to unlock it. Multilpe keys can be equipped at a time if desired, or different keys can be carried by squadmates. Obtain Dragon Key blueprints via Clan Dojo research, then build them in the Foundry.
Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped from killed enemies.
Polarize a Weapon, Companion, or Warframe (not in Simulacrum).

Forma blueprints are earned from Void Relics, or built Forma can be obtained from the Market or various vendors throughout the Origin System. Once acquired, open the equipment's Upgrade menu in the Arsenal, and select Actions to Polarize the item with Forma. Installing Forma applies a new Polarity Slot, which reduces the cost of matching Polarity Mods installed in that Slot.
Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Orb Vallis.
Start Bounties by either talking to Eudico in Fortuna or going directly to the Orb Vallis and finding a Solaris contact to speak to.
Void Traces can be obtained from playing Void Fissure missions. You are awarded some after collecting 10 Reactant in-mission from defeated Corrupted enemies.
Complete |COUNT| different Bounties in the Zariman.
Select and begin a Bounty by talking to Quinn in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet:
Shigg-

Have you dropped your mind? We’ve chipped on those scaffolds together since we were kids. Filled your empty bowl with half of mine. Every time. That is our way, our law.

I’m giving you until moonfall before Elder Konzu hears you’ve been skimming.

-|HINT|

'By the Unum' nothing! I am connected, you understand? I am told your client can only be one person. How you found them I do not know but by the Void we will all pay for your ignorance. And now you've dragged me into this? That they even know my name is a gun to my head! 

Now: either you get me an Orokin-era |HINT| or this broadcast unit is as good as dead. And so are we. 

-BV

You remind me of this Venusian kid I knew, pitched me a big score reselling K-charges on the low market. Look at all those munitions, he said, like a threshcone harvest!

Kid was talking about those lanes of unexploded Grineer field ordnance. Just drift up and pluck those detonators off, real gentle. Easy money! You heard of him? See?

Easy money packs hard truth.
The eye projects a flickering symbol from its faintingly glowing gem.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor: A datapad containing a catalog of luxury items - the kind affordable only by the highest echelons of Corpus society.
Transmit wave reading shows |HINT| Picos, not great, not terrible. Should link up fine to whatever interface this Ostron's got.
Variant of the standard-issue Corpus workforce gear. Serves protection and identity-masking requirements.
A typical Corpus identification plaque. Assignment details on reverse.

Some Corpus I turned out to be. Helping refugees, smuggling debt slaves. Mother would turn white if she could see me now. 

Running this wheel... it’s |HINT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ent:
Search crime scenes to gather evidence.

Use the evidence to navigate the mysterious Glassmaker's Weave for clues about the killer.

Battle Cephalites in missions to earn required Cephalite Resonance (5) to enter the Weave.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri:
Learnings of the Motherworld, New Loka Essays.

"We were designed by the Earth to live as part of the Earth. We cannot truly belong anywhere else, not in the whole of the universe."

Opportunity and Acuity, Protocols of The Perrin Sequence.

"'Create a problem then sell the solution!' No. To embrace Fraudulence is to embrace Idleness. Idleness creates dull minds. Dull minds fail. No. Opportunity is our watchword. Opportunity, and acuity."

On Strength, Cressa Tal.

"We think where once we obeyed. We bend where once we broke."
Gral born big. Big Gral follow. Small slugs hide. Big Gral find. Big kill small. Now Gral is small. No more |HINT|.
A plush toy, loved and well-worn... by a Grineer? Or does it hold some deeper, sadder significance?
Grineer comm-link circuits. Broad spectrum, ultra-long range. Weak cipher systems make remote compromise trivial.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf: A device for interfacing with the Weave. These markings indicate an unusual connection signature.
Metal restraints etched with the number |HINT|.
The shattered remnants of one who once received Nihil's judgement.
A tablet containing codifications of the laws enforced by Nihil.
Once carried by Nihil's jailers. This weapon was likely never needed, there was no escaping Nihil's judgement.

Dreams of the Dead Cred

Description: A data tablet that has seen heavy usage. Files are open on |HINT|.
A data tablet containing several encrypted dossiers.

Low capacity data storage device.

"We had it good under the Corpus. Debt in check. A future. Then Solaris United got into Mum and Dad's heads. And then Deck 12. They're gone, and I'm here, with all their debt and mine as well. I hear Vox knew Deck 12 was a risk, and Vox sent them all down there anyway. To burn."
Part of an unknown communications device intended for transmissions in the |HINT| mGal range.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ret: Exit Crime Scene? Revisit using the Nightwave interface.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Tim: Cephalite Resonance used to enter the Glassmaker's Weave
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea: Cutter's final note 'To whoever finds this'

I'm not proud. Never been proud. Just angry. It's all I ever had, and now I can let it go, knowing I made this happen. The System took it all from me, so the balance is squared. Let Nihil do what he will. His version of order can't be any worse than debt or war.

The traitors, the deceivers, will all get their time before him. Myself included - the Solaris turncoat.

I've played my part. Everything is in place. I know what awaits me. And I don't care. It was worth it.

Maybe the terror will keep people honest. Maybe that'll be a better life. Better than the one Vox took from me.

Lived too long in the shadow of the Tower. I had allowed myself the belief that all things Orokin were good, as the Unum is good. Not so. The past is no tree of plenty, not all of its fruits sweet.

Ah, that this should be the last thing I learn: 'not so.' 'Not so', learned at the hand of a demon self-made...

Colonial after-action report: Colonial Killsquad Trooper 67229 reported crossfire confusion. Is that true? Killsquad casualties were total with only Trooper 67229 returning. Trooper 67229 scheduled for recondition spiking at Saturn Five. Demotion to maintenance tier effective immediately.

With one mistake, the spreadsheet of my life tallies to a net ill. I have loosed a whirlwind upon the System - all life exposed beneath its mad and furious gaze. 

A dead thing furious at death. A lost thing that would steal meaning from all life. An ancient doom, and I have welcomed it in.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/AssassinateB: Draw Out the Target in |VALUE| Seconds
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo:
A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage that sends foes flying.
A good one for when you need your weapons to explode something or someone, into outer space.

For the record, I never blew up any elevator shaft to keep Corporate out of the Deepmines... But if I had, I would have used four-and-a-half buckets of Spring Poppers, and the explosion would have been glorious.
This one loves the soil in the Forward Base, lots of trace nitrates and glycerol left over from the mines were first blown out ages ago.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom:
This bizarre mushroom appears to be permanently frozen. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage. Icey slick sliding.
A taste of this and you’ll be dealing ice cold fury to anyone who gets on your mean side.
Watch your step though, Winter Spear makes everything a bit icy dicey. I remember when Nokko would crush up a bunch and sprinkle the dust on a slope. He'd have the Sprodlings sliding for hours.
You can usually find Winter Spear clumping in the Forward Bases. She prefers the relative cold there.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus:
This mushroom appears to continually excrete a highly acidic mucus. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
This sour little fella loves to make quick work of heavy metals like the ones used in Corpus equipment and armor. Nokko used that trick on some of my equipment before I got to know him better.
Handle with care. Way back when I had a mate try to pluck some without using the special tongs. It cost him a very expensive arm and a leg. Now I always use the special tongs.
The toxic sludge seeping through the Forward Base keeps the Borica fruiting all year round.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush:
This fungus appears to emit an electric charge. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_ELECTRIC>Electric Damage. Become lighting quick.
She’s a bolt of lighting. Quite literally. Useful for times when you want your weapon to turn your opponent into a walking arc welder.
The other roots and fruits seemed to work harder and faster when Thunder Button’s nearby. Try it yourself, if you need to be somewhere in a hurry.
You will find this one in the Corpus labs where it likes to leach off their power grid.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FieldResearc:
|OPEN_COLOR|GATHERING MUSHROOMS|CLOSE_COLOR|
The Deepmines are full of roots and fruits. Find mushrooms listed in the Field Guide in Deepmine Bounties, both as Bounty Bonus Rewards and from mushroom patches.

Fill out the Field Guide by Analyzing collected mushrooms. Fully Analyzed mushrooms increase the Nightcap Rank, allowing access to additional rewards.

Fully Analyze mushrooms to increase standing with Nightcap.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP: Cover your nose and hold your breath, this foul fella causes weapons to release a noxious gas with each strike.
Note: do not let the Sprodlings get into a patch of Reeking Puffball. All it takes is a couple bites and those little guys will start pumping out a stench foul enough to turn a kubrodon purple.
You can find this stinker in the caves, just follow your nose.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom:
This mushroom is always hot to the touch. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage. Not all will be as it seems.
Poison is in the dose. Use a little bit to warm up your belly. Put a whole stalk on your weapons to light up your targets from the inside. So hot it’ll weaken their armor.
Much of Venus is still a firestorm. Blister Stalk is the embodiment of Venus. A firestorm contained in fungus.
Scour the Nutrient Processing facility and you will probably find this guy sucking up the excess calories from the wastes.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro:
This mushroom is hard as an anvil and nearly as heavy. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
This is a mean one. Take this if you need to hit hard and have it hurt.
I once saw a rigjockey get hit in the head with one of these. Poor mucker claimed he could see nothing but Waverider graphicas every time he closed his eyes.
Search the Forward Base to find this guy. Plenty of heavy metal contamination in that soil for Ironwood to chew on.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job1Desc: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job2Desc: Got a Corporate manager causing all sorts of trouble from their forward base. Take 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job3Desc: Got too many merk-merks mucking up the garden in their Nutrient Processing center. Go deal with 'em.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/JobSPDesc: Busy day in the garden. Lots of tough muckers out there. You ready to get dirty?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush:
An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
This parasitic fungus that feasts on magnetic waves generated by Venus’ highly active mantle. Does nasty work to Corpus shields too.
Fun fact: Sprodlings love this one. Very much drawn to it, and you too, should you eat some.
This mushroom favors the Corpus Labs and the many magnetic fields within.

-Ordis
