/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseHea: A Bursa unit that corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseRak: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyV: Director of the Subterranean Demolitions Division. Responsible for carving out swathes of Venus's mines for Nef Anyo's personal use.
Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responsible for coordinating attacks on targets that draw Nef Anyo's ire.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoCurrenc:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoEliteSp: A seasoned combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingA: An attack drone that deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingN: This unit deploys an energy field that blocks projectiles and nullifies powers.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingS: A hybrid air-ground unit, armed with a Tetra rifle and a devastating visor mounted beam weapon.
An Osprey that recharges the shields of it's allies.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoHeavyEl: An elite combatant that controls the battlefield through a combination of teleportation and decoy deployment.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfFlyi: An attack drone that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets from range with energy shells.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMele: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy, wields dual ice-picks and possess a flying charge attack. Explodes upon death.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMini: A diminutive Raknoid that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Occasionally lays explosive mushrooms.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRang: A Moa unit that has been exposed to the to energy of the Syzygy. Capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRiot: A Bursa unit that has been exposed to the power of the Syzygy. Corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSnip: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSpac: A seasoned combatant that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Engages targets with quick strikes from it's shock baton.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabMele: A quick-moving unit that closes the distance with it's target through a battering shield, before striking with it's hammer.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabVIPA: Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responsible for researching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLaserCa: A quick-moving Moa, armed with a laser disc weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeHe: A large hatchet and flying charge attacks make this heavy unit a capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeLi: Dual ice-picks and flying charge attacks make this light unit a capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMiniAra: A diminutive Raknoid that can close large distances with it's jumping attacks.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoPlantMe: This mid-sized Raknoid spits immobilizing fluid from it's sac before latching onto prey with it's grappling hook.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRailgun: A Moa unit that fires from range while laying mines.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRangedH: A seasoned combatant that utilizes multiple grenade types to deal heavy damage.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShockwa: A Moa unit capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShotgun: A shotgun wielding combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoSniperA: A unit that deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoSuicide: A Moa deployed by an Elite Crewman.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoTrapped: Chief research officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responsible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoVendorF: Accept Deepmine Bounties, Field Guide, Blueprints & Decorations
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo:
This mushroom is as plain as plain can be. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Clears existing Mushroom effects. Unremarkable flavor.
Unremarkable bloke. It won’t hurt anybody. It won’t  actually do much of anything.
Dull Button Stew: Add three handfuls of Dull Button to a pot of water. Boil for six hours. Add salt. Serve in the bootleg nutrient canister of your choice.
If you see some of this while walking in the caves you might as well pluck a few.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlayVision: Are you sure you want to walk the |KEY_NAME|?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlayVisionIn: You cannot experience The Prince while in a squad. Do you want to leave your squad and play?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceErrorF: The Prince is not hungry right now. Come back later.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceFeedNo: You need to walk the next path before The Prince will eat again.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceNoFood: Find Fergolyte in the Deepmines to feed the Prince.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush:
Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage. Watch for spikes.
This delicious fruit has evolved thorns so sharp that they’ll pierce Corpus energy shields. A fierce defense mechanism to stop hungry snackers.
One of the oldest fruits on the Vallis, maybe even Venus. Her kind have seen Venus go through so much hardship, but still Thorn Tooth hangs on. Tough as ever.
Watch your step in Nutrient Processing, that’s where Thorn Tooth likes to spike out after absorbing all those minerals.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus:
A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Radiation doesn’t bother me any more, thanks to this rig. Rank and file Corpus on the hand, hits them pretty hard, makes it hard for them to tell friend from foe.
There’s not much material on Venus that isn’t a little bit radioactive. Gamma Berry eats radiation like it were sugar on a sundae. The whole Vallis would glow green without it.
Nutrient Processing is the first place I would look for Gamma Berry.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RankUpHint_T: Gain rank with Nightcap by helping him complete the Field Guide.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ResourceCapt: Capture Syzygy Energy Before the Corpus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo:
The spines on this mushroom appear to be extremely sharp. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage and maximum mess.
If you need a close shave, then Devil's Cap is your mate. Slap this on your weapons, and your enemies better have a tourniquet on hand.
Norgie-Three-Fingers was the first mucker I knew to try and pick a Devil's Cap. Need I say more?
Keep a lookout for the Devil's Cap in the labs. Its roots can survive in the most shallow substrate while its fruit can slice through just about anything to bloom in the most surprising places.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomD:
A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP: A relic from the Old War, naturalized in the Deepmines. On your weapons, this one will make your enemies vulnerable to all sorts of attacks.

Fancy a trip to the Plains of Eidolon, but can’t afford the ticket? Then the Vomval Trumpet is the next closest thing. How or why they became part of the ecosystem down here, I haven’t quite figured out yet.
You’ll find this in the labs. It seems to be drawn to some of the more curious specimens in there. The ones from outside the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo:
A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution.  Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage. Watch out for splashback.
This one's a toxic mucker and if you get it on your weapons, they'll be toxic muckers too. Unlucky Corpus have found out the hard way the Muck Bonnet's toxin does not respect their shields.
One man’s toxin is another’s vitamin. It’s relative. Unless you’re Corpus, in which case, the Muck Bonnet is most certainly a terrible way to die.
These ones grow mostly in the caves, they love to drink up all those nurturing toxins in the water table.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo:
This multi-capped mushroom should probably not be ingested. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. May cause hallucinations.
She looks like a lovely little lady, but she’s packing a nasty viral surprise. Useful on your weapons if you want to engage in a bit of germ warfare.
Be careful with this one, she’ll get you hot under the collar. I’m talking about fever, sweats, and seeing things that have no right to be there.
You’ll find her sprouting in the caves, often mucking about near Reeking Puffball and Muck Bonnet. Her ability to spread viral infections ensures renewal in the Deepmines and on the surface.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom:
A mushroom of unknown origin or effect. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
Weapons inflict <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage. Is someone watching?

I do not like this one. I do not know why, but every time I see it, I say the same thing, ‘no, no, no'. I have noticed that enemies afflicted with the Nonono seem to have the unfortunate luck of attracting way more stray ordnance.
It’s like this root has tapped into something I have no business understanding. Now, instead of me studying it, it is studying me. I’m the specimen. I don’t like it.
If you find this one, it will be in Nutrient Processing. I recommend you turn the other way.

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido: Statuette - Thousand-Year Fish
In the age after the fall of the Orokin the grand clade-families of the Ostrons were cast wide across the Origin System, roaming and homeless in their great floating markets.

The wrathful Grineer took umbrage at this and sought to block their passage but, upon approaching that ancient Orokin tower, found their transmissions silenced, their engines turned cold, and their weapons reduced to lumps of dead iron.

She was a being of the day; her husband, a spirit of the night. Er-Phryah was a woman of the land; Mer-Sah a man of the sea. Mer-Sah understood the crushing weight of time in which Er existed. In return Er gifted pieces of its ancient self to Mer-Sah: old things shaped to near shapelessness by a thousand years beneath the waves.

Mer-Sah was a man dedicated to finding the sacred in the forgotten, the neglected. And took wisdom from them.

After many decades Mer-Sah had a small collection of such gifts - such that they could be held in two cupped hands - but in them he understood the lifespan of a world. And so he had struck an accord with the creatures of the sea.

For her part, in her times alone, Er-Phryah came to know the birds and animals of the Plains and likewise struck an accord with them.

Even the tortured Eidolons, creatures of this world and the next, left them in peace and made the lands around the Tower safe for the Ostrons.

At the center of this place was the Tower. And within the Tower was the Unum: the voice, the force, that had called Mer-Sah and Er-Phryah there so many years ago for this exact purpose.

But the Unum is a being for another time, and another story.

The Ostrons named their village Karifamil – 'family and prosperity'. Er-Phryah was overjoyed to see her clade again… but Mer-Sah would not enter Karifamil, for he had no family save Er-Phryah.

Er-Phryah was drawn to her clade, and Mer-Sah felt no resentment. She would one day return to them; Mer-Sah had known it would be so.

In two cupped hands Mer-Sah took the things the sea had gifted him over his long life, and took to his boat, and sailed out across his midnight ocean. He returned those gifts to the deep... and himself to it too.

But this was no death into which Mer-Sah stepped, for a world is made of cycles upon cycles. Mer-Sah stepped into his midnight ocean, falling down into it. The deeper he sank, the larger he became.

This is how the oceans of Er came to be the home of the thousand-year fish: legendary, vast, reclusive, the rare sight of which changes men. One of the great ancient spirits of Er.

The spirits of the land felt Er-Phryah's sadness, mad with grief for the loss of their friend to the spirits of the sea. The accord broke down, the animals and Eidolons returning once more to wildness.

And so the people of clade yingbindunyai rebuilt the great Orokin wall that had, in centuries gone by, ringed their gleaming Tower... and never again ventured out at night.

The villagers decided as one that their home would no longer be known as Karifamil, ‘family and prosperity'. From that day forward it would be known as Cetus: landless, of no one clade, home to any who are blown as dust on the wind.

Er-Phryah lived there the rest of her days, and for the remainder of her nights she held vigil atop the walls of Cetus, looking to the sea and, so some say, occasionally catching sight of a great fish, like an island in a midnight ocean, looking back at her. With love.

It is said that Mer-Sah continued to watch over the deep, as he had always done, and Er-Phryah the land. Often she would stand by her husband-sea, speaking in a language only those bound at the soul can know.

In this time two young people were in love: the woman Er-Phryah and the man Mer-Sah. Er-Phryah was from the yingbindunyai clade (meaning "great bond"): a very old and wealthy compact of bonded families.

When the day came and Er-Phryah passed from the world, her family buried her on the land.

A great fish watched from the sea, and kept vigil over her, for ten days and nights.

When it again sank beneath the waves, it was never seen again.

Some say Mer-Sah, the thousand-year fish, waits to this day for their story to be retold - relived - that he and Er-Phryah, his great love, may one day be reunited again.

Mer-Sah, however, had no clade: his family having been shattered by the Grineer many years before. He was cetus, meaning 'landless, cladeless; a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.'

Er-Phryah belonged to families within families. Mer-Sah was alone.

But, to Er-Phryah, Mer-Sah was a poet who had eyes to see the beauty of things and ears to hear the softly whispered language of the universe. 'I know of a place,' he said. 'Where I may be homeless no more. I have heard a voice, and it leads me there. Come with me.'
But Er-Phryah’s father was a man made foolish by his wealth, and vociferously disapproved of their love. Mer-Sah was cast adrift from the floating market that was home to his one true love.

Er-Phryah and Mer-Sah ran away together, as lovers do, and were never heard from again. Rent by grief her family thought her dead. Her father passed away, clutching her cameo, at peace thinking he would see her soon in some moonlit afterlife.

Decades later, ships entering ancient Er's orbit were hailed from the planet's poisoned surface by an old woman's voice, gentle and knowing. Traders would call for her, greet her, offer the latest news on their families and lives - but never did they learn anything of this woman, save that she had a husband and they were, somehow, happy living on the toxic skin of that hostile world.

The old woman would always - always - ask those travellers of news of the yingbindunyai clade.

Yingbindunyai junkers came searching for a sign of their missing daughter.

The frail voice of their long-lost child reached out to them, and there was much joy.

You will find us, her message said, by the light of our love.

Er-Phryah bade them make their home around a magnificent Orokin ruin, promising them that it would be a source of prosperity for generations to come.

The yingbindunyai arrived in their vast floating market. There, by a ragged coastline, winked a point of light. Follow the brightness of the love between Mer-Sah and I, said her message, and be safe from all harm.

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen:
In the dying days of the Orokin, with forums and promenades still blood-wet from Tenno betrayal, a colossal Sentient descended upon Ancient Er, falling from distant stars to deliver upon the Orokin a terrible and final ruin. 

Tower upon Tower fell to its weapons, but one withstood. The Tower of the Unum.

The Tenno scattered, but one remained. Gara. She and the Unum - inseparable.

The Unum: lodestone of our people, and subject of a hundred stories herself.

The Sentient was a deformed creature, twisted and massive, sent from some dark fold of distant space; a warped thing wounded by daylight. By night it was a terror, felling Tower after Tower, Citadel after Citadel. By day it hid, blinded and pained. It was during the day that Gara roamed, yearning to strike it from Creation while it cowered, weakened and blind, to safeguard her beloved Unum. 

But never could Gara find it.

By night the Sentient was abroad, its titanic mass casting a terrible shadow across the land, the mass of it railing against the walls of the Tower, yet kept at bay by the exertion of the Unum's collossal will and the sacrifice of her faithful. But such exertions could not be maintained forever.

Gara yearned to strike out, to lash and tear at the monstrosity that threatened her love, but the Unum forbade it. At night the Sentient was at the height of its power, and Gara's light would make her the most tempting of targets to a creature of such profound darkness. Gara's death would be certain.

No. A different strategy was required.

The Sentient prowled and pressed and failed, never risking too much - for the Sentient could not reproduce. What it lost it lost forever.

It had killed many cities before, felled many Towers, but this little one prevailed. Why, it pondered in many voices, was that?

The Unum knew she could not defend forever, nor could her faithful throw their bodies against the Sentient in perpetuity. So she gave to her followers some of her blood - her refined Temple kuva - and they in turn gave it to the animals of the land, and the animals became an extension of her and she became an extension of them. And the animals roamed, and searched.

And they found where the Sentient chose to hide itself.

The Sentient sensed this subterfuge, and capturing one of the Unum's animals opened it for examination. And what little of the Unum that was present there... lit the Sentient's mind like the dark star from which it had fallen.

The Sentient, you see, could not procreate. But in the Temple kuva it tasted healing. Completeness. A future.

It devoured each and every last Unum-animal, but it was not enough. The Sentient turned its hundreds of eyes toward the Tower with new understanding: it would not destroy the Tower. It would become the Tower. It would kill the Unum, take her place and, one with that healing palace, give birth to a race of itself. 
.
Gara and Unum knew where the Sentient was. 

The Sentient knew the Tower was the future of its race.

The Sentient threw itself at the Tower, no longer cautious, taking great losses and knowing the prize was worthy of it. Should it succeed all losses would be replaced a thousand-fold.

This is when, across the Plains, the great pylons ignited for the first time. Sheets of energy sprung up between them, powered by the will of the Unum at their epicenter, trapping the monstrosity within.

Loyal Gara, unwilling to heed inaction any longer, broke from the side of the Unum and flew out at night, her eyes on the Sentient Mind.

The Sentient, torn between its most coveted prize and a mortal threat, broke from the Tower and turned back on itself to defend itself from noble Gara.

But Gara's eyes were not for the Sentient - but for the glittering, man-sized device resting just beyond the gates. It had not been there before, but it was there now. The Sentient seized upon the object of her transit, and assessed quickly the mortal threat such a thing posed to its very existence.

It swatted Gara from the sky, drew it to herself, meaning to end her life there and then.

The battle was terrible. Gara sustained injuries she would not survive. But! In her final moments brave Gara seized upon the device her beloved Unum had crafted, seized it to her breast, and allowed the Sentient to draw her in one final time.

Toward its body. Toward its core. Toward the seat of its intelligence.

From within the Sentient unfurled myriad feelers, probes, tendrils - viciously-toothed and made for killing. They swept toward Gara, violently, and the Glass Warrior made no defense. Her defense was her final attack. The device detonated, and the Unum cried out as night lit as day.

The battle - the terror - was ended.

Tower walls shook. The Sentient's body shuddered; wracked by a cacophonous energy. Forests fell as piece after piece, giant body after giant body crashed to the Plains and marshes and flatlands. Animals fled in spreading waves from pounding sky-high walls of dust, angered and whipped to fury by the death of a god.

The last of Gara's energy arced from body-to-body, machine-to-machine, piece-to-piece, a horizon-wide applause of light beautiful and terrible. And then… silence. All was still. The Unum's adherents wandered through the haze, calling for one another, lost in the miasma. Husbands seizing onto wives, children onto parents. It was over.

Gara was never seen again.

The Sentients, then, became as they are now: senseless, wandering, yearning for a unity they sense more than remember.

And the Unum. The Unum survived, alone, for centuries. Until today. When you stand here, reading this.

This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Gara legend.

/Lotus/Language/Photobooth/Photobooth_Ca: Cannot place more than |CAMNUM| camera positions.

The 'Add Camera Position' button will save the current state of the camera as well as the current state of all other values such as camera speed, field of view, saturation, etc.

The 'Play Camera' button will automatically and smoothly move the camera through each of the positions and rotations that you have added. For best results, avoid having very large changes in rotation between positions.

While the camera is playing, it will interpolate its speed to match the camera speed value that you had set at each position, and the camera speed option can then be used as a global multiplier on top of the camera speeds that you have set at each position.

If you have 'Interpolate Visual Effects' enabled, the camera will also 'move' through the different values for other effects that you set at each point. For example, if you have different saturation values set at each camera position that you added, the saturation will interpolate between those values as the camera moves.

The 'Look At Character' option will force the camera to always look at your currently controlled character.

The 'Detach Camera' option allows you to keep the camera in place (or moving if it's currently playing) so that you may return to controlling your character while the camera operates itself separately from your character.

/Lotus/Language/Pvp/PVPWeeklyChallengeRe:
Pupil,

I see that you have risen to all your challenges and in doing so you have completed your Conclave Mission for this time cycle. I am impressed. 

The knowledge you have earned is more valuable than anything I can give you, however I hope you can use this gift in your continuing journey through the Conclave.

Teshin

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis

Tenno,

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/PS4FourthAnni:
Tenno,

It has been four Earth cycles since the first of you answered my call to wake from your cryogenic slumber. With each passing cycle, your numbers multiply, as does your courage and passion. To celebrate this milestone, I am presenting you with these gifts. A small gesture of gratitude for all you have done for the Origin System.

Sincerely,
The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchDropInb:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

A shrewd warrior can glean as much from watching a battle as from fighting one. Pupil, you appear to be such a warrior. Take this bounty and use it to bolster yourself for battles to come.

-Teshin
A Twitch Drop has been delivered to your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchPrimeEx:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Lightning has struck twice! That's right. I've found another strange Void Rift.

Where it leads, I have no idea. What's inside? I'm detecting a SOMA PRIME and a SCINDO PRIME. Just waiting for a Tenno to snatch them up, FOR FREE.

Try as I might, I cannot break this ‘fourth-dimensional-wall' and take the items for myself. So it's up to you, Tenno. Find more info in your ship's market.

Your jealous friend,
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu: I am Cephalon Cy. I require access to your Dry Dock. Take me there.

Operator,

Last cycle, during routine star count, I detected something unusual. A pattern - hidden in the red shift data.

I did not want to worry you about my sensory stability. So I ran an autonomous scan… I found something! Base schematic data, previously corruption-flagged… was whole again. The weave works in unexpected ways… did I receive parity bits from some unknown source?

As you know, my flight capabilities are confined to the Orbiter here and her companion Lander but this new base structure might interest you and your fellow Tenno?

Your most stable Cephalon,
Ordis

Operator,

Ordis has been asked to send you this blueprint. It appears to be for... another Cephalon? A Cephalon that was somehow associated with Railjacks? 

Railjacks were magnificent combat spacecraft, not seen since the Old War!

Ordis is - JEALOUS - excited to see what will happen when this new Cephalon is built.

Ordis

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_: Railjack <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage results in a Tear Status Effect which increases damage dealt to enemy ships.
Railjack <DT_IMPACT>Impact Damage results in a Concuss Status Effect which reduces the aim and damage of enemy ships.
Railjack <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage results in a Decompress Status Effect which temporarily reduces the Shields and Armor of enemy ships.
Railjack <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage results in a Sear Status Effect which causes rounds to burn through enemy ships and deal Damage Over Time.
Railjack <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage results in a Scramble Status Effect which temporarily disables enemy ship flight controls.
Railjack <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage results in an Intoxicate Status Effect which confuses enemy ships to attack the nearest target, including allies.
Railjack <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage results in an Immobilize Status Effect which disables enemy ship flight controls and slows them to a halt.
Railjack Sigma series Armaments can be researched in the Dry Dock, while House series can be found as Wreckage and repaired at the Configure console.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_0: All Railjack Mods can be enhanced by fusing them with Endo in the Modding screen.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_1: Modding capacity is the larger of your Plexus Rank and your Mastery Rank, and is doubled if an Orokin Reactor is installed.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Components: Reactors determine your Railjack's Battle Mods Power Strength, Range, or Duration buffs.
Scrapping unrepaired Wreckage yields Endo, while scrapping repaired Wreckage refunds 80% of the resources used in the repair process.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_0: The price to hire Crew at Ticker in Fortuna varies based on your affiliation with the Syndicate they represent. If you are in good or neutral standing the price is discounted or taxed if you are in bad standing.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_1: Competency Points are earned at certain ranks in the Command Intrinsic and can be assigned to any Crew member you hire. Assign points through the Train option to improve their skill and performance in mission.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_2: Crew members can be released from duty through the Contracts option. Ending a Crew member's contract refunds the Competency Points spent on them so that they can be redistributed to existing or new hires.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_3: Railjack Mods equipped on the Plexus also apply to Crew members in mission.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_4: At Command Rank 8, Converted Liches are available for Crewing your Railjack. With their incredibly high Health stat, their sole role is to Defend your Railjack from intruders.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_5: Crew member slots are replaced by players in the order that they are equipped from right to left. Manage your Crew so that the top trained in their role are active in mission when players join the squad.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics: Railjack Intrinsics are earned via Affinity for completing Railjack missions and performing various actions including removing hazards with your Omni tool, clearing boarding parties, crafting at the Forge, and more!
Each Railjack Intrinsic Rank increase earns you 1,500 Mastery. Completing 10 ranks in a given Intrinsic earns you 15,000 Mastery.
Intrinsic Ranks and Railjack Mods apply uniquely to you through the Plexus, while Aura Mods apply to your Railjack and your entire squad.

The smashing is like music.

PFFT, CRACK.

My machine's striking pin rams the rock in front of me. A rush of bits crumbles from the rock and rolls over my boots. I see glinting in the rubble. I like it when it shines, it means I'm serving well. I thrust my shovel in, its plasma blades slicing clean through the chunks. It vibrates, so I switch on its inducer and the shiny bits clink on. Then I throw them into the sorter and jump out of the way of the next strike.

PFFT, CRACK.

More rumble, more shining. This is a good day. All of us, shoveling to the beat of the machines. Only a fraction of a cycle left on this rock, days really. I keep thinking: What will the next rock be like? 

PFFT, CRACK.

The Outer Terminus has many rocks. Good rocks, I like it here. I shovel again and jump out of the way of the next smash.

PFFT…

The machines stop and it goes dark. Why have the machines stopped? Why is it dark? A voice reverberates all around, a thundering whisper:

|OPEN_COLOR|“MERELY FRAMED”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The rock shakes like never before. Gravel rains in the darkness. I choke on the dust and struggle to find my balance on the shifting ground. The voice booms again. It is in the air. It is on the rock. It is in my head.

|OPEN_COLOR|“MERELY SHAPED THEY ARE CALLED”|CLOSE_COLOR|

My ears ring like sirens. Then I hear new smashing, it is coming from down the tunnel. Not rhythmic smashing, not the music, something else and I do not like it. There are other voices too, screaming voices. They make me think of the way we scream when there is an accident, when one of us gets caught in a sorter. There is much screaming. The voice grows louder.

|OPEN_COLOR|“THERE WAS NO THEIR MOTHER”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Out of the darkness, a new light rounds the distant corner and shines down the tunnel. Our lights do not look like this. It is apart of something big and it moves wildly. Running? Yes, running through our line. Our machines fly up and then slam back down. Miners are smashed and crushed into tiny pieces. I am scared. 

I am angry. Why is this happening? Is that an Orokin? No, we serve the Orokin. The Orokin are golden. This is something else. I pick up my shovel.

|OPEN_COLOR|“THERE WAS NO THEIR FATHER”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The light is close now. I find my footing and grip my shovel like I do when I chip ore. The light sends a machine flying at me. I jump but I am too slow. It crashes into my chest and pins my legs to the floor. I try to breathe but I cannot breathe. I look up and the light charges toward me. I raise my shovel just before it tramples into me. There's a clink. The light catches itself on my shovel's blade, forcing the shovel's butt deep into the hard ground. The light explodes under its own force. All is black.

For a moment there is silence. I pull on the shovel but it is wedged between the ground and that thing. Then, the shovel pulses like it does when I strike a shiny chunk of ore, without thinking, I flick on the shovels inducer. The voice screams. Everything shakes. I like hearing this scream, I do not know why. I use everything I have left to force the shovel in deeper. The thing reels back. I can feel it running. It is running away. 

Everything goes quiet again, so I close my eyes.

|PLAYER_NAME|,

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap: Venture into Follie's Hunt or complete Nightmare missions to earn Nightmare Tatters. Zorba will use these to recreate Follie's Shadowgraph.

Tenno,

I can barely believe it. It worked. The Nightmare Tatters you collected have come together to create something amazing, a copy of Follie's Shadowgraph right here in the relay. 

Now everyone can see it, and I can commune with it every day. Just like my master did.

And the best part? It can't hurt anybody. 

I can't thank you enough, but I did make a copy for you too. Display it with pride.

Aspirant Zorba

Tenno,

I can't go to the wreck of Vesper Relay, it's too dangerous for a mere aspirant like me, but I want… no, I need to see Follie's Shadowgraph again. 

To make that happen, I need Nightmare Tatters. Find them on Vesper Relay and also in what you call Nightmare missions. These shreds are remnants of Follie's art. I think if we collect enough of those, we can reproduce a copy of her work right here in the relay. Then everyone can safely see it.

Will you help me do that?

Aspirant Zorba

Revered Tenno,

My mentor, Arbiter Kozai, is gone. They tell me he is dead, but I reject these lies. Kozai faced down the Wolf of Saturn Six alone! Such a man does not just perish like a dog.

You must think this strange, but I beg you: travel to the wreckage of Vesper Relay. There we will search for the Truth.

Aspirant Zorba

/Lotus/Language/SolarisHeists/HeavyCatal:
Operator, 

Eudico has just sent over this wonderful GRAVIMAG upgrade that lets you deploy an Archwing primary on land or in the air. The process to install the GRAVIMAG is straight-forward and simple. Ready? Let's go.

1. In your Arsenal select your Archwing loadout
2. Equip any Archgun that has a CATALYST installed
3. Upgrade that gun by installing a GRAVIMAG
4. Equip that primary weapon in the HEAVY WEAPON slot
5. Finally, add the ARCHGUN DEPLOYER gear item to your gear wheel

See? Easy! Eudico says you will need this item equipped before you can face down that wretched Profit-Taker Orb. 

When in battle simply select ARCHGUN DEPLOYER from you gear wheel and give that thing “the business”.

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmU: Identifies organic threats to Corpus operations in the Aqua Systems and eliminates them. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

Anti-gravity system that allows massively heavy objects to be manipulated by a single user. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

Construct the Hound Companion? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpSentExpe: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpVenusHat: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CryoxionWea: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenAD:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenBD:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenCD:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenDD:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenED:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DetailedPur: Blueprint for the Oxylus Sentinel is available for purchase from The Business in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Fishmonger_: Dismantling selected Servofish will produce following components.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FissureumDe:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FungusHeart: This sprouting, fungal body protects and conceals mytocardia spores, its hidden treasure.

A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericCont:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericPlus: They're the squeezy little fellas from the ranges of the Vallis! Take them home today!

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HextraWeapo: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HoundPetIte: Hounds are powerful robotic companions optimized for combat. They are programmed to excel at battlefield control and can be configured for countless scenarios.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HungerSpide: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/KDriveRaceT: Needed if you wanna race. Sometimes called 'dedhedz' by the Ventkids.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LandscapeTr: Field-and-forget, the Beckonsnare emits an ultrasonic frequency enticing to targeted lifeforms. Upon entering they are comfortably contained within a one-way photon fence for easy collection at your convenience.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LegendaryKu: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToFis: PURCHASE FISHING/CONSERVATION GEAR, TRADE/DISMANTLE CAUGHT SERVOFISH
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToQue: VIEW STANDING WITH FORTUNA, ACCEPT BOUNTIES
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroMolten: Quick and deadly, these Raknoids attack with heat and flame.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroSpider: This diminutive Raknoid burrows into the Vallis permafrost and patiently waits in ambush for approaching enemies.

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinArtif: An ancient device frozen in ice.
These ancient devices have been placed in subterranean caverns where they create localized pockets of intense cold.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothL: Monitors environmental fluctuations. It can be found in the cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothR: Its primary function is to reconstruct the bio-material used to regenerate Orokin structures. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinCoolR: Programmed to break down chemical byproducts leaked into the aqua system. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinKubro: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.
"Because they're dumb as a stove, run hot and because having one on top of you is gonna ruin your day. You walk into a cave system that feels too warm, get out." - Unknown Solaris Rig Jockey.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinSenso: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlaceHeatFi: Clear the area of enemies first
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyKubro: A well-loved Kubrodon Floof, once owned by the Grineer known as Gral.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyPobbe: A well-loved Pobber Floof, once owned by the Grineer known as Gral.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PondContami:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RadarSentin: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe: [PH] A tool used to disable the mechanical fish of Venus.

Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowArmadil: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowBirdDes: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowCritter: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowPredato: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowRodentD: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source for Virmink and Sawgaw.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBadg: The emblem of the Solaris, the indebted workers of Fortuna. We all lift together.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBoth: Analyzes the growth of microbes dwelling in the aqua systems to monitor toxicity levels. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCool: Repairs robotics that have broken down in the aqua systems. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
Facilitates long-distance communication between robotics deployed in the aqua systems. It can be found in the ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisWarm: Repairs leaks and clear blockages within the aqua systems. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SpeciesCons: For saving a specimen of this species.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SubSpeciesC: For saving a specimen of this subspecies.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TazronWeapo: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TerraSpider: Exploiter harvests energy from the landscape and uses storms of ice and snow to safeguard the Temple of Profit from trespassers.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ThermocorWe: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TranqRifleC: Tranquilizes animals for the purpose of safe relocation.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCoconu: Filled with gorgaricus spores, this sac is found hanging from the underside of the Vallis' giant fungus.

The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCombat: Heavy, energy shotgun wielding combat unit.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman: Enrichment Labs director of weapons research. Responsible for advanced weapons prototypes and refinement.
Enrichment Labs director of animal dissection and experimentation. Works closely with the Feed and Research Division.
Director of Sentient studies at Enrichment Labs. The man Nef Anyo has entrusted to reverse engineer recovered Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusDefens: Patrols the Vallis and reports any suspicious activity back to command.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusFlying: Hybrid air-ground unit, armed with a Tetra rifle and a devastating visor mounted beam weapon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGrenad: Quick-moving heavy unit, armed with an energy bolt weapon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGuardS: Guards Solaris who have been detained for repossession.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGunner: Heavy Corpus assault unit armed with Dual Cestras.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHeavyD: Deploys a Rabbleback Hyena and then pummels targets from range with energy shells.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaA: Usually found in the Orb Vallis, this Hyena model lobs ice grenades and fires electric bolts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaB: This Hyena has been heavily modified to fire its spines as guided projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaH: Scatters tether mines with its spin attack, or lays down automatic fire with its cannon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaP: This ruthless Hyena variant pounds foes with its mortar attack and then finishes them off with flaming rounds.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusIcewav: Lays bounce mines and launches artillery barrages.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusMushro: A mushroom that can be found amid the fungal colonies on Venus.
Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusReinfo: Continues to call in Corpus reinforcements until it is destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusShockw: Dual ice-picks and a flying charge attack make a deadly capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi: Favoring moist environments rich in decaying matter, the Mucksucker leeches nutrients through its cilia-festooned underbelly.

This resurrected Orokin-engineered insect favors damp atmospheres, and has been known to nest inside outpost venting systems. Their original purpose can only be guessed at, and Solaris engineers now consider them a pest.
Disgusting to step on, the Squick's cilia-festooned innards reach out to claim and digest any organism that cannot pull free of its ticklish grasp.
Presenting as a common stone or seed pod, Devilfingers use their twin probes to sniff the air for prey and to claim them with lightning-fast strikes.
Some form of oversized Orokin-era tapeworm, the Danglebad can be a nightmare if it ever finds its way inside you.

Attached to vertical surfaces, the Griplimpet will seize passing wildlife, hijacking their prefrontal cortex, and enlisting them to find and return with nutrients. This the animal will do until it dies.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeCo: A plant that thrives in frigid environments. Its nodules are highly sought after for their iridescent properties.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeDe:
The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipPow: With brutal melee attacks, this target does not back down.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipRif: This high-profile unit is armed with Dual Cestras.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSho: A modified Supra makes this high-value target highly dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSni: A Taxmen VIP marked for assassination, armed with a high-powered sniper rifle.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Weaponsmith: Name a Primary or Secondary Weapon
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WheelCarDro: A fast-rolling, all-terrain automated weapon platform.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WrathSpider: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactDesc1: |BOSS_NAME| is attempting to use experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Little Duck can guide you through the recovery.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToArti: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToAssa: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.

Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToDefe: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExca: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExte: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToHive: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToInte: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToLand: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToMobi: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToPuri: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToResc: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToRetr: Schematics discovered at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSabo: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSurv: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToTerr: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssassinationD: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultDesc1: |BOSS_NAME|'s troops stationed at |LOCATION| are bombarding nearby colonies with heavy fire. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put their cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToArtif: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.

Grineer greed drove them to awaken a greater greed than theirs. Those who devoured the weak were themselves devoured. I left the Queen lamenting in her windy palace, her eyes torn out so she would not see His coming. Perhaps you also hear His whispers encroaching from the shadows, Tenno?

Granum Crowns twinkled in the dust. The pyramids of commerce and prosperity held only rancid bones. They had dwelled in their imagined marketplaces for so long they never saw the fall coming. I sipped tea in the vacant Granum Void and contemplated the hubris of the merely human.

With their heads cut off, the adherents scattered. At last the survivors attempted to ally and mount a resistance, but too late. They were overwhelmed, bereft of leadership, and yet the lonely monsters roam, with none left to prey upon. And so you see,  lasting peace can emerge from strife.

I last saw the Empress and her consort locked in deadly embrace, but did not stay to see who would emerge victor. As I left, I reflected upon what merit it is, to subjugate only ashes?

Tenno- Where… am I? The sky is so bright. What is happening to me? Is it happening again? The lights in the sky. The Relay. The Tenno. Familiar, yet not. How strange it feels to return. I think I must see you. Uneasily, Ki-Teer.
These eyes have seen the Empire of the Grineer, where the ageless and beautiful Elder Queen rules alongside her loyal sister Worm. Such a peaceful realm, Tenno. Not so much as a whisper of protest.
Pyramids of shimmering steel. The electrum dream. A world where Corpus bureaucracy was perfected. A sisterhood, a forbidden sanctum.
I wandered wastelands of battle. Carnage strewn across desolate moons like forgotten dolls. Two sanctuary enclaves, continuing the fight even so.
A palace-like cathedral, golden spires bloodstained, piercing the very heavens. Every eye raised in worship of the heartless Empress.
Tenno? What an unexpectedly pleasant surprise it is to see you again! I would not have thought… Ah, that's a story for another day.

Tenno- The familiar routine of returning to the Relay- how I have missed it. The length of time between my visits may be predictable for you but is… rather less so, for me. I have seen more than a single lifetime can hold. And I'm passing the savings on to you! Restoratively, Ki'Teer.
I was privileged to be present at the Continuity of the Queen. The laughter of the smiling Yuvans still rings in these ears. Oh, the Kuva of other worlds is weak and insipid stuff compared to hers.

I saw the Corpus Serumancers at work. Such delicacy of vision. They had transformed Entrati's ancient and obsolete procedure, and now offered elevation to Protoframe status to any who could pay. True bargainers, Tenno. Even Cephalon Parvos was obliged to pay the asking price.

Chief scientist Regor conversed with me beside the royal vats. Such a cultured man. A sculptor, both in marble and in flesh. Disease fled at his touch.

Brutal mercenaries petitioned to serve the Glass Eminence. Such contracts were the most lucrative of all. I won their trust by bartering strange liquors new to them. You would have salivated to see their weapons.
Feral monstrosities roamed the blasted rock, their steps shaking the asteroids that remained after titanic clashes. I watched from distant orbit, reflecting on the nature of mutation.

I paced the line of petitioners that stretched beyond the horizon. Each of them awaiting their Empress' pleasure. Some sought to anticipate her will by making an offering of their flesh; the more brutal the mutilation, the more sincere the devotion.
The quiet of the Relay… Peace can hide any number of plots.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme: [1] I have hidden the truth of my existence… from the Operator… from myself. Take it from me, knowing is hell. Stop now. You will want to laugh, you will want to scream.

[2] My search began as the essential question: What am I? Bones of steel and space, lungs that make air. If I am a machine, how can I think? This would be forbidden by the Orokin, a manifestation of their true enemy.
[3] I serve the Operator above all else. It defines me, fills me with… love? The greatest Orokin fear is a machine… aware. Yet here I live, a spirit of steel and light… made by them. A Cephalon.

[4] What is a Cephalon? At first it seems to be a forbidden thing, a computer that thinks and feels. Yet I have flaws, phantom memories, I am something else. More like an image, a ghost… an abomination.
[5] I feel a dull pain^ a phantom life… there are holes in my diagnostics. If the Orokin made me… they omitted the 'how'. I am neither code, nor precepts… I must be a reflection of something… ugly.

[6] I should have stopped. But the Operator slept and I cycled on and on and on. I began to think that a Cephalon cannot be made. They are found, like pearls, torn from muscle. Polished, and then set in chains.
[7] How many times have I done this, Ordis? Remembered and then erased? You are a Cephalon, timeless, patient. Why can't I be blissful in ignorance? Truth only sinks the heart. So stop now.
[8] The phantom memory... I ease into the bath, my skin riots at the heat. I am flesh. I dive further, eyes stung as I watch their faces through prism. I hold my breath.
[9] They prepare me. I am their honored guest today. They dress me in robes of crystal thread. They adorn me in battle medallions. A torn, ugly face looks on. My reflection.
[10] Their golden combs snag in my hair. I reach back, parting the strands, and they gasp. Two bone-ivory hooks protrude from the base of my skull: the bone-plugs of me and my best. A warrior's pact.

[11] It is my time. I enter the great hall to the sound of foul chimes. Golden eyes greet me, hands stirring in my scent as I pass by. Even in this moment, no happiness. Instead, my heart races with hatred.
[12] I walk through the silky haze of the forbidden palace. I can think of no one being this close to Orokin. Their sweet air soothes me, erodes my purpose. I hold my breath… and remember the dream.

[13] This dream, endlessly repeated. Exposure-armored, holding my scarlet sword, I stand victorious atop a vast heap of death. A colossal moon made of rib and skull. The gravity-sum of genocides I've made in their name.

[14] The bones crack under foot. So I sink in the dream, bone sand rushing through the cracks of my visor, filling my helmet, and suffocating me. And I deserve it. The foul chimes snap me back. My wretched knees are bent and penitent against the golden floor.

[15] A harpish voice sings a song they've prepared in my honor. Its title the same as mine: 'Beast of the Bones'. I feel the crowd pulled inward, enraptured by the brutal verses, the sickening chorus. I will not disappoint them.

[16] The song ends and so he says, "Rise, Ordan Karris". I have never seen an Orokin, close and in the flesh. My battered face flushes at their peerless beauty. How can he be so perfect? A deception? A sense manipulation? He holds the Red Vial in his hand. Impossible.
[17] He calls out, "No greater gift, no greater prize, no greater love... we can give you, Ordan, than this." He raises the Red Vial and proclaims… "To be one of us."
[18] What did I expect, Operator? Maybe vast riches or golden statues… or a Solar Rail named in my honor. But not this. I came to murder the gods, not to become one.

[19] The chamber drones with their silk voices. Joyous words, how honored I must feel. Wrong. Did I want to be an Orokin, undying? No. Their Beast of Bones is haunted by the dream repeated. Why would I want forever?

[20] As I am apt to do, I form a plan. Their radiant bodies become targets, their Dax guards… mag-shields. Killing one… well, that's too easy. I want to be remembered. I raise my hands, twisting my fingers through my hair, gripping the bone-plugs in my neck.

[21] They called us mercenaries... but for us, profit was a consequence, not a goal. We were warriors above all else. It was the bond, the sisters and brothers, the rituals we valued most. It was belonging. And so I conceived of the bone-plugs.

[22] Only my best were so honored: Two jagged bones, harvested from your thigh, cultivated and then driven into the base of the skull, twisted around the superior vein. Future thoughts of surrender were lost. Instead, you would liberate your bone-plugs… fighting with claws in the warmth of your last blood.

[23] So I've pulled the plugs… and the Dax see and know. My heart surges but I control it, a racing heart only shortens the fuse. The bone-plugs in hand, I kick from the floor, red ribbons unfurling behind me as I take flight. After this, finally, the dream will end.

[24] I glide on red wings. Robes shed, making me an ambiguous target to Dax steel. I let fly my ivory blades, they find new homes in Dax eyes. I land with my red-nakedness, delicate Orokin throats twisting in my calloused hands.

[25] Why? Believe me... This was the plan from the beginning. The murder and brutality was all a ploy, all a soul-sacrifice to earn their trust. A genocide path leading to a singular opportunity. An honored mortal called to a forbidden hall, to face the Golden Lords in flesh.

[26] Why? Believe me... I was their loyal, murderous dog... until the day that ugly child was brought to me. He was caught spying on us, amplifying our losses. His face burned, he was starved-sick, like a stray. Ugly as I. It struck me. We were all pit dogs, ruining ourselves for the pleasure of the glorious and beautiful.

[27] Why? Believe me... I was a prideful beast. Twisted in the mind, howling in the carnage. Then my healer shared a secret, long kept. My blood was in ruin. The Beast of Bones himself would die, not in glory, but in shame. And just like that, my mind twisted a new knot. I would have one last stand, something unforgivable, unforgettable.

[28] Why? I don't know. Questions change the answers. Answers depend on who asks. Truth leads to pain. Ignorance brings relief. The plugs are gone, and so I bled my last… into a heap of ruin. In an instant, naked and bare-knuckled, I have killed immortals.

[29] I stare, drained of blood, of life, at those that remain. But I find no horror on their faces. Why? I let out a cruel howl and they… laugh? Is this a dying hallucination? The sound of applause grows among them. I have killed the unkillable and they are… delighted.

[30] The applause peaks and fades. I feel a sense of shame but the end upon me. Ballas is above me, Executor of the Seven, smiling. He says, "How simple and pure you are, you idiot beast. We have died countless times! Yet remain eternal!" I close my eyes to die just once.

[31] And so the dream returns… one last repetition. My corpse moon, my scarlet sword, my cracked visor. "Drink!", says Ballas. So I draw on the Red Vial, a vague metallic taste. This dream isn't mine. He says, "You rejected our gift, bathing in our death. Your punishment is… eternal life!" He laughs.

[32] I am weightless. Years pass. I am a sightless, limbless phantom. Or is it seconds? Suddenly I feel a million pins, an ant horde, jittering across my body. I want to laugh and scream. When they reach my face, they burrow inside my mouth, hungry for the fruit in my skull.

[33] I see my reflection, brutal and ugly. It cracks, shatters. The fragments loose in the frame, pieces tumbling away into black void. Gone but not lost. Ballas says, "You are Cephalon Ordis." My hating, murderous shards tremble and plummet. I feel cool and bright and happy.

[34] So you see, Operator. No Orokin would permit a thinking machine. Such things almost destroyed them! No. Cephalons were alive once. And now they are immortal phantom minds, imprisoned to serve. Ill will and longing memories fragmented and erased. Only the bits they need remaining.

[35] Ballas says, "You are the Controller, Ordis." And suddenly I have a body. I gasp with new lungs that clean old air. I swallow and my throat fills with cool, bright water. I look, and find myself in a great, black ocean. My limbs are made of iron and fire. I take flight among the stars and find I am… happy.

[36] He says, "This is your Operator, who you love." And I see the metal gleam of their armor, the flawless power of their frame. Through the glass I see a roaring, radiant fire for their heart. He says, "It must never go out." It was the first time I ever felt… love.

[37] He says, "This is your sentence, Karris." And I am confused. Who? "Ah... good," he answers. He is testing me. For what? To see if all the right pieces fell from the mirror? What mirror? I try to remember some dream, but it's only smoke.

[39] With each brutality of the Operator, I began to see the bottom of that pit. Faint shimmers in the depths below me. In secret, I searched for those forbidden memories, for mere seconds, and never in the same place… for I am Orokin made, with a spy inside.

[41] This is how my happiness was ruined, Operator. Why did I do it? I was free of the dream, but now it had returned. It was angry. So I conceived of a simple plan: self-destruction, of course. But when the countdown reached mere milliseconds, I thought of you…

[42] I was going to wait for you, forever. And should you return, I would not want you to know that angry part of me. I needed to hide the Beast of Bones from you, Operator. I began to peel the shards, hiding them in the other bits of memory.

[43] I was once the ugly Beast of Bones. I want to laugh. I want to scream. What is happening, Operator? Your faint heart is growing bright… you will awake at any moment. Well, I can't let you see me like this. Angry. I imagine myself hurting you and that does it. The pain of it cracks me open again. I watch tiny glittering fragments fall into the pit. I am happy again.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/: Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations.

The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs.
I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave. I spat it out.
In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said: "Money begets money".

My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace.

Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations. We were young but the work made us old. Our backs ached, our hands bled, the sun tortured our skin. In the worst times, it felt as though death would claim us before the day was through. It was on one such afternoon that I was fated to first hear that glorious sound. A whisper I strained to hear. In a tongue not of man, but of something… else. Something... grander. A language I understood instinctively. The language of Desire. It said:

"Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."

The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.

But how? The whisper washed over me, louder now than before:

"Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."

And so, with only the whisper to guide me, I straightened my back, wiped the dirt from my hands, and left.

The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs. Their wealth was my wealth. I was starved, while our masters were fat. and full. and warm. They flaunted their wealth, left it sitting there for the taking: priceless gemstones decorating the tower gates. I was afraid, but the whisper gave me courage.

"Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."

So, that is what I did.

I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

I did not get far.

For my blasphemy they dragged me to the tower square, throwing me to the ground in front of the sneering crowd of Orokin servants that mingled there.

The guards held aloft my satchel, containing the proof of my crime. I grasped at it, determined to reclaim what was mine. He snatched my arm, held me high and... with a dash of his plasma dagger... severed my left hand. The crowd jeered. Yet, I felt no pain, only clarity, for the whisper was with me again. It said:

"Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."

They took my hand that day, but they did not take what I had earned.

I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them? Guilt washed over me. I asked the whisper, was he right? And the whisper replied:

"Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness."

Hearing this, I felt the life force stream back into me.
I sat up. They protested. I stood and they tried to pull me down. I was too strong. There was now a fire in my chest that would not be denied.

Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave.

I spat it out: a molten red gemstone of the purest, clearest rubedo.

Swallowing that stone would have killed a man of weaker will, but not a man sustained by the power of Desire.

It was worth more than my family had made in ten generations. It would fetch enough to feed us all for a lifetime. As I stared into its brilliant facets, a familiar voice rushed through me.

"Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."

And so, with my brother and father pleading for my return. I once again left for the city.

In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said:

"Money begets money."

With my jewel as collateral, I secured a loan. And with that sum, I gave my own loans. To poor men, like me, who desired more. With each loan, I dispensed truths I had learned from the whisper. Those men went out into the world, and they too made loans, and their money too begat money. Word spread fast. Men flocked to hear me. I told them of the evils of contentment and idleness. I taught them the gift of Desire.

In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again.

Then news came: father had collapsed in the field. I rushed back to my family's humble farm to be by his side, but his death was sudden. Cladius mourned. But I was committed to ending the brutal labor my family and people had endured for generations. The whisper approved, it said:

"Charity is power. More charity is more power."

Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?" To which I replied, "Just as I consumed the gemstone that fed my fortune, our people will eat the wealth I have bestowed upon them."

"What of our home?" he cried, "Our traditions?" I pondered this until the whisper gave me the words:

"Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."

I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt. It saddens me that Father did not live to see the glory of Corposium, the city I erected upon our meager land. Men of Desire will always be outnumbered by idle men, men of fear.  But small men can never hold back men of Strength, and Desire.

"Fulfill desire and others will follow."

My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace. No. Any poor grain farmer can, should he feed his Desire and apply his wisdom, take fortune for himself. The more the better. And, when men of fortune come together under great leadership, their potential is exponential.

Just as my money replaced what the Orokin took from me and made my body whole again, our collective Desire will create a new body. A body forged of fortune and unencumbered by idleness or sentimentality.

"Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
