A noble choice I won't soon forget.
Very well. Let it have its freedom.
I'll let you say goodbye, then. Well done.
It came from the Cambion Drift. Maybe it's time to let it go back home, never to return to your side.
If you let your companion go, you'll never see it again. But you will have my respect.
Has the time come to set your loyal friend free forever? The decision rests with you.
Just in time. Stasis will arrest the spread of the Infestation for now. Bring the stricken beast to me, and we can discuss how to proceed.
You've saved its life, Tenno. It'll serve you loyally, but first, we need to address the Infestation in its system. Pay me a visit soon.
Good work. That tranquilizer will stop the Infestation in its tracks. Bring the specimen to me, and we can decide what happens next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl: What you did with those... things... was a deliberate insult.
Wait. Is that… why you did it?
Do you remember when I first bred Infested? How we played with them for hours.
I'm sorry you don't appreciate my sense of humor. But I did make you happy, didn't I? When you killed them.
Vilcor, my sweet sire. What good is a weapons expert without something to kill?
Your work proceeds, my son. Clearly you thrive in isolation.
Outside your control. Shackling me was never going to work.
'Shackling?' You contaminated the family... and yourself! You had to be protected from these… mad urges.
You were worried about me. Thank you for the overdue recognition.
Your restrictions will be eased. Slightly. I name you Kermerros. The runner who outstrips his own shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions: Finding the parts necessary to make bait should not be too hard. Take down a few Infested and look for parts.
I suggest eliminating Infested in the vicinity to secure bait-construction materials.
In order to proceed, you will now need to gather materials.
Enhanced target eradicated. Going the extra mile there.
Target down. Eliminating this enhanced opponent will prove worth the trouble, I think.
Objective complete. Enhanced target terminated. A rousing display of martial vigor.
Infested will now be drawn to the Infusion. Terminate them close to the vessel to expedite the process.
This will draw more Infested. Dispatch them while they are close to the vessel in order to complete the bait.
This will lure Infested to the area. Kill them near the vessel to finish concocting the bait.
I have located a suitable vessel to use in creating the bait.
You should see a cauldron-like outgrowth close by you can use as a vessel to make the bait.
Use the vessel nearby to make the bait.
A shame to have missed an opportunity. Still, the bait remains useable if...mundane.
That is unfortunate. You can still use the bait; it just lacks that added 'oomph'.
Never mind then, we all miss out some times, y'know? Bait's still good, just not EXTRA good.
Warning. Juggernaut inbound. Kill it close to the vessel to enhance the bait.
An apex Infested is approaching. Slay it near the bait-vessel to infuse its ichor for improved effect.
You got a big boy comin'. Stuff that in your bait-box to max it out!
Hey, you got the big guy, huh? With that gore in the mix, the bait's gonna be irresistible!
Elimination of this enemy has substantially improved the effectiveness of the bait.
Good work. Extra effort that I believe will pay off handsomely.
That's no good! You gotta bop the infested near the jug, or we'll get nowhere!
Only Infested that are terminated in proximity to the vessel contribute to the Infusion.
If the Infested are eliminated too far from the vessel, this will not work.
Good. Now place the materials in the vessel and start the infusion process.
That should be sufficient. Use the vessel to begin infusing the bait.
We are now ready to begin the bait infusion. Move to the vessel to proceed.
Bait successfully deployed. The desired target is approaching. Eliminate it to fulfill mission parameters.
Proximity alert. Baited target has arrived. Immediate termination is advised...
Ah. The main event has arrived. Here's your chance. Kill the target.
Target eliminated. Congratulations on a job well done.
Confirmed target is down. Deimos just fractionally improved its odds of survival.
A flawless victory. Well, effective anyway. The target is no more.
Hostiles eliminated. None of these appear dangerous enough to fit the rather colorful descriptions of the infested we are hunting. Keep looking, Tenno.
Carnage comprehensively complete. Additional incentives/rewards have been authorized, well done, Tenno.
I don't think we found Mr. Scratchikins, but I think we've found some of his friends!
All done! You're absotively posolutely the best of what's left!
Excellent work, Tenno. With the ground well-prepared we can now proceed to the next step.
You will need to create a killing zone. Activate local excavators to clear yourself some room to maneuver.
Well, that showed them! I don't think any of those were Mr. Scratchikins though; he's a slippery one!
It will be necessary to clear nearby Infested in order to achieve optimal hunting conditions. Please proceed when ready.
The Cephalons tell me the Infested specimen was located and slain. A small victory, but victory nonetheless.

Loid tells me the target was eliminated along with a perhaps deadlier secondary target. Two entities working together would go a long way to explain the more lurid stories. A most satisfactory outcome.
There is a strong possibility the target can be lured here with the correct bait. Locate the relevant ingredients to proceed.
The Grineer confirmed losing several squad members to the infested you are hunting. I have uploaded coordinates to where the encounter occurred.
Wow, the grunters can't keep up with you! They look all mad hehe! They said we should go play with Mr. Scratchikins if we're so **expletive deleted**!
I bet if you check in with the Grinner survivors they can point you to Mr. Scratchikins!
Warning: You are now in the region indicated in the reports of a "murderous" infested, caution...
Oh, I can't wait to meet our new Mr. Bitey Scratchikins!

The Infestation is a marvel, in its own way; an endless fountain of ever-changing flesh, bone and gristle. A particularly murderous specimen has been reported assaulting other teams. Would you be so kind as to find it and put an end to it?
With the larger fellow out of the way, maybe there's a chance for me yet. Salvation!
You exterminated both the alpha specimen AND its mother? Most impressive! And unlikely. But impressive! Is the next step, by any chance, saving me?
Perhaps if you bait out the Prime Infested in the area - and kill it  - you might then retrieve me! You can do that, right?
Goodness. You Tenno really are as scary as they say. Oh, I'm getting a positive fix on you, please keep going.
They… they barely breached your perimeter! You're almost to me, don't stop now!
I...errr... I think you maybe stumbled on some sort of nest, there's a LOT more infested showing up out there. Guard yourself, Tenno.
Well, friend Latrox has marked off a few places NOT to look. I guess we keep going to the other places...
Well, if I'd had you around, I never would have gotten into this mess. Keep looking, Tenno, I think you're close.
Oh! Oh! Ah. Those pack of monstrosities that were chasing me gave up around there. I'm sure they've all crawled off by now, should be perfectly safe...
Congratulations, Tenno. As I said, Une has his uses. The sample data he just sent, for example, is... acceptable.
It's always nice to have one's expectations exceeded. You saved Une, and he, in turn, sent a large quantity of data. Most agreeable.
You made it! Oh, I could kiss those scary metal feet of yours! One last favor: Please watch my back while I collect the last of my samples, I can't go back empty-handed after all of this.
Hello? Anyone? This is Corpus representative Latrox Une. I'm lost, cornered by Infested, and my locator is... well, it's been eaten. I am in the direst need of assistance... help?
Oh perfect! Your signal is getting stronger, so you're getting closer to my position. Please keep at it!
My stars. Those chimeric monstrosities were never provided the remotest chance of disrupting things. You're terrifying. Well, come, save me!
You must locate me. I was near a Purifier before I got chased off, I remember that much. Perhaps look around there? Try to pick up my trail?
Unsurprisingly you are not our only guest. A stranded Corpus agent, Latrox Une, has run into difficulties amid the Grey Strain. Latrox is useful at times, kindly see if you can help him at all.
Hey, hey, who's the king? That's right; you're the king! Long live the king!
Parameters exceeded. Well done, Tenno. In my defense there was no indication of a second entity, let alone one so... unpleasant.
A large predatory organism in the vicinity must be removed before we can reclaim the base. Use bait to lure it out.
Friend Latrox says we're all clear to proceed. He says we're in the right area and everything! This is SO exciting!
Excellent work, Tenno. With Latrox' help we now have full scan data for the area around the base.
Researcher Latrox Une has agreed to assist our reclamation efforts. Please protect him while he conducts the necessary survey.
Efficiently done. Now we can continue the restoration project unimpeded.
It will be necessary to clear the area of hostile Infested before any positive inroads can be made to reclaiming the base.
The site has been restored, and Loid tells me it went even better than we hoped. Very well done, Tenno.
All clear. Loid tells me there are strong connections across the network. The reclamation is a success.
You are in proximity to the base location. Once I reactivate the dormant elements the Infested will attempt to prevent completion of the process. Prepare for area defense.
Of old, there was an Entrati base installation in this region. See if you can...
Are you going to look for the old base near here? I'd love to see it again!
Good work, Tenno. There are useful materials here that will assist us in the reclamation project.
Hooo boy, did you just use the cache to lure that humungous thing out? Brilliant!
Oh hey! Hey! There's a cache nearby. Maybe see if you can open it? We could use the resources inside to fix the base!

The Infestation has covered them now, but there are key installations on Deimos that could still serve us well. Locating and securing one of these places will help the reclamation, Loid can give you the details.
I feel sympathy for them sometimes - after all, they're just acting naturally, as naturally as can be expected for a macro-plague. We're the real monsters here, after all.
Another cycle continues unbroken - they rise, they attack, they are repelled. At least you dealt with them with merciful efficiency, I applaud that.
A tragic waste of flesh and blood in a way, but what are we to do? We cannot simply sit back and allow the Infested to consume us, can we?
The Infested have been put back in their place, I gather. They will return, I have no doubt of that, I hope you will be able to help us again when they do.
Infested breach point located. Proceed to the breach point indicated, then...
Make new friends!
Congratulations, Infested activity has been reduced to within acceptable parameters.
No further hostiles detected. Breach designation: closed... until next time.
That's the way! A good, no, a GREAT haul! You've got a nose for this, Chip! Wish I had a nose...
Check you out! Ya big old treasure hunter, you! You're amazing!
You're King of the Hill! That was out-standing my Tenno! I'm gonna make you a crown!
Our squiggly new friends look all tuckered out! They won't be coming back... for a while at least.
Infested activity registers at zero. Well done, Tenno.
All hostiles eliminated. Breach designation: Crushed. Good job, Tenno.
WOW! You're fantiddliastic at this! Those little ole artifacts never stood a chance!
No way! I think you got everything! What makes you so good at this? It's me, isn't it? I make you good!
Wow! You're the best dancer on all of Deimos; our squiggly new friends are totally tired out!
Phew! Guess we won't be seeing our squiggly friends ever again. Nah, I'm sure they'll be back someday.

Aggression from the Infested is a given, but it cannot be allowed to go unchecked. Loid can direct you to locations where the Infested are massing to breach our perimeter. Work to cull their numbers for the security of us all.
A sterling effort, I suppose. Do enjoy the fruits of your labor.
Very good. Very good. You see, Deimos is unforgiving, but not without its gems hidden beneath the mire. Every scrap and crumb is welcome.
Loid informs you have excelled yourself. With more help like yours perhaps we can turn the tide, perhaps...
It's a little unseemly, isn't it? Grubbing for resources like some rock-hopper. Essential, though, we couldn't continue without it. How far we have fallen...
Strip mining for resources can be accomplished in indicated zones. Begin processing when...
Oh boy! You going to do it? There's gold in them there hills!
Resource extraction completed within satisfactory parameters. Kindly undertake further extraction operations when ready.
Although crude, strip mining is the most efficient method to use for resource extraction. It's not like we have to worry about marring Deimos' natural beauty.
Wow, you've tapped out the whole seam. Isn't it time to go home?
You're really good at this! Shouldn't you get a reward now?
Operation complete. Baseline parameters... exceeded. Congratulations Tenno on your exceptional performance: Well done, Tenno.
Your virulent oppression of the unresisting Infested substrate is truly impressive. It does make me wonder at your motivation.
I can't believe how much you did there! Way to go above and beyond, Chip!
Incredible, you make it look so easy! How did you learn to do that? Can you teach me?
Proximity alert. Strip mining zones are located nearby. Commence mining when ready.
Scan data indicates natural resources in this area. Strip mining recommended.
Are you going to do some mining, Chip? Can I come along too?
What are the chances we'd end up at a mining spot? You're SO lucky!

It may not look like it now but Deimos is rich in natural resources. These resources can still be liberated by strip-mining the Infested substrate in designated areas. Tenno, if you have a mind to go digging Loid can show you the most fruitful spots.
You have restored a great deal to us, Tenno. More than you know, I think. Your dedication and single-mindedness is... admirable, I suppose.
Thank you. We've lost so much to the Infestation over time, but it was necessary - absolutely necessary. Or so I thought...
More lost treasures for the collection, I appreciate your efforts to reclaim what we could not. I hope the compensation I can offer is adequate.
Ah, most pleasing, Tenno. I don't hold any delusions that we can regain our former glory - I'm not such a fool - but seeing these again is... a comfort to me.
Artifacts are located in the indicated zones. Infested substrate will require removal prior to...
Yay! Treasure hunt time, Tenno!
Artifact collection complete. Proceed to debrief for cataloguing and archiving.
A satisfactory quantity of artifacts, I suppose. You will be adequately recompensed for your efforts.
An impressive display, Tenno; artifact retrieval parameters exceeded. Additional reward-incentives have been authorized.
I find it interesting you have such an obsession with artifact hunting. Truly no stone left unturned...
Proximity alert. Deimos artifacts are located nearby. Commence retrieval when ready.
Archival data indicates artifacts can be found in the vicinity. Collection advised.
You smell that, Chip? Smells like artifacts, y'know; T_R_E_A_S_U_R_E!
Ready to get rich, Chip? There's artifacts close by, you go ahead and grab 'em!

Location and retrieval of Deimos artifacts is always a priority. The data I can collect from them is a valuable resource in its own right. If you want to join the hunt then Loid can direct you some likely spots. Bring back all you can carry.
Proximity alert. Motile Infested aggressor incursions imminent. Prepare for defense.
Proximity alert. Breach point of Infested aggressors detected.
Oh boy! Heeeere we go! Are we gonna start some playtime at the breach?
Here's the Infested breach! Are we going to make some new friends?
The big puppy is taking a nap! You tired him out good, Chip. And you got a core sample, too!
Taking down the apex alone would have been sufficient. Just had to prove yourself, hmmmm?
There is an apex Infested in this area that you'll need to deal with before you can take a core sample. Prepare some bait and draw it out.
Latrox has now routed core sample data to us, Tenno, he does have his uses.
Excellent, Latrox has collected a number of samples on our behalf. Well done, Tenno.
Contact our Corpus friend Latrox! He can help you to get a core sample if you protect him!
Now THAT's all done with, I suppose you could grab a core sample.
Proximity alert, eliminate local infested aggressors in order to procure a core sample.
I'm told you have extracted a set of core samples. Good work, Tenno, I believe we're done here.
Loid tells me you got all the core samples needed and more. Excellent. These will give me considerable insight into the problem.
Based on the other core samples I have located the best place to get the final set. Proceed to the excavators.
Well done, Tenno, that little fracas has secured us a core sample from the grateful Grineer.
There's some Grineer survivors workin' round here that might help out; I should have baked cookies!
Geological core samples can be procured nearby that will reveal vital data about Deimos Infestation levels. Please...
Just ignore them and blast infested, it'll do more good!

It is vital that we gain a proper understanding of the Infestation on Deimos in order to protect the heart. Loid will instruct you on how to procure geological core samples in relevant areas. This would be a great help to me.
Mission parameters have been violated. The mission is no longer tenable.
Oh no! You can't complete the mission now. Booooo!
Well...that was less than ideal, wasn't it? Mission failed.
Oh, tough luck! You can't finish the mission now, so there'll be no cake for anyone - frowny face.
Mission objective now unachievable. Fantastic. Now we are just going to have to start over...
It is likely the Grineer ran into difficulties when they encountered this organism. Continue your search, Tenno.
Ssssssh. The big puppy AND its momma are taking a nap! You rule at playtime!
A large predator roams this area. It must be neutralized before we can attempt to locate the Grineer. Advice - look for appropriate bait.
Maybe these were what chewed on the grunters? They don't normally like asking for help, y'know?
A large concentration of Infested are close by. They must be dealt with before we attempt to locate the Grineer.
I'm sure that the Grineer will be able to make it out on their own now. Thank you for indulging me, Tenno, all non-infested are allies, and we need allies.

The poor Grineer are out of peril thanks to your charitable efforts. Such a demonstration of your destructive power is also... helpful in keeping the peace, should they ever consider becoming... aggressive.
I have a positive fix on the Grineer beacon. Please move to assist.
Whee, I always like the grunters, so funny!
The contents of this cache appear to be Corpus in origin. Useful but not what we are looking for. Continue, Tenno.
An impressive victory, Tenno. Sadly the cache itself gives us no clues about the Grineer, although the resources it contains are always welcome.
Oh, hey, there's a cache! Maybe the grunters left it behind. We should try and open it!
These look old, I don't think they're from the squad we're looking for. Shame... no wait that means they're still alive, maybe, yay!
Excellent data recovery, Tenno. It appears that some Grineer lost a fight with infested here, but that was long ago. We need to keep searching.
There are Grineer artifacts buried in the infested substrate nearby. Activate a Purifier so we can get a better look at them.

Grineer may be... unsavory, but ultimately they are not the infested and we need all the help we can get. Kindly locate and assist a stranded squad of Grineer. Rest assured they will be non-hostile, these Grineer fully grasp their situation here.
Latrox has his uses, but he seems clueless about the location of any caches. He is likely lying to keep them for himself. Corpus is as Corpus does.
The Corpus researcher Latrox Une is in the area. Seek his assistance for cache reclamation.
That's it; you're all clear. Now... where were we?
Excellent work, Tenno. With the Infested so comprehensively out of the picture, you should be clear to proceed.
Proximity alert. Multiple Infested aggressors. Secure the area to continue with cache reclamation mission.
Loid tells me you have a cache unlocked. A decent enough haul for our collective efforts, I am not sure what we would do without these occasional windfalls.
According to Loid, you located a cache and brought additional bounties home along with it. Very good, Tenno, I'm starting to like you.
Oh, hey, there's a cache near here, maybe it's the one we're looking for?
Ok, so Mr. Grunty waved his fist and said something rude when I asked him about caches, so I don't think he knows about any.
Given the poor performance of those Grineer it's a good bet they haven't found any caches lately. Keep looking.
I have located a squad of Grineer survivors in the area, questioning them may assist in finding any abandoned loot.
Scan logs have registered a substantial cache of lost resources in this area.
Time to make some new friends, best brush your teeth! Wait - Do you even have teeth?
Some useful data was revealed but the primary cache has not been located. Keep looking, Tenno.
That is a positive wealth of data, but sadly not the data we are looking for. Nonetheless, good work Tenno.
Maybe you could use a Purifier? The cache might be covered up by squelchies!

Over the years many expeditions of both Grineer and Corpus have become trapped on Deimos. Caches of resources left behind by the survivors still dot the surface. See what you can find and bring back, Loid will show you where to look.
I've successfully established a link with the researcher's data stream... interesting. Proceed to the indicated location, I believe I've found something noteworthy.
Well done, full sample upload complete. This data will be invaluable in cleansing Deimos.
Hey, there's a Corpus researcher close by! Latrox Une! I bet he'll help us if we help him!
Those old diggers sure can go, right? We got deep enough; you can stop now.
Well ok then, mister smarty-pants! ALL of the excavators made it through their cycles, you rock at this! Pun fully intended!
The anomaly appears to be buried. You will need to use an excavator to reach it.
Loid tells me you have retrieved the samples I wanted. I am... pleased. I suppose you should have a reward for your efforts.
Loid tells me you have exceeded expectations by retrieving all of the samples I desired. You have materially assisted my progress through your activities. Well done, Tenno.
According to the scan data, this is the final location. Whatever is buried here represents the most unique anomaly detected. Please, proceed with extraction.
Everything's better with new friends, don't you think? Oh, and I got the coordinates of where to go next off them, nice guys.
You have achieved double the Grineer's kill-count and saved the day, a salutory lesson in lethality I'm sure they won't forget.
I am detecting Grineer transmissions in the area, somewhat panicked ones to be precise. Please investigate and render assistance - we are mutual enemies of the Infestation.
Anomalous objects were scanned within this region. Be on the lookout for...
Don't be silly, retrieving them won't make a difference!
Anomalous object secured. Keep searching, there are more out there.
Wow! You got all the pieces and the big puppy too! I wonder what it's been chewing on to get like that?
I have detected a nearby cache that may be the source of an anomaly. Kindly locate it...
I'm sure you've apprehended by now that Deimos is...not as it should be. Several anomalous objects worthy of study have come up in recent scans. Loid can take you through the retrieval process.
What a lot of fresh Infested body parts. Shame we're not making stew.
You slaughtered both of them! So exciting. The Orokin designed you well.
Lifeform detected. Predator. Large. Loid, help them deal with it!
Mmm. A fine harvest of polyps, fermented the old-fashioned way: in a Juggernaut's digestive tract.
Listen up, Tenno. We will not be making more Loid stew today. We are going after some sweet Fungal Polyps. And not a word to Mother.
These supplies are a little aged, but maybe it'll improve the flavor. Good job!
What a haul. Luscious and perfectly preserved. Very nice.
A sealed supply cache! Loid, help them get it open, please?
Thank you, little sprouts. You've been very helpful.
Amazing! I can discern so much information from these samples! Orrrr I could eat them.
A Purifier can scan for those Polyps. Luckily, we have a helpful Necraloid who can find one. Oh, Loid...
My daughter and Loid regularly prepare simple food that the family can ingest in our... current state. A straightforward task, but she would appreciate help.
Wowee! Blam! Blam! Schnikt! That'll put a scare into the rest of them for sure!
Outstanding. The loss of prime organisms will help to dissuade other Infested from entering the vicinity.
Eliminating the dominant Infested is vital to our progress. Proceed with caution and lure out the Infested prime.
Area secured. You may proceed further into the tunnels.
Enemy count... zero. That was excellent work, Tenno. Please continue towards the objective.
Whoop! Here they come! Man the barricades!
Awesome! You got 'em all! That'll teach 'em not to mess around in here. Right?
Infestation threat levels have been shattered. A most effective expedition. Congratulations, Tenno.
Damage in this area is at critical levels. You will need to exterminate all mobile Infested in the vicinity.
I trust you are fully equipped to deal with the large numbers of Infested awaiting you in the ruins. You will need to be... uncompromising in your aggression.
The mist has dispersed sufficiently. You may continue your sweep of the ruins.
That's so much better! You got this place locked down in no time!
We must find a way to clear this infernal mist before we can continue.
The Infestation is creeping into the vaults, and it's threatening to undo everything we have worked for. Eradicate them for me please, Tenno. It's what you're best at, after all.
An adequate kill-count. You may proceed further into the tunnels when ready.
You rocked them! It should be pretty quiet in the tunnels for now.
Infested incoming. It is imperative we maintain area control. Hold fast and head high!
Welp I guess friends explode on you sometimes. Daughter doesn't seem too sad, though!
You did a valiant job of keeping the Juggernaut alive... while it mattered. I suggest we press onward.
Fungal Polyps have grown in the fissures. It might be... expedient to gather some for Daughter while here.
Done and done! There's no stopping you, shiny!
A most meritorious resolution to the problem at hand. We are most impressed by your conduct, Tenno.
We're real close to the place that's been rrrrrumbling! Let's see what's popping!
I'm glad you're available, Tenno. We need to discover what is destabilizing the tunnels and what long-term effects the fissures are causing.
I have sufficient data to chart a route to the fissures. Please proceed.
All clear! We know how to get to the fissures now! Let's go!
You will need to get that Purifier functional to gain access to the fissures.
The seismographs have been dancing a merry tune of late. Kindly find a way to seal the fissures currently opening up in the tunnels before even more of Deimos becomes uninhabitable.
Aww I was just starting to like him, her or it. Purifier's not far now.
Very good. Thanks to your adroit handling of the Infested, you have harvested an outstandingly good crop.
I am detecting Fungal Polyps ahead. Disgusting, but I understand Daughter has a use for them.
Most satisfactory. I estimate it will be a considerable time before the Infestation achieves critical levels again.
Oh that showed them! They won't be showing their Infested faces around here again! At least not for a while...
Hey, we made it! Fire up that Purifier and we can get out of here!
I have located within the ruins a functioning Purifier. If we can activate it, that should push the Infestation back for a time.
Yay! Goodies from the box! We can push on now.
We've gained more than enough resources to cover our needs. Good work, Tenno.
We will need to access a cache for the resources necessary to activate the Purifier.
Well, mixed results, I suppose. The samples you collected will prove useful.
Brilliant! You throw like a pro! You should do this more often!
There is an experimental fluid we can deploy that may temporarily disrupt the Infested. Call this a test.
If the Infested gain too much ground in the subterranean ruins they are sure to breach the isolation vaults eventually. Cleaning is always such a chore... though perhaps you could help out?
Congratulations, the Infested are in retreat. We can now push onward.
You cleaned them all out! That was amazing!
Infested are gathering to drive you back. Defend this location until their numbers dwindle.
Well now, THAT'S all taken care of. You can be a bit scary sometimes, y'know?
Exceptional lethality. Very good work, Tenno. We can move on now.
It will be necessary to thin the Infested herd even further before we can proceed.
A tricky undertaking, but you responded commendably. A job well done, I think.
You aced it! You've got a great throwing arm, y'know, anyone ever tell you that?
Finally. We can get the experiment underway whenever you are ready.
We have a unique opportunity to conduct an experiment upon the Infested in their natural environment. Continue into the tunnels, and I shall explain the procedure.
Oh boy. This mist stuff was real nasty-smelly. I'm sooo glad you got rid of it!
That was handled with commendable alacrity, Tenno. Kindly continue to the experiment site.
The mist in this area will hinder our efforts. You will need to find the source and shut it down.
Loid tells me he has an experiment he wishes to conduct on the Infested in the tunnels. In the interests of science I would like to indulge him. See what he needs and help out if you have a mind to.
Exquisite! Rapturous! Fermented to perfection! Oh, we must do this again. Very soon.

An interesting expedition, I trust? You did well according to Loid, a reward is in order for your efforts. I do hope you'll go again, there is so much more to be found, things hidden from... a mundane gaze.

You are to be congratulated, Tenno. Few can confront the guardians of the isolation vaults. A fuller mastery of the Void and all its implications would be helpful, of course, but this must suffice for now.

Very, very good. You descend and return, most pleasing. So many descend and remain as remains. Perhaps you might learn more once you strengthen your Void connection, it is a difficult place to navigate with only one eye open.
You have returned as I knew you would. You dance a delicate ballet, Tenno, no obstacle seems to get in your way. Your forebears would be proud.
Truly no stone left unturned. Your dedication and skills do you credit. It seems there is little wonder in what befell the old order, how could they resist such focused fury?
My favored explorer, back from the depths. It was all that could be hoped for, I trust? Loid tells me you overcame all perils with pleasing verve, you have earned my gratitude.
When intrepid explorers returned from the Void they would isolate themselves in the vaults until they re-aligned with causality and sanity. Technology useful against the Infestation may still -
You stay out, Tenno, there's only death and decay down there!

Much has been hidden from us on Deimos. The old ruins beneath the surface must surely contain the deepest and darkest secrets. Find a way to get inside and the Necraloid will guide you through. See what's happening down there. Tell me what HE has been up to...
That should do it, hand the samples over to me, please.
Marvelous. That should be enough to keep the Entrati happy, give them here.
That's more than enough. I'm in your debt, my gargantuan metal friend.
Tenno! You're close by! Can I...err beg a moment of your time?
Someone's here! I'm saved! Wait... you are here to help?
There you are! Oh, a sight for sore eyes. Look at you! Magnificent!
And that, my friend, is a clean sweep. All samples uploaded. I'm going to lie down.
Done and done. Every sample uploaded. Science and your Entrati friends owe you a debt. Huzzah!
We are green across the board, all samples cleared. Remarkable.
Fantastic. I'm starting the data upload; this always draws infested, so keep me safe, if you wouldn't mind?
This is the part I hate. When I upload the data, the Infested will undoubtedly come sniffing about. Do not let them interfere!
Here we go. Processing... Oh, I hate it here. Hate it. I would give anything to get off this forsaken rock.
Beautiful, now we just need a few more like it.
Lovely. Think we can get a few more?
Perfect, now we need to grab some more samples, just to be sure.
There! That one dropped a sample! Grab it!
That ugly one just coughed up what we're after, could you grab a sample for me?
I swear if the Entrati weren't demanding samples... Ooh, there's one! Pick it up quick!
...I repeat, this is Latrox Une, intrepid Corpus explorer and in something of a spot of truly terrifying bother. I really would very much appreciate some timely and violent assistance.
Is there anybody out there? Please let there be somebody out there...
No! Bad monsters! Get away! Shoo! ...Will somebody PLEASE come and help me out of this jam? Back! Back!
Oh. I say. Hello there. Look, hate to bother, but I need to collect samples, and, frankly, I'm in a bit over my head. Orienteering. Organ landscapes. Monsters. Mainly the monsters.
Hello? Latrox Une. Our Entrati friends have, I suppose, 'requested' that I provide them samples of native… fauna. Not the kind of people one can really fail, if you catch my drift. Help?
What a relief! I was expecting to get my head bitten off at any moment. While you're here, can you help me collect some samples? Just a few, and then we're gone, I swear.
I think that's a respectable amount, given the circumstances. We could have gathered more, I suppose, but frankly, our Entrati friends can go and suck egg sacs.
Upload complete. I couldn't manage the whole spread of samples, but screw it; I'm out of here.
How can a whole moon be so disgusting? That's enough samples for today, catch you on the flipside.
Protect the immediate area from incursion.
Please keep the established perimeter secure. Thank you.
You keep this part locked down for a bit, okay, Chip?
Hostiles eliminated... Utterly eliminated. The area is secure.
A crushing and comprehensive victory. The Infested have lost their appetite for now.
Oh man, you made that look easy, they won't be back anytime soon!
That took care of the first wave. More are coming.
The Infested appear to see this as a territorial dispute. They are not backing down.
Oh boy, I think you made them mad, there's a bunch more coming!
Scans are clear of further reinforcements. Finish what is left.
These are the last stragglers. I can detect no more are approaching.
I think they got all tired out; there's no more coming. This is all that's left now.
Infested casualty rate has topped fifty percent.
You have eliminated more than half of them. Keep it up.
You go, Chip! You're halfway through 'em!
Infested are gathering. Kindly move to disperse them.
A large concentration of Infested is massing nearby. Action required.
Whole buncha Infested coming together. Could be trouble!
That was the last of them. Defense protocol successful.
Infested incursion defeated. The perimeter is secure.
Hey, you ok there, buddy? I thought they'd get you for sure.
Here's your sniffer! Juggernauts find polyps simply intoxicating... and so do I.
Ah, a motile infested protomass! Juggernaut, to you... and just what we need.
This guy will sniff out the polyps. Just make sure nothing else eats him first.
Let him gobble these up. They're no good raw, but processed through a Juggernaut? Intoxicating.
That's it. Eat up that raw fungus.
Just let him eat. He's happy. And soon? I will be.
One more polyp should do it...
Just one more.
Almost done. Last one.
He's oblivious! So, uh, keep him safe and quiet? Mother can't know I'm doing this.
Keep him safe while he grubs around for polyps.
He's in a trance. Total synaptic overload. This is the good stuff alright.
Let him sniff out a few more...
Stay with him. He's still hungry.
He's not done yet, and nor are we.
On to the next one!
Keep on sniffing, Juggernaut.
There he goes. Our boy's got a nose for the good stuff.
No, no, no. They'll kill him. Don't let that happen!
An overfed, slow Juggernaut is easy prey. Protect him!
If those Infested kill him, it'll ruin everything!
Limbic system overload! He's berserk. Better pop his pustule!
Those polyps have gone straight to his head! Take him down, fast!
He's had enough alright! Look out! Harvest time!
Alright, alright, we got our polyps nice and fermented. Grab 'em.
Smell that? The good stuff served hot. Collect 'em before they go cold.
Ta-da! Fermented polyps, swimming in digestive juices. Just what we came for. Time to collect!
He's getting good and full. Do NOT let anything burst him.
Keep him alive!
Protect him. He's looking like a five-course meal on legs right now.
Hey, you're near some Fungal Polyps! Mother takes a dim view of them... but YOU could collect some FOR me! Please?
Polyps are dreeeamy... but Mother forbids me from having any. You get it. Be a love and grab me some?
Hey, I need to keep this between us - don't tell Mother - but would you be a dear and pick me up some fermented polyps? It won't take long. Promise!
He's caught the scent. Help him dig!
He's found one! Quick, dig it up!
That's what we're after. Be a love and dig it up?
Mmm. These babies put the fun back in fungus. You'll keep this just between us, right?
Excellent job. Now, this stays a secret between you... and me.
Delicious. And the dreams you get... indescribable. Mother would never understand.
It's a brutal process, but you handled it expertly. We'll be doing this again!
You're a genius. An artisan. A culinary master!
Incredible job. Healthy, happy Juggernauts make the best fermentation tanks.
I have detected a high concentration of resources in this area. Dispatching excavator units for exploitation.
Scanning... detecting sub-surface resources. Excavation units en-route. Kindly assist in their deployment.
Hey, there's a ton of resources buried around here. I'm calling in the diggers!
Full excavation of site complete. An excellent haul.
A full cycle has been made by all excavators. Outstanding.
All the diggers got through digging, that's great!
An excavation unit has been disabled. Kindly prioritize protection of the surviving units.
We have lost an excavator. Focus on protecting the rest.
Oh man, we lost a digger. Better be super careful with the rest!
An excavator has completed its digging cycle.
An excavator reports - mining sequence complete.
Green light! That's a digger finished diggin'!
Autonomous excavation units can be found in the vicinity.
I have located excavation units that may prove useful for this next task.
We need to find a way to dig down. Guess we could use those digging machines?
An excavator has been severely damaged. Do try to keep it functional.
Severe damage has been registered to an excavation unit. Please prioritize it.
One of the diggers is getting smashed up! Don't let it blow up or we'll lose out!
An excavator has powered down. If you can scavenge an energy source, it can be brought back online.
An excavator has lost power. Re-initiate it with a locally-procured power source.
One of the diggers ran out of juice. We better see what we can find to power it up again.
Excavator back online. Continue protection and monitoring.
Excavator power levels acceptable. Mining sequence restarted.
Okey dokey, that fixed it! It's working again now.
Excavation complete. A satisfactory haul.
Mining completed within acceptable parameters. We took what we could.
Well, we got some stuff, I guess, coulda been better, no?
Hive located. Destroy it with weapon-fire.
I have detected a hive nearby. Shoot to destroy it.
Oh! Oh! Look! There's a hive! Nuke it!
You will need to destroy some Infested hive-tumors to draw out the larger specimens.
If you destroy Infested hives the larger Infested will soon appear.
Blast some hives to call up the bitey brigade!
That got their attention. Hostiles incoming.
Infested activity spiking. They will be upon you soon.
Ok, now that they're good and mad, hope you're ready!
All hostiles down. Move on and destroy the next hive.
Area cleared. We should locate another hive.
They're all tuckered out! Let's go find some more playmates, yeah?
Infestation activity has been reduced to within acceptable parameters.
Area clear. That should buy us breathing room for a time.
It's gone all quiet, that means we won!
FRIENDS now, Tenno?
Oh, this good. So close and not dead yet.
Grineer, friend. Tenno, friend. All friends together.
All alive. You GOOD, Tenno. How Garv help?
Grineer live, Infested die. A GOOD day.
Garv is glad Tenno on side.
Har Har, Grineer best!
Ha! Grineer strong!
Oh, Tenno! Not so fierce, huh?
Hey! Tenno! Come!
Want something, shiny?
All friends on Deimos. Come!
We kill Infested. You kill Infested. See who's best, yes?
We all kill Infested. Yes? See who kills most.
Up for contest? See who kill most Infested first, yeah?
Grah! Kill quicker! Tenno is winning!
Tenno won't beat us! Shoot! Shoot!
Don't let Tenno win! Shoot more!
Ok, ok, Tenno wins. What you want to know?
Bah! Tenno is king. Garv knows secret, wanna hear?
Impressive. How can Garv help Tenno-ally?
If you gather the correct materials you can persuade the Infestation to open up for us. Think of it like gathering bait.
Hey that entry looks like it eats stuff, maybe we can get it to open up if we feed it.
The Infestation is strong but stupid, with the right materials we can fool it into letting us enter.
Protect the vessel while it is stewing. The stench is bound to draw Infested.
Now we're cooking! Uh-oh something's coming, don't let it grab the snacks!
Be on the lookout for Infested, they will likely come and investigate - do not let them disrupt the process.
Infested giblets. That should do nicely, find more.
That looks yummy for a monster-door, let's find some more.
Collecting tissue samples from Infested can supply us with a biological 'key'.
Oops. Well we can make another concoction I suppose.
Ha! You suck. We'll have to make another snack now.
You need to hit the orifice when you throw. Now we will need to start over.
To access the isolation vaults you will need to find a way through the Infestation first.
Sooo the Infestation's got the entrance to the iso-vaults squeezed tight, any ideas?
The isolation vault entrances are deep beneath the surface, we'll need to enter Infestation tunnels to reach them.
Good. Now take the concoction and throw it against the large cloaca I have marked on the map.
Ok, now grab the snack and throw it at the monster-door.
The combined sample is ready. Hurl it against orifice-portal and it should open.
Very unpleasant, but undoubtedly what we need. Just a little more...
Ok, we better get another one to be sure.
We will need additional samples, but this is a good start.
That should suffice, place the components into the vessel.
Now we just need a jug to mash everything together in.
Excellent. Take what you have gathered and place it into the vessel.
There. Now we can progress into the tunnels. Do not dawdle.
Yay! Let's go inside before it starts chewing!
Well done, we can access the Infested tunnels now. Head inside.
Warning. The mist in this area is charged with growth hormones. The Infested will become unkillable if we cannot disable the source. See if the containment unit can be of any help.
This mist is weird, isn't it? Sure makes the Infested mad! Now we gotta find a way to stop the alarm and the mist! Hey! Maybe the alarm is 'cause of the mist!

The composition of this mist is heavily altered. It will greatly enhance Infested tissue regeneration and aggression. We need to shut this down quickly. Locate the containment unit; it may be of assistance.
Ah, I believe we have found what has been creating the fissures, and likely the mist too. Destroy them, Tenno.
Oh wow! They are NOT happy! I bet they're the ones making the mist... ewww!
Interesting. I suggest you eliminate the Infested immediately. They are undoubtedly the source of the mist.
Pick up that emitter unit. Its duration will be limited, but if you can deliver it to a fissure, it should be able to nullify the mist at source.
Oh hey! It's a containment unit. If you grab that emitter thingy and get it to a fissure it'll flush the mist!
Take the emitter from the unit. It should be able to disperse the mist as long as it has power. Carry the emitter to a fissure.
Well done. The mist has reduced somewhat but is still present. Recharge the emitter and seek out another fissure.
Phew! That got rid of some of the mist, but there must be others! Recharge the thingy and find another fissure!
Good. I am detecting less mist, but I believe there are more Infested like this. Ensure the emitter is charged and hunt down another fissure to close it.
The emitter will be useless without energy. Perhaps recharge it at the containment unit.
The emitter requires more energy to function. The containment unit it came from should be able to restore its charge.
Uh oh! The emitter's getting dim. Can you power it up somehow?  Maybe take it back to where we got it?
Quickly! The emitter still has some charge left - put it into the fissure to seal away the mist.
The emitter's running out of juice! Get it to a fissure quick before it flakes out!
The emitter will be able to seal off the mist incursion if it has sufficient power left. Apply it directly to the fissure.
The containment unit is close by. Let us hope it can offer a solution to this mist.
Mr noisy-alarm is near us. He's gotta have some way of dealing with the mist, right?
You are approaching the hazard containment unit. It should have some utility in combating the mist.
The mist is definitely coming from these fissures. The emitter will need more energy to seal them. Perhaps the containment unit can recharge it.
Look! The mist is coming from the fissures! Go back to the containment unit, charge the emitter, and we can seal that fissure!
The fissures appear to be the source of the mist. You will need to power up the emitter to close them off. You can return to the containment unit to recharge the emitter.
Watch out! If the bad puppies get close to the fissure they could dig it up again!
Caution. The Infested may be able to re-open the fissure if you do not stop them.
Keep the Infested away from the fissure, or they may find a way to crack it open again.
Excellent work, Tenno. We'll have these all sealed in no time.
Well done, but there's no time to waste. Find and close the other fissures.
You shut it down! That's great, but I think there's more that need shutting...
Hmm. An old hazard containment unit in the tunnels is sending out an alert. Kindly see what has set it off.
We got alarms going off in the tunnels! We gotta find out what's making all the racket!
Alert! I have detected warning signals emanating from a hazard containment installation. We should investigate.
Those maggots are unusual. They may be related to the mist in some way. Perhaps they are emerging from the fissures?
You see those squiggly, glistening, gross, dangerous-looking things crawling at us? Let's go see where they're coming from!
I have not seen anything like these maggots before. They must be emerging from the fissures.
Excellent. The mist has been contained, and the fissures sealed. That was difficult work; I trust it was not too draining. I will monitor the area in case the mist returns.
You shut all the fissures and the mist is gone. That was tough but you cracked it! Go you!
Crisis averted. Only trace compounds of the mist remain, and they will soon degrade. It is fortunate you were able to endure the experience, Tenno. I will keep watch in case the fissures reopen.
Exceptional work, Tenno. The air is actually purer than it was before. I will maintain a link with the containment unit so we will be forewarned of any future resurgence.
The area has been fully stabilized thanks to you, Tenno. I will be monitoring the containment unit in case this happens again.
We're all clear! You made that look easy! I bet those scary mist chumps won't be back anytime soon!
You will need to release the cache before we can access it. See if you can damage that growth.
You will need to release the cache before we can access it.
The infestation's got that box gripped tight! Blast that sucker!
A job well done. You have exceeded projected expectations.
Efficiently procured. The additional cache contents should prove invaluable.
Wow, you were quick! So quick, I reckon you saved more of the box contents!
That is the last small tumor. Now return to the main growth and break it open.
Well, that was... unpleasant. Still, you have done enough to make the main tumor vulnerable now.
That should be enough, try and break open the box again!
Oh hey, no fair! There's a protective cloud over the Infestation! You gotta get inside it to hurt the blobs!
The Infestation is protecting itself with a sort of barrier membrane. Move inside the barrier before attempting to damage the Infestation.
Interesting. There is a sporoidal barrier protecting the Infestation. Get inside it before attacking.
Smacking down on these tumors seems to be doing something, keep doing that!
The Infested substrate has formed tumors anchoring the cache. Blast them free.
I have detected these tumors are maintaining a grip on the cache. You will need to burst them.
These caches are often left by shipwrecked crews. They are usually worth investigation.
These often contain valuable data, as well as resources. Please find a way to access it.
What's in the box? We gotta know what's in the box, right?
No. No. No. You cannot breach the... you cannot breach the Infestation from outside its protective barrier.
No damage! You gotta get inside that bubble to do anything to the growth!
As I predicted, no harm can be inflicted from outside the infested barrier. Proceed inside.
Look for pulsating trails connecting to other nearby tumors.
The growth over the cache is seemingly invulnerable. Look for any Infested tumors linked to it.
Nothing. Maybe we can find another way to break it free? What's that connected to it?
Very good, now we shall see what the cache holds.
Excellent. You should be able to retrieve the cache now.
Woohoo! WHAT'S IN THE BOX?!
Cache is open, and contents secured.
Infestation defeated. The cache held some valuable data.
Well, blasting things was more fun than opening the box...
Purifier operational. Prevent any Infested from interfering with it.
Keep the motile Infested at bay while the Purifier does its work.
If Mr. Scratchikins pays us a visit and plays too long, the Purifier's gonna stop working.
We call this a 'Purifier'. Once powered up, it establishes a harmonic with local fauna in order to extract data.
Once powered up, a Purifier's influence will make nearby flora extrude sensory filaments. These are a rich source of biological data on the infestation.
When its got juice, a Purifier upsets the plants, and they stick their tongues out to taste what's different. Power it up, you'll see!
Purifier operation completed, and rare samples gathered. This data is excellent.
A fine harvest indeed. The information received exceeds expectations.
All done. You even got some extra rare shells too - so smooth!
I have detected some rare mollusks within range. The data from those would be particularly valuable.
More calcified samples have additional data. In particular, look out for unusual mollusks, they are high value.
Sometimes we find rare shells, and they are super worth it. Grab them if you can!
Rare sample retrieved. Excellent work, Tenno, keep it up.
Congratulations, you have secured the special samples. Now finish the rest of the job.
Oh, hey, you got the special shells! That's top work! Still need to do the rest, though, I guess.
Purifier sweep is fifty percent complete. Continue operation.
The Purifier is halfway through its operation. Remain in proximity.
Purifier's half-done, keep at it, and soon it'll be whole-done!
With the correct stimulus, Deimos can be persuaded to give up some of its secrets.
The Infestation on Deimos may seem overwhelming, but we can make that work for us at times.
You ever seen a Purifier? We use them to find out stuff about the Infestation and what's under it.
Warning. Infested damaging the Purifier will disrupt its operation.
Infested aggressors are damaging the Purifier. If this continues, the sweep will have to be abandoned.
Purifier's gonna break if bad puppies keep getting at it!
Purifier sweep is complete. Assimilating captured data.
Those alien blooms are unsightly but valuable. The Purifier has finished its work.
All done! We got a ton of info off those plant tongue things.
The device I am interested in is nearby. Locate it and determine if it is still functional.
The machine is close by! I hope it still works!
The Entrati device is in proximity. Find it and assess its condition, please.
The Infested are adapting to the fluid, and the samples show signs of corruption. I will do the best I can with any further samples you recover.
We're about done! We can still get more samples but they won't be quite as fresh as the first batch.
The sample quality is degrading as the Infested assimilate the fluid. Recover more samples if you can; quantity must substitute for quality.
Now, with a full charge, the device should have synthesized a sac of fluid. Retrieve it.
Enough charge and the machine makes a gooey sac, grab it!
The device has generated a fluid sac derived from the input. Pick it up, please.
The device is being charged by enzymes released from the connected tumors. Keep destroying tumors.
Whatever you did, it's charging the machine; keep doing it!
The destruction of connected tumors is charging the device successfully. Keep at it until we have a full charge.
This is the good bit! Throw the sac at an Infested to mark them and then KILL THEM!
The experiment begins: Throw the sac at an Infested to mark them, and then destroy the marked Infested however you see fit.
Now, simply throw the sac at an Infested to mark them. Once marked, terminate them immediately.
Well, that was a waste. Prepare another fluid sac and do try to be more accurate next time.
Aww that's no good, you gotta hit them with it. Better get another gooey sac...
Unfortunately inaccurate, Tenno. We will just have to generate another fluid sac and try again.
We have located a device in the tunnels that can help us expand our knowledge of the Infested.
We want to know more about the Infested. There's an old Entrati machine in the tunnels that can help us. You're going to love this!
Using an old Entrati device, I intend to undertake an experiment to expand our knowledge of the Infested. Come along!
Excellent. I require tissue samples from that Infested to examine the effects of the fluid. Deceased samples, preferably.
Oh that sure made them mad! Kill it and grab me a sample!
Interesting. The subject appears to be very aggressive. Please secure a tissue sample once it has been eliminated.
Oh boy! It barely still works! Follow those trails and see if there's a way to charge it up!
We are fortunate this device still functions at all. Follow the linkages to find a way to charge it up.
The device is in poor condition. It will need charging to function. Look around for connections to the Infested substrate.
Yay! Victory! Thanks for the help, shiny-friend! Shame we couldn't get better samples, though.
Well, we completed the experiment successfully, although I must admit I was hoping for better results.
Adequate, I suppose. I will glean what I can from the samples gained.
Outstanding. The samples you took are top-notch, prime Infested meat. Well done, Tenno.
You got the best samples possible! That was a thing of beauty, friend-o!
Excellent work, Tenno. These samples will expand our understanding of the Infestation immeasurably.
Warning. Toxicity levels in these tunnels are deadly even for Warframes. The vaults lie beyond, but they will be inaccessible until the toxicity has been reduced.
Oh wow, it's so toxic in here it'll burn your casing off! We need to do something or the vault won't open!
Airborne impurities from the Infested have rendered these tunnels highly toxic to non-Infested. We cannot access the vaults until the toxicity level has been reduced.
Warning. Warframe safety parameters exceeded. We must retreat.
I gotta go, it's too toxic in here for me. Cya!
Accumulated toxicity means it is impossible to proceed. We must leave the tunnels immediately.
Organic material from the Infested can help counteract the environment and keep us alive longer. They are well adapted to this.
Hey we can use Infested ick to keep the toxin off you.
Use organic samples to help stabilize yourself against the toxicity levels.  The Infested carry their own 'antidote' of sorts.
Some of the Infested are adding to the toxicity level. Deal with them quickly.
Some of the Infested are real stinkers, get 'em before they make things worse!
Certain Infested organisms are massively increasing the toxicity levels. Eliminate them.
Warning. Toxin levels becoming critical. Find an organic antidote quickly.
Hey you don't look so good, find some Infested ick to reduce the toxic level.
Toxicity is reaching levels beyond even your capacity, Tenno. Use an organic antidote from the Infested to stabilize yourself.
These are the last of the Infested in the area, the largest and deadliest specimens from deeper levels. Be careful.
The biggest Infested are coming, if we can make it through these we'll make it to the iso-vault!
The strongest local Infested are inbound. This is their last gasp, defeat these and we should be clear to proceed.
Toxicity levels are dropping now the Infested have retreated. We can proceed to the isolation vaults.
Hey the tox-level is coming down now the Infested backed off, we can go to the vault!
Toxicity is falling away to nothing with the Infested gone. We can now access the isolation vaults.
There is a guardian here, a Necramech. You will need to destroy it so you can explore the ruins.
Ok, Chip, now you just need to beat a Necramech so you can explore the ruins in peace  - did I mention that part already?
There is a Necramech guarding the ruins. You will need to defeat it in order to roam the ruins.
A fruitful exploration and you defeated a Necramech guardian. There are further mysteries to be found when you are stronger, but this must suffice for now. Head to the surface when ready.
Yay! You got the mech and nosed around the ruins some. There's more to the vaults when you grow into it - right now we should head home.

With the Necramech beaten, these ruins hold nothing more for you. However, once you fulfill your true potential, I feel confident you would prove capable of accessing further, more deeply hidden sections of the Isolation Vaults.
With the guardian defeated and the vault open there is nothing more to be found in these ruins. Time to exit, Tenno.
You got the 'mech and opened a vault! That's everything you're gonna find down here. Time to get out while the getting's good!
All objectives complete. You may now leave behind the ruins and head to the surface. There is nothing more to be gained here.
This is the logic puzzle you must overcome to access the inner chamber. I cannot help you further. The victory is one you win alone.
You gotta solve the puzzle to open the iso-vault on your own. They made it like this so nobody crazy could open up the vaults and break iso.
Opening the inner chamber requires you enter all four parts of the code accurately. This final step must be done by you alone, I have reached the boundary of my permissions.
Warning. Damage registered - structural integrity at fifty percent. I can be restored by Void energy, kindly assist if possible.
Hey hey I'm gettin' kinda busted up here, like half-dead! Help a friend out? You can re-juice me with Void energy if you can spare it.
I have suffered substantial damage. Request stabilisation with Void energy if available.
Follow me. I will take you to the safety interlocks.
Come on, I'll show you the locks on the vault.
There is one last obstacle to overcome before access is granted. Right this way...
Damage approaching critical levels. Self-preservation protocols active.
Imma gone have to bail if this keeps up, I'm all but done -help?
I must retreat. Farewell, Tenno.
W-warning. Damage.. severe. I cannot hold on much longer. Void energy required.
Hey, Chip, help a buddy out? 'Ole Otak is going down hard here...
Critical damage has been registered to this unit. System failure imminent. Void energy recharge essential.
You can only make three mistakes before the vault will lock permanently. Be sure before you input.
If you botch it three times the vault locks you out for good, so don't do that ok?
A maximum of three errors are permitted before the failsafe protocol seals the vault. Do not simply guess.
This is a sanity test that was applied to prevent unstable minds from entering or exiting the Void.
The code's to stop anyone crazy getting in or out, should be easy enough if you're not crazy, Chip!
A sane, rational thought process is needed to finalize opening the Vault. Void exposure often brought about the opposite state of mind.
Beware of the guardian. It will be hastening here to investigate the vault opening.
That's going to bring the Necramech running, well, striding. You better get ready.
The Necramech is coming. Fight well; I wish you luck.
Emergency. Micro-jump escape activated. Goodbye, Tenno.
Uh-oh I'm outta here, cya!
My casing is compromised. I must withdraw. Good luck, Tenno.
With the generators all active, it is now possible to open the vault. One obstacle remains...
Ok power's on, now we gotta use that code on the door!
Now that I have activated all of the generators, the vault door is now active and awaiting the correct code...
While disabling one arm is a good start, the Necramech remains eighty-two percent combat effective.
You got his arm! You're doing great!
Well done, one arm down. Keep at it, more of the same.
With both arms disabled the Necramech is still forty percent combat effective. Do not stop attacking.
You got his other arm! That's brilliant!
Another arm out of action. Excellent work, almost there...
The Necramech has ceased function. A most satisfactory outcome.
Aaaaand he's down! Never doubted you for a minute, Chip!
I confess I had my concerns, but that was expertly handled. The guardian is completely disabled.
Ah. The Necramech guardian is here. Defend yourself, Tenno.
Here's the big guy! He sure ain't pleased to see you, Chip!
The guardian of the vault approaches. You must defeat it, Tenno.
Error. Two attempts left.
Oh boy, that ain't it! Good thing you got two more tries!
Unfortunate. You have two attempts remaining.
You have failed the sanity test. The vault is now sealed. Disappointing.
Oh wow you blew it completely! I'm kind of impressed. We ain't getting into that vault now.
Final attempt failed. Vault has locked down permanently. Are you in fact deranged?
Error. One attempt left.
You just bein' dramatic, right? You know you only got one shot left, right?
You are down to your last attempt. I suggest you think carefully this time.
You are almost through the Infested tunnels. The Entrati ruins lie just ahead.
Just a little further! You're almost through the icky infested bits, the ruins await!
The Entrati ruins are close. Keep pushing, and you will be there in no time.
Much that was found in the Void ultimately remained buried down here. Even before the Infestation the vaults were a hazardous area to enter.
This was a bad, bad place way back when. The Void could send you crazy and you had to stay in here 'til you calmed down.
Isolation was always difficult for the Entrati to endure. It seemed to eat at them, erode them, so each time they dreaded it a little more.
Shed no tears for the Necramech. For they are now relentless enemies to all. And there is no countermanding that.
Spooky ain't it? I think the family forgot a lot of what's really down here, even before the infestation they'd begun to stay away. Well. most of them had.
The vaults were extended and reinforced many times. The outer layers have all but collapsed under the Infestation's relentless spread, but the inner chambers remain unbreached.
It seemed such a worthy endeavour when it all began. Precautions were taken, protocols followed. Look at them now.
They knew the Void'd hurt them but they kept going back, poking around trying to figure stuff out. Sure, it was important, but I think they started to hate it.
You are not the only one to take an interest in isolation vaults of late. It is a fascinating development, really. Seeking a future in the past, perhaps.
Some of the knowledge that was brought back from the Void never left these vaults. I hope you can find a use for it.
There's all kindsa stuff down here. Some Void stuff they never let out of iso 'cause  it was sooo not fun.
I do not know what riches you may find, if any, but you will certainly discover some small measure of wisdom locked away down here.
Infestation activity has dropped to virtually zero. A speedy resolution.
All clear. Task performed with creditable expedience. Additional reward authorised.
That's the lot! You dealt with the scratch-ikins double-quick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD: Alright, that's enough. Return the specimens to me, and I'll give Loid what he needs to take you down to the Heart.
You're still alive! That means we can fix this, we can get the Heart back if we work together.
Tenno! You've got to avoid detection!
Be patient! Let them pass before moving on.

Tenno? Still functional? Listen carefully. Getting back to the surface is not going to be easy. I don't know how to break this to you but your Warframe… it's barely functional. You're going to have to stay low and out of sight. I know a shortcut, but you've got to do the rest.
Alright, with the Void closing up, you're going to be too weak to help in that frame.
Snake's in rough shape, but she's got enough juice for one last ride. What do you say? Ready to go 'Old War' style?

Alright. Not ideal, but I've cross-routed your Warframe impulse stream directly to Snake. Now, she'll feel heavy but you'll get used to it. Head outside and we'll run a field test before your descent.
You're nearly out. Be cautious.
It's too soon for them… Are you sure about this?
Not at all. But we'll have to make an exception. Just this once.
Having fun? I mean it looks fun! And quite dangerous. Oh good, there's another up ahead!
Alright, but there's another up ahead. Watch for its pattern and try to get past it.
Alright. I've got the calculus data for a restart, but I'll need ten quanta of Leptosam. Son?
Let her sleep. Wouldn't want her to worry.
Even if I agreed to help, what about the Necramechs down there? Just one of those things…
I… I have it… should we wake up Grandmother?
Do you think they will be willing to go back down? Son and I can bait the Wyrm to draw the Infestation away, up to the surface.
I've got a little something that I've been saving for an occasion like this.
Lots of Bitey Scratchikins on the scope. Maybe they're planning a party for you!?
But think of all the time we'd have for hobbies…
To be fair - it was not exactly a 'simple mistake'.
Son has strange ideas about what victory looks like. The Solar Rails, The Tenno, we all depend on the Heart to keep the wall open to the other side. If the Heart stops, everything goes with it.

Noticed my collar, did you? A not-so-gentle reminder from dearest Mother. No one in the universe can hold a grudge as deep or as long. She took away all my Entrati command words with it. Loid's got more respect in this family than I do. One simple mistake.

How many times do I have to say I'm sorry? I broke the containment protocol. I carried the spores in. I screwed up. And suddenly, they all acknowledged my existence! Suddenly something I'd done actually mattered! As if humiliating me would undo what happened to them. We're a lost cause. The Infestation will come for what's left of us, in time. Ah! Speak of them, and they shall appear!
Admit it, Tenno. It's beautiful, isn't it? Maybe it's not the abomination you think it is. Maybe it knows better than Mother. Maybe we ought to succumb to it. Let it win.
By the Heart, it's… dead.
Oh, so you're talking to us now?
Stop.
STOP!
Good.
Shut up! I wanna see how low she can dig.
The wall's closing, Mother. It's over.
Mother, don't. This isn't the time.
I wonder where he gets that from?
Oh please, you've been playing dead since the day I was born.
Good? You think this is 'good'?
Of course, you do, anything to make you feel better about yourself.
At least he didn't try to kill me.
Well, I wish you hadn't.
Proceed to the Heart. Otak and I will take a damage-assessment scan of it.
Hm. That doesn't sound happy.
Requiem Cipher. I'm embarrassed to say I'm unsure what to make of this. Tenno, can you figure it out?
Don't distract them. This is very mentally taxing for a Tenno.
I didn't expect you'd get through the door before I had a chance to finish. Forgive me, but this is the only way.
Success!
Clearance approved, Tenno. I now grant access… to the Necralisk. Mother awaits, but I should warn you, she is not entirely herself.
'Intra-dimensional' what?
Sounds like it bears repeating, Loid.
Otak, I've already explained it.
It's not that we don't trust ya Chip but... to let you in, I think we'd just feel better with the gesture. Come back with gore on your hands, thanks!
If we were unclear… demonstrate your readiness by destroying Infestation. Only then will I grant entry clearance. Act accordingly.
When you get to the Heart, you'll have to patch the damage and then we'll restart the system. It's a lot, but we're counting on you.
--Daughter, the spores… Son, you're on repairs.
--Tenno, can't have this area contaminated. Clear out those Infested and destroy their spore clusters before we seal the chamber.
Where the hell is that Necramech?
No one listens to me--
I rigged Snake with an old Omni tool. Ready?
Spore clusters, clear.

They're an insufferable lot, aren't they? My son, Father. Blustery and spineless, all at once. His absentee wife, Mother, who can't see past what she's lost… to see what she has. And who can blame the children? Daughter, trying to convince herself she's so different. It only makes her more the same. And the boy, poor Son, he mistakes kindness for mediocrity. Who's he competing with other than himself? But in a crisis, they can come together.

I've no idea what you're talking about… but even as they've forgotten themselves, their names, their bonds… they might still be a family. Seems you're an important part of that now. So maybe I can help you and your family? This Warframe Xaku. Somewhat of a family themselves. A sum of many, a composite of others we lost in the ages that our Entrati family has served here.
There… and now… I think we've had more than enough excitement for one day. I could do with a little lie down...
--There's no time for training exercises.
---Tenno. Get down there. You're just going to have to learn as you go.
Alright, squeeze off a few rounds, and get a feel for the--
But we've got to prepare--
Typical.
That's my girl! Glorious!
You've got this, Snake!
Yes. A rest…
You gave her a good send-off. You have my thanks. Ah, Snake... I'm gonna miss you. But you've earned your rest, alright? Rerouting you…
Snake? SNAAAAAAKE!!!
Snake? SNAAAAAAKE!!!
There it is! Tenno, you've got to destroy this thing or we're back where we started!
Hu-ho-ho! You have no idea how jealous I am right now!
I've managed to bring additional systems online.
She's waking up. You should have additional functionality.
Rerouting power to… yes. Secondary systems are back up.
That's it! All systems active. She's fully operational. Go get 'em.
Seal the Chamber. Initiating restart sequence. By Lohk we pass through and beyond.
Restart in 3… 2… 1…
Again. 3… 2… 1…
It doesn't make sense. Something must be interfering… I checked the equations.
Don't yell at me! Again!
That should hold. What do you think, Mother?
Perfect, just perfect.
You sure you've got the correct derivatives?
The chamber's sealed, that's it for your ride and a one way trip for poor Snake. I'll cut the reroute as soon as the Heart's beating, and you'll be back to your old self again.
Well, check them again!
Come on, Snake, stay together.
I know you can do this. Track the patterns, anticipate.
Oh, so it's ok if you do it?
--Take it easy. I've summoned some Velocipods too.
The caves won't be exactly clear... but it should help. I've dispersed some specimens to keep the Infested out of the way.
Eat Pobber pellets, you--
You're going to help me rebuild my sample collection. You're probably wondering what happened to it in the first place. Why don't you ask Brother when you see him.

Note the curious way they float above the surface to feed. Don't bother trying to spear them in the Exocrine itself. Too damn viscous. Their biology is crucial to my study. Infested, but not entangled in shared consciousness. If there's a hope in halting our mental decline, it might be here in these humble little specimens. Get to it.
Looks like you've got the hang of it… but you have to understand, helping my so-called 'family' is the last thing I'm inclined to do. You'll have to make it worthwhile.
We call that Wyrm 'Fass'. Don't worry about him, though; he's got bigger problems than you.
'Vome'. His sister. They don't get along, as you'll soon see.
This is a good opportunity for you, actually. There should be useful detritus falling from the explosion… try not to get crushed, little one.
I'm afraid I cannot open the gate with hostiles in proximity. You'll need to destroy them before I even think of powering the door!

I remember my birthday. Woke with a knot in my stomach. The hum of my specimen tanks was missing, silent… but I was surprised to find a little box, wrapped in a red bow. A gift from my family that never, ever remembered. The note said: "Best wishes for my best Sis." Can you guess what was in the box?

A white powder, as smooth and fine as silk. My entire collection, cremated, atomized, and returned as a gift by my deranged Brother. If you see him on your descent to the Heart, don't be fooled. He'll stab you in the back if he thinks it'll get him a moment's notice from Mother.

Don't feel the least bit sad for him. He'll regenerate an even emptier head and exact his revenge. An endless cycle. Vome's the only proof I've got that the hivemind can be divided. Just collect what you can so you get to the task at hand…
Detecting active Necramech signals nearby. It could be Father. He loves a good fight. Whatever you do, don't mention Mother. Nothing he hates more.
That went well!
This must be one of the last of Father's Necramechs - it won't last long.
Guidance signal was coming from over there.
Its struggle is a valiant one, but I fear the worst for our metal friend.
Ah! The stalwart defender falls. Rest well, noble Warrior. May you some day rise again. Now: to business.
--'Functional'? We are… and we've summoned Chip here to help us!
Here we go again.
Mother...
No, Mother. You did all of that. You're as wormed as the rest of this place. The Heart is about to fail, remember?
Loid, I had the most distressing dream--
--The Wall of Lohk was before us, I had my proofs, my father's. I could hear him... I could hear him tapping... tapping at the Untime door--
--we went in but again, he wasn't there. My husband congratulated me. Sarcastic halfwit. All the while, hive-weed was sprouting all around us. But, it was just a dream.
Oh... Oh... oh fu--
It'll take more than an old Orokin thug to keep the Heart beating.
Oh, I don't blame you, you're just the product. The Orokin had no respect for my father's work. Though I suppose you proved him right in the end.

Same as Deimos. The Infestation got in. Got to me and my family. Stole our names, our ideas. I can hear its hive-voice scratching in my mind: let the Heart stop beating, let the door close forever. Only my dreams seem real now, so I sleep.

It's what makes you special, you know that, right? All thanks to my father. It pumps the arteries of 'the here' and the Void. The Entrati family has maintained it for an age. But it's breaking down, and only that idiot knows how to fix it… the man I used to call my husband. I think he's left for good this time… Maybe you can find him? Probably sulking somewhere outside…
Oh! Aren't you a fascinating specimen? Organic-ferrous exoflesh, hybridized internals, Untime trace… you're a Tenno, aren't you?

You need me to tell you where it is. Which I wouldn't have to bother with if not for my parents, whose collective heads are so far up their collective lower sigmoids the only air they breathe is what they secrete.

Aww… that's kind of sweet. But look at us. We are beyond help. The disease vectors are too complex, changing faster than I can study them. We can only prolong the inevitable. Look, if you help me get back some of what my brother shredded, I'd be happy to return the favor. Deal?
We must prove to Father that the Heart is deteriorating. This will be more dangerous than any Grey Strain monster we've faced: We have to talk to... Daughter.
You fight well for a runt-frame! If you're ever interested in something a little more 'Old War' sized… Wait. Wait. She didn't send you looking for me, did she? I'm not going back.
Look, you were the second wave, kid. The Necramechs were Void-shielded, Sentient-pulse immune… as bright as a bag of hammers and just as dependable. Not like you.

When I met her, Mother, she was as brilliant as she was broken. Chasing her father's ghost, convinced he was still 'out there'. I thought… I thought I could fix things. I thought I could fix her. Like she was a loose light-board or leaky hydraulic. So yes, she's right about me: I am an idiot. But I'm a reformed idiot. I'm done with her. This "Heart is breaking down" is just another tactic of hers. Don't you see? Everything has to be about her.
What?! Visitors?!
Look at you now, a real 'Chip' off the ole monolith! Just the right sort to save us from the coming cataclysm! C'mon!
--Sorry Loid, it's just too exciting!
--but how are you, anyway? Things good?
I call that one 'Bitey Scratchikins!'
Tenno.
You received our distress signal. Mother will be pleased--
We agreed: I was handling orientation protocol--

We are in crisis, Tenno. Our defense against the Grey Strain has failed. The NECRALISK is in lock-down but it doesn't matter. The Infestation has compromised the very Heart itself. We have been forced to re-phase into Martian--
