As I was saying, our defense situation is dire. Our remaining Necramechs have reverted to their autonomous-kill precepts. They will not distinguish you from those things.

It is imperative you meet Mother, receive her instructions, and prevent the imminent intra-dimensional catastrophe. Demonstrate your combat readiness and I will grant you the requisite security clearance. Good luck.
It's not your fault, Chip!
Have we tried turning it off and on again?
The Infestation wormed into everything. After the great purge - there were no Dax, no Tenno, to defend the place. Just us.
Technically it is… and now you face an existential threat. If the Heart stops beating, the wellspring of your power dies with it.
Tenno, meet the head of the Entrati family. What's left of her, anyway.
Mother! Wake up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAlc: Alchemy? Did we finally figure out how to make gold from lead? Magnifique!
Alchemy. Tinkering with forces they clearly did not understand. What unholy project seared this onto your psyche, Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArb: Bah! Take down the drones first, or else you are simply wasting your time!
The little flying ones are protecting the others, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArc: Look at you, Drifter, masquerading as a winged angel. As if we don't all know the truth. You're no more angel than I.
Take to the skies, Drifter. For Sol's sake you must banish these demons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss: Whoever gave life to this beast thinks themselves equal to the Luminaries. Please, I ask you, undo this blasphemy.
What better fit for the heretic than a creature as unnatural as this archon. Such a chimera could never have been created under the light of our Sol.
I sense nothing from this one. No malice. No hate. No jealousy. Just an overwhelming urge for emptiness. This…entity must be defeated.
The Fragmented One. When you confront this beast, you are battling against nothingness, fighting for the very concept of life itself. This is a battle none of us can afford you to lose.
My favorite kind of violence: targeted, vindictive… intimate…
"In Lua's name, we strike down our enemy - not with joy, but with mercy."
This must be one of the many demons that does not blindly follow Roathe. Teach it some discipline.
So, it falls to our drifter to vanquish the demons from this heretic's psyche. Demons that Roathe seems either unwilling or unable to purge himself.
The sinner who leads others into sin carries the weighty guilt of all those they led astray. This creature before you is one such sinner.
Drifter, is this hateful wretch a demon from Roathe's past or yours? Either way, your descent is halted until they have been dispatched.
What wicked souls this future holds! I do not generally advocate for murder, but in this instance, an exception I must make.
Oh Kullervo, you sorry beast. So suggestable. So angry. A perfect citizen for this purgatory.
Does this one not understand? All sins are forgivable, but first one must forgive themselves. There is no redemption in revenge.
All Lua's creatures are sacred… but I am willing to entertain arguments against the spider. I am not a fan.
Wait… Is that? What wicked abomination scuttles forth? I… I must look away. I do not do well with spiders.
Were these wretched creatures sentenced to this purgatory because of their music? I have heard their noise, and believe the answer is… yes.
In my life I have strived to endure countless mortifications, and none was more arduous, more tortuous, nothing shook my faith like listening to music from the year 1999.
This poor creature, corrupted first by ambition, then by the Void. Does he himself know he is not pure? Tenno, help him find Sol.
Loyal. Driven. Relentless. Fanatical. I respect this Vor fellow. Even if he is a glorified vat rat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos: A battle against a powerful foe. It seems Roathe got his own hands bloody, on occasion.
Such battles were meat and drink to me! Study the foe closely. Match their movements. Honor them with the intimacy of death.
Lua! Shield us with your grace! Bless our blades with your light!
Only the light of Lua can prevail against such hellfire!
Let the devil strike this holy image! Sol's fire is stronger than his!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBre: Mindless destruction. Perhaps this is a memory of the devil's from when he was a little boy, smashing his toys.
A massacre of targets that do not fight back? Familiar. The only problem is narrowing it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef: Like an unfortunate urchin, Father Lyon Allard has become caught in the machinery. If this descent is to continue, best make sure he is not chewed to pieces.
The devil's depravity has drawn Lyon into its vortex! You must keep him safe!
The Refractory is trying to purge Marie from the system! However amusing that is, if it succeeds, this venture is over!
No! Marie, take heart. Our friends will defend you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc: We went to Tau to make a new and glorious home for ourselves. Resources were simply required to begin again.
Such machines… what empty scars they must leave in their wake. Yet without them, no progress is to be made.
Sol, guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal... Sol, guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal...
It is all right, Marie… they are only phantoms, they cannot truly harm you.
I can only pray that the Luminaries took pity on all these poor souls…
How ill-equipped we Orokin were for war - that we had no gods behind which to take shelter from the atrocity of it all.
In these deepest reaches, I fear Lua's light will not pierce the veil…
Be strong, brother of my soul - we will endure this torment!
Lua, be with us… Stay with us, now…
Come, shadows of my past - wage siege upon my mind all you like! You did not defeat me then, and you shall not defeat me now!
"Though my feet step on the sands of the shores of Death, I shall see Thy countenance shining upon the waves, and be glad."
My soldiers never recited doggerel. They just wept and cried for their mothers as they died.
Is it safe for us to delve this deep?
Bah! The only dangers here are imagined ones - though you are the expert of such things, are you not?
We have travelled far in one another's company. Nothing like shared horror to breed kinship.
'Horror.' I would have you spend an hour within my mind, Roathe, and see how you fare.
This is a kingdom built of my mind, and I, its emperor! I command you all - obey me! Stand down!
There are no servants here for you to scream at, Roathe. Only far braver souls than you.
Sol has fled from this place - these memories - the Luminaries cannot help us here.
Your "Luminaries" were never real, Marie. And if they were? They would have turned their faces from us in disgust.
This suffering begins to feel like great boulders, one more upon my shoulders with each floor.
Indeed. Imagine what it was like to live this kind of carnage in the waking world, Marie?
This war you fought, Roathe. Was it… truly madness to such a degree as this?
Was it this charmingly fantastical? No. Does this capture the level of egregious cruelty and mindless, horrific butchery? Yes.
Par Sol! How are we meant to endure this suffering?
The most simplistic concept that is impossible to teach and yet so very quick to learn the moment one sets foot into the theatre of war is this; those who can, are those who survive.
More, and more, and more… See them all. Count them if you dare to try. Every bullet. Every corpse. Every life spent. This is the song of war.
Lua, guide us…
What was so worth taking, that you were willing to bring… such terrible death?
Salvation.
Cloned soldiers, royal guards, hulking necramechs and Void-torn children. All to see the Sentient uprising laid low. And what did it amount to, in the end?
Such is the cycle of all revolutions…
Drifter - if you feel this is too much, we can turn back. Do not put yourself at risk for his sake.
I do not hold the Drifter's leash. If they wish to end this, they are quite free to do so.
Hm. This chaotic adaptation of your mind to my memories - is not wholly unlike the Sentient's ability to adapt to new attacks. It is nearly just as irritating.
Need I remind you that the Drifter is aiding you by doing this, Roathe.
I commend you assisting Roathe in this pursuit - but do not endanger your psyche on his behalf, Drifter.
They have their own motives in this "pursuit," I assure you.
I take no responsibility for the corruption that happens to my memories as they are filtered through the Drifter's psyche. I do not want to hear anyone whining.
The only complaints I hear are from you, Roathe.
What could this… even possibly represent?
Oh, yes, that was a fantastic evening…
The Dark Refractory, as brilliant a design as it is, does not work on those with Infested blood. Oh, how I wish I could do this alone.
Are you certain that is the reason it rejects you? And not some other deeper corruption, perhaps?
Phantoms of your past, dancing on puppet strings… a morbid dance, to what end?
Oh Void. Lyon, you are miserable at poetry. Do us all a favor, and stop.
This place… it reeks of evil. Even the look of it speaks of horror.
I hate to tell you, Marie - but your dear Albrecht is to blame for most of this… aesthetic.
Remarkable. Hold the lens of another's mind to your own, and what comes out the other end is a sea of fragmented colors like the twist of a child's toy to rays of light.
Ha! I thought this was simply just one of your less flattering evenings, devil.
And what is this supposed to represent, devil? Your childhood? Your mother, perhaps?
I will remind you that I could have abandoned you in that primitive and unenlightened hellhole, yet I did not!
Why could you not summon a memory of a quaint summer picnic, espèce d'énorme casse-pieds!
Why, I deeply apologize that my memories of war are troubling you so, Marie! You are welcome to depart at any time! There is the door.
Hm. This… This, I admit, I am having trouble discerning where its origins might lie in my memories.
I do not know which is more troubling - when you can recall… or when you cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExt: I believe the meaning of this is quite clear - death. And a great deal of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo: Pathetic. Well, wake up. Let us begin again.
I am sorry. I do hope this is not causing damage to you…
Oh! By Sol, you poor thing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel: Ash and bones!
Uriel, ignite my blood!
For you, a blistering kiss.
I invoke… devastation.
Do you smell burning?
Ignis!
I am the Inferno.
Savour the pain!
A gift.
Enough of this.
This ends now.
Is this what you came for?
Kneel! Kneel and I spare you!
Alight! ALIGHT!
Uriel demands BRIMSTONE!
Breathe in the smoke!
Melt as wax!
Burn!
Vythelas!
Catenach!
Gulphagor!
Well played.
I will see you… soon.
Good form… nicely done.
Next time? Aim a little higher - to the left.
Not bad, Drifter… Not bad.
Match; Drifter.
I do hate… this part.
Effective. Inefficient but effective…
And here I thought… you loved me.
All is fair in love and war, hm…?
You will be paying this back to me later, I assume, lover?
And I thought you were the one who enjoyed taking a beating…?
Was this for what I said last night? You needn't… make it so dramatic…
Is it strange how romantic I am finding this?
Is this how you treat all your lovers?
If you wanted me on my knees at your feet… there were easier ways, dear…
No. NO! What have you done?!
Marie, Lyon. Say nothing.
You are a SAVAGE.
To the stronger monster: I yield.
When we wake, I'm drowning you.
Hm. Fire didn't work. I think I'll just drown you.
It's your throne now, Usurper. Use it wisely.
I know what whispers in your skull, Lyon. Fire silences them all.
I will burn the optimism right out of your very marrow, Marie!
Lyon. Marie. A BAPTISM of Brimstone for you!
There is no concept you could embody that is grander than ME!
Pray me away, Marie! Just try!
Chain me, wound me, I only grow stronger LYON!
(Laughter)
Mm, did that hurt? I do hope so.
Do try a little harder than that!
Come and dance with the Devil of Tau!
See how wonderfully it burns?!
Yes! Bleed!
All turns to ash before me, as will you!
Oh, how I wish to see you suffer.
Go! Turn and leave me here, before it is too late! You know not what you do!
Why? Come to debase me even more? Or are you just here to rob my corpse?
I really do not know why I continue to agree to this. Fine…
You should be quite glad that you are doing this in a dreamstate. And not, in fact, in real life.
Tell me, did fighting and dying in Duviri become this boring after a while?
Must we? Yes, we must. All right, here we are, perfunctory, perfunctory, perfunctory.
I suppose this is all at least a distraction from lurking in that crypt all day.
I can think of twenty one reasons why you should have stopped this by now, and one very good reason why I should have stopped going along with it.
Yes. Come. Laugh at the coward Roathe. Why not?
Oh, how perfect. How transcendently flawless. Of course - of course - I am what waits for us! I am my own worst enemy.
Back for more, are we? Yes, I get the feeling we have only begun to scratch the surface of what was hidden away.
Third time's the charm, as they say? Have at thee!
Each time we do this - you bleed a little more out of me… What a sick game this is. I like it.
Five times now, you've done all this work to turn over a new stone in my mind… I'm simply flattered.
Albrecht saw fit to defile my mind! If you want that scrawny little butler of his to march up those stairs, you will do as I say! Fight me!
Drop. By bloody. Drop. I will have it all back. Until I know what is missing. SEVEN. AGAIN!
Eight. And still, I feel there are holes - sections of my mind, left incomplete. Why?! Why, Albrecht?!
Nine! Is this what it was like for you in Duviri, Drifter? Endlessly. Tirelessly. Dying. Come. Let us dance.
We Orokin played all manner of games with each other, you know. Twisted, political games - psychological warfare - romantic intrigue that would make you sick. But this? Nothing like this. TEN!
I think that is what makes me so intensely furious at Albrecht - this level of corruption. What he took from me. We Orokin played games. But memories? Memories to us were… sacred. ELEVEN!

Look at our ultimate punishment, Drifter. Not the Jade Light - but to turn someone into a Cephalon. To be able to rewrite someone's memories at will! To change what they have experienced is to change who they are. TWELVE!
What Albrecht did to me? He corrupted my very being, Drifter. To rob me of my memories… is to change how I know myself. Is to change Roathe. And that. Cannot. Stand. THIRTEEN.

I will abide by so many kinds of depraved games, Drifter. The kinds that would make your skin crawl just to think about it. We Orokin were fundamentally immortal, after all. But to rob me of myself? No. FOURTEEN!
I do not care where Albrecht has gone to hide. I do not care what steps he has gone to to protect himself from his so-called "Indifference." I. Will. Kill. Him. FIFTEEN.
To render a man into nothing more than - than this? A miserable pile of secrets unto himself? It is a greater sin than any Orokin could ever have dreamt up in their wildest nightmares. SIXTEEN.
I am a patient killer, Drifter. I am, above all, a strategic man. If you need Albrecht to survive long enough to save the universe? I am not so foolhardy… I will wait. For now. SEVENTEEN!
Mark my words, Drifter. The moment "the Indifference" is dealt with, and Albrecht is no longer required? I will lick his hot, wet blood from my claws… Eighteen.
I have learned enough, Drifter. I am whole enough. Stop here, and turn back. Leave this place now.
No. Drifter. Stop. Stop immediately. There are memories that are buried for good reason, and I command you to LEAVE!
I am not a man who begs. I am a man who bargains. And whatever you wish for, you shall have it - whatever you desire, it shall be yours. Simply turn around… please…
On your knees. Where you belong.
Oh, that was fun. Let's go again, shall we?
Try not to take it personally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHiv: Bursting pustules. I fear we have strayed into Roathe's adolescence.
Such boils fester within all. Sin is our sickness. We are morbid with guilt and shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInf: This one is easy - the air on Tau was toxic for us. And so, efforts had to be made to make it less so. See that you do the same, if you wish to survive.
What is that horrible smell? Devil, is that you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt: Like fleeting thoughts that escape one's grasp, these devices seek to elude us.
Chase the drone, catch the drone! Did the devil play children's games once, long ago?
Ah, the Dark Refractory… a wonderous Orokin invention. Turning memories and visions into lucid waking nightmares. Shall we begin our descent?
Albrecht's serum tore my memories from my mind - and this Dark Refractory is the key to unlocking them. Violently. Let us begin.
A shame this Orokin invention does not work with Infested blood… I could do this in peace and quiet. Well? What are you waiting for?
My blood is… unworthy. Violent. The machine demands yours. Offer it.
Albrecht stole my mind. Violence is the sole means to reclaim it. Show me you speak the language of death.
Albrecht you thief! I will tear my memories back, whatever the cost.
Hush now - let us spill some blood, but we dare not disturb Albrecht's slumbering progeny.
How quaint of Albrecht to make his devices picky. My veins flow too richly with strain, yours do not. A simpler vintage. Go on, then.
Lucid nightmares in a golden pond. How... Orokin.
A tower like this would have been worth a fortune on Tau. A shame that land is not quite up for grabs anymore, hm, Usurper?
To trespass the halls of ones own mind in search of answers. If the Gods were ever real, they'd have written such a story don't you think?
Why? Why return here? To this? To use my past - to use me - for target practice?! Very well! On we go!
Yes. Come. Kick my corpse. Mock the memories of my violent past. I suppose it is better than you doing this in the waking world.
After all you have learned, you return here. Why? Do you believe there is something left to be gained? Some stone left unturned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLeg: Ah! Hunting with a Kavat! We used to set them on convicts back in my day. Splendid for working up an appetite.
Dear sweet giant cat, lead us swiftly to the heart of corruption!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo: Go on. Rummage through my things. Take what you need, it's not like I can stop you… yet.
Even his memories are a mess. Clean this place up. Take what suits you, he obviously does not care for it.
What is the gluttonous beast hoarding the spoils of war? And what is that odour? Roathe, is this your true form?
This demon, this Gruzzling, it mocks us all with its greed. It must vanquished. For decency's sake.
I am accustomed to not trusting that which I see… I may be to blame for this one.
In the fog of war, that which you perceive often is not as it seems. Be watchful.
I dislike being mocked. And I even more so dislike being hunted. Kill that thing.
Do you ever get the feeling as though you are being watched?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo: You have arrived… good.
Ah. There you are.
You are… whole?
Enter. Rest.
Here, you are safe.
The phantoms shall not touch you here.
Fear not. Lua shields us.
Mon miracle - how may I aid you?
Let me lend you Lua's shield, my love…
Lua's light will guard you, mon miracle.
Wherever you shall go, I shall follow at your side.
Come, mon miracle, in this place you shall know no fear.
You have come to be blessed, yet it is I who feels lighter by seeing your face.
Let me touch you, and heal what little suffering I can, my love…
To endure such horror… and for what? For him? I am forever in awe of you.
And it is I who they would accuse of being part of the statuary.
Does this idleness serve a purpose? Or has your mind simply wandered?
Hm. I wonder if you have "transferred" elsewhere. Such as to fetch luncheon.
We all have better tasks we could be seeing to.
What, literally, are we waiting for?
Are you afraid or… merely unprepared?
(Sigh)
This is becoming insufferable…
Lua's blessing is not so bold as Sol - it will be with you, when all else seems to fall away.
Silver tears of Lua, wash over this soul - be with them in darkness and in pain.
In the agony of the night's darkest terrors, Lua comes to bring us home. And she comes to you now.
A blessing of Lua is a steel thread - clutch it tight, and it shall shatter. Let it weave through you, and it is unbreakable.
Lua bless your path.
We descend.
Yes. Onward.
If we must.
Together.
Yes, mon miracle.
With me by your side.
As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMan: Manics! Their minds are shattered. They know nothing but aggression. For them death is the only possible mercy. Give them salvation.
Would you look at that? Grineer Manics. Madness weaponized. You can't help but admire the mind who brought these to life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar: I was just about to light the candles.
Bonjour, bonjour! Peace… what little I can grant, in this dreary place.
Come, rest - and take what blessings Sol may grant to you.
Here, I might gather you into my mind, if only for a little.
A moment to breathe, before we move on, n'est-ce pas?
In this desolation of the devil's mind, we take what shelter we can.
Come! Sol's light has not abandoned you yet - and neither have I.
And did you think little Marie had left your side? Jamais!
Mon cœur, there you are! I was so worried!
And there is my wolf, at last - come, let me tend to you.
Oh, mon cœur! Come, and let me give you my help in this terrible place.
I do not know why you insist on helping that awful devil - but where my wolf goes, I shall always follow.
I shall never leave your side, mon cœur.
Take shelter in me, mon cœur - as I so often have in you.
My wolf - rest, and let me comfort thee in what little ways I can.
Come, mon cœur! Let Sol bless you, as you have blessed me.
If we are going to stand about and collect dust, I would rather do it somewhere else, n'est-ce pas?
I do not like lingering in the devil's mind. It makes me… itch.
The longer we stay here, the more I start to feel like I have a tail. Can we go now, s'il vous plaît?
Is there a purpose to your stalling, or have you fallen asleep?
I do not think we can stand here forever. Ô Sol, tout sauf ça. Je ne veux pas être piégée dans l'esprit de ce singe pour toute l'éternité...
Are we… lingering… for a reason? There must be a reason… n'est-ce pas?
Are you looking for hidden prizes? Trésors de lutin, perhaps?
I do not like the fighting, but… neither do I trust the silence. May we go?
Sol has guided us here for a reason… there is much work to be done.
May the light of Sol show the way through this dark and accursed place. Stay strong. We are with you.
I beseech thee, Sol, to bless them. For though you do not know their face, you know their heart.
Sol will guide you now through this terrible task, I know it. Be strong.
May Sol guide you.
Sol be in your heart.
Oui, we fight on.
With Sol's light, we will endure.
Be strong, mon cœur - I am with you.
I have faith in you, my wolf.
These corrupted memories will never defeat you, mon cœur!
Remember, mon cœur - the devil's horrid past cannot harm you, if you do not let it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMel: A struggle to keep pressure from becoming too great. What were you bursting with, Roathe? Anger? Humiliation? Lust?
Bon. The devil's is our locomotive and we must blow off his steam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DNec: Ah, the ever-ready, if not always effective Necramechs. Their devisor never received enough credit for his creations…
While the effectiveness of these lumbering Necramechs fell off towards the end of the war, we never would have survived to that point without them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRac: Speed would be important when on the battlefield, I suppose.
Ah. Yes. I remember training for live combat… I do not miss it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRed: Usually, I relish attention, but I recommend staying out of the light. Trust me.
This light, it is not of Sol. It is the searing attention of scrutiny. It will burn you if you let it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol: I do not know what is funnier - the sight of this, or how wonderfully deranged it is!
Un jeu de bagatelle? Children's toys have come to murder us all?! Devil! I blame you for this!
Do not underestimate any kind of foe in large numbers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSen: Ah, finally. The Sentients. My true enemy.
These are them? The lost souls of Tau? I… only feel a kind of sadness for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DShr: Deep within Roathe's own psyche we find a shrine. To himself. Why am I not surprised?
Our society was rotten through with ritual. I dimly recall some ceremony or other like this one? Offerings? Tribute?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSpe: Some advice I learned early in my career, if I may? It is not what you kill, but who you kill that matters in the end. So… get out there and kill someone… special.
A rotten fruit will spoil the whole bushel, as the saying goes. Seek out the sinner amongst them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi: I must give recognition to whatever lunatic managed to repurpose such well-worn Orokin turrets. They certainly were not intended to do this.
From this, I feel… the ghosts of a great sadness that reach from beyond the veil.
Mm. We used to train like this - forced out of our armor, defenseless, exposed. The ghosts, however? That, I admit, is novel.
A time when the devil was exposed? Forced to fight for his life? Ah, to have seen that in person!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem: No! The work is not done!
Please, help!
No. NO!
I do not fear what comes!
This pain is his will.
Not here. Not now!
You cannot kill my soul!
I can endure.
This is impossible!
The whispers grow louder...
Find me in the afterlife.
Of course, this would be how it ends!
Do not avenge me, please.
You will get me up this instant, do you hear me?!
This pain gives me STRENGTH!
Please bury me with my people.
Help me up, or I will draw and quarter you!
You think this suffering is not welcome?
I cannot let a heathen win!
I will rip off your finger nails one at a time, if you do not help me immediately!
Watch… over Marie.
I was too weak.
I cannot die, I cannot die, I cannot die, I cannot die.
Death is a sweet temptation…
