When the weather grows warm, and mother is inattentive, I love to dip my head in the cool, bubbling stream. Mother shies me away from water, ever since father was taken by the sea. Or so she tells me.
I feel I owe the sweet, little citizens of the world a great debt of compassion. When I am heartsick they afford a great and abiding comfort.
Blessings upon you as broad as your compassionate shoulders, Outlaw.
I wonder what father would have had to say about you, Outlaw. Mother looks upon you kindly… and father was always contrary… so perhaps it is best you never did meet. Yes.

I find it curious - do you not? - that one has no memory of what they were before they were themself. As I remember nothing about it, I know nothing of it. And yet, I am certain, I was not always Koral. Were you always an Outlaw, I wonder?
I think I should very much like to be a Tamm. I would live upon cress and milk and gambol with my friends and never ever be sad.
I wished to gather some water bugs for our supper. I asked the fishes if they had seen any, but they were greedy and wanted them for themselves and so said nothing.
What are you gawping at?
Peasants. Getting their filth all over everything.
One day, Imp. One day I get to hear your scrawny neck go snap.
I haven't forgotten how you spoke to me, "Drifter". I should have your tongue for that.
Oh, not AGAIN! THAT REALLY BOILS MY… URRRGH!
MY TROOPS SHOULD HAVE BEEN HERE AN HOUR AGO!
WHY ARE YOU EVEN RIDING A BLOODY KAITHE IF YOU DON'T KNOW HOW TO CONTROL IT?
Someone find me some troops with some COMMON SODDING SENSE!
Next time I'll stay in control. Keep out of Wyrm form. Dethrone the little bastard.
One more second of that miserable bloody singing and I'll go to the edge and jump off.
Again and again I lose myself, and devastation follows.
Did you come to mock me?
If you dare come to me with pity, I shall throw it back in your face.
Do you see the marks his anger left on the land?
I weep for ownerless toys, and empty chairs. Letters unsent and love long forgotten. Should I weep for you, too?
Bombastine envies me. The King's Favorite. He wishes we could trade places. So do I.
If the Void truly preserves consciousness… then there is no hope of an end!
I was created to be Sorrow. Written into being. To serve as a lesson. Can that change?
I have known happiness. Even love. I shall not speak of it. I shall only sing.
The fish never complains of the salt of the sea, for it is all he has ever known. But I? I cannot forget what once was.
We've all experienced unpleasantness, but that's no reason to dwell upon it! Chin up!
Nothing puts one's woes in perspective like helping people who REALLY need it! People with REAL worries!
People need to understand that unhappiness is a choice! A little exercise sees me right as rain!
People complain about Thrax doing this horrible thing, or that horrible thing. But what about all the good? It's never boring! Have they stopped to think of that?
I know, I know, the Dax are bullies and the weather is apocalyptic. But at least no one's died! Today.
Yes yes I know being persecuted can be difficult, but try living with someone who won't stop going on about it. Positive thinking! That's the way!
A smile is like a yawn. Someone does it and pretty soon you're doing it yourself.
If you're at a loose end, you can always help Koral take care of her animal friends.
I always swear I will not indulge in that horrid… wyrm behavior… But I just get so. Very. Very. Very. Happy.
People are so keen to write me off. As if I don't have the hardest job of any of us.
You certainly make old Teshin happy. Perhaps one day he'll even tell you that himself.
To the Void with you, Fergin! The King says I can play as loud as I like! What I wouldn't give to hear his grumpy old voice again.
You ever gonna make that move? He's never coming back.
"You ever do requests? You do? Go to the edge and jump!" That's what he'd say. Every day.
"Komi is for true Orokin! Shawzin's nothing but a Dax toy!" Ah, he was full of himself.
You know what he'd say to me? "You think you're making Father proud? Playing Shawzin all day?" Like I was nothing but a loafer.
Real exciting game you got going on over there! He was there every day. Then one day, he just wasn't.
What was that, Fergin? Can't hear you over the crowds! I keep thinking I'm gonna look up and see him scowling across at me.
I've got an audience! I don't see anyone lining up to play Komi with you! Every day it feels like a little bit more of this place is lost.
Oh really? Why don't you come over here and say that to my FACE? I know just what he'd say to that.
This one's for you, Fergin! He hated my music. Hated me, too. Void, I miss him.
"Shuddup," he would say. "Who taught you to play, a kaithe's arse?" Now all I hear is this shawzin.
We're both more dangerous than we look you and I. Keep your distance.
Were you followed?
Keep your hands where I can see them.
You don't know me. You have no idea what I'm capable of!
Beetles in the earth. Biting oh-so-gently. Tunneling. Up through my skin.
I've seen them. The black-eyed children. Pointing at me.
The first scholar looked into the Void and he feared it. And his fear took shape. Do you understand? That's how all this started!
I can't stay in here forever. I'll starve. Get bitten. Catch the swarming rot. Little eggs under my eyelids!
Listen! There. Did you hear it? Rap. Tap. Tap.
Not safe here. They'll find me. Her with her carriage. Always nosing around. Got to move. Find a new place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAb: Hey, hey! Where you going? You're no better than the stupid Tamms.
What? So you're going to wander away too? Just my luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc: Think they'll listen to you??? Love to see that.
Go ahead, but I don't even think Brimon could get those Tamms back into their pen.
Get them back into the pen… PLEASE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId: HEY. Get over here you dumb beast. No, here. No. Come… ahhhh.
YOU WANT TO GET EATEN. FINE. WALK AWAY. SEE IF I CARE.
Barris, herd the Tamms. Barris, the Tamms have wandered off again. Barris, why aren't you watching the Tamms. Ugh… I never asked be a stupid shepherd.
HEY! Do you want to fall into the sky??? Wish you would, you straw-brained Tamm. UGHGH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe: UGH. Stupid Tamms are out again. They won't come when called but I'm the one who gets in trouble when they get lost.
Being a shepherd is so… dumb. I'm no good at this. Why do I have to do this dumb job anyway?
Are they trying to get themselves eaten by Krubies?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSi: That was one of the smart ones.
Gee… You're kinda good at this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSu: Woah. How did you get them to follow you?
What did you say to them?
Okay. I'll try to do it just like you next time. Thanks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison: Oh my, they seem to have friends.
You'll just have to dispatch these fellows too.
My, my. They are hostile aren't they?
Bravo, what a show. Time for an encore.
I hoped that was the last of them, alas, no.
Very efficient. At this rate, I'll be home for supper. What to make?
I never doubted you'd show up. Not for a second.
Ah! There you are! Might I bother you for a spot of assistance?
Ah ha! Right on time. Be a love and help a fellow out? I appear to have been captured.
And behold: someone has come along to free me, as I said they would.
Your task, which I'm sure you will fulfill admirably, is to ensure my freedom from these… ne'er-do-wells.
A favor: rescue me, so that my one and only head may remain attached to the shoulders which you see before you.
As there seems to be some sort of misunderstanding. Can I implore you to clear things up with my captors?
Please, persuade these brutes to set me free. I told you someone would be along to help.
Very much obliged, oh hand of fate. Cheerio!
And, thanks to your timely intercession I shall be on my way. Ta rah.
Wonderful. Funny how things always seem to work out, isn't it?
Handily done, friend of mine! Until next time!
A superfluous demonstration of competence! I would expect nothing less!
And that… would appear… to be that! Wonderful! Until next you are needed, my little good luck charm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceAc: Beat my time? That's rich. Love it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa: No shame in losing to the best, eh?
Is there nobody capable of challenging me, huh?
Chin up. You'll do better next time. Hopefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId: My best course yet, my best time yet. Neither Dax nor demon can beat me.
Mathila says I'm both handsome and swift. Is it true? Oh it's not for me to say.
I'm pretty handy with a blade myself. Makes the Dax jealous.
You handle a Kaithe like you've done it countless times before. Reminds me of myself.
Bombastine tried racing me once. He didn't try again.
You, um, ever wonder why Mathila's so happy…?
This is MY favorite course but there is no shame in YOU finding it too challenging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceMi: By the king, you are fast.
Not bad. Not bad at all.
Dear me, have you been practicing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe: I get it, why race when you know you can't win?
I say. You. Fancy yourself a rider? A wager, then! Impress me and I'll help you out. What do you say?
Beat the best or wallow with rest. Care for a race, Drifter?
Name's Brimon. Fastest Kaithe rider in the Kingdom. If you think you're faster. Prove it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSt: Best of luck. You'll need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu: What? That's impos- DAH. Fine. A little something for your trouble.
HOW? I've raced that course a million… Oh very well, take this.
Dahh… That was...impressive. Here, this is for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin: My grandfather had a saying. In a fight, anger is as good as courage.
The skies are burning today. There will be conflict in your path.
Do not mistake anger for petty spite. Only one of them may be righteous.
Hmm. You have fire in your eyes today.
Remember, only a fool seeks to stifle his anger. It is the loyal bodyguard of conscience.
Trained by a Sentient over a Dax! Is it any wonder things fell out as they did? I could have done so much more.
If you coveted anything in this world, Drifter, I would hope you had the courage to go and win it for yourself.
Ambition braces the soul. Envy only embitters it.
There is a rankness in the air today, Drifter. The sour entitlement of spoiled children.
Bombastine will be abroad today. A petty man hiding behind a mask of ingratiating smiles.
Every time you leave this cave, I fear it will be the last time.
Fear kills you twice. First in the mind, and only later in the body. So arm your mind well.
"Be hearty therefore, and cautious in your speech. For one who speaks his fear aloud to his comrades before the fight is like unto a cupbearer bringing poison."
It is good to see you. My dreams were… not wholesome.
Go out into Duviri and fear nothing you find, for the most fearsome being in all Duviri should be you.
I believe… the years weigh a little lighter on me today.
I woke to the sound of the shawzin. Was that you, or my dream?
A man spends his joy freely in his youth. In his old age he must hoard what little he has left.
(humming Smiles from Juran)
One may chase after happiness through the fields all day like a fool, only to have it alight on one's open hand without warning.
Valeria...
There is too much I should have set right. The chance will never come again.
"I am bound for the Inn at the End of Days. Death awaits me like a faithful Yaskutai. See, the warming glass is prepared."
This leaden day is too much to bear alone. Do not go solitary if you can help it, my friend.
The heavy heart is all too eager to embrace wounding lies. Truth may hurt, but what hurts is not always true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties: The Tenno seek to assist you. The weapon they have sent is inelegant, but devastating.
A Tenno archgun has manifested. They must feel the situation is truly desperate.
Through the Paradox, the Tenno have sent a formidable weapon. Let us hope it turns the tide.
An enemy that cannot retreat is the most dangerous, for they have nothing left to lose.
This ruin offers little shelter. Stay mobile.
The beast is cornered. Wear it down, but be alert. Wyrms have many tricks.
Don't hate me because I'm beautiful!
You provoke me at your peril!
Don't follow me. This is NOT your concern.
Chase me!
Stop following me!
I see you, chasing me!
You play with fire, fool!
This is futile. Stop.
You can't catch me!
I know what you're planning!
You wish you were this fast.
You would goad a DRAGON?!
Leave me alone. No further warnings.
Look how big I am!
You don't have to do this.
You're beneath me and you always will be.
For this shall you lament and repent!
You are only making things worse!
Well? Come on, then!
Get back!
I'll devour everything that makes you, you.
Will you just PISS OFF?
I feel you will regret this rashness.
I feel radiant!
Oh Void, oh no. Oh nononono!
I'll take your face and make it my new mask!
You cross a deadly line, fool.
You have suffered. You shall suffer again.
Yes! YES! Release your negativity!
Get them away from me!
Well, aren't you persistent.
A FATAL mistake, as you will soon LEARN!
Tuneless, tone-deaf ingrates!
Growth through conflict!
Thrax! Majesty! HELP MEEE!
What enviable determination.
You've had your fun. Now I have MINE!
I will no longer be victim to your pathetic cruelty!
Keep going! I am LOVING this!
There's no way out of here.
This is not a free ride.
You! DARE?!
Another burden.
Oh, that tickles!
Augh! It's crawling on me!
No hangers-on!
Aagh! Begone, vermin!
I will not carry you.
You'd better hold tight!
No! Please! Don't hurt me!
Off you get, leech.
Miserable! TICK!
I will make you regret this.
And where do you think you're going?
I... I don't want this!
Get your filthy hands off me!
Off! OFF!
Enough!
Oh no you don't!
Eurgh, its fingers are like slugs!
IT'S NOT FAIIIIRRR!
I'M BURNING!
WE ARE UNITED!
IT'S SO BEAUTIFUL!
I KNEW IT!
Did SHE put you up to this?
You mock me for the last time!
Misery shall have company. I swear it.
Are you as excited as I am?
Got to get OUT!
This isn't fair! I deserve this victory!
Your confidence is misplaced!
You should have fled while you still could!
Nearly got you there!
What happened to my legs? What happened to ME?
You wouldn't take these liberties with any OTHER wyrm!
I'll pound you to a sodding paste! Just wait!
I shall provide you with reasons aplenty to mourn.
Am I going too easy on you?
I'm going to be trapped in this ugly form forever and ever!
Don't you DARE deny me this!
I'll grab you by the heels and smash your shitty brains out on a rock!
Back into the pit with you!
Come on! You can do it!
I'll drag you down with me! Don't think I won't!
WHAT DO YOU WANT FROM ME?
THIS IS THE ABSOLUTE LIMIT!
SORROW WILL DEVOUR YOU, BONES AND ALL.
I SHALL ENGULF YOU WITH MY JOY!
I'M DYING! DYYYYING!
YOU WON'T TAKE MY VICTORY!
YOU BROUGHT THIS ON YOURSELF!
YOUR EFFORTS ARE WASTED. SORROW IS ETERNAL.
LET ME SEE THAT SMILE!
YOU'LL BE IN HERE WITH ME FOR ETERNITY! IS THAT WHAT YOU WANT?
YOU KNOW I'M BETTER THAN YOU! AND YOU HATE IT!
BASTARDS! MISERABLE CONNIVING BASTARDS!
THIS PAIN WILL PASS. YOURS WILL NOT.
OH, RAPTURE!
DISGUSTING LITTLE MANIKINS ALL OVER ME! AAAH!
I'M WINNING TODAY AND THAT'S FINAL!
RIGHT! THAT'S IT! THAT'S THE END!
ALL HEARTS CAN BREAK. EVEN YOURS.
SUCH CATHARSIS!
I'm so scared I'm so scared I'M SO SCARED
I'll see she never sings again. It was ME that gave her that voice... it's I who deserve the stage, not that ungrateful harpy! Me, me, me!
I was the rightful heir, but the boy was chosen... why is this always happening to me? What is wrong with me? Am I not... GOOD ENOUGH FOR ALL OF YOU?
It's too much! The sadness - nobody else can bear it like I can. They aren't strong enough! It's me. It has to be me!
I tried! So help me, I tried! I have all this JOY in my SOUL and yet when I try to SHARE IT, NOBODY WANTS TO KNOW! WELL, TRY IGNORING ME NOW!
You! You were never on my side to start with, were you? All along you've been plotting with them... siding with them... preparing to betray me! IT'S TIME FOR YOU TO BE AFRAID!
It's not fair! The things I did were supposed to break her, not make her his favorite! I was meant to be the one who was loved! Me! IT'S NOT FAAAAAIR!
I could have been a good King! But I'll never get the chance, because they HATE ME! EVERYONE HATES ME! WELL, GUESS WHAT? I HATE MYSELF MORE!
I'm sorry! I dragged you into this... this spiral... and now I've just doomed us both! It's too much!
I get it! I do! You all want Happiness, but none of you wants to put in the work! DO YOU THINK THIS BEAUTIFUL LIGHT IN MY HEART JUST GOT THERE BY ITSELF? DO YOU??
Who are you? Who are you really? Why do I hear whispers in my head when I look at you? WHY ARE YOUR EYES LIKE THAT?
The Orowyrm cannot be subdued out in the open. Use the Orvius and find a way to force it back to its lair.
To tame a wild kaithe, it must be ridden. The Orowyrm is no different.
You have control. Cut the ties that bind.
Now, use the beast. Destroy Thrax's bonds.
For too long, have I been denied the recognition I deserve. Look at these yokels: agog to hear my latest play. Here: deliver the manuscript.
I've written that impish brat of a King an ultimatum. You! Deliver it! IN PERSON!
These are the ashes of someone dear to me. Someone... gone from me. I beseech you: take them to their final rest? I cannot bear the loss one moment longer.
Party invitations! Splendid! Best deliver them as quickly as you might.
I found this in one of the crypts. It's put a curse on me, I know it! I need to you take it to a safe place and leave it there.
I have written a letter explaining Luscinia's TRUE character for those who need to know. Deliver it. I'll see that songbird roasted yet.
Here! The proofs of my royal ancestry! Take them where they need to go!
I have written down my memories of life under Thrax, so even if I perish, the truth shall not. Take it to a safe place for me.
Be a dear and run these cake recipes over to the needful souls on the other side of Duviri?
Acrithis lent me these books. She said they came from the Scholar himself. Bad things in them. Void things. You need to take them away!
You will run errands for absolutely anyone, won't you?
I find myself bored. Execute somebody. Anyone will do.
Straight ahead, keep going, off the edge of the world, can't miss it, goodbye.
Those sentries look down on me. "There goes Bombastine," they say. "Fire a shot over his head and watch him jump!" Well, today, you're taking them down to MY level.
Smug Dax sentries sitting up there, thinking they're safe. Never been in a real fight in their rotten lives! Go and batter the hell out of them!
From their high perch cruel Dax led by a cruel King ruin and victimize all. Justice is unknown in this cold place, yet I beg: cast them down. For once let THEM be the ones to mourn.
When you have a heart full of light, toxic people can be SO irritating. Arrogant sentries, for example. I think you'd learn a lot from teaching them some manners.
It makes your flesh creep. Walking under those towers. Knowing a Dax could pick you off any time he wanted. I can't stand it! You have to clear them out!
Ah! I know those Dax. They're the ones that like to use me as a target in their spitting contests. Even the score, would you? Oh, I've dreamed of this.
Nothing galls my arse like the sight of a Dax sentry lording it over the rest of us from on high. Up you go. Beat them to a pulp.
The King watches me... day and night. The Dax... the ones in the high towers... they are the King's eyes. Blind him.
Some people really do think they are above others! I'm hesitant to send you into this combat experience at this stage of your personal journey, but it's for the best.
Urgh. Watchful eyes always looking down at you. Making your skin crawl. Get rid of those sentries!
All it requires is one fortunate shot, and your Drifting days are over.
Pointless. You remain massively outnumbered.
Oh, dear. I lost a sentry post. I may wet myself.
One day, so I swear, your head shall adorn that very tower.
The dwelling should be rightfully mine, obviously! We shall claim it, you and I. And if the Dax object, give them your worst.

That imp knows that I am the rightful heir. His minions have murdered my sage and even now set fire to his records house. Therein are the laws of Duviri succession, soon to ash! Hurry! You must stop them!
This place... holds memories. Sweet ones, of a life that might have been. I can't bear to see the Dax swarming here. Dispatch them.
I'm going to need somewhere to run to. In case this all goes wrong. A place to hide. Yes. I know just the place. But they're already there. One step ahead of us. Keep it safe for me!
Well. What was the point of that, exactly?
Allow me to assist your faltering recollection: Duviri is mine. I break what I like.
No amnesty for insurrectionists.
I am the King, and The King's word is LAW! Everybody knows that! Everybody!
You're pathetic and helpless, and nobody cares about you.
You're getting nooo-wheeere! Anyone with half a brain would just give up.
You were livestock. Slaughtered at my command every day. Why pretend you're anything else?
Your struggles are always entertaining. But we both know they're useless.
Quickly, take the beast through the portal.
Force the beast back to its domain.
Force the creature through that portal. Only in its lair will it be vulnerable.
You will need my Orvius to challenge this Orowyrm. Find it.
Our mutual friend waits with my Orvius. If you desire to subdue this Orowyrm, take it.
The Orowyrm must be subdued, for that, I offer you my Orvius. The rest is up to you.
Bring it on! I never get tired of watching you die!
Oh, Orowyrm? Looksee. Your main course just rang the dinner bell!
You really want to be crushed, burned and humiliated? Very well. I shall indulge your cravings.
Good. Now, overcome its mind.
You've mounted the beast, but are you in control?
You are nothing more than a passenger. Seize control.
Master the brute while you can!
The spirits of the greedy dead rise, wanting me to return what is obviously mine! Well, I'm keeping IT ALL! You! Banish them!
A legion of FARTY LITTLE ANCESTOR PHANTASMS is attempting to deny me my birthright. Some nonsense about ineligible bloodlines. Purge them!
The ghosts of my past will not let me rest. I sob and I scream and still they haunt me. Please! Banish these shades and let my soul live?
Not everyone is strong enough to confront the darkness within. Are you going to keep putting it off, or are you going to take action?
They're coming. Out of the ground. The unhallowed earth. Shadows. Moving. I can't look at them. MAKE THEM GO AWAY!
How the shades envy the living. Craving our life, our warmth. Sorry, ghostlings. I feel you, really I do, but I'm going to ask my friend here to put you down.
That gormless CHILD in the Palace is letting his night-terrors run free. While diddums slurps his cup of warm milk show them what a real nightmare looks like.
The 'King' has many petty demons. You are stronger than he. Tear them to shreds.
It's time for you to face the shadows - oh, but don't be afraid. Everything is joy! You just have to be strong enough to see it.
My own nightmares are bad enough. I don't want Thrax's crawling inside my head too. Kill them kill them KILL THEM!
Mmm. Thank you.
You do have your uses.
I should allow you to dispatch vermin more often.
Good luck getting rid of their stench.
The Dax have been collecting tribute from the peasants. What about ME? I think you should collect tribute from THEM. I'll make better use of it, naturally.
Oh, that Imp has gone too damn far this time! He's had his Dax confiscate MY BELONGINGS! POUND THEM INTO THE DIRT AND GET MY GOODS BACK!
The Dax are guarding their pay chests. Blood money, every coin of it. Repay them for the misery they have caused.
Find out what's inside this chest, and as you do, ask yourself: what painful truths am I locking up inside my own wounded soul?
Listen. If I'm ever going to get out of here, set up someplace new, I'm going to need funds. Maybe...maybe you could find some Dax pay chests. They won't miss them.
'There goes raggle-taggle Bombastine, with nothing to his name but bad verses and bile!' Get me money, Drifter. I want to drip with gold.
I'm the rightful king of Duviri, so the Imp's taxes are MY taxes. If these Dax have a PROBLEM with that, then you can make problems FOR them, can't you?
Thrax melted down my jewellery for coin to pay his thugs. Misery for misery. Let me see them dead. Whatever they have is yours.
Sometimes joy is there for the taking, and sometimes nasty surprises lie in wait! You need to learn the difference. Not for me; for yourself.
You know what's in those chests the Dax are guarding? Evidence, that's what. I need it. Even if you have to go through them to get it.
Peasant! Stupid thieving peasant!
I shall retrieve that and tear off the thieving fingers that stole it!
That is  not yours, you putrid dimwit!
You evince a sad desperation for all that is mine. Would it then please you, should I spit upon you?
Some days I yearn for the simple life of a farmer. No reason why I shouldn't HAVE that, of course. Why don't you round me up a herd of my own?
You see how the Imp neglects his duties? Beasts left to roam at will, eating and shitting wherever they like! IT'S MADDENING! ROUND THOSE STINKING THINGS UP!
Poor lost Tamms. Where can their mistress be? It would be too sad a fate if the wolves took them. Round them up, good drifter.
Look. Tamms running wild. They'd be happier in the safety of a pen, and in their hearts they know it. So you can round them up with a clear conscience.
Don't tell me Tamms are harmless. I've seen the way they look at me. All that CHEWING. Round them up and keep them away from me!
I want EVERYTHING. Every coin, every thread, every blade of grass. The Tamms in the field! Yes! Steal them for me!
That stunted brat can't even keep the Tamms in order. If you don't sort them out sharpish, we'll be tripping over the brainless things for weeks!
I understand how the Tamms feel, lost and listless. Be kind, Drifter. Bring them home.
Oh Barris, have you let the Tamms out again? He takes his responsibilities SO seriously. I'm sure he wouldn't mind you helping him out, this once.
The Tamms are plotting something. They're out of their pens. I don't like it. Round them up. Put them back.
Mucking about with farm animals. That really is all you're good for.
Ranch work. A peasant you are and a peasant you shall always be.
Oh, bra-vo, shepherd. Perhaps you should retire and become a dung-shoveler!
Congratulations, Drifter. Finally you have found creatures who look up to you.
When people have more wealth than they can spend, they hide it. People like that make me sick. I want you to find what they stashed and give it to me!
Wait. You're near where the succession scrolls are hidden. If that wretched Imp hasn't burned them all, that is. What are you waiting for? Find them!
Thrax has had many secrets buried over the years. Evidence of his cruelty. Fragments of ruined lives. Bring those secrets to light again.
You won't be happy until you can stand on your own two feet. Something's hidden nearby. YOU are going to find it. By yourself.
I need protection. Talismans. Incantations. Weapons. Whatever you can find. Search around. There has to be something I can use!
By sacred law, any treasure dug up in Duviri is automatically the property of the King! Not today, 'your Majesty'. Today it's finders keepers.
MY REGALIA! This is where the bastard Imp hid it! Find it, and I'll get you a front row seat at my coronation!
If what Acrithis says is true, there are secrets buried in Duviri that reveal an even greater mystery. If I can understand WHY I am... I might be more able to bear it.
This challenge requires patience. Persistence. Oh, and just a little pinch of perspective.
I locked something up near here, I know I did. Books. Dried roots. A prisoner? Can't be sure. But I need to find it again.
Nothing but a dog, grubbing in the dirt.
Someone toss this ragged beggar a coin.
Oh, well done. You found it. Now look for your dignity.
It is very much like watching a rat run a maze.
Some people have it all. This fellow, for instance. Strong. Fast. He even has Void powers. What I wouldn't do to have what he has. You're going to kill him and TAKE what he has.
That's him. Thrax's enforcer. MY REPLACEMENT. For two pins, I'd come down there and smash his face in myself! But I can't, so you have to. Help yourself to his chest.
How many times did I dream of escape, only for one of those hulking brutes to bar my path? Show no mercy. Whatever he guards, you may keep.
One can't keep a Krubie and never let it bite. I suppose I'd better let you off the leash, shouldn't I? Fight the bad man and take the goodies.
I can't bear the sight of those things. Thrax's favored. Like something out of a vapor vision. You're going to have to kill it. And take whatever it was put here to guard.
That oaf bars my way every time I try to return to the Palace! Wouldn't he look so much better coughing his last while you loot his chest of goods?
I TOLD the Imp these Void-sodden travesties were a STUPID idea. 'But they're so strong, Lodun!' Kill one. Take what it's guarding. Prove me right!
Centurions and Legates. A child's idea of strength. Break his toys and scatter them. Make his wealth your own.
Today, you fight miscreants and claim your reward! Life is a glorious adventure. I do hope you understand.
Thrax brought monsters to life to defend his Kingdom. But you're stronger than Thrax, aren't you? You're a monster-killer. Treasure-finder. Aren't you? Well?
Interesting! I'm learning so much about your weaknesses.
Do you suppose that you have won, worm? Excellent.
Good fight! I loved the part where you flailed about like a fish on a mudbank!
I suppose not even you can lose all the time.
Sometimes the only thing standing between a man and the wealth he deserves is a bunch of idiots in armor. I'm sure you can handle them.
We're not going to fire a revolution sitting on our arses! Weapons out, take down a few Dax, ferret out their chests. LET'S GO!
What little I had to call my own, Thrax took from me. Please, take my possessions back from the Dax. They may be dust and mold now, but they are still mine.
You can't expect everything in life to be handed to you on a plate! You'll appreciate what you have all the more if you fight for it. Like now!
Too many people. With grudges. Reasons to hate me. Wanting me dead. Going to need leverage. Funds. Find me some funds even if you have to murder a few Dax to do it.
So many beautiful masks I might wear, all jealously hoarded by those Dax imbeciles. As if they could ever use them! Take them, Drifter. For ME.
All that peasant tribute going to the Dax instead of me, Lodun! The True King! IT PISSES ME OFF! KILL THEM AND FIND WHERE THEY'VE HIDDEN IT!
There are songs Thrax forbade me to sing. He took them from me. Locked them up. If they have not rotted away, I would dearly love to see them again.
Along life's path, there are many hidden riches by the wayside. You just have to be brave enough to seize the moment.
Thrax could have me executed with a snap of his fingers. I need something I can use against him. Whatever these Dax are guarding has to be important.
The Orokin knew exactly what to do with your sort.
Feel good, do we? See how bright you feel when you're dangling from a gibbet!
What an irredeemable thug you are.
Void, I despise you.
The mark of true nobility is an affinity for horseflesh, you know. I want to be the patron of champions. All YOU have to do is win.
He treated his bloody Kaithes better than he treated me, his own executioner! I want YOU to outrace his champion. That'll wipe the smirk off Thrax's mewling face!
Was there ever a time when Duviri was a happy place? Laughter, Lunaro, games and races? Help me remember. Surely a running Kaithe feels no sorrow.
Your pain doesn't make you special, you know. What you need is a little exercise! Take that Kaithe of yours for a run!
Kaithes terrify me. I keep dreaming I'm at a race, and those pounding hooves trample me to pulp. Maybe if you ran a race... and that DIDN'T happen... it might be okay?
How would it be... to own the fastest Kaithe in all Duviri? Glorious. Make a little boy's dream come true.
Thrax has a favorite, Kaithe. None but his own dainty arse may sit upon it. I want YOU to ride it and beat the King's own record! That'll teach the little toe-rag.
I cannot bear to see the Kaithes neglected, but I am no rider. Perhaps you can bring them joy, even on this dark day.
Think how lucky you are! You get to ride free across beautiful Duviri! Maybe a race would help you keep that in mind?
That Kaithe might be mad. Void-struck. Dangerous. You'd better ride all the crazy out of it. Wear it out. To be safe.
Behold the adoring crowds.
Well done... Kaithe!
Aww. You failed to break your neck.
I should lay tripwires down. To make this interesting.
The Kaithes are your salvation!
Find a mount or perish!
Bombastine, Duviri's preening peacock, was consumed by Envy. Oh, many envied him, but he cared nothing for that.
Bombastine was envious. Of what? Anything.Wherever his gaze fell, it seemed other people had it better.
Hear now of the one they called Lodun — the high and mighty prince of... nothing. For within him burned a fire and a fury he could not control.
Lodun of Duviri was nicknamed 'the Prince of Fire'. A mocking title, for he ruled over nothing, least of all himself.
Sorrow is a poison, and yet some drink it like wine. One such was Luscinia.
Sorrow is the bitter spice without which life is too sweet. Luscinia indulged in it... to excess.
When happy Mathila wanted to see nothing but happiness wherever she went, it soon caused problems.
Unfortunately, Mathila was convinced she knew what would make people happy better than they did.
One haunted day in Duviri, Sythel awoke with the thought: if I could destroy what I fear, I wouldn't have to fear it anymore!
Afraid to go outside and afraid to be shut in, Sythel lived a timorous life. Usually, she was too scared to act... but not always.
It is unjust that Thrax has the sole power of life and death. I want some too. Nearby a man is marked for execution. Save his life, that I may also, rightly, be thought of as Lord of Life and Death.
I find ONE citizen willing to support my claim, and the bastard Dax are trying to kill him! Keep him alive!
A man insulted my singing. Thrax has decreed he must die. More pain, of which I am the source and font. I beg of you, spare that man. Spare me just one more misery to live with.
Maybe helping people who are REALLY suffering would put your woes in perspective? Oh, maybe you could find time to rescue a condemned man?
I ordered a man executed. I was sure he was conspiring against me. But now... I'm... I'm afraid he might be... innocent. You have to stop the Dax. Before it's too late.
People owe you their life, don't they, Drifter? How does that feel? Save a condemned criminal for me. I want to see the pathetic gratitude in his eyes.
Thrax has a prisoner. The Imp wants him dead. I want him alive. I respect your skill, the Imp does not. Clear?
A man nearby is marked for execution. I would have him die in pain for what he has done. So... spare him today so he may face an even darker fate.
I know the King never makes mistakes, but his officials are only human. They're holding an innocent man. I know you'll do the right thing.
The Dax want to kill one of MY prisoners. You mustn't let them. I need him alive for... secret reasons.
You sentimental sap!
I kill who I please. I killed you often enough.
You have saved nothing.
You are soft. As. Pudding.
I can hear them now. Little children laughing at me because they could solve the maze and I couldn't. I won't have it. Solve the wretched thing!
Grah! I can never work these STUPID mazes out! Wait. YOU can do it for me!
A Royal maze. I think... I think I lost something precious in a maze like that, long ago... please, would you quest on my behalf, for some small piece of sweetness?
I think some simple little challenges will perk you right up. Ouu, why not have a go at this Royal Maze?
I'm scared of mazes. You never know what might be skulking at the center. You go look. I'll wait.
I grew up hearing stories of these odd configurations. How riches awaited those clever enough to solve them. Show me what that feels like!
While I deal with whichever of the Imp's INCOMPETENT ministers set this travesty up, YOU can take it back down again.
Secrets are lost in mazes like this. Sometimes souls are, too. Perhaps some wait for us there, now. Let us look. What choice do we have, after all?
Royal Mazes teach independence and build character! Don't give up! Keep trying!
One day I might be locked up in one of those mazes. Then you'll have to get me out. I need to know you can do that. Show me.
Bra-vo. Aren't you clever.
I must admit: watching you fumble your way through that was becoming embarrassing.
Took you long enough.
How to keep an idiot occupied...
Witchcraft. You should be hung.
Be warned, Drifter. Your Void-meddlings are forbidden by my law.
What goblins and doppelgangers are you consorting with?
Do not do that again. One of you is quite enough.
Something's calling for you through the Void mirror. Aren't YOU special? Get rid of those Dax and see what's so urgent.
I don't know what Void-cursed nonsense that mirror is harboring, and I don't care. I just want it dealt with. Get rid of those Dax and find out what it wants!
The Other Side reaches out to you, through the King's mirror, defying the Dax. Answer their need!
Dearest, you've a friend calling from the other side! What fun! Attend to the mirror, and do enjoy yourself.
Something's trying to reach you. Through the mirror. The GUARDED mirror. This is YOUR problem! Deal with it!
Hours I've spent gazing into Void mirrors, and here you are, with some mysterious benefactor gazing back! Deal with those, Dax, and see what your friend wants.
One of the Imp's mirrors is up ahead. Slaughter the guards and find out what it wants from you. (aside) When I'm King, I'll have them all smashed!
The Other Side has known much sorrow. I feel it in my heart. From the far side of the mirror, they call to you. Find them!
Now, one never turns aside a friendly hand. A dear friend is calling to you from beyond the mirror. Do the polite thing.
One of us has to kill those Dax. Look into that mirror. See whatever's waiting there. You. Obviously. Not me.
I am better than any of them! Fate and small, jealous others have conspired to inflict this upon me! You! Will you defy their cruelty and aid me?
I've seen YOU drifting among the isles of MY kingdom! If it weren't for that manic little IMP! He's got it in for you. If you're not a complete idiot you'll see that we should... HELP... one another.
I am Sorrow, and suffering is my lot, but today the burden is too much to bear. If my pain is avenged, perhaps... perhaps it will be lifted a little?
There's no excuse for negativity in this wonderful kingdom. I think someone like you wants to be part of the solution, and I'm happy to say I can help.
Can I trust you? I have to. They're everywhere. Plotting against me. I need you to destroy them. Every single last one!
Duviri has owed me for an age, short-changed me at every turn. We shall set things to rights. Let us collect.
Another day, another insult to my dignity... my right! Return me to my rightful place OR SUFFER THE CONSEQUENCES!
I have grieved for long enough, while others in Duviri have laughed at my pain. Today, we shall turn the world upside down.
You can't dwell on your woes for ever! It's time to spread some positivity for a change. Oh don't worry. I'm on this journey with you.
They've kept me locked up inside my own mind all these years. Frightening me with their tricks. Now I need you to make THEM afraid.
Bravely done. For this one night at least, Duviri is calm.
Emotion is no longer in turmoil. The calm of the true warrior has prevailed.
What happened? My head... Why can't I remember?
What did you do? I'm... sleepy.
I feel... nothing.
Bombastine was never satisfied. He wanted more... for all that others had was an affront to his being.
Oh, Bombastine was admired, even loved. But others were loved more, and that was poison to him.
As the never-to-be king's fortune rose, so too did his fire... his indignation... his Anger.
The most petty and trivial things could spark Lodun's anger. But the flames quickly rose.
Perhaps Luscinia's misery would end if she inflicted suffering upon others? Others who deserved it?
Thoughts of revenge come easily to a heart turned bitter and cold.
To the Happy mind, all things seem simple. Problems could be solved simply by making them go away.
Like a child hiding its face in play, Mathila hid from the truth. Nothing but joy mattered.
Sythel looked in horror upon what had been done in her name. Surely there would be consequences!
Like the first rumblings of a landslide, the ominous consequences of Sythel's actions began to build.
With sweet words, he persuaded others to his side. But his thoughts were only ever of himself.
Behind his acts of kindness and generosity lay but one thought: how can this performance benefit me?
So everything was met with Anger. And Anger was his undoing.
Now anger is a powerful weapon, be sure of that. But it burns friend and foe alike.
At first, Luscinia felt some comfort from her actions. At least she was doing something. But her sorrow grew.
Revenge may bring some relief at first. But as Luscinia found, it is often cold comfort.
Mathila did not understand that you cannot bring Happiness to the world by making unhappiness a crime.
Why could other people not simply be as Happy as Mathila was? Why did they have to be so difficult?
Another might have taken courage from seeing the things she feared exterminated, but not Sythel.
Sythel's fear spiraled. The more she tried to be bold, the greater grew her fear of being found out.
With each new conquest, never once did he think: 'Surely that is enough. Surely now I can stop.'
Like a child becoming bored with each new toy, Bombastine moved from one fixation to the next.
Friends and family were scorched and retreated away from him, so his rage became like a stone in his chest, weighing him down.
The more Lodun's anger drove people away, the more certain he became that he was right.
Luscinia wept for those she was hurting. She tried to dismiss it as weakness, but her heart rebelled.
Sorrow had made Luscinia compassionate. She could not give pain without feeling it.
If she doubted, she hid it. Her failures merely made her more determined to succeed.
Mathila's plans were failing, but she put a brave face on it. With a whistle, she went back to work.
Her brutal actions had consequences. Like a deadly pestilence, Sythel's fear spread across Duviri.
Sythel left fear in her wake. Doors were closed and windows barred, and voices spoke in whispers.
Demented beyond hope of return, Bombastine set his heart on the throne. Was he not as good a king as Thrax?
If Bombastine could only have loved himself, he might not have yearned to become someone else.
Lodun turned his anger inward... and found the source. Not the world of folly and betrayal but his own shortcomings.
In his heart, Lodun knew he was angry with his own powerlessness. And no amount of screaming could remedy that.
Luscinia had set her feet upon a dark path, but she had to walk it to the very end.
As if with a prophet's gift, Luscinia could see disaster looming, but she could not turn aside.
Mathila embraced optimism with the zeal of a fanatic. Her plan would work. Duviri would be Happy.
Mathila understood that one sometimes has to be cruel to be kind. If happiness required force, so be it.
Fear ruled Duviri... and yet Sythel, the embodiment of fear, was more afraid than ever.
All Duviri now lived in terror of Sythel. What a long shadow this scrawny little figure had cast!
And so the envy that might have motivated him to better himself hurled him headlong into disaster.
Bombastine thought his self-doubt was his alone. If only he had known how many others suffered it too.
He became an enemy to even himself.
He saw there was nothing righteous or noble about his anger. It was just the raving of a petty, paltry man.
One final act, then. One last howl into the storm. Misery would have company, at least.
Even as she prepared to risk everything on a final reckless gamble, Luscinia already knew the outcome.
Now no rational person could look upon this chaos and feel Happiness. So Mathila abandoned rationality.
Joy and madness are both known to laugh aloud. Mathila leapt from one into the embrace of the other.
Sythel was afraid to go on, but she was even more afraid to stop. Her fears were allying against her now.
Even as her plans led to disaster after disaster, Sythel was more afraid of what might still come to pass.
Thrax's 'power' is rooted in the Undercroft. Pfeh. Without it, he's not that big of a deal. Not really. Perhaps you should make your way inside for a little... takeover bid.
The blasted Undercroft! Nothing but a haphazard mass of chaos under the Imp's rule! Get a portal open. I have HAD ENOUGH. We are FIXING this mess.
The Undercroft is in agony! The Paradox, twisting the Void, tearing me in two impossible directions... oh, get inside and put an end to it!
The Undercroft is a messy, chaotic place, and you will need to work SO hard to keep it together in there, but I believe in you. You've got this!
You have to go to the place where bad dreams are real. The Undercroft. Whatever's wrong there, make it right. Hurry!
Ah, the Undercroft. A seething mass of Void-ridden potential, spiced with childish nightmares. Give me some.
The Imp allows chaos to brood under his very nose! If I had my way I'd have all those Undercroft portals BRICKED UP! Get in there and find out what's wrong this time!
Duviri pretends it never happened, but the Undercroft remembers. The tragedy... the Zariman. Whatever calm you can bring to that tormented place, please: do so.
It's time for you to descend into the Undercroft and make things right. It may not be what you want, but it IS what you need.
Everyone's afraid of the Undercroft. Even Thrax. It's too close to the Void. To... to HIM. That's why I'm sending YOU in there.
I want what a man of my talent and worth rightly deserves, and that includes the Undercroft that Thrax guards so jealously. Off you pop.
The Undercroft is an ulcer in the guts of Duviri. Something's happening down there. I can feel it. SORT IT OUT, for Void's sake!
Acrithis tells me the Void is emotion's keeper. Nowhere is the Void stronger than in the Undercroft. Why does it howl so? Please... answer its cry.
The Undercroft is a source of unbridled negativity. We are about joy and nothing but joy. So your path is clear, isn't it?
I can't go near the Undercroft portals. Can't bear to think about what... might... come out of them. It's going to have to be you.
Whoever controls the Undercroft grasps all of Duviri by the roots. I won't let its reputation stand in the way of claiming what's mine. Get in and do what you have to.
Does that brat on the throne have ANY IDEA how often I've had to send forces into the Undercroft to clean up his mess? Maybe you'll do a better job. See what's amiss.
I heard that in the Undercroft, we may prevent tragedies from ever occurring. If that is true... please, see what lies under its veil.
I foresee your life journey taking you into the Undercroft. Don't dwell on the choices that led you there. Just be in the moment, and act mindfully.
Oh no. Oh no no. There's something wrong in the Undercroft. I can't go down there. Not after what I saw that time.
What have you done?
You are to stay OUT of the Undercroft.
Do NOT venture there again. There shall be no further warnings.
That place is forbidden for a REASON!
Mmmm. Cunning devices like this feed Duviri with power, just so those witless peasants can piss it away. It's wasted on them. Recalibrate it in MY favor!
Damnation! This ABSURD contraption has broken down AGAIN! Fix it for me. I need all the power I can get!
This structure and I share much. Both of us once useful, both of us discarded, both of us now derelict. Both... forgotten. Might you bring it to life again? That one of us may live on?
I can tell you want to be useful to the Duviri community, and fixing that generator would be a wonderful use of your time.
I don't like this. Broken-down machinery is suspicious. It attracts attention. Hurry, fix it before someone sees!
The King has these generators built, and then he lets them go to rack and ruin. Get it running again. Give me a taste of his power.
Fix this blasted generator! I'm going to find whoever let it break down in the first place, and WHIP THEM RAW!
If this ruin could flow with power again, perhaps this purgatory may hold just a little warmth for one such as me. Will you make it right? I hardly dare to ask.
A broken-down generator. What a useful metaphor for the isolated soul! Reconnect it, and reconnect the currents of your own heart.
I think this generator pumps the air in Duviri. And it's... broken? Oh Void. I can't breathe. My head's spinning. I'm going to die. Fix it!
Execution was far too kind. I should have set you on a treadmill.
You are no hero. You are merely... an errand runner.
Are you not degraded by such work? I shall never understand the common mind.
Oh. I was hoping you'd fry yourself alive.
For that, Drifter, I shall break something of yours.
That witch Luscinia's poured poison in the King's ear with her harpy's verse. After all, I've done for the arts they mean to kill me! Stop his ingrate thugs!
Look: They died with my name on their lips.
The imp's grown suspicious of me. His spies approach even now to *surveil*. ME! One more BUCKET OF PISS splashed in my face for the world to see. Take care of this before we're both in the stocks.
The hollow ones mock my pain. Find out whether their hearts can be broken.
Either you keep stewing over your grudges against the King's Dax, or you channel that energy into something positive. It's up to you!
The Dax know EVERYTHING! Why did you let them find out our plan? You've got to wipe them out, quickly! Come on! Let's get cutting throats!
Hah! 'Dax'. She has them wrapped around her little finger. "Oh boys, go smack Bombastine's bot-bot for me." They won't be expecting YOU.
You shall have to do away with a greater number than that to trouble me.
The imp thinks he can send his clanking cretins to haul ME away? As if I were nothing but a filthy tam-snaffler? RIP THEIR ARMS AND LEGS OFF!
The Dax. Responsible for so. Much. Sadness. And yet they have rarely answered for it. Redress the balance.
The Dax hurt you. Give yourself permission to hurt them back. It's what you need.
It's only a matter of time before the Dax find out what we're up to. There's a bunch of them nearby, acting suspicious. You need to get them before they get us.
I've often wondered what power the Otherworld spirits could offer a man like me. Nothing ventured, nothing gained... rebuild one of the lost shrines and let's see what happens.
If I have to summon the ghosts of the past to back up my claim to the throne, I WILL! All YOU need to do is put the shrine back together.
The monuments to the lost now lie in ruins. If you could reassemble one, just one... it might make a difference.
Someone's left that shrine in disrepair. It doesn't matter who. If you truly want to be happy, you need to be the bigger person and mend it.
There's a broken shrine nearby. That's bad. Leave a shrine broken, and THINGS will come after you. All bony hands and snaking tongues and... Please. Put it back together.
That meddlesome witch Acrithis says there is hidden knowledge in the old shrines. Assemble one. She can't keep it all for herself.
The relics of my ancestors, shattered! He's trying to erase my proof of ancestry! Rebuild my great-grandmother's shrine AT ONCE!
A gravestone is a sorrowful sight, but sadder still is the rubble where a stone once stood. Let them not be forgotten kind Drifter, rebuild.
That shrine's broken. The easy thing to do would be to let someone else fix it. But that wouldn't make you happy.
There's a shrine. And I thought it was cursed. So I broke it. Into bits. And now I think I'm cursed. Just.. just put it back together for Void's sake.
Play with fire, burn your fingers. Will you ever learn?
Now whatever made you think that was a good idea?
I declared the Shrines forbidden because I know better than you do. Do not test me.
You seem more apt to stacking alphabet blocks, I think you would agree.
Look at the beautiful Wyrmlings! How loyal they are!
The little ones would gladly die for their creator!
Wyrmlings only emerge when fresh meat is nearby.
Find a way to stop its spawn!
The King expects me to do my best work on a pittance. You can see how unjust that is, can't you? I refuse to live in penury! Fetch me some more suitable reward.
Double the bounty on that thieving scum.
Our kingly imp's got something precious of mine, and I want it back. Find that boot-licking treasurer's stash!
Others find comfort in material things. Seek them out for me, my dark angel, that I might drown my misery in excess.
The King can't find out what we're doing here. Oh Void. What if he already suspects? We'll have to make it look like a simple robbery. You don't mind stealing, do you?
I shall simply have to kill you and take it back.
I shall extract its value out of your stinking hide.
Oh! A pretender and a thief. What a worm you are.
What dragon is Envy? A hunger never sated, a gift never enough. It darkens the sunny days with a wanting that never is met.
The fire within Lodun was his Anger. Unable to control it, thus, was he consumed. Behold the great dragon of Lodun!
Sadness is the dragon that devours itself. It spawns many children - lethargy, self-pity, self-doubt.
The Tales of Duviri
Happiness becomes a dragon when you allow it to master you. The indulgent, the cowardly, the indolent... to whose skirts do they cling?
For an instant, as she shed her pitiful human form, Sythel was no longer afraid, for she had become fear.
Subdue Lodun's Orowyrm before all Duviri is consumed by his anger.
Lodun is filled with fury. He will scorch the earth.
The Orowyrm Bombastine is as jealous as his master. He craves the validation of victory.
Bombastine's bitter envy seethes with venom and spite.
All Duviri lives in terror of the Orowyrm Sythel. Subdue her so that Duviri may have calm, if only for a day.
The Orowyrm Sythel flies in the stark terror of the storm, lightning-fanged. All fear her.
Mathila's Orowyrm seeks to inflict her idea of happiness on all of Duviri. Subdue this tyranny.
Mathila the Orowyrm rejoices in her dominion. The Void itself is her plaything today.
Luscinia's coils are wracked with sorrow on this day. Her heart is ice, her breath a blizzard.
The Wyrm of Sorrow is ravening with despair. She will make all Duviri mourn with her.

I'm will not be 'kept in my place' by swaggering bullies! Just because I wasn't born with strength of arm, they feel like they can push me around? Teach them that my worth and talent are worth far more than their... engorged biceps!
The king's bounty has risen on both of our heads! You'll need to deal with this before we go any further.
In my time as the King's captive songbird there have been many jailors... many tormentors. One of them now walks nearby. Let them taste the bitterness I have lived with all these years!
Dax Officers are meant to set a good example for the rest of us. This one needs to be punished. Think how happy she'll be when she's learned her lesson!
I feel sick. The King suspects. I'm sure of it. He's going to send an assassin after me. Any moment now. You have to get to the assassin first.
I cannot abide a bully, especially not a bully in uniform. Teach that Dax Officer not to push the little people around.
Ah. My fallen friend. You shall be avenged.
Well. He failed me. So he's better off dead.
You! How dare you! He was better than you! Finer.
I had such high hopes for that one. Ah well.

Kullervo, Kullervo, warrior-born,
From his mother's breast he was torn.
Doomed to go wandering all forlorn,
Kullervo, Kullervo, made to mourn.

Kullervo, Kullervo, swaddled in lies,
Raised to a life of groans and cries,
Took to his task with sorrowing sighs,
Kullervo, Kullervo, death was your prize.

Kullervo, Kullervo, sworn to the sword,
Sweated and slaved for the head of the horde,
Bruised and bludgeoned and scarred and gored,
Kullervo, Kullervo, warrior's ward.

Kullervo, Kullervo, far he strayed.
Lips to the steel he blessed and prayed,
Whispered promises that boy made!
Kullervo, Kullervo, friend to the blade.

Kullervo, Kullervo, ragged and thin,
Tracked back the path so steeped in sin,
All the way back where it did begin,
Kullervo, Kullervo, sought for his kin.

I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.

Too craven to chase death, I awaited it. The father of fears, and yet I was still afraid. 

The currents whispered coward. I clenched my body into a fist as a foetus must and blinded myself afresh.
 
Stark pain smoked the juice of my living tomb. Why did the saga not end by itself? Why must I still act?

Steeped in solitude, I found I could no longer endure my own company. 

Disgust did the work of courage. I tore the mundane membrane, slid weak and mucosal into Loid's embrace.

Loid nursed me then, tending first to the uprooted ruin of my eyes, then to the mouth whose grin no longer hid behind flesh. 

The agony bit deep, but it was clean. Blameless love bled up from me. 

I had decided to live.

I felt no certainty as I donned clothes rough and strange to the touch of newgrown skin. I had none of the selfless zeal of the soldier. 

The same cursed question still pursued me as it had before: was I, even now, trapped in the rictus of the Wall?

The apparatus of logic would never yield an answer. Only resolute action remained. If I must be a demon, let me be an honest one. Let me prove my nature by what I do next. 

Purpose. Let me leave such blazing footprints behind me as no unclean thing would dare to walk in.

I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.

The majority of the Cavia merely died. I gave the Void living beings and it sent me back bedraggled cadavers. The dead lay stacked in pyramids around my deserted lab. I was nothing but a failed priest.

But a glass splinter of stubbornness still stuck in me. And so, I persisted. The correct combination of creatures would work.

I realized my error as I sweated by visionary nestawood cinders, beside Loid who curled pale and sick from chewing too much of the root. The catalyst was uniqueness. That attribute was what caught the interest of the bland and undifferentiated Void. 

It was not necessary to explore queasy debates about the Oro; animal minds simply lacked the full distinction of a singular persona. My Kalymos, I was sure, was an exception, but I would not sacrifice that loyal being.

Perhaps I should have. The sin I was to commit was worse.

The very last breeding pair of Cervulites was smuggled to me, causing Loid no small inconvenience. A species on the brink of extinction. Here was the uniqueness the Void sought. I was certain to the pit of my entrails.

I loaded the pair on to their Seriglass bridal barge, along with an expendable avian and a Norg for mental ballast. Fish, fowl and beast. A facile equilibrium.

They did not die, save one. They came back changed. Witnesses. Pilgrims, even, chanting freakish praise to the one beyond the wall.

I knew, then, that my gambit had lost. So long as I worked through scapegoats, my guilt would only deepen. I must atone for what I had done through my own blood.

Standard laboratory hygiene would have been to dispose of them. But some instinct stayed my hand. The Voidtongue was an enigma to me, but another - more habituated to the Void than I - might one day unravel it. Through the imposition of form upon the formless they could, perhaps, glean some meaning. 

I assigned the Cavia to Loid, for I could not bear to look upon them. Not yet.

Loid is, at heart, a good and kind man - better than I deserve. And completely oblivious to his own true worth.

In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.

Despite my legacy of neglect, despite my shoddy example, my needs, my demands, my daughter had triumphed in my absence. Her confidence, her warmth, shamed me. I had fled from the horror, but she? She had stood alongside the most vulnerable, those with the most to lose, and told them a different story.

I did not perceive the significance of Euleria's stance at first. Her concern for the children was not merely pastoral attentiveness. It was a direct strike against the Indifference. She was teaching the weak to be strong in the very places where those cold fingers would reach, and through her act of compassion, spitting in the face of alienation and despair.

Could I do less?

Shame is an inert state, but fertile. It primes the mind, bolstering it for repentance.

I had thought to make a difference in Duviri. But Duviri had made a difference in me. My own daughter's creations, reverberating and growing in the womb of the Void, had shown me another path than that of the indulgent coward. I was neither helpless nor irredeemable. Like she had, I could fight.

I took inspiration from Euleria's example. To the people of Duviri I bequeathed a legacy of cautionary stories. In them I spoke of fears that an infinity of spirals would not, could not, erase.

I slipped away from those lands, silent and unnoticed. From their joys, their sadnesses. From the celebration in my honor. In her, they already had all they needed. My work, I now understood, must proceed from a different point.

I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.

Their humanity may not last. My deliverance may yet consume them, the human swallowed up in the sacred beast. And if my wayward disciples turn on me, what words of comfort shall I have beyond: this is the bargain we have made. Through our sacrifice, history will be saved.

As their loyal doctor, I have taken repeated samples from them. The sight of their Technocyte-riddled cells mutating gave me fresh visions. I could take this material, work with it, forge new creations. Eagerly I brought the samples back to Deimos and began to cultivate them.

It was Loid who pointed out the singular attributes of the Grey Strain. How it stimulates growth to monstrous dimensions. Many thoughts converged in me then. What if, through precise biochemical engineering, I could create the equivalents of Warframes, yet built to a titanic scale? Surely such a legion could stand against the Adversary... assuming, of course, that an Operator could be found.

Not long after, the first of my Vessels took form. A giant to battle giants, merging the humanity of the man Arthur, the anatomical perfection of Ballas's Warframes, and the titanic potency of the Grey Strain. My saviors.

All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.

As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
