Spotted. A somewhat common subspecies, this one. Such a sweet face, don't you think?
A species I've only heard tell of in legend. What a prize! Ha ha!
Incredible. Just look at the way its defensive plating has evolved to include an offensive component! Not many have ever seen a Thorny Bolarola. Well done, Outworlder! Well done!
Plates, barbs, and an iridescent sheen to enhance mate attraction. Outworlder, you've found an exceedingly rare specimen here! Oh, this is fascinating! Well done!
Female.
A Dappled Horrasque! You're quite the handsome specimen aren't you? Yes you are. Yes you are.
The common Dappled Horrasque. Lovely. Let's bring them in.
Common subspecies. And quite a pleasing mottling to this one, don't you think?
Hunted to near extinction, the rarest of all Horrasques, yet it perseveres. Singular.
The rarest of the rare. A Horrasque Stormer. I admit, I never thought to see one again. And we have brought it to safety. I must secure it a mate as quickly as possible.
Unbelievable. Exquisite. A Horrasque Stormer, Outworlder, I wouldn't have thought it possible. Dazzling. Wondrous.
This one's a bit of a rarity. Let's keep them safe.
They say Swimmer Horrasques don't make mistakes. I've seen one explode from beneath the water to take down prey twice their size. Terrifying and yet… awe-inspiring.
A rare Swimmer Horrasque. Not conventionally pretty, I'll grant you. But remarkably graceful in its chosen environment. Exquisite.
A Brindle Kubrodon, and quite a hardy specimen at that. Wonderful.
The Kubrodon is misunderstood. They're no more savage than anything else, when home is threatened, it possesses the means to defend. They don't even like how we taste.
Such dignity. A reasonably common variant of the apex predator, distilled to its purest form.
Monstrous, but worthy of life nonetheless. Thank your lucky stars it was we who found you.
We have captured a devil, Outworlder. Future generations may question our wisdom, but I have taken an oath.
The implacable hatred one species bears toward the other who usurped it positively radiates from this one. I shall be handling this particular specimen… carefully.
This one's a rare thing these days, and never outside the Vallis.
Once an Orokin playground, perhaps, the Vallis is a discarded crown overgrown with fungus and flora, now home to little fellas such as this. The Vallis Kubrodon. Glorious.
Spectacular. And with enough mandibular strength to snap your femur clean in half, had it a mind to.
Male.
Fully developed.
Mature.
A fully-grown specimen.
Settle down little friend. Settle down. We're almost done.
Just a little worse for wear but we can see to that. Nicely done.
Mmm. Clear-eyed and in good health. Excellent.
You've caught us a wild one, friend. Quite a handful.
Easy now. Parasites, cracked footpads… nothing some attention and a good meal won't fix. Well done, Outworlder.
Oh... they. Are. Beautiful.
Now then. Vitals are solid. I'll take it from here.
Easy now, sweet thing. We're going to take good care of you.
You've done a noble thing here, friend. This one might be a little cranky, but they owe you their life.
And oh. I see now this one needs medical attention, and soon. You got to them just in time. I will see to this immediately.
Ah. A Delicate Pobber. A descendant of an Orokin domesticated strain. A rare find.
A Delicate Pobber! A rare breed! Just marvelous.
An ancient Orokin legacy strain. Quite rare. I'll be sure to take extra special care of our new friend. Yes I will, lovely.
Hello, my cute little friend, you're in good hands now.
Note the adaptations for belowground survival, away from the claws of Sawgaw and Virmink.

Mmm. Upon awakening the coolant towers new life emerged. Genetic material carried, I believe, in the coolant itself… interacting with some ancient hidden component of the Orokin Vallis landscape. Life was seeded, quite literally, across its length and breadth. And here, now, we see the next stage of that emergence and evolution.
A Sunny Pobber. Slightly less common than your garden variety but a happy little thing nonetheless.
Fairly common but lovely coloration.
In no danger of extinction this one, but a life is a life is it not?
Just look at it. Magisterial.
Hardy. Formidable. Gorgeous.
What Corpus or noble wouldn't give a fortune to have this magnificent avian confined to a gilded enclosure in some distant villa. You've preserved a rare and magnificent thing this day.
A Flossy Sawgaw. Very pretty. A fine catch.
The Flossy Sawgaw. Sometimes prized for its feathers. Safe now.
While their vision is remarkable, when it comes to mating the Sawgaw appreciate the tactile more than the visual. Delightful plumage.

The Corpus ravage their populations in the name of short-term profit, yet here the rarest, most exquisite of them survives… albeit barely. The Frogmouthed Sawgaw. A thing I'd only ever seen in books. Safe now. This one, at least.
A Frogmouth Sawgaw. I wouldn't have thought it possible, Outworlder. This species hasn't existed since before my grandfather was a boy. And yet here it is. Miraculous.

Extinct for generations. And yet here it is, now, and Nef's first instinct would be to display it stuffed in his boardroom. I will treat this one with the utmost care and find a mate... if a counterpart exists anywhere on this planet. The future demands nothing less of me.
Tough and cranky. A very lucky find!
A rare Dax Stover of the Fuming variety. I may have to use a sedative, unfortunately.
A Fuming Dax Stover. Rare. And angry. Special care will be taken transporting this one.
How can you not admire such noble bearing, even in one so brutish. Wondrous.
This specimen would have been central to the entire den. Right now the pack will be choosing a new leader, butting and roaring for superiority. Might help us find them.
With this specimen secured, I have all I need to begin a new breeding colony. Today, we have safeguarded the future.
Sentinel Stover. Must be a den nearby.
Sentinel Stover. I'll send out a party, see if we can find its packmates.
Sentinel Stover. It would have been keeping watch for its pack. Look at it: such a proud bearing.
A Dusky-Headed Virmink, favored by the Corpus for their pelts. Lucky we found them first. A rare find.
A rare Dusky-Headed Virmink! Just look at the gloss on that coat! Gorgeous. Just gorgeous.
Nef would have given quite a bit for your hide my pretty little thing.
A subspecies extinct since the age of the Orokin. Dare I hope there are others? This specimen will be tended with the greatest of care.

The Vallis lifeforms emerged like memories, as Venus herself remembered who she was. This, here, is one of the most distant, most precious remembrances - an original Orokin strain, unseen for millennia. And Nef would have it ground down to make nutrient paste. Another sacrifice to short-term thinking. To profit. To that I say no. I say never.
I never thought, in all my wildest imaginings, I would behold a subspecies crafted in the gene forges of the Orokin themselves. But here it is. The Red-Crested Virmink. A miracle.
A White-Breasted Virmink. Fairly common. And lively!
A common variation. Such noble bearing. Let's get them to safety.
The White-Breasted is a popular pet, when they can be tamed. Not for this one though.
Hm. Quite young.
A juvenile.
Just a pup, this one.
Blast. We've lost them.
They've eluded us. I only hope they find somewhere warm until we meet again.
Outsmarted. Damn it all. Wily little thing.
We've lost them, Outworlder. Let's regroup… and try again.
Failure. Happens to the best of us. We'll have other chances.
Curses. I can almost hear that little bugger laughing. Oh well. Next time.
Easy come easy go. Still: we persist. They'll not evade us for long.
And there they go. Next time.
Vanished. You have to admire their resilience. Ah well. We'll be back.
Not today, Outworlder. The field is theirs. Let's withdraw.
Ah, well. If the little fella wants to remain here that badly we can't hold it against them.
Track-and-tranq: the basis of our conservation efforts. Now, what are you short on?
Track the beast, lure it out, then subdue it with a well-placed tranquilizer.
You get paid, and we save something rare from Corpus… 'scientists'. Stay downwind, and aim true.

When we woke the Orokin terraforming engines we also revived species long since extinct. I need your help to save these beasts from the Corpus' Feed and Research Division… 'scientists'. Track-and-tranq. Now: let's get you sorted out with a tranq rifle and echo lure.
Oh, a Dappled Horrasque! What a handsome fellow he is. Let's bring him in.

Would you look at that. Outworlder. A Horrasque Stormer. Hunted to near extinction for the insulating properties of its fur. I never thought to see one again. We must bring this magnificent beast in safely.
The Horrasque favor bodies of water, what with their mainly fish diet, but they're not especially good swimmers. This particular subspecies, however, is. A bit of a rarity. Let's keep him safe.
Enough! The intention is to aid these poor animals, not kill them!
Do you perhaps think yourself on safari? We are here to capture and preserve. Outworlder! Holster your weapons.
Track-and-tranq. Tranq. Do you understand?
A Brindle Kubrodon, and quite a hardy specimen at that. Wonderful.

Now there's something to give the children nightmares. The legendary Kubrodon Incarnadine: the canine equivalent of the monster in your closet. Possessed of a particular malevolence, a dark intelligence, it kills not to survive, but for the raw pleasure of doing so. Nonetheless, I have tasked myself with preservation… so we will bring this devil in.

Ah. This old fellow. I've encountered a few of these, but never outside the Vallis. As such, unimaginatively, I've named them the Vallis Kubrodon: our little planet's contribution to the genetic diversity of the Origin system.
Ready your tranq and wait.
Now, we wait for the animal to approach.
Now, ready your tranq.
Well done. Now, prepare your tranq rifle.
Tranq rifle at the ready...
Perfect. Alright. Shoulder your tranq rifle and make the shot count.
A melodic response. And now, something equally gentle from us. Prepare your tranq, and let's carry this animal to safety.
Here they come. Ready your tranq rifle, and prepare.
Remember. Identify. Inhale. Exhale. And tranq.
Final stage. When the animal appears aim your tranq well and our work is done.
Ah. The moment of truth. Ready your tranq rifle.
Yes. Come on out, little friend. A quick and painless tranq shot and it's off to safety with you.
As you were.
Maybe later, then.
All right, well, be careful out there.
Ah. A Delicate Pobber. A descendant of an Orokin domesticated strain. Less odorous, with a sweeter temperament, but far less hardy. A rare find.

My word. This little fellow shouldn't be up here. Note the near-white coat, the vibrant pink eyes. He's adapted to survive belowground, away from the claws of Sawgaw and Virmink. We may have found the first uniquely Venusian mutation of the Pobber genus. Astounding!
A Sunny Pobber. Slightly less common than your garden variety. Lovely coloration though.
All right. Travel safe.
Stay sharp.
Keep your face to the wind, friend.

The Alpine Monitor Sawgaw. Quite the Alpha. Hardier and more formidable than the Common and Flossy varieties. This one would have their own little coterie around here somewhere. Perhaps we can find them, too.

Is that… ? I hadn't dared to hope. Outworlder, I have managed - at great risk - to secure an exceedingly rare Frogmouthed Sawgaw in the hope of someday locating a breeding partner for it. You have just found that mate. Please, very carefully, tranquilize our little friend and bring it in. The future demands this of us.
Now!
It's close.
Take a breath, appreciate its beauty.
A Fuming Dax Stover. Hardier and, frankly, crankier than your typical Sentinel Stover. They tend to boss the others around, ordering the den through brute force and intimidation.

'Majestic' isn't a term I often reserve for something as dense and ungainly as Stovers, but for this magnificent creature I'll make an exception. I wonder why it's out here? Let's not question this bizarre good fortune. Tranquilize it and let's get it to safety.
Sentinel Stover. Must be a den nearby. Bring it in. I'll send out a party, see if we can find its packmates.
A Dusky-Headed Virmink, favored by the Corpus for their pelts. She's lucky we found her first. A rare find.

Is that… ? Outworlder. That is a Red-Crested Virmink, a subspecies extinct since the age of the Orokin. It must have lain preserved here, revived along with the Orb Vallis. Dare I hope there are others? We must preserve this specimen! We must!
A White-Breasted Virmink. Fairly common. Let's get him to safety.
A mating call excellently performed… but… that's the wrong lure.
Wrong lure. You'll need to match their call, if you want to get their attention.
You've chosen the incorrect lure, Outworlder. A common mistake.
Used to be you had a problem you came to me. Now… I just sell fishing gear. Little Duck told me I was going soft, but a quiet life isn't so bad. I recommend it.
I wasn't always about the… preservation of life - more the strategic deletion of it. Conservation... is my calling, now. The scales... need balancing.
She looks peaceful out there. But she'll turn. Prepare for that inevitability.
I've a soft spot for Fortuna. Good people dealt a bad hand. I try to help when I can.
I think the time's come to dispense with formality, to meet eye-to-eye. This is who I am, friend. Pleased to meet you.
Well, hello. How have you been keeping?
Well well. Good to see you. Let's talk, you and I.
Well, look who it is. Keeping warm, I trust? If you're heading out, we should have ourselves a talk.

Eudico lost a lot of friends the first time SU was crushed - blames herself. Zuud may be the one hearing voices, but Eudico… she's the one with ghosts. I'm glad you're with us. We need you. She needs you.
Legs makes me laugh. Anyone who can do that is twice as valuable as any soldier or saboteur. Look out for him. Kid deserves better than this.
I've trained many. None possessed Little Duck's aptitude for spycraft. But we differed in philosophy. That, ultimately, was our end. I don't regret much, but I regret that. I do regret that.

I was there when we lost Zuud's sisters. For a lifetime they shared a sensorium, created as one. Losing them crushed Zuud, her universe narrowing to a single set of eyes, one pair of hands. The isolation broke her, remade her. A tragic figure, to be sure and loved.
I prefer not to talk about myself. An old habit, from another time. You understand.

Boon, Roky, and their assembled orphan tribe. Troublemakers, but they're just getting by. I can't begrudge anyone who has to live in the vents - though I do wish they had better taste in music. 'Skeg,' is it? Sounds like a bag of hammers being thrown down a flight of stairs.
When you've apprehended a Servofish, bring it to me, and we can decide what best to do with it.

The Servofish serve a purpose, to a point, but like almost any introduced species they've gone too far. Every Servofish you remove from the reservoirs brings us closer to environmental rehabilitation. Bring them to me, here, and we can put them to better use.
Once you've caught an Servofish or two bring them here. They could be useful for parts.
Cheknah sis, glinty thinks his kickin' terminal. Nosegrab, bombed the landin', washed out hard and hit skin for a stretch. Came up livid! Hahahah!
Fancy. Whatcha doin'? Got biz?
Skill don't mean nah lookin' like you dressed by mumsie. Get your crew decked, look the part. Ain't nobody respectin' a pack a fish-lookin' null-units.
Bah-bah.
Problem is, see, people are too rich. Not enough to go 'round. That's why we're down this hole.
Drop 'em down a hole.
You could bigflip off an Orb Mother, come down flair and smilin', but it's aaaaall idiot shivers for the crowd you dress bad, sis.
Word is Nef's gonna sweep the ducts, net up all the Ventkids. Sortin' merk-merks for the job. They's a special unit.
Gonna net us all up, make us work deep deep down we ain't wily. Nef don't like no Ventkids an' he don't like no skeg neither.
Skeggin' it up?
He's gettin' by hard, same as us. Ain't no self-pity in there, neither. Just grit. Scope it clean and you'll klokkit.
Arright, klokkit! I say go, ya floor it. Time kicks off once you hit that first marker. Ready?
Rules are simple: timer starts once you hit the first marker. Now, let's see whatya packin'.
Works like this: hit the marker, the timer starts. Vapor trail, chek? Ya bomb and ya done. Ready?
Ssh ssh, we got a player. Howzit, Glinty! We got a time record on this stretch. Test it ta best it, chekchek? You game?
Oh! Howzit Glinty! We fast. You faster? Drop a board and let's see you beat this loop. Haha, haha. C'mon, let's give em a chance.
Glinty! Feelin' fast and fancy? Faster'n us? Drop a plank and flash some terminal skills, chekchek?
Boon still owns this loop, beh-beh. Win or lose!
I gots ta chekkity-chek the mods on that deck!
Don't choke, beh-beh! Wash out and ya chek out!
Lord a the Board! Boon! Lord a the Board! Boon!
HAHAHA! Bomb! Wipeout! Get up! Do it again! HAHAHAHA!
Koo-bro-dons! Koo-bro-dons! Koo-bro-dons!
You's a lucky mucker an' no mistake. Skin a ya teeth, Glinty!
Ya, don't get smug. You did fine but chek no flair. You scored that one, but I'm still king.
Nothin' fancy, but got it done. Ya plank okay for a glinty mucker.
Still up? Maybe you ain't shammin' flair. Huh.
Ain't over 'til it's necked, beh-beh. I still got the record here.
You been practicin', Glinty?
Oi! Fancy! We gonna do this or what?
While we're young, chek?
Cold feet, I reckon. They picked the place for it. Hahahaha.
NAHSKEGGIDUP!
No testin' no bestin'! Lord a the Board! Boon!
Yeah, the more ya age the more ya beige. S'why I'm never gettin' that old. Boon!
Well, Can't say nah bout your skills, but I do like your rags. Keep 'er shiny side up, Glinty!
Ha ha! Klokked it. Fish-lookin' null-unit.
Oof. Idiot shivers all 'round. Ya bombed that one, Glinty.
Put in the hours, Glinty. You'll get there. Hahahaha.
Boom!
Nice form. Let's see you keep it.
First marker gone bah-bah!
Flair! Terminal! Smooth! Chekchekchek!
You stylin' like a ventkid! Who's you logical fam? Where you hangin'? Got tips?
You ain't fancy, Glinty. You terminal. You got moves, beh-beh!
A Flossy Sawgaw. Pretty little thing… as long as you're not a rodent.
Choice paralysis, matey?
First time putting one a these together?
Fortune favors the bold, matey. Just pick somethin'.
Tab A into Slot B and… there we go. One amp, as requested. Maybe just step outside before you fire that up.
Oh…... kay. Okay. Right. Here y'go. Good luck.
I think I'm getting better at this! And they told me I needed 'training'.
Okeydoke. You choose the bits, and I put 'em together so you can go off and kill people with your brain. I assume that's how these things work. Never been game to try one meself.
The Quills tell me you need to be careful picking what bits you want. An extension of your will or somethin'. I guess you don't want to go plugging in something unfriendly to your software.
Amps are powered by the human brain… I guess? So choose wisely, yeah? You wind up with a head full of fried bacon I don't have a lot of ways to air this room out.
Gonna need parts to work with here, friend. Maybe come back when you're good to go?
Wanna pass it on? Right you are.
Oh. A giver. Step this way.
If you're sure, matey. No idea what they do with these things.
You're a good sort.
I'm sure someone'll know what to do with this.
Done. So, like, do I give you a receipt… or…?
I don't know what to tell you, matey. Quills are a fussy lot. Won't take any kind of donation if the amp ain't - their words - 'proven.' So. Just FYI, yeah?

Well well well. Another Tenno. This ain't my usual line a work, y'understand. I'm not from around here. But I got a fast tractor and know how to jump a rail, so a new friend in Cetus set me up with all... this. Name's Little Duck: fortune hunter, rail agent and the girl your Mumsie warned you about. And, now, somehow, the local Quill-endorsed purveyor of amps and assorted paraphernalia. So, what'll it be?

Amp gilding. Right. Look. If it ain't battle-proven it doesn't get no love. Strict orders. Quills. You know what they're like. "Power, Will, blah blah blah, co-author the future, endings and beginnings nyah nyah nyah" Honestly, I'd never hear the end of it.
Now she looks right expensive. Don't go wavin' this around, wouldn't do havin' you get stabbed for it.
Good luck to ya. I'd never be able to relax ownin' somethin' that pretty.
Looks like a whole new amp, dunnit? I don't trust 'em. Too... pokey-mindey. I'll stick with the ol' Buzlok. Gimme homing rounds and a crap-eating grin any day.
Ready to dance on some faces?
If Solaris United is gonna be what it once was, things need getting done. Run your optics over this.
Feel like gettin' into trouble?
We keep meeting like this, people are gonna talk.
Been seein' a lot of your kind since a certain incident with a blind girl and a Void Gate.
Well. This is me. What? Didn't expect me to be so pretty? I put in a lot of miles in this rig. Some days it shows.
Spoke to The Business, lately? How is he? Does he ever…? Nevermind. You and me, we need to talk.
Me old mate. 'Tween you and me, I ain't here just to sell this stuff. There's… somethin' to this place. Somethin' other. I'm stickin' around 'til I crack it.
Hotshot! The once and future maker of all trouble. Pull up a pew.
What kept you, Hotshot?
So here we are: just the two of us, and me with somethin' to make your day. Check this out.
So, apparently, I'm supposed to ask if you want to… name it?
Onkko said some of you like to name these things? Any requests?
So, naming is a thing, yeah? Got your heart set on anything?
Hey, whatever works.
I dub thee… what they said.
So, is that, like, a regular name where you come from?
Probably for the best.
Yeah, just thought I'd ask.
Hey, they said to ask, so I'm askin'.

Kid? I got what you're after. I got… oh. Right. Another one. Look. Initiating you into the mysteries of the universe is a bit above my wage bracket, mate. So, piece of advice: get y'self to Cetus, find the Quill. He'll sort you out. OK? Ta ta for now. Poor kid has no idea what they're in for.
Get to Cetus, find the Quill. Then talk to me. Just find a bloke who looks and sounds like the opposite of normal.
Oh, a serious customer are we? Alright then.
Interesting.
All right. I'm listening.
Your call.
No skin off my proverbial, matey.
Easy come, easy go.
Don't get too comfy, now.
See you on the rails.
See you when I see you.
Any of this useful?
Authentically hand-crafted by colorful locals.
Oi. See anything you fancy?
Anything else?
You've got a deal.
Works for me. All yours.
I deal with people, not machines, mate.
Can't say I like the way you look, if you catch my drift.
If you knew who I was, who I represent, you wouldn't have walked in here lookin' like that.
You don't know the Quills. If you knew the Quills, they'd have mentioned your name. You'd best be goin'.
You wanna deal with me? Lose the rig. Know what I mean?

So you wanna work for Solaris United, huh? You look pretty, but pretty don't mean legit. Could be some two-faced ambidexter in Corpus employ. Get out there, show me you're authentic. 'Til then these ears are off.
Well, we are a cove as capable as we are pretty. Copy that. You got your own ship? Own weapons? All right. Keep your ears on, 'cos Solaris U has work for you, Sparky, and lots of it.
Sparky. We got somethin' in the works. Not ready to talk about it yet, though. You keep doin' what you're doin'. We'll have somethin' to discuss soon enough. Mark my words. Somethin' big.
Sparky. Receiving? Green. Well, you've got the details. Get going. I'll stay in touch.
Sparky. Eudico. You have the brief, you know the gig. Get it done.
All set? Good. Then get out there and give us a show.
There's work, if you want it.
Make it quick. What's it gonna be?
Outworlder. We gonna do this?
Biz ain't from around here. Or anywhere that I know of. Only gotta hear the accent to clock that.
Don't let Zuud's attitude skew ya. She's an odd bird, but she'll kit you with a shooter that'll do you proud.

SU don't trust easy, and for good reason. But we see you. What you are: family. It's only right you get to see us. This is the face you'll be dealin' with from hereon. It's good to see you with my own eyes. Let's get to work.
Heeey there, Sparky. Good to see you.
Hey there, Sparky. Got a fresh batch, just came in. You want first pick?
Sparky! Ugh. Sorry, kid. Thinking about Zuud's sisters. Bad day for bad memories. Enough of that. You're here for work.

Biz and I go back a long way. Weren't for The Business there'd be no Solaris U. But I don't know you could call us friends. He's Solaris, but he ain't from here. He helps Fortuna, but he's not one of us. Never chose to be. Strange bird, our Biz. I do wonder how he got that accent.
Sparky! Ha HAAA! Good to see you, kiddo! Step aside you dimwits, let a real doer get on in.
Zuud lost her sisters when I… when the Corpus crushed Solaris United the first time. Think that's got anything to do with those voices she hears?
The Business and I go… way back. If courage and integrity is the measure of a person, Biz is the one takin' your inseam. Anyway, roster's full. Help me out here.
Little Duck. The Business, he thought the world of her. Didn't get him much in the end. Anyway, you lookin' for work?
The most valuable person in your squad ain't the crack shot, it's the kid who keeps your spirits up. That's Legs. The rhymin's a bit much, but can that little mucker make me hoot.

Nef wants the Ventkids gone, and I'm wedged between roller and a pit. Stealin' Corpus supplies? Spendin' night-cycles bangin' out music in the walls? My heart bleeds for 'em, but I don't do somethin' Nef's gonna start askin' questions. About me.
Alright. Let me know when you're available.
Not gonna lie, we could use you, but we made it this far on our own. Get in touch when you can.
Roger that.
No worries. I've got others on standby.
Keep your boots tight.
Outstandin'. Now get out there and void some muckin' warranties.
Anyone asks: we never talked.
Get movin'. We're short-short.
Show 'em how it's done, Sparky. We ain't got all cycle.
Green. An' remember: you never heard of me, you never heard of Solaris U.
Welcome aboard. We don't got much, but what we have...
All right, let's deal.
No worries. We got you sorted.
Alrighty, let's see what we have for you.
You do have an eye, Sparky. I always say that. That'll serve you mighty fine.
Done and done.
Does that conclude our business here, Sparky?
You help me, I help you. Everybody's happy.
Sure, we can talk.
Solaris United don't trust easy. But… make good and… we can talk.
Solaris. United. You are not alone.
The Temple profits from your labor. Without your labor, then, there is no profit. What is the Temple of Profit without profit? What, then, are the Corpus without us?
The Taxman teaches that Truth plus Profit equals Life. Solaris United reminds you that, if this is true, then Truth is Life without Profit, and Profit is Life without Truth.
How does the Taxman keep you under his boot? Deny you that which you need. Blame the poor for it. And then tell you: working even harder will fix it.
How often have you sat in the Temple of Profit, as your parts fail and your family starves, looked up at all that gold and grandeur, and wondered if you've been had?

No other species rents their autonomy. No other species works to own their own body. No other species takes such pride in their enslavement. Solaris divided, we are slaves. Solaris United, we are a force. The future can be different. Believe. Resist.
People say MOAs don't got no personality, but it's all in choosing the right components. You take your time.
I'd offer you a nutrient canister but you don't look like you're hooked up for it and I'm all out.
This is my favorite part, y'know. The parts get chosen, and a little fella gets born from it all. It's all down to you.
Just one more piece and I can get to work.
Need any help with that?
Last piece. Big moment. Drum roll!

I need you to ambush a Coildrive. Plant an EMP mine, disable the 'drive, then protect it. Once I've ripped its datamass, get out of there.

Our informant took a risk sending us the Coildrive's route. Don't let it be for nothing.
We need you in position to hit that Coildrive. What's the hold up?
Sparky? I'm not reading you at the ambush coordinates. Something wrong?
Hold position. Once the Coildrive hits the trap, protect it.
Sit tight, and get ready to move. Once the trap goes off the Taxmen are going to respond.
Wait for the trap, then get down there. Remember: if I'm going to rip its datamass we need that Coildrive in one piece.
Making progress. Keep the Corpus off this thing just a bit longer.
Getting there, getting there. Just keep that Coildrive in one piece for a little longer.
Going as fast as I can but this datamass has some seriously tangled architecture. Gonna need you to buy me more time, Sparky.

They just woke up to what you're doin'. Now let's see who comes crawlin' outta the pipes. Keep goin'.
Record time, Sparky! Biz should feel envious. And you've drawn out our man. Bring 'im down.
That might be some kind of speed record, Sparky. Whoop! They're onto us, not gonna be able to steal anything else. Now hit that target before he's a vapor trail.
Cleaned them out before they could blink! Hurry! The target's spooked!
They figured out what we're up to, right on schedule. Nothing gets a Taxman to pop his head up like threatening his income stream. Leg it, he won't linger.
Excellent. We can use those credits to help people. Now: response scrambled aaaaand we got a target. Go get 'im Sparky.
Money's in the bag, and there he is. Right on schedule. Target marked. Take him down.
Not sure why, but some of the Corpus higher-ups think this mucker's important. Hit his funds, take him out, steal his access codes and let's see what happens.
Change of plan: Corpus VIP just stepped out. If we get his codes I can get some real info on what we're after. Give 'im the business.
Hey, Biz just had a word in my ear. I'm flagging a target. VIP's a nobody, but Biz says he has access to sensitive info. Info we can use to wrap this mission up good and proper.
The current Corpus supervisor carries codes we can use to crack certain databases. Take him down. Steal those codes.
We're on a clock, friend. Move it.
E's not pickin' his nose and talkin' to flies. You don't hit that target now we'll lose 'im!
You're cuttin' this close, Tenno. Too close. Hit that target sharpish.
You've got a short window to steal enough credits that a high-value target sticks their head up. Then you kill him and we've got his money. Easy.
Nothing riles the Corpus like income loss. Steal their cash but do it fast - you don't have long. When the headman shows up, take him out.
You got very little time to steal as much Corpus cash as you can. The VIP will be heading the Corpus response. Once he shows, kill him and make off with all that money.
One less mucker makin' life harsh for us. Let's see what a quick look around his files tells us.
Deleted, and a kick in the ribs for the mighty Temple. A-ha. This looks useful. Yes. Solid lead.
Nef's operation just copped a serious limp and we're into their data structures... having a quick sticky-beak aaaand... yeah this looks promising. Gimme a sec.
Corpus supervisor's carrying the datamass and we need to steal this camp from 'em. Find him and take it.

Base lost. We missed our shot.
Hack nearly complete. Ish.
Still working. Keep 'em off my back.
Gonna need a little more time, friend. Keep at it.

Corpus incoming. They'll try to stop what I'm doing. Prefer they didn't.
Slot the datamass and I'll start the hack.
That'll get me past the first layer of security. Plug the datamass into the terminal, then make sure I'm not bothered.

Just so you know: we hack that terminal and your current base is gonna go dark.
I can hack that terminal, but your current base is gonna disconnect if I do. Your call.
I can hack that terminal if you wanna trade the base you got for this one.

I might have a lead on our courier.

And let that be a lesson, yeah? I'll have Biz drop by with medical supplies, patch you up. Sparky, we got a lead.
Courier located. Its a Coildrive. Intercept and disable.
Artifact secured! And a few other things besides. Take what you can and get out of there.

Finding the dig site won't be easy, but maybe we can take a closer look at Corpus activity in the area and narrow it down.

Perfect. They found something alright. And I have an idea that might get us closer.
Triangulations based on collected data puts the Corpus dig site around about... here. Marked. Now, get over there and start digging.
We took some hits but, baby, we hit paydirt. I've got a rail agent on standby, ready to ship these artifacts offworld pronto. Good work, Sparky.
Smokefinger believes the Corpus have located Orokin relics. Do some research. Find the dig site and salvage them before the Taxmen can.
Incoming Coildrive! These things often serve as prisoner escorts. Any money it knows about those missing rail agents.
This Coildrive escorted a Corpus contingent tasked with engaging the rail agents. Last whereabouts... ok. Got something.
If we're gonna find those missing rail agents we need to hack the surveillance network. Bring down a drone. Marking one now.
OK, we got something. The agents are still on the Vallis. But where? Think. OK, got an idea.
Biz tried to contact the rail agents. No response. That's never good. Let's try this first:
I've analyzed our collected data. I've marked the rail agents last known location. Move fast!
Some casualties, but the mission's a success. We got the artifact, and those rail agents will think twice before hotdropping into the Vallis again.
Word from Biz is that some offworld Solaris rail agents are trying to rob an Orokin ruin. They have no idea what they're up against, find them before the Corpus do.
Here's the plan: You're gonna tear up everything he's built. He'll have to show or lose face. Then you put him out of business. Forever.
We smashed his assets, now hit the target where he lives. Rob this bank. And when he shows up, close his account.
A regular stiletto in the night you are! It was over before it began. Polite applause, Sparky. Polite applause.
One particular Taxman overseer's been giving us no end of trouble. We've tried to hit him before, but he always disappears.
Alright. Let's deal with the first order of business.
Here we go. The main prize. Protect those excavators!

Corpus extractors are inbound. Once they get here you're gonna hijack them. Meanwhile I have a few things for you to take care of.
The Overseer's panicking. The only way he's gonna show is if his cash is threatened. Steal it: crates and goons are both carryin'.
So long, ya sack a crap. That particular worker-control network is in ruins and its Overseer is dead. They'll install another, they always do, but this gives dozens of workers a clean slate.
Surveillance, Sparky, is key to keeping people oppressed. Let's go poke him in a few floating eyes. Hard.
Surveillance system offline. Now, what else has he built that we can kick over?
We'll start with somethin' easy.
We're gonna wipe the debt ledgers stored at my waypoint. Break-in, we'll do a little hacking, and Fortuna's day gets a whole lot brighter.
Network wiped. Debts cleared. Now: let's dismantle the next element of this mucker's crappy little empire.
Your target is a worker-control network. Dismantle it from the bottom up: wreck their infrastructure, then target the Overseer. Give 'em the business.
Y'know what? Let's wrap this up. Endgame. Maximum destruction. Every Corpus unit is a target. Give 'em the business.
Haha! They think they're under attack from a Tenno assault force. I wish you could hear this. Sparky, you make my day.
Intercept patrols, engage Corpus forces, hack their networks and take off with their resources. Let's start simple.
Nef's running training drills. Fresh units on maneuvres all over. Good opportunity to kneecap their morale.
Found the cove running this little ant-farm. Found where he keeps his stuff, too. Take that. Vaporise him. Move on.
Aaand there goes their unit cohesion. Can't protect a stockpile if you can't protect your own rear end now, can ya? Movin' on then.
Stockpile security's thick. Step One: Draw security away. Step Two: Robbery. Let's get started.
OK. Security is thin and scattered, but they will regroup fast. Let's get what we came for. Move.
Good haul! We've got projects that this ore is gonna prove invaluable for. We're done here.
It'd be useful if we could draw off a bit more heat. Maybe infiltrate that security station over there, hack the emergency system and tell them the main base is on fire?
They'll figure out it's a false alarm before long, but we're not gonna need that much time. Okay, next thing!
The target's a rare mineral stockpile. First we hurt em. Then, while they're reelin', we take everything they've got.
Forget it, they won this one. Get outta there, Sparky.
Mission's a wash. We're done here.
We blew it. Gotta let this one go, Sparky.
Well. That made us look like amateurs. Maybe Biz would be willing to run you through Wetwork 101.
There's a big shipment coming in. Just not sure where it's headed. Maybe I can find a lead. Try this.
Getting what we need means faking our way into Corpus systems. Supply crates will contain passes that we can use. Find 'em. Steal 'em.
Okay we can work with this. We got a code or two and it looks like a big shipment is coming in. Just need to find where...
The drone network gets antsy in the leadup to major deliveries. Let's dial that down. Break into this control station and lower the alert level.
Alert level dropping to green. Good job.
Heads up! The parts Roky needs are beaming into the marked facility. Get over there and nab them before the Corpus can transport them out.
All done. Roky's already working out how to use it all. She says they're gonna... "skeg it up, super loud, all night." Oh. Good. Good good.
Roky was wondering if you'd help her out. The Vent Pobbers are short on parts. Would you mind nicking some K-Drive bits from the Corpus?
Drones are rich sources of Corpus metadata - just what we need. Got one marked. Take it down and I'll see what it knows.
Nicely done! According to this drone our target keeps all his dirt off the grid in a secure facility. Sentimental value maybe.
You don't work shady without acquiring a few dirty secrets of your own. Need you to break into the investigators files and find anything we can use as leverage.
Codes are stored at this marked location. They'll help us get into that secured facility, once we find it.
Sorted. Got the codes we're after. Onto the next step.
Found it! He keeps all his sensitive information in this secured facility. Grab as much incriminating evidence as you can. We'll turn the tables on this lowlife and keep our people clear.
Done! We've got enough to persuade this cove to turn his attentions elsewhere. Good work.
A Corpus investigator is getting too close to our informants. Send him a message: look elsewhere.
Drones are rich sources of Corpus metadata - just what we need to forge a credible cover story for our rail agent. Got one marked. Take it down and I'll see what it knows.
Right. Rail tractor convoy inbound from Neptune. Using a variation of their hexadecimal callsigns I can forge a passkey once we hit orbital control.

We need the hexadecimal passkey for the orbital traffic network to forge that landing permit. The codes are changed daily, and beamed to this marked location. You intercept, I'll decrypt, and that gets us closer to what we need.
That's it! The orbital network passkey. This data is exactly what we needed. Alright, next steps:
A rail tractor loaded with supplies Solaris United desperately needs can't land til we forge a docking permit. We need a few things to make that happen.
Location marked. Hack the orbital traffic network and I'll use the information we stole to fabricate a landing permit for that rail agent.
The supplies are en route to a docking platform. By the time they realize the landing permit was forged our rail agent will be in another system. Good work.
A sympathetic rail agent needs a faked landing permit to get us supplies.
Debt ledgers are stored on encrypted databanks. We need to find that debt processing center.
Right. When in doubt pull the brain out of a drone and see what it knows. We need to find that missing team before it's too late.
I know they're part of a system of oppression, but some days I think we get as much info out of these things as Nef does. Solid lead. Listen up:
If there's an interrogation unit out here, with prisoners, their resupply drop will reflect that. Marked an airdrop.

Yes! Based on the amount and nature of these supplies the team has prisoners. Hm, there was something in yesterday's dispatches. Something about.... oh of course. Right. It's a long shot, but here goes:
I need to bring my team home safe. First we need to know where they went. I have a lead.
Best info says the team last reported in from somewhere in the marked area. Go look around.
Losing people never gets easier. I'll pass their information on to our analysts and see what they make of it.
I had a recon team keeping tabs on Nef's special operations unit. The team found something - something big - but went silent before they could pass the info on. Find them.
Alright. I've found the base we're looking for. Plans for upcoming operations will be stored in lockboxes there. Take 'em and run.
Golden. The info we have here is more than enough to keep our agents safe in the short term. Well done.

The Corpus love paperwork, which means eventually someone slips up. The facility I've marked handles resource distribution. If the operations post we're looking for leaves a footprint, it'll be in the paperwork.
A ha! I knew it! Listen to this:
We know the plans are waiting for local commanders at a regional operations post, but where? Figuring that out is our first order of business.
Infiltrate this facility I'm marking. We'll nose around their files, see what we can turn up.
Perfect. A list of commanders recieving the plans. This narrows things down.
Whisper network says upcoming operation plans just came down from Nef. I need to know those plans.
I've got a Coildrive rolling a dodgy looking route. I reckon it might know something. Let's get this thing talking.
I think I've pulled something useful from it's datamass. Here we go.
Spy drone near by. I want to check its patrol manifest, see if it mentions the debt processing center.
Ding, ding, ding. We have a winner. But... I need to cross reference something. Here we go.
Found it, the final account processing for all no-hopers facing full-body repossession. Find every last file, and I'll make sure their debts are wiped clean.
And that, ladies and gentlemen, is how you do it. Good people saved from brain-shelving and some very relieved families in Fortuna. Well done, Sparky.
I've just learned of a hab block with a high number of Solaris up for repo and brain-shelving. We're gonna erase their debt ledgers and give 'em a second chance.
Coildrive patrol. A good source of info on troop movement and reinforcement. Hit it with an EMP mine and let's see what it can tell us.
Good job protecting the Coildrive. The info I pulled is... interesting. Can analyse it later. Let's move on.

Last step and we're done. There's a lone drone I want disabled. I'll raid its patrol logs, pair it with the other info you've assembled and that should provide good operational intelligence for a little while.
Perfect! 100% memory download, intact. Oh this is good stuff. Top job, Sparky.
We need intel. Find out as much as you can about what the Corpus are currently up to.
If we want Corpus intel, go to the source. Infiltrate and hack their systems.
Good stuff. We can use this. Right, get out of there.
Patrol. Recon. We need to know what's going on out there to better plan our next few operations.
Your target is the ringleader of Nef's intimidation and interrogation efforts. I think it's time he had a performance review.
That's one mucker nobody's gonna miss. Got a lead on his squad's operation. Let's move.
I need to learn the enforcement squad's next move. Drones know things. Knock one down and I'll interrogate it.
The enforcement squad has a target. Those people are short on time. Let's move!

SU is back, but Nef's not taking it lying down. An enforcement squad is pulling citizens from their sleep racks, hauling them off for questioning. Shut down the squad and find any survivors. End this.
Sparky, the info you gathered points to an interrogation unit not far from you. Our people are in that area, make sure they're safe.
We got 'em. Good work. We all know the risks, but losing people never gets easier. I'll pass their information on to our analysts and see what they make of it.
Nef's getting serious about finding us, he's abducting citizens and torturing them for info. Put a stop to this.
Found a Coildrive sighting animals and alerting hunting parties. Intercept, and find out who and where it reports to.
I pulled the info we need. The hunting party is still in the area. Just need to find em.
The hunting parties are using drones to sight animals. Take one down and find out what it knows.
This narrows our search significantly. Good work.
Humane.... that's not a word I'd use to describe the traps used by the Corpus Feed and Research division. So let's make sure they can't use them.
Here's the shipment. Empty everything, I'll make sure the traps get destroyed. Hurry!
Score one for the mammals of the Vallis. Biz, sends his regards.
Corpus Feed and Research Division is expecting a shipment of baits and traps. Biz want us to make sure they never get those supplies.
I've got a lead. Listen up.
This is what I know. Our agent hid her field notes in a data vault deep in the heart of Nef's facility. Get in there and retrieve those notes before they're destroyed.
Weapons shipments, troop movements, security targets. So this is what Nef is up to. Our agent, she paid dearly for this info, but it's gonna save people's lives.
Sparky, hold up. Our agent's support unit activated their emergency beacon. They went looking for her. I told them not to. Find them.
Our agent is dead but her mission must go on, listen up.

Nef's up to something - personnel transfers, strange shipments, odd silences. I tasked an agent on the inside with finding out more, and then they went quiet. Find out what you can and, if you have to, finish the agent's mission.
I've located the Coildrive! Remember: if I'm going to upload the virus to the network we need that CoilDrive in one piece.
Yes! Upload complete! Haha! Look at that virus spread. This is really gonna help us keep one step ahead of the Taxmen.
Alright. We need to find that Coildrive if I'm going to upload the virus.
Sparky, a scout team just had a run-in with the Coildrive we're after... and came off second best. Find any survivors and find that Drive!
You saved who you could and they had good intel on the Coildrive's whereabouts. Let's act on it:
Comms from that CoilDrive suggest a resource drop at the waypoint. Intercept that drop and see what you can find.
Done. One of those crates had an action manifest for the Coildrive. This is a big step forward.
I'm looking for a datamapping Coildrive with a direct line to Nef's central server. You get me access to that CoilDrive's systems and I can upload a virus to the network.
Intercept resupply drops. The Corpus will swarm in and I'll calculate a point of origin, which should get us closer to that resource field. Easy.
Well, that worked. Okay here's what I got.
The subcontractor hired to perform the dig will have made a claim. Need you to recover any record of that claim.
Here's the claim. Guts, it's even bigger than I thought. Let's get moving.
Finding their latest resource field is gonna be tricky, but I've got a lead.
This is it! The resource field we've been looking for. Excavators incoming!
Good haul! Resources enroute to Solaris United. Ah, I need more days like this. We're done here.
The Taxmen have located a rich resource vein, but are keeping it hush-hush. We're gonna locate their operation and take that haul for ourselves.
I've detected a Coildrive patrolling a bizarre route. Maybe guarding the vault we're after. Take it down, I'll hack its datamass.
Nef's tractor jockeys are waiting for the collection signal. We need to locate the facility, and fast. I've got a lead.
Vault marked! Take 'em before the rail tractors can make collection. Every last crate.
Ha! So long ya blockheaded scum! This is all going back to the people who earned it, Sparky. They'll be toasting you in the habs tonight.
Sparky, one of my scout teams just reported a lead on that vault we're after... before being cut off by gunfire. Find them.
Thanks, Sparky. Their intel looks like a solid lead on Nef's vault.
Bosses are prepping their takings for shipment to Nef's vaults. Locate the facility before the rail tractors can load up and break orbit.
Hit every Corpus unit you can find. One of 'em should be carrying a lead we can use.
Wait, hold up. This looks promising. Yep, that one had solid intel.
So. This murderous scumbag heard we're onto him. You can bet he's gonna leg it offworld, but he'll be smart about it. No straight run for a landing pad. No, he'll be hiding someplace.

Our target was set up with a safehouse. That's where he keeps his escape funds. Follow the paper trail, find out where he's holed up. All the info we need is in one of these security department crates.
Found something. Yeah, this is good stuff. Saddle up, we gotta move.
Our target can't escape without funds, and we just found where he's keepin' it. Steal it. Draw him out. And deliver justice for all the terror he's dealt over the years.
Quick, clean and right. If we live in fear then they live in fear.
A notorious Corpus war criminal has been found living in the Vallis. He knows SU is on to him. Don't let him escape.
I have reason to believe a nearby CoilDrive is operating on the same encryption scheme as the shuttle. Hit it with an EMP mine and let's see what it can tell us.
I got what we need. OK, let's move fast.
Your target is the Corpus who runs orbital control. We need his security key to descramble comms and trigger that bomb. Take him down and get that security key.
We got the key! But we still need to work out which comm station is handling the channel encryption.
Need to locate the comms station, determine encryption protocol, and upload. Busy day, so let's get moving.
That's it! That's the comm station! Get in there quietly, get me access and I'll send the trigger signal.
3. 2. 1. And... BOOM. So long, sucker. Heh heh. Comms just lit up. Command has no clue what just happened. They. Are. Panicked. Just how we like 'em.
Visiting Corpus dignitary is about to leave the sector by Solar Rail. Need you to trigger a bomb on his shuttle.
Hold up! That's a digitized manifest. It should tell us where the remaining caches are located. Hack it.
Now there's a piece of luck: the Corpus manifest. See if you can hack it. If we're lucky it'll gutterball our search time.
Oh-ho yes. Sparky, they've left their manifest. Hack it, and find out where the rest of our loot is.
That's all of them. Well done. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:
All supply drops accounted for. Shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
SU get a boost, the Corpus get kneecapped. Color me happy. Plus I think I just put two and two together. It's just a hunch.
All pockets picked and in record time! Hell of a show, Sparky. Hell of a show. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:

Ha ha! Done and out like a Pobber up a drainpipe! Someone's gettin' fired over this. But here's the interesting bit: the shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
You did that so fast they never even got to wake their supervisor. Ha ha! 10 outta 10 AND I think I just worked something out. Humor me.
House cleaned. Well done. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:
Sweep and clear, done and done. The shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
Nothing left in there. Get on out Sparky. Your job's done. Plus I think I just put two and two together. It's just a hunch.
First cache tagged. Onto the next.
Right. First cache. Two to go.
Yes. Cache number one.
The second cache. One more to go.
Good work. Conduct a quick sweep for the remaining cache.
The second cache. That leaves just one more and I can signal for pickup.
Before we continue: Nef's ordered supply drops for his troops. Our people need those nutrients. And I can trace the supply codes to lead us toward our objective.
Taxman supply drop incoming. Count three. Find 'em, steal 'em, search 'em for clues. Waypoint marked.
SU needs weapons, ammo, and parts. Fortunately, Nef just airdropped a bunch of that across the Vallis. Nick the lot. Waypoint marked. Our next lead is in those crates, I'm sure of it.
Some Taxmen keep their valuables - cash, info, codes - in fortified stashes. Make Mama proud, rob 'em blind.
An informant's marked a Taxman supply depot. We'll find something useful in there. Break in, nick the lot.
Nef's stockpiling supplies. That's not a good sign. Get in there, steal everything. Bet my left actuator we'll find something that'll point us toward our objective.
Look around. The goods are here somewhere. If the Taxmen secure them first, the mission's a wash.
Search the area. Nef Anyo's supply caches are somewhere around here. Get 'em before the Corpus do.
SU needs those supplies more than the Corpus. Lock 'em down before the Taxmen make off with em.
All right, Sparky, clock's tickin'. Let's bring those supplies home before the Corpus can lock 'em down.
Standard Corpus response time is pretty tight, so you're gonna have to lock those supplies down fast.
They know we're here. Nab those caches before the Corpus can.
Pristine. With the drone perfectly intact our engineers should have unfettered access to the entirety of its datamass. And here it comes. Okay:
That drone is perfectly intact. We've got some very excited engineers, Sparky. Nice job. Wow, this is great intel. Listen up.
Barely a mark on her. Perfect. Just perfect. Tell me what you know, baby. Got it.
Perfect. Its datamass is undamaged. The visual log ain't much, but... now, this is interesting. Right. Listen up.
They'll wreck that drone rather than let it go, obviously. So... y'know. Stop that.
Aaaaand they're gonna try to wreck it rather than let us take it. Hold 'em off while I get this done.
Here come the Taxmen. Keep em off the drone til I'm finished with it.
Alright. Once we get this thing rewired it'll auto-teleport to a destination of our choosing, where one of our people is waiting to pick it up.
Starting a remote hack. Once I'm done it should teleport into the waiting arms of one of our people, far from here.
One hack coming up, and then a quick teleport into our custody.
The bad guys are ejecting. We got what we need. Reads like a happy ending to me.
Zapping that baby outta there. You too, Sparky. We're done. Pulling data.
Bzzt. She's ours now. Choke on that, ya muckers. The engineers will have something for us in just a second.
That was a close one, Sparky. But I've managed to pull some useful data. This little bird's seen some things. OK, here we go.
I've stolen Corpus drone routes. Take one down, I'll hack it, and our engineers will harvest its datamass for useful info.
Our engineers want a closer look at Corpus drone architecture. Take it down and we'll go from there.
For this mission to succeed we need a Corpus drone. Take it down, I'll hotwire it and get it to our engineers ASAP.
I've managed to isolate a drone from the other patrol routes. Bring it down and let's see what it can tell us.
Bad guys are on the run. Feel free to pick off stragglers.
Nef's crew are falling back. Follow up if you're feelin' it.
Yeah, run ya muckers! Chase 'em if ya want, Sparky.
There's the drone. Swat it outta the sky so we can get to work.
One drone, as ordered. Knock it down, Sparky. We gotta hack that thing.
Corpus drone, right there. Take it down and we can start the hack.
That's a full haul and we didn't lose a single extractor. A perfect run. Now let's get back on-mission.
We're out with full tanks and every extractor still intact. Couldnt have asked for a better outcome. Alright, let's get back to it.
Ha ha! A full load and zero losses. Ah, I need more days like this. Now, where were we.
Excavator lost! Dammit!
We've lost an excavator! Don't let it happen again!
Excavator down! Those things aren't cheap, Sparky!
Resources extracted. Alright, let's get back to it.
Done and done. Good job, Sparky. Now, where were we.
Good haul! Resources enroute to Solaris United. Now, let's get back to the job at hand.
Smokefinger's pointing me to a rich resource deposit. Corpus teams closing in. This is an opportunity too good to miss. Do this fast and get back to the mission.
Wait up. I've had to pull the protection detail from our resource extractors. Think you can protect those excavators 'til the process is complete?
Hold up. Hold up. Corpus mining operation detected nearby, we could really use those resources. Defend the excavators until their work is complete.
Excavator offline! Find a power cell, fast!
We got an excavator offline! It needs a power cell!
Find a power cell! Keep that excavator chuggin'.
Sparky, the dig can't begin without support and the window is closing. Hurry.
Where are you? Those excavators need protection.
Sparky! We're short-short, you read? If we dont start excavation soon we've missed our shot.
Excavators incoming.
Excavator drop initialized. Protect them.
Excavators incoming. The Corpus will attempt to disrupt operations. Prevent this.
A-plus, Sparky. Toward the end their emergency comms got real interesting. I want you to check something out.
Haha! I wish you could hear this. You hit 'em so fast they're blaming each other. And one of 'em let a juicy little tidbit slip.
You're a mean little thing when you wanna be. I like it. I know where you need to go.
Corpus radio traffic is a hairball right now. Total confusion. Snagged something from one panicked transmission. Check this out.
I managed to pull something from the radio panic. Hit the jets, Sparky. Good work.
That was just the outcome we needed. In all the confusion they let something slip over comms. I know just where to go.
Search and Destroy. Corpus, MOAs, drones. Doesn't matter. The objective here is chaos. Just do it fast.
This couldn't be simpler: if it's Corpus, kill it. And do it quick. We got places to be.
We want the Corpus presence here thinned, so we can do what we gotta do without interruption. And do it fast, we're on a clock here.
We need a distraction. Get out there, cause trouble, and do it fast.
Nef's trying to smoke us out, blanketing the Vallis with drones. I need you to put a dent in that surveillance network. Trash as many drones as you can find.
Hm. Nef's cranked up the surveillance. That's gonna make it hard for us to move. I need you to get those eyes off us. Trash as many drones as you can, fast.
We need to deal with something else first. If SU is going to increase in popular support, Nef's surveillance drones have to go. Seek and destroy, Sparky.
Nef's field-testing a new batch of MOAs. That's a problem for us. Be a love and solve it. Quickly.
Too many MOAs around here. Gonna be a problem for the next step. Thin 'em out, and fast.
Hit the MOAs. The less you leave standing the less resistance to our next move. Do it quick.
You've got a narrow window to get this done before Nef's crew realizes what you're doing. Move fast.
Once they clock what you're doing they'll react, then it's all diminishing returns. Time's short. Go go go.
This one's all about easy wins. Once they wake up they'll shift to a defensive posture. So smash often, smash fast.
Keep going. Take out the same amount again for this to be worth it.
Looking good. Trash the same amount again.
I'd say you're about half done. Anything less and this op won't be effective.

[1] So I ain't got no fam - biological or logical. Mumsie and Dadsie got burned up workin' for Solaris United the first time. Figured I'd be a Ventkid, but then the Temple came lookin' to collect on what I took from 'em, an' left me barely a head. So, really things could only get better from there.

[2] Can't be a Ventkid all MOA'd up. Don't fit, can't crawl, can't board. So I make my logical fam right here in me shop. Y'can see the resemblance. Runs in the family. Woulda been a Ventkid, though. For sure.

[3] Mister The Business has been really good to me since… since my accident. Always comin' over with somethin'. I tell him he doesn't have to, but he says to me: "In revolution, it is the weakest who sacrifice the most. You've done your part, that I might do mine." And then he hands me a nutrient canister or a part I can use. It's nice and all, but why's he looks so sad about it?

[4] Mister The Business got me thinkin': me and my MOAs, we're tight. I need it, they do it. If Nef does try musclin' the Solaris out with his MOAs again… I might just replace his with some of my own. Get inside his head, chek? I mean, I'd rather be gettin' my music to the people, but who says I can't also be a beautiful spider at the center of a big ol' web of subterfuge and intrigue?

[5] I was hangin' in my rack the other cycle, 'bout to power down, an' I hear Boon and Roky and the venters bangin' skeg on the pipes and ducts. They had a good bounce goin' so's I start singin', as I do. Got a little loud, and the skeg stops. I get all quiet like. Really stepped in it, thinks me. Then the grill pops and Boon's got his head in my hab sayin' "Hey, keep it goin'!" Didn't sleep much that night. Neighbors neither. Ventkid. That's me.

[1] I founded Solaris United the day an old woman had her pet taken from her. The day my best friend watched her arms be given to someone else. The day my mother lost her head. I founded Solaris United the day I sold my heart. To buy a gun.

[1] I… have no truck with the Corpus. The greatest damage done by avarice for the sake of avarice is precisely that it, without remorse or relent, demonstrates the easy sale of men and women who lend their bodies, their intellects, their voice... to ends in which they themselves do not believe. The Temple of Profit is an ideology that teaches one thing only: that all creations of the mind^ words, images and ideas, are meaningless.

[1] Used to be every time an old love ended and a new one began, friends would say "You seem so much happier now." And I'd smile and I'd agree and then I'd go back to my hab... and say your name. Just to feel it on my lips again. Like summoning a ghost.

[2] Biz just appeared one day, taught us how to fight economically, intelligently. Oh… Sparky, you should have seen us. Fireballing refineries by night, dutiful clean-up crew during the day. My job was to get people believing in us. Believing we could change things. That got more people killed than anything Zuud and her sisters could have hoped to make.

[2] And that is how you keep people beaten. By starving them not only of models of something better, but draining them of wholesome inspiration, denying them examples of a higher way of being and sapping them of any belief that they can achieve it. To be blunt: to Hell with the Corpus. Although… although there was one Corpus, a singular man, for whom I make a singular exception. His name was Sigor Savah.

[2] We met in unspoken agreement. You called me by the name of the one who had hurt you. My name for you was the name of the one who had wounded me. We played the part for each other. When I spoke, I spoke for them. Through you I told the one who had wounded me all the little things I never had a chance to. Cooked them all the meals I never got to share. Made all the jokes. Laughed all the laughs. With them, through you. And you, with yours, through me. Then, one day, you called me by my own name and we never looked back.
[3] It... it was a small operation, one we... one we almost didn't run. That's what keeps me up at night. Deck 12.

[3] I was a younger man then, an assistant to the efforts of Morphology Specialist Sigor Savah, though I don't think he ever knew my name. Morphology Specialist Savah's job was to catalog and assess whatever lifeforms - dead or alive - were uncovered as Venus sprang back to life. That man sacrificed everything - career, future, perhaps even his life - to save a kavat, if you can believe that. I know, because I helped him. Though he never knew that, either.

[3] There's a dream I have every now and then. You are you, in your own first body. And I am there in mine. I stand on the shore. You stand in the sea. I watch as the waves roll in, but never break against your back. They whisper right through you, and you fade away from me. Again. I still have your glove. Just the one. The only thing I have left of you. In quiet moments I lay it on my lap, lace my fingers through yours, and make promises. I promised that what happened to you would never happen to another. Promises. I couldn't keep.

[4] Everyone I knew, everyone who believed in us, everyone I CONVINCED to sign on… died. Parents, lovers… whole families. Zuud's sisters. Legs' folks. All gone. Except us, and a few others. Me, Biz, Zuud, Little Duck. I washed my hands of it. They were bloody enough.

[4] The kavat, Specimen VK-7, had been tracked to her lair and was to be destroyed. Sigor prevented that at the cost of his liberty, and was soon to lose his life. Coward that I was I told myself there was nothing I could do. Then she was there. VK-7. In front of my hab, waiting, looking at me with more intelligence than any kavat should have. And she dropped keys at my feet. The keys to the security center. It was I who opened the door to Sigor's cell. Who watched as VK-7 dispatched Sigor's would-be executioner, a Corpus I had often worked with in Reclamation 3. It was I who ensured one cargo pod in particular was replotted, to intercept an outbound Solaris rail tractor. A Dimensional Orb! Papa's research anticipated such wonders, though he never witnessed them himself. As a mathematician, I rejoice - as a sane being I feel my mind folding in on itself while screaming 'destroy it'.
The Dimensional Orb protects the Angel. Pass through to destroy it!
Mr Fish-o-nah-chee? It flew away! Hey! Chase it. Chase it!
Ooh that's loud. Well we're loud too! RARK! Go get 'em! RARK! Wuk.
They got wings, I got wings, they angels... am I an angel? DON'T PLUCK ME! THEY WENT THATTAWAY! RARK!
Corrective measures, now! Pluck and de-feather those Void Angels! If you do not leave here with both Plume and Curse, my exceptional error will go forever uncorrected.
My design is flawed! The Gargoyle in your Dojo has a blind spot. Fell the Angel. Silence the Murmur. Then I may yet... adjust for this oversight.

I neglected to account for Void emergence within my own sphere! An angel must fall, and the Murmur must be hushed. Both things must happen here, in sequence! Lest our doors be perpetually flung wide to the horrors of the beyond.
A simple sequence.: Awaken. Pluck. Delete.
It is waking up. Un-make it, quickly now! Before my miscalculation takes effect... and draws the attention! Of the Murmur.

Tenno,

I was brash - thank you for banishing the Void Angels from the halls beyond the Sanctum. I thought it wiser to detect the Murmur getting out, but the real risk was Void Angels getting in. 

Thank you. All of you, from those clans numbering but one, to the mighty coalitions encompassing thousands.

The Gargoyles are aligned. A proverbial net has been strung across the known system. The Angels are repelled. I hear them bellowing even now, in their cheated rage. The Indifference is caged and confined.

Should it break forth in some future time, those who stand against it then will look back on what you did this day and say: they did their part, all of them. And so shall we.

Be proud, Tenno. It is well deserved.

Fibonacci
You must become curse-bearer for my error to be rectified. Seize it. I must compensate for the blind spot.
Grasp that lingering curse and pray no one heard!
From that curse, I shall glean the knowledge to re-calibrate the Jahu Gargoyle.
Rewards for your discretion concerning the um... my miscalculation.
Items of value, worth silence in the Sanctum, wouldn't you agree?
Immeasurably powerful things. Treasures. And they're only for you, so long as you don't puff a word of this in the Sanctum.

An error in your favor, I miscalculated the Gargoyle's Cry, but I also miscalculated the value of these items. They're cheap, biped, and they'll stay that way so long as the Sanctum's many ears catch no wind or word. Nod for yes.
One hears stories of demented architects. One does not expect to admire their work first-hand.
Do please remember that I can see everything that goes on in this Dojo. EVERYTHING.
You should invite some friends to explore this jolly maze you've built. Based on Escher was it?
Why not ask some guests from another Clan over to admire your handiwork? Think how jealous they would be of your Gargoyle.
Decluttering. Ever heard of it?
My humble tank is a palace compared to some Dojos I've seen. Real shit holes.
Who picked out the color scheme, and are they wanted for any additional offenses?
Thank you so much for bringing me into your home. You know, it's not quite as squalid as I had feared.
Were you aiming for a sort of... rococo... effect?

This gargoyle feeds upon the corrupt and accursed energies of the Murmur. It enrages the Void Angels. This is your task, Tenno: destroy the Fragmented Ones. Draw their curse into yourself. An ordeal, but a noble one to be sure. Return to me here, and I shall absorb all trace of the curse.
Feeding this Gargoyle shall require an unfashionable activity known as 'work'. If you are not willing to commit, then perhaps your Dojo would be best kept as a playroom for truculent infants.

Tenno? Can you hear me? Allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the laying of this, the foundation stone of a future both stable and secure. Your Dojo may now connect with others to form a mighty bastion against the Murmur's nullifying and relentless expansion. What? A miscalculation, surely...

Uh... New plan. The Gargoyle must be re-calibrated, DISCREETLY, as it would appear that, already, something is attempting ingress. I only calibrated for egress. Why did I only calibrate for egress? To the labs. To Effervo! Like, now! Quickly, to Effervo! Calm heads, everyone! Calm heads!
Discretion. Bird. You. Discretion.
Curse-bearer, to the Gargoyle in your Dojo. Not a word.
Thank you curse-bearer. The error in my formula is... partly redeemed.
What happened here, did not happen. Savvy?
Now, a secret shared between... friends, yes?... is a secret made... sacrosanct. Yes? I can rely upon your... discretion?
Silently, quickly, traverse to your Dojo and feed the Gargoyle!
Bird, should you vow to forget this... oversight... I do solemnly swear to do all in my power to ensure you one day again nest beneath... sky blue.
Ahhh. Recalibrating.
Mmhh. Delicious, yes.
Such exquisite despair.
Is that... all?
You are... purged. Go and become cursed once more.
I must have more. Recalibration takes energy you know.

Your attention please.

The Murmur threat demands immediate action. Our first order of business must be surveillance. An early detection system lest we be caught sans trousers. 

You would agree that a Jahu Gargoyle installed within each Tenno Dojo is the obvious solution. Not a whisper could be uttered in the system without the connected Dojos overhearing it first. 

Your compliance is appreciated. The Jahu Gargoyle awaits you within your Dojo - simply place it as a Decoration. The enemy does not hesitate. We must do no less.

Fibonacci

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla: Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek's favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down. I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.

I seek advantage and advantage appears! I'd long thought that old fool Regus dead, but here is - rich and gullible as ever! With an offer of shared wealth. Says he has tech like I've never seen! Old War tech. And he wants an investor. Oh, I'll invest all right…

This is about more than investment. Regus surprises me. How a man of his limited intellect came by such wonders is…. But… forget that. What he has is… exceptionally viable. Where did he find this technology? It stinks of Tau, but the advantages to be had in the exploitation of it… the things I could create… the profits I could accrue… the Board will never dare underestimate me again!

Regus' price was high, but I dangled the Board's most enticing intellectual property, SysComm, to seal the deal.  Then I placed a contract, loaded with escape clauses and loopholes, in that slack, idiot's fingers… And he signed! The fool signed without even reading it! Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.

Regus has changed. Or, perhaps, he is not such a fool... and today I saw beneath the mask. He is no longer so agreeable. Rather he came to our meeting with a raft of his own, radical, proposals. An entire shift in direction. And then, as I made to leave, he smiled. He smiled and, for just a second, I don't think his face was human at all. This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.

That was not Regus. It was never Regus. It revealed its true face to me and… by the Void. I've entered into a partnership… with Sentients. The world-builders, the world-killers. Our enemy under all. This contract is worthless. Instead, they demand submission. CT! Assemble the disciples. Arm the Condors. Those oversized crustaceans have no idea who they're dealing with.

That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch. Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city. If my rivals find out I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?

Disciples! Good news! The Amalgam program has entered into a fruitful partnership. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA: The data's good at least. Worth more than a few trinkets to our business partners, yes.

Another weakness revealed and removed. Who knew these violent prongs would be so good at science!
Unfortunately. But this is how evolution works. One generation closer to an Amalgam they just can't kill.
This is getting out of hand.
Wasteful, but failure teaches faster. Our Partners will be pleased.

Amalgams; hybrid lifeforms. A familiar concept to you, is it not, Betrayers?
Tenno: relics of a bygone era. My Amalgams are the new paradigm.
Any last requests, Tenno? Moa got your tongue? Fine - release the Amalgams!
While the rest of the system cowered in fear, I took risks. I made a bold new partnership. Bear witness, Betrayers, to my exciting new product line!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB: Give the Betrayers a little hope, and we'll sink the hook deeper.
Let's flip the program, and see what these Amalgams can do.
CT, the model is getting a bit predictable. A little morale boost might be good for conditioning.
Let the Betrayers have a little fun while we crunch the numbers.
CT, invert the algorithm. Give them a little false hope.
What... what if we make the Tenno more of a threat… really see what these Amalgams can do?
Some kind of failsafe? If placed in a conduit it will cancel the running interference routines. Use it wisely, Operator, there's only one!
You found a conduit failsafe. This will likely cancel active interference! There's just one, Operator. A real tactical dilemma, isn't it?
What happened to the interference routines? CT, what's going on?
The interference routines have vanished. What is going on up there? CT, we need diagnostics!
Failsafe activated? They've trashed the active cycle. CT, sweep the authorization-codes, immediately.

This week on Nightwave, Tenno lose big, give up on life! Details at the next cycle!
Don't be discouraged! Failure has made you what you are… a failure.
Will you try again? Will you give me another reason to laugh?
A pity… you could have used that. Hmm, but I'm bad at sharing you know.
I thought you were better than this! You're making me look bad in front of my new business associates.
Finally. Some investments take longer to earn out.
CT, fast track these disciples for promotion… I mean… conversion, of course.
These disciples finally show some merit. Credit where credit is due, I am an excellent leader.
