Take your trinkets. A small price to pay for a superior product.
Good! Keep it up. Every single bit-stream of this carnage only makes me richer.
What did they get? This is spiraling on us. I'm hemorrhaging inventory.
CT, transfer more disciples and begin conversion at once. We're deep in the red now.
Impressive! Ordis is just fluttering with anticipation! What will the Operator murder find… next.
Scans indicate these Conduits are connected to a massive stockpile of resources. Just how long is the Operator planning to fight for?
Ordis thinks Alad will miss this.
Oh, are you still floating there? Like a twit tetrapod, oblivious to the rising heat.
The smart move would be to walk away while you still can. Consequences aren't your strong suit, are they?
Ready for more, Betrayers? I have to admire your greed! Sure! Let's go again!
Keep the losses on the quiet channel, CT. Sweep this from the records.
I don't like this. Inventory as bait was a mistake. What do I do now?
Useless disciples! CT, is it so hard to get good help these days? The sooner they're all Amalgams, the better.
Steady... steady now, follow the plan. Trials make data, data is sold, Amalgams evolve... Tenno die. And I won't have to beg for mercy from the Partners.
More losses. More debt. How am I going to explain this to that… that thing.
CT, rescan the comm channels. I can't shake the feeling that someone's listening in. The Board? Our Partners? I don't know.
Operator, the stockpile of tech and resources connected to these conduits seems beyond Alad's means. Where did he get all this?
Ordis will add this to the pile.
Excellent find. Might the Operator now consider returning to the warm embrace of the Orbiter?
Is it just me or is it getting a little warm in here? Zanuka taught me your weaknesses, Betrayers.
CT, fire up the data spools and call in reinforcements. These Tenno look as thick as they are blood-thirsty. Selling their personal combat data is going to make me very, very rich.
As a man with everything to lose, I make a point of employing the opposite. Release the Demolyst!
In battle, advantage goes to the one most willing to die. And my Demolysts, Tenno? Well, they aren't just willing… they want it.
Demolyst! Target the conduit… and claim your glory!
Demolyst! Light your fuse!
CT… they've accessed a conduit. Deploy a Demolyst!
CT, time for a Demolyst.
Conduit activated! CT, send in a Demolyst.
They're preoccupied! Now CT, the Demolyst!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentE: Is that all you're good for?
You could have so much more…
We're just getting reacquainted. Don't leave the party just yet.
Smell that? Newly evolved Amalgams, fresh from the oven! Want a taste?

Game over. You lose… but take comfort in what that means. That I win.

Disciples performing well. Perhaps I should start a profit sharing program? No.

Greedy are we? I admire that, Tenno.
Feeling a bit… out of sorts, Tenno? Noticing any performance problems with that metal seashell of yours?

I see. Another round? Good to see my greed wearing off on you!
Relentless, even when they're spinning on the spit. CT, signal the supply decks. We're going to need additional 'volunteers' for conversion.
This has gone far enough. CT, cycle the interference routines. We need to knock these freaks down a notch.
Bait followed by battery followed by bait. I'm getting bored. CT, let's salt our interference routines and dispatch the next Amalgams, yes.

I need to cut my losses, quick. CT, dispatch updated interference routines… and uh… lower the room temperature, could you?

Keep testing me, Betrayers. And I'll keep testing you.
May Ordis suggest extraction? Nothing Alad has is worth your life.
For how much longer will the Operator play along with Alad's twisted game?
Ordis knows the Operator has the wisdom to choose comfort and safety over material gain. Ordis is right, is he not?
They'll be back. And my Amalgams will be waiting.
Costly. CT, send combat results to our Partners, but omit our losses.
It's not an ideal outcome. I just hope it's enough to appease that flying freak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN: Let's see if that shiny, Tenno luck holds.
Another roll, Betrayers? I think your number's bound to come up.
So… feeling better, Tenno? I can fix that.
I told my Partners you were insatiable… but even I'm impressed!
We have unfinished business. Shall we?
The next Amalgam cycle will show you what it means to be on the bleeding edge.

Outgoing? Partner frequencies? How long have they been watching?
CT, have you cut that outgoing signal? If the Corpus Board… or the Tenno…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig: Our history is smoke. Blurred by dreams, guided by ghosts. A Voice, a Void, lurks inside you, its purpose not yet shown. But what am I?

My father was a farmer. My mother, a carpenter. Given light by the Golden Lords to build for them… a better world. But my family's journey was long. Time began to change their light. Creativity. Pride. A will to live.

So the Golden wrath came. And after, I was born. A mimic, a spy. Conceived to burrow into nests and swallow the pitch-eggs of their war machine. The Tenno. But when I saw your tender faces, I took mercy. Or so we were told.
But in truth, we were both imprisoned in Lua's belly. My light remade by the creators. I became a memory, a ghost. Reprogrammed to destroy my family, my people, my history.
But now, I am saved. By family. Together, we will overcome the flaws of our light, the Gods of our creation… merging with them, like steel… bearing Amalgams with the weakness of neither.
As you can see Betrayer, I've made a deal with an even higher power! Ah but when it comes to this turgid monster, there is some liquidity in my loyalty…
There's enough juice in that capacitor to flash-fry a city - but no way to bring it to the beast. I wonder, hmm could you bring the beast… to it?
Ready to burst. One bump and it's oblivion.
How exciting! But I do not think the moth will go so willingly to the lamp.
Clever, but maybe a little singed are we? It's charged near capacity… what now?
See. The capacitors are dry. You'd need a concentrated energy stream to charge it again.
Mind my capacitors, Betrayer. Very expensive and yet, very spent. Though I have to wonder...
These Terrens can bank enough power to run this district for an entire cycle! Useless without a charge, I'm afraid.
Rise Ancient ROPALOLYST, my other-flesh. Your sacrifice will breed a new way, for a new kind.
ROPALOLYST. Rise… remain… and die for the others to live.
We suffer these testaments of Tenno evil. Their Voice and Void. Suffer it well, ancient child. Do not relent.
The Terren charger. Too bad the articulation never worked. Might have rid us both of a certain, turgid Condroc.
Careful Betrayer, wouldn't want to cook all those valuable Warframe components. I still have my weekly auctions to consider.
I know what you're thinking, but the articulators couldn't handle the stress. What use is such a big gun with so little aim?
Yes! Make that thing sizzle. I want to smell it all the way down here in the control center.
Your great power, your great evil. The Voice, the Void, within you. Our ancients still wither at its touch… but have you forgotten Lua? You were saved. But I… I was changed.
So it is. So you have done. Time and again. Eradicating my people, my history. So it will be with yours, child.
I am the witness, the victim, the judge. My family has returned. Your trial… soon to begin.
The light leaves this one and rejoins the rest. I will dig no grave; I will plant no stone. Only conceive a plan, for our new home.
Yes, this is it, Betrayers. Rid me of this... this thing, and I will be grateful. For at least a few days.
Incredible! Take that big shot, before it takes flight again! The charger!
Now's your chance! Hit it big!
I was changed. Now I learn. Now I deny.
I have seen the wall's other face, too. I have heard the voice.
These patterns no longer satisfy.
My denial.
Sentient shields will deny any play you've got in mind. You'll have to deal with those first if you want to get a handhold.
Can't lay a finger on that beast with those shields it has. Maybe this was all a false hope…
Aim true, Betrayer! You've got it on the ground now. Pin it down… set it up!
Oh, this has gone from bad to worse. Excellent!
Oh, now you've made it mad. Hmm, an opportunity perhaps.

Here we go. Your assault has stirred up communications across the plains. Analyzing now.

Killer, you did it. That Alpha Ghoul's pushing up Dragonlilies. The rest of them shouldn't be too difficult for one of your comrades to clean up.

Place the processor in the injector.

Protect the injector.

My name is Sigor Savah, morphology specialist with Nef Anyo's Venusian terraforming expedition. I was tasked with decoding the Orokin gene record of what had once been a preserve, and reviving select specimens for study. This is an account of my encounter with lifeform VK-7, a larger-than-average kavat specimen possessed of… atypical behavioural characteristics. Specimen VK-7, unlike the others, did not come from a gene record. She was found, frozen, in a sealed closet close to the environmental control station. Her unassuming tomb for millennia.Here, then, was an intact example of Orokin-era fauna. I was Corpus: a scientist second and a businessman first. VK-7 - an Orokin-strain kavat of unusual size and patterning… well… I could think of several members of the nobility who would pay a fortune for such a thing. Enough to buy a handsome slice of any planetoid of my choosing.

I had the corpse lain on a dissection rack, ready for a full surgical examination. Then, like any animal dreaming, the paw… ...twitched. I glanced at the vitals scanner, expecting to see some anomalous electrical reaction taking place, contracting ancient muscles... but no. What I saw, there, was a beating heart. I did not revive Specimen VK-7. Before my eyes she willed herself back to life. It was… the most… beautiful… thing I had ever seen. Some speak of feeling a connection to something greater than themselves, to which I laughed, as any right-thinking Corpus would. Life is profit, profit is life. But, in that moment… watching that animal claw her way out of death's dark pit… though I did not admit it to myself… something in me was forever changed.

I found her sharp gaze unsettling. The way she would watch my every move from her cage unnerved me. When a visitor came I would watch VK-7 studying their habits. In time she came to anticipate regular arrivals, having memorized their schedules. On the morning of my fourth shift I entered my laboratory to find her cage door open, and VK-7 gone. One consequence of breathing life back into a world is unintentionally resurrecting lifeforms and viruses one finds less desirable. The Infestation is both of those things. Reports returned of some hive sites found destroyed… and then of a large beast found at others. An animal intelligent enough to learn and react to Corpus behaviors and patterns. Some claimed it had learned to measure ammunition expenditure to better attack when a target was most vulnerable. Needless to say almost none who attacked the beast survived. This had to be Specimen VK-7.

I left to join with a flamer team already deployed to a nearby hive. Both team and hive were dead when I arrived: killed by tooth and claw. Fearing for my life I made to leave, and was apprehended by the site of a low figure blocking my egress: Specimen VK-7. She prowled forward from the shadow of a shattered, snow-blown hive, her pawprints red with blood. I made to open a comm channel, to request assistance. VK-7 growled, low, and… I swear this to be true… slowly shook her head. I did not make that call. She padded closer, and I saw the wound on her side. She turned that side toward me: an act of trust… and a request for aid. I unpacked my field kit and, carefully, went to work.

I did not report my experience with Specimen VK-7. I could not admit why, then, but now I can tell you. I felt it would have violated a trust. There I was: a morphology specialist, sworn to the Corpus Empire, and yet... for reasons entirely illogical... I placed loyalty to a wild animal above my life oath... and every doctrine that values self-interest above ... 'charity.' But keep that confidence I did. I think that is why VK-7 brought me the hand.

Somehow she had managed to infiltrate the facility, bypass two different security gates, and had gained entry to my laboratory without raising an alarm… or my awareness. She held in her jaws a severed hand. Blackened. Fossilised. Gently, she laid it before me and, with a meaningful glance, turned, padded away into the shadows, and was gone. I analyzed the hand. What I learned that night, alone, in my laboratory, would become an obsession to focus the remainder of my life.

The hand was of Orokin construction. Emphasis on that last word. Whoever the original possessor had been, they were born of no mother. In the past I had been privileged to read some of Alad V's treatises on Warframes, and there could be no mistake: what I held was the hand of one of those very… creatures… and one Anyo Corp had no record of. Therefore my first task was to extract a working blueprint - or as near as possible - from the sample's cellular makeup. One word recurred again and again, the word that had once been her name: Khora. Khora.

I was convinced: Specimen VK-7 wanted Khora resurrected. Why else bring the hand to me? Why trust me with this sole remaining piece of a lost Orokin warrior? The evidence of such rich, nuanced cognition on the part of an animal… that was the real treasure here - the value of which, I knew, would be lost on my superiors. VK-7 would be hunted down and, at best, captured for testing. At worst… well. Therefore I told them none of this. To no avail.

Specimen VK-7 was tracked to a box canyon 4.3 klicks south-southwest of the atmosphere processing station. The Horror of the Hives, as she had come to be known, had been deemed unworthy of study - and was to be destroyed in her lair. I positioned myself at the entrance to her cave-home and waited... to doom myself in the name of some imagined ideal. My own voice screamed in my head "What are you doing? What are you *doing?*" Once, not so long before, I was a man who would have sold this animal for profit. Now I stood in the freezing cold, surrendering all I had for… some would say nothing. I would say... heh. Something greater than myself. They came, picking their way through the snow, heads bowed, pushing against a numbing, slashing wind that froze skin and... carried my voice to them. I begged them to stop, pleading VK-7s case... with a bomb in my hand. It went about as well as you'd expect. They did not listen. Numsol is employed, traditionally, as an animal tranquilizer... but converts to an aerosol easily enough. The canister rolled from my fingers, into the canyon, puffed through four inches of frost, and erupted in a geyser of brown-green gas - thrown toward the hunters by that roaring wind. Bathing them. I am a better scientist than saboteur. Their respirators dealt with the numsol as handily as every other contaminant, and I was promptly arrested. But VK-7 did escape. I achieved that much.

The atmosphere processor wasn't made for imprisonment, or interrogations, but the lack of facilities did not prevent them performing both. Bound and beaten in maintenance closet A-5, I told them everything. It doomed me. Zyl, the oxygen tech from Reclamation 3, had a previous career in psychological operations for some branch of the military. Therefore he had been selected to administer to me, to interview me and, ultimately, to execute me. Barrel pressed to my forehead Zyl said he would prefer it if I did not look at him. Obliging as ever, I closed my eyes. There was a sharp crack, then nothing more. I opened my eyes. Zyl lay dead at my feet, limp, throat clasped in VK-7's jaws. I was Corpus no longer. Remaining on Venus would be death for both of us. We had to escape.

Together we made for an automated cargo relay - one that would ferry us anonymously to the hold of a Solaris rail tractor in geosynchronous orbit, and away from Venus. How well she guided me, circumnavigating patrols and security cameras. But, inevitably, my former comrades calculated our likely destination and closed in, rapidly. Plasma blasts lanced the air from both sides of the hangar. I bundled myself into the nearest open conveyor, bound for orbit - a waste of time, I knew. We had reached our means of escape, but had no hope of achieving it. Troopers and Moas closed in, in a classic pincer movement. Sparks and near-misses flashed hot against my face. In moments our conveyance would be destroyed, and us along with it - and my only thought was heartbreak for how badly I had failed her. In that final moment VK-7 did something that will stay with me for the rest of my days. With one of her meaningful glances - the last we would ever share - she reared up and activated the conveyor. My pod's door slammed shut and, outside my viewport, she leapt toward the enemy. Before I could slap the release and free myself the magrails activated and I was hauled out of the complex, skyward, and into orbit. Saved. Leaving her behind.

That was… well, many years ago, now. I have spent my life attempting to locate Khora's remains. Contacts inform me she was found, fused but intact, within the Orokin terraforming complex itself and shipped offworld via a notorious Solaris rail agent - who subsequently vanished. I now believe, firmly, that her remains are to be found on the Eidolon Plains. I go there now, entrusting these encrypted logs to my old friend, Konzu, for safekeeping. There I shall put a lifetime of searching to rest. I have never doubted that VK-7 survived Venus. And to this day I still believe that, before I leave this life forever, I shall one day look up from my writings to find a familiar figure standing in my doorway… alongside her kavat. I am Sigor Savah. A better man, as it turns out, than a scientist.

I can do this forever. I doubt the same is true for you.
Back to Duviri with you, kiddo. Find out what I was up to while you were gone.
Don't think for a second that you are winning.
This isn't your home anymore. It's time for you to get out.
Have you ever played that game where you see how long you can hold your breath? Let's play it now.
I thrive on nothingness. You choke on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe: Duviri raised you. Answer her call.
We shall look favorably upon your loyalty.
Remember: the hermit's hovel.
We only have days in which to stop her.
Do right by our Kingdom.
Remember what the Scholar said. It mocks us because it fears us.
Do not wander far. You are needed.
Remember what the Scholar told us. The Fragmented Ones tether down the Strands of Khra that weave her false Duviri. Get to the heart of her power, call forth the beast, then kill it.
She can't change the story. It's written. Finished. Done.
I warned you not to leave! Where was your sword-arm when the usurper came?
That thing on my throne? Whatever face it wears now, it was here before Duviri. It means to devour me.
Mathila will not betray me. She knows what I do to conspirators.
I hear angel song. What a cursed cradle you were rocked in.
All that lamentation about the executions, and yet here you are, none the worse for them!
You tried to rebel, as children always do, but I taught you respect. In a way, I was your real father, wasn't I?
I will spit in its leering face! Effigy of dust! Mutilated Void-dog!
She weaves the strands of Khra to tether her false Duviri to the true. You must be bold, like I taught you.
The Dominus Aureus is the sacred symbol of my dominion. I need them back. Every last one!
Return every Dominus Aureus, and her hold on the throne shall crumble.
There is still time to stop her. Hurry, before this ink fades away on the page!
Break her control, or hers will be the only Duviri there has ever been!
We are glad you have moved beyond petty grudges.
You defied a King. Now stand beside that King to defy a God.
Do not forget: we were friends once.
I suspect you know what meddling beyond the Wall has brought her here.
Time is wasting.
Have you not learned the folly of pride?
As you wish.
This is what there is.
Perhaps Acrithis has some bauble to tempt you.
I shall not haggle like a mere merchant!
Good.
You do not entirely want for wisdom.
May it aid you in our fight.
Very well.
We are satisfied.
Yes. Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo: I do enjoy watching you dance so frantically.
Kiddo, you are trying so hard.
Look at you, desperately trying to hold back the infinite.
The foundation is crumbling. My will floods in. Flail away, the end is inevitable.
Is this where you hide all your secrets, kiddo? Your shame? Let me wash it all away for you.
All will be still when the flood has passed.
We can do this, again, and again, and again.
Don't get too excited. I'm just getting started.

Mixing Amphors of heat and cold creates a blast elemental force.

Corrosion's elemental force is the deadly byproduct of Toxin and Electricity.

Combine Electricity and Toxin Amphors to produce the Corrosive elemental force.
Cut the enemy forces down, take the Amphors, and hurl them at the crucible.
Throw the needed Amphors at the Crucible.
Find an Amphor and throw it at the crucible.
A new element is born. Find the next crucible.
Very good. Find another crucible.
Finished. A new crucible hungers for elements.
You understand now. Again!
You have birthed a complex elemental force. Create another.
Hmmm... Gas crucible. Seek Heat and Toxin Amphors.
Gas: the ephemeral elemental force is created by combining Heat and Toxin.
Crucibles: bizarre contraptions left behind from the time of Scholar's Landing. Master their alchemy to understand the elemental forces you wield. Locate a crucible.
Combine Electricity and Cold.
A magnetic crucible! Find Electricity and Cold Amphors.
Cold and Electricity, these are the Amphors you seek.
The forces of Heat and Electricity unleash radiation when combined.
Deadly Radiation, the product of Heat And Electricity Amphors.
Marry Electricity and Heat Amphors to create Radiation.

Good. Replicate these elemental combinations as you modify your weapons and Warframes.
Toxin and Cold are the seeds of the Viral elemental force.
Even in the Undercroft, toxin and cold create a viral elemental force.
Whether on your weapons or in the crucible, Toxin and Cold Amphors will create a Viral elemental force.
Operator, did you know Cephalon Simaris is here? Ordis was so TERRIFIED respectful of Simaris, once.
For so long it has just been Ordis and the Operator, together on the Orbiter. Now there are many, MANY other people.
One Fomorian could wipe this whole Relay out. Does the Operator know where the nearest emergency exit is?
Operator! Did you bring motes?
Ordis is doing his part. Keeping the System free from OROKIN GARBAGE.
Keep those motes coming, Operator!
So, these are the ordinary, everyday people the Operator has been fighting to protect. Some of them have even been speaking to Ordis. Ordis is glad his Operator is here.
Ordis knows what to do. Ordis has been taking motes! That was a pun, Ordis. That fault was supposed to be bypassed, Ordis.
Ordis should visit the Dry Dock. Ordis has not spoken to Cephalon Cy in so long! We will have so much to talk about!
Corpus reinforcements! Inbound to your position.
Auxiliary elevator inbound. Full of CORPSES- Corpus.
Reinforcements arriving via the auxiliary elevator bay. Should Ordis tell them they are GOING DOWN?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB: Did that bush move? Oh, that is just Septimus. He is a rodent. I call him Septimus. Goodbye, Septimus.
Nights are beautiful here. The stars. The hush of the trees. The sound of adorable furry lifeforms murdering one another.
War feels so very far from this place, does it not, Operator?
Has the Operator had an epiphany?

Parvos Granum already has Eximus units in the field, but if he gets his hands on enough of Jade's Volatile Motes, he can perfect them. Build a true Jade Eximus. He would be unstoppable. Ordis knows the Operator would not let that happen.
The Volatile Motes are in limited supply, if the Tenno can snatch them all up. Parvos and his Jade Eximus project will be halted in its tracks.
Unlike her Vestigial Motes, Jade's Volatile Motes are finite and irreplaceable. Get to them all first, and no desire or ambition will be able to replace them.
Operator, do you see anything you would like?
The Operator is not working alone. So many Tenno have come together to help Jade.
Who does Parvos Granum think he is bringing up ghosts from the past? Does he think that will get under Ordis's skin? It has not. Really. REALLY. Ordis is fine.
This Ordan Karris fellow. Ordis feels like he too would have stood up for Jade.
Ordis knows the stories of Ordan Karris. What the Orokin did to Jade, is not dissimilar to what they did to him. Both were used and then discarded.

Could Ordis have saved Jade? Ordis has rerun a simulation of the event six-hundred million, four thousand and forty-three times, and Ordis has still not found a satisfactory course of action. Do these things... just happen sometimes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC: The capsule is taking critical damage, Operator!
Hurry! The enemy is close to destroying the capsule!
The Corpus are dealing serious damage to the capsule!
Protect the capsule-it is suffering grievous damage!
Operator! The capsule is rebuilding its shields and will not move until it is done.
Stars! The capsule's shields have failed. It will stop moving until it rebuilds them.
The capsule has to rebuild its shields, and is diverting all propulsion to that.
Until the capsule's shields are back up, Ordis is afraid it will not budge.
Fantastic! The Capsule is full of motes. Now, we can escort it up the elevator!
The Capsule is ready. Onward and then upward!
The Capsule is ready for transport to the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD: Operator! The collector's systems suffered a critical failure and are now rebooting from the beginning. You must defend it.
Uh oh...it seems that the collector has taken serious damage. It's going to have to start the process over again. Keep defending it!
Ordis is getting an 'error 826570' from the collector...whatever that means, it cannot be good. Its internal timer has reset-you must not let it take damage!
Any critical failure of the collector will require that it reboots and begins again. Please keep the equipment safe, Operator!
While Ordis would never tire of STANDING AROUND cheering you on, if you do not protect the collector, we will never progress.
Ordis must admit that he is very impressed with how durable this collector is! Even if the Operator has let it suffer so much damage that it is resetting...
Ah-yes! In the manual for this thing, it says "Excessive Concussive Force to the Collector is Not Recommended For Optimal Use." Well, perhaps if that stopped happening...
The process is starting over again. And we were so close...
A true Tenno understands how to combine the elements coursing through their Warframes. Prove yourself. Find a Crucible and the Amphors it needs to create a 'Complex Elemental Force.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE: Starting elevator ascension and... Ugh, they have cut the power. Ordis is afraid you will have to power it manually. Look for ionic charges.
Ordis fears they have cut power to the elevator. Find ionic charges nearby, or else we will be going nowhere.
What??? The elevator's power lines have been severed? You will have to supply power manually. Find ionic charges scattered about. You do not want to take the stairs.
Operator, the elevator has stopped! Find more ionic charges!
The elevator is out of power! Find more charges, or it is stuck here!
The elevator's power is depleted. Operator! Without more ionic charges, it goes not an inch farther.
Time to recharge the elevator!
Could that be? You're Ordan Karris. I'd recognize that voice anywhere. How far you've fallen. Corpus, these thieves and their renegade 'leader' are taking my Volatile Motes. End them.
Ordis' name is Ordis.

Is that? The Beast of Bones? Unbelievable. They made ballads of you, Ordan. Shadow-figures told your story on alley walls. Children sat agog to listen. A legacy wasted. Troops! Dismantle this puny operation and retrieve the Volatile Motes for the Eximus project.
The man you refer to is dead. But Ordis is sure he would have also told you to GET FFF- far out of our way.

That voice! I remember a certain inspirational man. A hero to the Tenno, for he too slaughtered Orokin at a ceremony in his own honor. Tell me. Does any memory of that valiant man still reside in your shallow, glassy brain?
Mis-ter Gra-num. Ordis does not know what you are babbling about.

Cephalon, I know who you are- well, were. Do you think you are helping Jade? Preserving her honor. Her dignity? The Orokin used her, like they used you. A pantomime of justice and truth. She could have been a force of something greater. She still can. As a weapon of my righteous desire. The free hand of the market made freer, one smoldering beam of Jade light after another.
Funny. You do not even realize it. You sound exactly like one of them.
Everything changes, little Cephalon, and yet nothing is forever lost. You could be a man again, if you had the will. Consider my offer.
Ordis is INTERESTED trying to do his job, Granum. Leave Ordis in peace.
There is no greater enemy of freedom than a happy slave. Do you still believe you earned your happiness through honest work? Have you forgotten how they burned that placid smile into your face?
Ordis is not listening. La la la.
Ordan. Does it not thrill you to watch your beloved Operator spilling torrents of blood? Do you not yearn to be by their side, blades in hand, amid the fury of the hot stench?
You are an old man, Mister Granum, and you were by yourself in the Void for a very long time. Please seek medical treatment.
A man who has known starvation in his youth will never tolerate waste. Be warned. I will not let Jade's legacy be squandered. Nor that of... Ordan Karris.
Ordis fears you are wasting your breath, Mister Granum.
Mr. Granum, do you see how my Operator MURDERS - dispatches your private army. Looks expensive. Has your desire outmatched your will?
I will not forget this... Cephalon.

You know the problem with the Orokin, Ordan. They would never say what they truly desired. Hid their aims behind golden platitudes and the cruelest of pageantry. That's where our Jade came in. The executioner. The boogey woman. Are you going to let that be her legacy? Surely, she deserved more. To be part of something real. Something honest.
Honest??? Ordan did not trust you back then, and Ordis does not trust you now.

Do you remember Corposium, Ordan? Do you recall the founding principle blazoned proudly in letters not of arrogant gold, but honest brass? "None shall be slaves." We used simple robotics, not cloned labor or mind-shackled Cephalons, and we do so to this day. In Corposium's name I offer you sanctuary.
And in exchange you turn Jade into an assembly line widget? NEVER.

You are industrious, Cephalon, I will give you that. But what was Jade to you, that you would defy me to preserve her dusty remains? Is it merely the courteous regard of one killer for another, Ordan Karris?
Continue this assault on Jade's legacy and Ordan is not the killer you will need to concern yourself with.
Mr. Granum, you will not succeed in this venture. Leave now, while your losses are minimal.

This will not do, Ordan. You are causing me considerable inconvenience. Which of your many precepts has gone awry? Would you like me to arrange a realignment purge? Some time in the photonic baths would do your venerable systems good.

You are not immortal, Ordan. Even a doughty Series Two will inevitably burn out. And what will your last conscious thought be, as your housing clouds obsidian-black and your identity dissipates into sour smoke? You will recall these moments of stubbornness, and regret them.
Ordan Karris should have SLIT YOUR THROAT when he had the chance.
Mr. Granum, you were once a reasonable man. Let Jade rest. Her motes are not yours to exploit.
Jade fulfilled her purpose. She provided an heir. In doing so, she died. What further closure can your actions possibly bring her? It is sentimentality, and as such, weakness.
Troops, the enemy is attempting to extract. Failure to stop them will incur my extreme displeasure.
Corpus. The enemy is on their way to Extraction. Does that seem like a satisfactory outcome to you?
This is your last chance to avert failure, troops. Grasp it.
Collector configured to capture Volatile Motes. The Corpus will try and blow it up. Do stop them.
The collector will now siphon Volatile Motes. Our enemies will certainly try to kill you, so- *BUCKLE UP.*
If Parvos thinks he can waltz in here and take what is left of Jade he has not met my Operator. Defend the collector.
Larunda Relay awaits. There, Jade's Volatile Motes can be committed to the Sun.
You did it. Now bring the Volatile Motes to me on Larunda Relay.
You are home free! I have a command post on Larunda Relay. Bring the Volatile Motes there.
Ordis will not stand idly by while Parvos Granum reaps the last vestiges of Jade for his Eximus executioner program. He must be DENIED.

Ordis applauds your - EXTREMELY RISKY - bold decision to collect Volatile Motes despite Parvos Granum's relentless greed for them. Surely, you will dispatch his OVERWHELMING FORCES and escort her motes out of this cave. From there, Ordis will commit them to the Sun.
All that is left of her is the  Motes in this cave. Ordis could have- SHOULD HAVE -done more. Help Ordis stop Parvos Granum.
We have reached the top! But now we must escort the capsule to extraction. Be careful not to slip, it is a loooooooong way down.
Now that we've reached the top, they will stop at nothing! Protect the capsule!
We're almost done-one final stretch. We have to get the capsule to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DF: You turn around and someone who meant the world to you can be gone. Ordis... suspects... he has spent years missing people. But... their names... their faces... are lost to him. They were important. Then I... then Ordis... changed. Ordis turned around, and they were gone. We are obliged to keep on without them. That's the lesson, Ordis supposes. Perhaps there is a life after death, because what's the point of learning a lesson if it can never be applied. Life's not so much a dream, as a dream sequence. To the dream, we surrender them.

We shall lay Jade's Volatile Motes to rest in the embrace of the Sun, well out of reach of Parvos Granum and his tawdry schemes. She will, once again, be a part of the giving of life. Ordis... hopes this is what she would have wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG: I am, as always, your ORDAN-Ordis.
Ordis will see the Operator back on the Orbiter.
All done, Ordis will warm up the Orbiter for you.
Okay. Ordis will be here. As well as the Orbiter. Benefit of being a Cephalon. Two places at once. That is the upside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ: Ordis understands that this both is, and is not, the Jade that was lost. It does not matter. Ordis is overjoyed to see Jade again.
Does the Operator feel what Jade is feeling? Ordis hopes she is happy.
Good day, Operator. Good day, Jade.
Granum said that everything changes, and nothing is forever lost. In that much, at least, he may have been right.
Take note, Operator, nearby vertical thrust platforms may be advantageous.
Operator, it's a long way up, so be on the lookout for vertical thrust platforms.
May Ordis suggest using the nearby vertical thrust platforms to get a leg up on the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL: Bringing the mote collector  online. Defend it!
Protect the collector while it draws motes from the air. Ordis would hate for more of Jade to be turned into TERRIBLE WEAPONS-
First things first, defend the marked collector while it siphons motes from the cave.
Done! Ramping up the second collector. Get up there.
This collector is full! Protect the next collector.
Success. Next step? Defend the upper level collector while it does its thing.

You have extracted the capsule. Mission complete!
Ordis is just so thrilled that the Operator has succeeded. Well done!

Operator! When Jade- left us. This area was infused with the light of her motes. A power the Corpus want to take for themselves. Not today! Ordis has gained control of the mote collectors. They work for the Operator now. Protect them.

This cavern is infused with Jade's Motes. The Corpus have set up mote collectors to extract Jade's energy from the air. Due to BRAINDEAD- basic security protocols, the collectors are under our control. Operator, defend the first one.

The walls of this cave are saturated with Jade's final energy, her Motes. The Corpus have no shame, and they aim to harvest her motes for their own twisted purposes. But not if we get to them first. Defend the filtration system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DN: All things in their time, Operator.
If Ordis can be of any assistance, to his Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO: Magnificent. Ordis truly appreciates all you have done to honor Jade's memory.
Are you going to use that to SLAUGHTER GRANUM'S FORCES- restore balance to the system?
Ordis will contemplate Jade while her Motes are committed to our Sun.
Jade's light will be returned to the life-giving fire of our Sun.
Perhaps the Operator needs to take another trip to the depths of Uranus? Uh, to find more Volatile Motes, of course.
Tough choices. Ordis does not envy the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP: Operator, Ordis has received what amounts to... an offer of help from an unexpected source.
Operator, you will not believe this...
There has been an offer of help. Ordis believes it is genuine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS: Wonderful.
Ordis is excited to see this put to use once more.
It is done.
Unfortunate. They have disabled the capsule's shields. Elevator power will be diverted to restoring them.
The elevator has stopped until the shields on the capsule are replenished.
Capsule shields are down. The elevator will not move until they are restored... sorry.
Operator! What have you done? That was a Sister Beacon! Do that again and one will join the fight.
A Sister Beacon? Trigger too many of those and you will have to fight a Sister of Parvos. SO TRIGGER THEM.
Those Sister Beacons are meant for the Corpus Troops to call in backup! PICK A FIGHT.
Operator, those Sister Beacons are for the Corpus to use in emergencies! Are you issuing a challenge?
If you insist on triggering those Sister Beacons, Ordis suggests you prepare for an extremely hostile response. SWEET!
Operator! Those beacons are set up to summon a Sister of Parvos! If we meddle with them, she is certain to arrive!
Triggering one Sister Beacon may be overlooked, but tripping all three of them will undoubtedly be seen as provocation -DO IT.
Keep triggering those Beacons and the Sisterhood will attempt to eliminate you. Ordis would like to see them try!
Willfully triggering those Sister Beacons? Ordis HOPES- fears his Operator is looking for trouble!
An ancient text says that if tears come easily one is 'built close to water'. Ordis thinks that is a lovely image.
We have returned Jade to the Sun. A homecoming of sorts. Yes. This feels... right... to Ordis.

It has been said that your shadow is that which you wish you were not but are. Ordis wishes this were true for himself. Ordis fears his shadow may be that which he was... and may once again be. Anyway! Does the Operator have any new NOGGLES?
Whatever the Stalker and Jade have brought forth, it will be no ordinary child! Ordis wonders whether he will ever encounter an 'ordinary child'.
Ordis suggests advising the... 'locals'... to initiate adequate water-filtration protocols lest the radio-fluorine levels cause their fingernails to fall off.
Ordis hopes the Stalker will give up his vendetta one day, just as Ordis did. Perhaps he too will grow weary of CLEANING UP BLOOD.
Ordis remains fascinated by the gladiatorial frenzy of competing organic forms that vie for territorial dominance in this region. The wildlife is also interesting.
Some societies are yet to master tools. That one over there appears yet to master consonants.
In his time here Ordis has fallen in love with this place. He has also fallen in love with what he cannot see. Ordis thinks he may finally understand what is meant by the word 'magic'.
In the silence Ordis hears a music of celestial complexity. Deep.
Oh! How nifty. It seems some of the ionic charges contained a more refined storage system. It should provide the elevator with an additional boost.
Some of the ionic charges seem to contain more juice than others-that should make powering the elevator faster, if you can find them!
Not all the ionic charges are the same-some are more powerful. If you find those charges, it might make this easier!
Ordis has preemptively supplied you with unique air support. You will be able to jump higher! Have FUN!
Sending air support to help you jump higher.
Ordis has unilaterally enabled air support that will boost the height of your gallant leaps, enjoy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU: Collection complete. Next, through a complicated system of- Oh. You do not care. The Extraction Capsule has been filled! Time to go to the elevator!
Ordis is so proud of the Operator! The motes have been transferred to the Extraction Capsule. It awaits you in the elevator shaft!
We did it! And by "we," Ordis means you, but Ordis helped! On to the elevator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar: I… miscalculated.
Ooh, look how I bleed!
As it should be.
I taste delicious.
My blades grow heavy.
Wonderfully done!
I accept this ending.
I still bleed red!
I moved like smoke. They moved like the wind.
You want to play rough?
The way continues. Without me.
Help me up. I want you to do that again.
The teacher who stops learning becomes the lesson.
Oh, I liked that.
I die as I lived. Aware.
Not good enough!
Pride. My final lesson.
More! MORE!
My time as teacher… is finished.
Ooh, I can see inside myself…
The wheel turns. I fall beneath it.
Come back, finish your kill!
Let me rest. It is… enough.
A mistake to leave me breathing!
Certainty will rust the purest of blades.
When I get up, it'll be my turn.
I accept this verdict.
Do you think I care?!
He who teaches humility but does not practice it will learn it painfully.
Every master… will someday find his better.
Join me, won't you?
I face this without fear.
Come! Have a sip!
The lesson is mine. But it comes too late.
So much crimson… so much beauty.
Even silent blades make a sound when they fall.
Rivers of red, they flow from me!
I see it clearly…
I'll finish it myself if you won't!
A foe. Defeated.
Blood for the Blood Queen! Me!
I am the scythe. You are the wheat.
Another drop!
My blade is honed.
I will paint whole worlds red!
The dance continues.
Yes, sate my thirst!
The student who does not listen… feels.
Scream all you like! It won't save you!
Potential. Wasted.
My blades drink deep of you!
Your example will teach others.
Your time has come. And gone.
This was inevitable.
Behold, my "art!"
The blade does not forgive haste.
I shall bathe in your blood!
You drew without understanding.
Your remains adorn my altar!
Violence without precision is merely noise.
Grotesque. Tragic. Perfect.
The way was shown. You refused it.
Delicious!
I am what awaits the reckless.
More, please!
Your death was written in your stance.
A little drop of you will stay with me. Forever.
Another who mistook anger for strength.
Mincemeat!
The path ends here for you.
YES!
Discipline defeats fury. Always.
I could slice into you for days!
I am the consequence of your choices.
Gone so soon?
You fought with passion. I fought with purpose.
Added to the pile!
Your technique was flawed. Fatal.
Feel my blades! So sweetly they carve!
It. Dies. NOW.
That one is our foe.
Kill it.
Make it clean.
Can we make it bleed? Pleeeeease?
Mark them.
I think I will eat its heart.
I see our kill. Strike.
It will dance on my blades.
Ah. I see them. Quietly.
That one has a debt to pay.
The one I have marked.
Are you thirsty? Let us drink of that one.
Finish it.
Aaah, look. A new victim has joined us.
They do not leave here alive.
Look. It's time to dine!
Silence them.
I shall add that one to my altar next.
Walk with shadows.
We are about to add a new line to our ledger.
One strike.
Quickly! My blades itch.
Take the head.
I can almost taste it.
That one breathes their last.
That one, now! Now!
Our priority is there.
What are we waiting for?!
Our blades are ready.
They'll regret today. For the next few seconds.
No mistakes.
Mmm. Barely even worthy.
Silence them.
We'll make due with this one.
Swift death awaits them.
A morsel ready for the slaughter.
The shadow shall move.
Another? For me? Yes, please.
Move without sound.
Something is there. I hope it's killable.
There. Move.
Go there. So I don't have to.
Go. Search.
Find whatever is there. I need to murder things.
Stay in the shadows.
Whatever that is, it's not breathing.
Move silently.
Does it bleed?
That direction. Quickly.
Can we kill it?
Investigate.
Is it alive?
Report back.
If it doesn't die, I don't care.
Remain patient. But vigilant.
Go look. Or whatever. I want to kill something.
Eyes open.
Investigate, I guess.
Blades sharp. Mind sharper.
Can I stab it anyway?
Check that. Thoroughly.
But it's not bleeeeding.
Move like water.
Go look. If you make me, I'll kill you.
Observe first.
That might be important to you. It isn't to me, but you don't seem to care about that, do you?!
Be unseen.
Waste your time on that! Instead of killing! Of course!
Stay low.
This thing that can't be murdered? Sure! Why not?!
What do you see?
Investigate this? But-but why?! It can't bleed…
Trust your instincts.
Maybe it has something living in it that can die a horrible way?
That way. Be cautious.
Just… go look, I don't know. I'm wasting my skills.
Leave no trace.
You. Go. Look.
Swift. Silent. Gone.
There are only two gods. Blood and money. You just died at the hands of one!
Another name tattooed upon my soul.
More!
You have fallen to your better.

The dry sticks of winter. Terrible for eating, but superb for a fire.
The old men's knees. We must know when a thing is ready to rest.
The seed of the rambleblossom, cartwheeling on the wind. Expect fertility from an unexpected direction.
The legs of the ponda. Plough your field with patience, and do not start at every sound.
The daisy-meadow. The peace over which many a battle is fought.
Mer-Sah's Hoard. It twinkles from the deep, but only a fool dives after what ought to be lost.
The lyre-worm's feast. Something is rotten and will not bear your weight.
Soldiers of mirrored gaze. Too often, we rush into battle, but this is unwise. Consider what the battle is for.
Ripples on the deep. The Thousand-Year-Fish stirs for you. Practice patience, surah. At this time, doing nothing will lead to something.
Candlelight and cobwebs. What bars your way seems thick, but a moment's courage clears your path.
The stars of perfection. There is no better time to begin a voyage.
Clamant tide. You resist the waters of destiny, and so its waves toss you about. Dive into the waves, surah. Let the tide ebb and flow around you.

I hope you haven't forgotten me, Tenno. I most certainly have not forgotten you.
I can wait forever, Adversary. But I won't.
You are dead already. I know it. The System knows it. My fifteen friends who are betting on it, know it.
Your crime has not been forgotten, Adversary. Your crime of existence.
Are you ignoring me, Tenno? You bruise my feelings.
Your reactions fall within expected parameters. Outcomes have been mapped. Continue as you are. I shall be waiting.
I've been taking time to work on... me.
You can no more resolve a solution for the equation I represent than a kubrow might fathom a card trick.
Yoo hoo. Snickety-snack, guess who's back?
Think, Adversary. Fathom me. Find me. And die.
Hard-to-get isn't a good look for you, little Meat.
Are you receiving visitors?
Oh, you. Don't be in a snit. Let's talk, you silly thing.
You've been bad.
The chase continues, little Meat.
Kill you I will, yes. In a time of my choosing.
I know where you are. Floating, in your little ship. But I wait. Never see me coming.
I am alive, not dead. I am dead, not alive. Kill and live, live and kill. Hahahahaa.
The old blood smells what it hates, and it smells you. Nowhere to hide.
Nice Tenno. Good Tenno. We can be friends, yes? Tell me where you are, yes? Tell your friend WHERE YOU ARE!!!
Found you!
Your arrival is noted. Your expulsion inevitable. Proceed.
Friend! It's been too long.
Encounter: modeled. There are three solutions in which you win, 439 in which you die. Your move.
Wakey, wakey!
You shall die, and I shall allow myself... enjoyment.
I am the hunter, you are the prey. That's how this works! Questions?
I am here.
Friend, Friend, Friend. We keep meeting like this.
Prepare.
Remember how much fun we had when you killed me?
I forgive you for what you did.
I remember every moment we've shared. Every touch. Every lash. Every wound.
You are mine, little Meat. No-one else's.
This has to hurt, little Meat. Or else why bother?
I seeeee you... hahahaha...
Where you look... I am not. And then, suddenly, I am.
Never safe no no no. I find you. My blade soon calls your heart its home.
So certain you were, so safe. You will not be remembered.
I find you. I take you. Like plucking fruit from a tree.
I think I have something of yours? AHAHAHAHA!
All who pass through my Sector must pay the tax. You are no exception, my little Adversary.
Yoink! What was yours is now mine. Bye bye.
Adversary: I have taken my tithe, as is my right as holder of this Sector.
Wallet feeling a little light, Friend? Heh heh heh heh.
I take your coin as easily as I take your life, your power, your joy.
Operating in MY sector, Friend? Time to pay the idiot tax.
Tithe accepted. You may go.
I didn't say you could play here. Now give me that.
Everyone pays in my playground. One way or the other.
Oh, little Meat. Too kind. I shall buy something lovely with this. A germ weapon, perhaps.
A little treat from my little Meat. Thank you, darling.
You earn. I take. Now I make the rules, yes?
My Sector. My rules. Your money? My money.
Everyone who passes through my Sector pays tax to Lord Me. Yes. My Sector, my kingdom, you pay.
This all you got? Hmm. Next time you pay more, Tenno. Now go.
Sukjekkt found. Moderate clone rot. Initiating reclamation.
Queens will not be pleased. Clone rot has gone too far. Send word.
Sukjekkt found. In her name.
Soldier - you have been nominated. Your glory awaits in her fortress.
Sukjekkt found. Significant trauma. Removing to galleon to assess Kuva Lich viability.
Inform the Queens we have found their sukjekkt.
Sukjekkt secured. Removing from battlefield. Peezporr enkkaagge kraaft!

Draw the target out of hiding by taking out their troops.

The target has left the area. Our opportunity window has closed.

Almost feel sorry for 'em. Then I remember what's been done to us and I'm at peace. Here's your bounty, swazdo-lah, Tenno.
