Good work mate, doubt them gib-faced buffoons got anywhere close to the amount of Syzygy they needed.
Looks like foraging season is over. A bountiful harvest for you means slim pickings for them. Good.
Got a hunch that a few Syzygy are about to fruit nearby. Find em'. Then stay close while keeping the merks away.
The Syzygy blooms for minutes, releases its energy and then dies. Get close to 'em and capture their energy before the taxmen get anywhere near.
For the love of... Just heard the merk-merks are foraging for Syzygy. You got to get to them first. When you do, stay close til they're done blooming.
'Nother cluster of Syzygy blooming. You know what to do.
More fungi ready for ya'. Get that energy before the merks do.
More about to bloom. Don't let the Taxmen pluck 'em first.
Don't listen to that trash, mate. Corporate just wants a little fungal remediation, is'all. Get in. Get out. Get paid. Easy credits.
Right? Something messing with our gear? Sure you ain't been snacking on these mushrooms, mate?
Job sure would be easier if these mushrooms weren't so mucking pretty to look at.
Watch the spores! Get back to the airlock you MUCKERS! Run! What the hell is that??
Hey. For Sol's sake who let a mucking kid down here? Hey! Get back here. Stop mucking about with our gear.
You little mucker. You dumped me muckin' accelerant. Huh, smart little mucker.
No corporate. No co. Nokko. I'm gonna call you Nokko.
All this fungi… I swear it's filtering the waste from the towers. You take the fungi away and Venus goes all fire and brimstone.
It has come to my attention that some Solaris are refusing work orders in the deepmines. Such insubordination will be dealt with swiftly.
No. Mr. Anyo, sir! I will not comply. I'm shutting down the elevator. Nothing more goes up and nothing more comes down.
Well look at you, Nokko. You ain't some leftover freak that some Orokin mucker made in a lab. Don't know how or why, but somewhere along the line you became the roots and fruits.
I should have never sent Solaris to do the job of Corpus.
Nokko! They're coming.
I'm blowing the mineshaft. No more coming in. No more getting out.
Just you and me now, kid.
Okay. Nokko. Your garden is safe.
(Happy noises)
It's getting dark, Nokko. I don't think I can help you much longer.
(Sad Nokko noises)
Goodbye, Nokko.
(Warm low sigh)

You're trying to tell me, that I, good old Nightcap, died down here ages ago? Haha. You better be careful, The Prince can play tricks on you. He's a funny fella, just like Nokko. But you gotta keep your head on straight. Trust me, you ain't careful, this place will turn you all sorts funny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN: Ohhhh. Look at that, mate. That's a prime sample, that is.
Whoa. I haven't seen one of these since. Since… Well, since a long time.
Doesn't get any better than that, now does it.
Oh, you're making me jealous mate. Out there in wild, fingers in the soil, just seeing what you can find. I'd be out there too if it wasn't for corporate messing the whole thing up.

Dreamers. Ever think about what lives below the surface? An entire universe that we step on everyday. Quietly toiling away, making life above possible. Until some bigwig with a plan says, 'sterilize this filth.' Well, Dreamers, that's exactly what's about to happen in the Deepmines below Fortuna. Unless somebody drops in to help.
There's a buzz in Fortuna. Something's changing. Something's growing. In the basement below the basement. And that something is calling out for help.

You ever wonder, who speaks for the dirt? For the untold millions of organisms living beneath your feet? Mushrooms, fungus, microbiota? The creatures that keep the circle of life turning. Nowhere is that life more fragile than the Orb Vallis. That's where I'm hearing it from. A voice in the darkness calling for backup. Dreamers. Are you going to answer that call?

Hearing strange reports from Fortuna, Dreamers. Mushrooms sprouting where they've never sprouted before. In the walls, the machines, in the toxic wastes. They say they're hearing something coming from the vents that lead down to the old decommissioned Deepmines and it sounds like laughter.

Mushrooms. Some can kill you, others make a great salad, and still others, they can spread your mind out until you're not sure where you end and where the universe begins. But not everyone respects their local fungi, Nef Anyo has called for their eradication from the Deepmines below Fortuna so he can build his Palace of Prosperity. If you ask me, someone needs to head down there to show Nef where to shove his new palace.

Nora here, Dreamers, and tonight we're truly hearing from the underground. Down below the Vallis lies a deep, deep mine, and down in that mine live some special little guys doing no harm to nobody. Enter a certain tinpot hemorrhoid by the name of Nef Anyo. He wants to build a shining Palace of Prosperity in that dark, damp garden. No regard at all for the folks who have roots down there. You gonna stand for that, Dreamers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP: Dull Button? Good in soup and that's about it.
You chose a Dull Button. They have a flavor, if you boil 'em long enough.
You let them do what? Tenno, I will find you. Mark my words.
You cannot stop progress. I will sterilize this cesspool.
Who is this… "Nightcap"? He's not on any work lists or debt ledgers. Find him and end him.
Tenno, you used to protect the Orokin Seven, now you fight for this… festering scum. How far you've fallen.
Corpus. You can't even conquer a hole in the ground? What am I paying you for?
What is with these Tenno and their obsession with promoting weakness?
You think you've won today, Tenno? My resources are bottomless. I will spend you to death.
Mess with my operations again. I dare you.
Do I not deserve a space where I can be safe, Tenno? Your Lotus hid the moon in the Void for you, and you won't let me have this? Shame.
By the Void, Tenno. Why are you so scared of a great man doing great things? I pity you.
Thorn tooth? Things might get a little prickly.
A Thorn tooth is the fruit you want when you're looking to make a pincushion outta someone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR: Oh mate. You ate a Gamma Berry didn't ya? Oh well, little radiation never hurt no one.
Ah, a Gamma Berry? Mutations should be temporary, 'least I think.
Those Virmink couldn't have had a better protector than you. Not a scratch on 'em.
Walk in the park. Those critters almost looked like they were having fun.
Totally unharmed. Nokko would be proud of that effort, he would.
Nef's captured some Vallis animals, some nonsense about a zoo for his new palace. Get 'em out and escort the beasties to safety.
Nef's taken some top-side critters hostage. Free those Virmink, and see that they get out safe.
Gib-faced muckers are kidnapping Vallis animals for some sort of zoo? Cut 'em loose.
Safe and sound back in the Vallis wilderness. Nicely done.
Good work. Just like Nokko would'a done.
Roam free, fluffballs.
You really legged it out there.
Proper jailbreak that was.
Done already? You been drinking your go go juice. Don't stop now.
I'd say that lucky mucker owes you but I don't think they need anymore debt. Let's just call that a freebie.
You piked 'em right out of there. We got more work coming.
One less repo on Nef's ledgers. Let's keep going.
Taxmen just arrested a topside worker for debt crimes. Let's cut that chap a break and set 'em free.
Word is, Nef's got a Solaris locked up down here for heavy debt. Let's pop 'em free before their tinker winds up on a shelf.
Fruits and roots tell me there's a rig jockey in a cage around here. Got time for a little jailbreak?
Sprodling's secured. What a relief! Now that that's taken care of, let's see what other Corpus nonsense we can spoil.
Don't worry little fellas, you're safe now. Okay. Next order of business.
You're safe little Sprodlings, but no more playing round the merks, you hear me? Gotta be tough on the little ones, for their own good, you know?
Good as the day they sprouted. Bounce on little ones.
I thought for sure they were done for, can't thank you enough Tenno.
Look at them bouncing around like they never got kidnapped by an army of morally corrupt mercenaries. Good on yah.
Who puts Sprodlings in cages? Mucking Nef and his band of morally compromised geneticists, that's who. Crack 'em free, will ya?
Red alert. Nef's goons have captured some Sprodlings. I'm not saying they're gonna put them in the juicer, but if you rescue them first, they won't have a chance.
Taxmen have gone and nabbed a few of me favorite Sprodlings. Let's rectify that, shall we?
Couldn't even blink before you healed 'em all. Mighty impressive.
The Sprodlings are bouncing back to health in record time. Here's hoping they're more careful about what they eat next time.
You're quicker than you look, mate. Sprodlings would hate to play ya in hide and seek, that's for sure.
That's all of 'em. Here's hoping they can stay safe.
You got all the Sprodlings hopping again. That's good to see.
All me Sprodlings are back where they belong. Now let's see if we can hit back at Nef.
Word in the garden is that a few of Nokko's Sprodlings got into Nef's fungicide. Need you to find 'em and give the jolt of life.
Nokko's little Sprodlings help in keepin' me garden safe but Nef's poison has been taking its toll. Find those tykes and nurse 'em back to health.
Ah, this one, this task's important. Nef's poison water is making the Sprodlings sick. Need you to find them and get them jumping again.
Happy? Now get back to gardening.
Off they go.
Think that one liked you.
I reckon' our little prince there is a bit famished. He'd love some fergolyte, if you got some.
Hear that? Guess you don't. Our prince is telling you he's hungry again.
I think The Prince is ready for some more Fergolyte if you can get your mitts on some.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS: Good hustle. That's the last of the energy cells AND merk-merks. Ah, Nokko, would be proud of you, he would.
Just like the old days with Nokko. Reckon that hurt the bottom line almost as much as it hurt them.
Without power down here taxmen'll be working double time to keep Nef happy. Let's see if we can't make things worse for 'em.
Corporate only cares for their bottom line, and what you just broke? Looked proper expensive. Fancy some more mischief?
Muckers'll have a hard time hurtin' the roots and fruits in the dark.
Corporate can't operate down here without energy, just like the Vallis can't do without the roots and fruits. Here's hoping they realize that eventually.
There they are. Lazy as usual. You know what to do.
Found 'em? Time to cause some damage.
Cells are in your neighborhood, looks like. Scuttle 'em.

I'm in awe, mate. See if you can make the next job look that easy.
Taxmen keeping their supplies out in the open. They should be more careful. Someone might take 'em. Right?

Corpus rank and file ain't the sharpest, but keeping supplies unguarded? Teach 'em to take better care of their things.

Coolant waste. Industrial waste. People waste. You name it, I've got fungi that'll be more than happy to gobble it up for ya.
Who does this Nef fella' think he is? Coming to the Vallis pretending he alone can make it green when the roots and fruits have been doing that work since time immemorial.

So, what's with the get'up, is it Naberus or something?
Mushrooms. Some's good for you. Some's bad. Some's somewhere in between.

That Nef Anyo bloke's trying to sham some sort of glow-up for the deepmines. Deepmines are doing just fine.
You find it bright in here?
Hey, who's this Narmer I keep hearing about? Sounds like a bunch of gib-faced dung muckers to me.
Sometimes, it feels like I've been down here forever.

I do miss the surface. Wonder what Fortuna's gonna look like when they finish construction.
So, ready to do some gardening?
Felt like, for a while, that Nef was going to leave me garden alone. Then that mucker comes mucking around again. Good thing I got you to help.
You'll look for Nokko when you're out there, right?
Busy day in the garden. Lots of jobs. You finish one, come back, I got more.
Fruits and roots can usually take care of themselves, but against these invasives? For that they need some help.
So, Nef wants to build some sort of 'Palace of Prosperity' down here? What in the life-giving dirt does that mean? The deepmines is already a palace for the roots and fruits.
Deepmines is a community. Organisms living for each other. Don't reckon we're gonna let one mucker ruin that so he can sit down here by his lonesome.
Yeah, I got a bit of work for you. Head down to the Deepmines.
Just get outta bed? The garden's buzzing, mate. Let's get doing.
If you see Nokko out there, you give him my regards.
Okay, let's stop wasting time.
We are way past due to get these jobs done. Chop, chop.
No biggie. Not everyone's cut out for a hard day's work, I suppose.
You sure? Fruits and roots could really use your help.
Suit yourself. Got all sorts of jobs waiting for you should you change your mind.

Some say some of the more peculiar looking fruits can widen your thinker. Don't work nothing for me… but if it works for you, a bit of advice: You make your mind go wide? Be wary of who you let put ideas in it. A wide mind is a trusting mind, and not all muckers can be trusted.
Each species is like a person. It's up to you to come to know them all. What do they like? What don't they like? How do they help each other? Help you? And maybe most of all, how can you help them?
Taught me'self how to draw making this guide. Got pretty good if I do say so me'self.
The… uh… The fruits and roots… You… uh… You don't hear 'em in your head too, do yah? Just checking.
You got your fruits, above ground. And your roots, below ground. The fruits is the pretty part. The roots though, that's where the magic is.
Talkin' mushrooms? Well, sorta. They don't talk to me like, 'oi, mate let's grab a drinkie'. I still got my marbles. But if you look, and listen close? They got something to say and I can hear it.
When I first got sent down here corporate told me the fungal colony was some Orokin mess. Escaped from a lab and all that. But I don't know, the roots and fruits, they feel older than that.

The mistake some muckers make is thinking they're the only mucker in existence. Roots and fruits know more about each other than they do about themselves. You wanna survive down here? You gotta come to know the roots and fruits. I used to keep a field-guide, collected all sorts of info. Got destroyed the last time corporate got all spicy down here. You help me build it back up? I can help you come to know them all.
If you see Nokko out there, give 'em me best.
Right then.

Always here if you need me.
Take care.

Anytime.

You'll do just fine.

When corporate doesn't listen. We make 'em listen. Right?
Say, you wanna talk gardening… foraging… outfitting. You come to the right place, mate.
All of the deepmines, that's me garden. And you, you're me gardener.
Can't let invasive pests into your garden, 'cause your garden, it ain't got no line of defense against them. 'Cept you.
The longer I'm down here, the less I want to go back up.
Sure, I can leave, just don't wanna. Feel rooted to this place, I do.
Everything here's been collected in the Deepmines.
Take what you need, leave what you don't.
Yeah, I suppose I'd be up for a trade? See anything you need?
'Appreciate you keeping my, y'know, existence on the hush hush. Don't know exactly what dosh I owe, but imagine it's quite the sum, what with the miracle of compound interest and all.
You keep this between you and I, yeah? No need to let the taxman know we've been exchanging goods.
This is what I got. All things I've thought could come in handy at some point.
You've been fighting for the fruits and roots, so I'll let you share in their bounty.
So, you ever seen a tree? Never had the fortune to me'self. But I reckon I'd like to come to know a tree someday.
It's all good.
Maybe next time.
Good on you. Don't buy anything you don't need.
Aye. This'll help me, yeah. Been a spell since the last payday.
Ah. I'll be putting this toward me debt.
That's what I would'a picked.
Violet's Bane?? You must not like these muckers.
A Violet's Bane? That's enough to make someone sick.
You need to sit down? You look a bit wobbly.
So… Learn anything? Or is that all nonsense?
Like I said, nothing to it. Now, you wanna get back out to the garden?

Oh. You took a Nonono? Try to stay away from those me'self.

The amp: your primary tool in control and defeat of the Eidolons. The stylus with which you shall inscribe your name in the pages of future history.

Time is relative. Choose when ready.
I see permutations tumbling, resolving behind your eyes. Beneath your skin. Exquisite.

Once, long ago, I would look backwards, feeling for the fading tendrils of our might-have-beens. But those avenues are closed now. Too far gone. Instead I comfort myself with the music of the universe… and the sense of her close by. Her choices brush against me, like the arm of a passing stranger, and I am… happy.

A bold reaching toward consequence. How shall this be remembered?

No effect without a cause. No reward without an earning. No name without a legacy. Return once the amp has proven itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI: You are an instrument most perfect, Tenno^ tuned to the pitch of the Unum.

That device is insufficient. You are directed to secure and employ additional Eidolon lures.
Energy spike. I advise falling back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkoSt: Allow us to improve your efficiency.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun: Listen. The territorial voicing of the Condroc: carrion-eater and opportunistic scavenger.

The Kuaka. The elder cousin of the Vallis Pobber, but unlike that herbivorous rodent the Kuaka possesses an irritable temperament and will eat almost anything. But, precisely as its cousin, the Kuaka will bolt at the first hint of danger.

The Mergoo. An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and by large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.

A Vasca Kavat. An invasive, nocturnal species carrying the symbiotic Vasca virus. They are stealthy, and extremely aggressive. Be careful. And one last thing: should any kavat companions be… bitten… you should secure an antidote quickly. Good luck.
Hunter, this particular Bau is close to going full Nephil. A timely catch.
Look at the fight in this one. The viral load in its veins must be immense. I'll prepare a double-dose of curative.
How many animals have been drained by this Bau? How many nests and lairs wiped out? Still, we cure and persevere.
A weak little Ostia no more, are you? Well, before the week is out you'll be back to being a regular kavat - and happier for it I'm sure.
I do love kavats. I hate what this loathsome virus makes of them. I'll be glad to cure this Bau, and find them a more suitable home.
A common Condroc. Carrion makes up nearly the entirety of their diet.
The Common Condroc could never be called glamorous, but their role is a necessary one.
They've learned not to scavenge Grineer camps, but fisher-folk still take potshots at them.
Scavengers prevent the spread of disease and pathogens. The Business is wise to collect them… but why? Surely he could not be populating some far-away Moh of his own?
Traditional Ostron hunters and bridge wardens still use the feathers of the Condroc as fletching for their arrows.
A rare Emperor Condroc. Note the warm golden plumage. Hear that robust call.
This rare Emperor Condroc would be the leader of several Condroc committees. What could have lured them away from their aerie? No matter. This is our good fortune.
The Emperor Condroc. A rare sight. You must not miss this opportunity, Tenno. Should it take flight, it will retreat to its aerie and be lost to us.
A Rogue Condroc. Scavenging ways abandoned, this one prefers fresh meat and hunts it. Unusual behavior for a Condroc, but not unheard of.
A loner. Extra effort will be made to re-socialize them.
A group of Condrocs are known as a committee. This one has no time for such things.
Rogues often wipe out entire colonies of Kuaka and even Mergoo. The Condroc's role is that of scavenger. The Rogue has lost its purpose. It would be better to… no? I could… Very well.
The stomach acid of the Condroc is useful as a powerful antiseptic. Perhaps you have need? No? Very well.
Female.
Note the pale coat, indicative of a subspecies that spends most of its time belowground.
An Ashen Kuaka. They don't like the light. Let's move this along.
An efficient ratter, the Ashen Kuaka. Very helpful in controlling introduced pests.
The Ashen Kuaka makes for good eating, Tenno, but if preservation is your mission so be it.
A rare pleasure, my little friend.
Note the superficial similarities to the Ashen Kuaka, but this specimen's eyesight and digestive tract have evolved to serve a rodent that almost never visits the surface world.

The Ghost Kuaka are birthed in collectives far, far belowground. There they live on grubs and roots. This may be their first visit to the surface. I will do what I can to make the experience a pleasant one.
A Plains Kuaka. Nature's janitor. Slow-roasted and paired with hot chimurr is a personal favorite.
A foul-tempered omnivore - but key to maintaining ecosystemic balance.
Population levels of the Plains Kuaka are in no danger of dipping, and this one's services are required elsewhere. So, off they go.
Another Kuaka. You are aware the female of the species becomes fertile immediately after giving birth, yes?
I once knew a hunter who, in dire straits, walked many days using two of these animals as shoes.
Properly skinned and sewn a Kuaka can make for a useful improvised waterskin.
Male.
A Coastal Mergoo. Fisher-folk honor them.
Ah, these little ones do make me laugh.
The Coastal Mergoo. Perhaps the most common seabird in these parts.
Mergoo flocks deprive smaller mammals of nourishment. I am content to remove a few; however you see fit.
Note its grasping foreclaws. Mergoo will often swoop in, clutch some small target and fly off before anyone's the wiser.
I've seen Grineer troopers divert from objectives to hunt and kill these particular specimens. For the plumage. Very hard to find these days.
A Splendid Mergoo! Lords and ladies of the nest these ones. Highly prized mates, for obvious reasons.
It is well you have saved this one. Populations of Splendid Mergoo have been in sharp decline since the arrival of the Grineer.
I'll note the area, keep an eye out for the nest.
Mergoo, woodland plumage. Perhaps the adaptation is an attempt to elude the Grineer.
I've often seen a Woodland Mergoo dart from foliage to zap an insect from the air. Cunning.
Should you find yourself lost and starving, watch the Woodland Mergoo. They often know of ant colonies and grub nests. Useful protein in emergencies.
A rare and hateful guest, this one. I think your welcome on the Plains has been well overstayed.
This Nephil has been Vasca so long its digestive tract can no longer tolerate solid food. Just… blood. Rehabilitation will be difficult for this one.

This poor, wretched thing has been utterly overtaken by the virus, with no recollection of having ever been kavat. It now exists only to spread the virus. But I will bring them back to themselves. I swear. They will love the sun once more.
Your time in the sunless lands are at an end, my anguished friend. I will lead you home.
Nephil Vasca. Look what the virus has done to a once-noble animal. It will be an honor to return this beast to itself. The curative is ready and waiting.
In its prime, this one.
Adult.
Full-grown.
If they are engineered from fertilization, and if the virus is doctored, Vasca can be trained, even domesticated. Wild specimens? Very different.
Ostia Vasca. I am researching a means to inoculate wild kavats against the virus, but… with little success as yet. Thank you for this.
The local wildlife will appreciate this unnatural predator being taken out of circulation. I will administer a Vasca curative as soon as they arrive.
Yet another Ostia Vasca. For every one we remove it seems two more appear. Almost as if in response to our efforts.
You know, every now and then a melancholy Offworlder will arrive, thinking to get themselves Vasca-infected as a means to live forever. Too many novels, I think.
You've caught us a lively one.
This little one has endured hardships. No more.
An impeccable example of the species.
So full of life, this one. It shall do well.
Oh dear. This one has not had an easy road. Evidence of not just battle scars, but burns… even shrapnel. This is why the Grineer must be expelled. The conflict threatens all life on the Eidolon-Moh.
Breathtaking. I've rarely seen such a beautiful specimen.
Eyes clear. Strong vital signs. Easy movement. Excellent. I'll take it from here.
Easy now.
Ha. They don't like you, Tenno. If only they knew you've likely saved their life.
Ah yes. Impaired vision. Evidence of skin plucking. Some respiratory distress. A timely intervention on our part. I'm moving this one to the front of the line.
A very young specimen.
A juvenile.
An immature specimen.
The common, garden-variety Condroc. Their primary diet is carrion, though they can hunt when they need to.
A rare privilege, Tenno: you behold the Emperor Condroc. This one will have several Condroc committees under their thrall. A superlative example of the species, worthy of the title 'Emperor.'
This Condroc has gone rogue from their committee. It happens, once a Condroc gets a taste for the hunt.

The Bau Vasca. An uncommon find. An Ostia Vasca drains many animals, including other Vasca, to survive long enough to become Bau. One look into its eyes will tell you: it barely remembers the animal it once was.

The rare Nephil Vasca. The apex manifestation of Vasca virus colonization, compelled by the viruses imperative to spread and consume. The Nephil knows little but hunger and death. They can be cured and rehabilitated, but it is a long, long road. We had best get started.

The Ostia Vasca. Still coming to terms with its… condition. Left unchecked it will become an apex predator - or die - in a matter of weeks. Most do. Many Ostia are out here, concealed, stalking… fighting for nourishment.

So. The Business has given you his blessing. Here on the Eidolon-Moh, what you call the Plains, balance is threatened. Once I would have tasked you with culling out-of-control populations in order to support failing ones. But, for now, those days are gone. My partner has chosen to devote resources to relocation instead, and I must grudgingly admit the program is proving effective in restoring a healthy balance to the Moh. Let us begin.
We are agents of balance, you and I.
Things live, things pass. To the turning of the wheel, we bear witness.
Through strife and predation, the species of the Eidolon-Moh struggle to survive. We correct the balance.
A new day, a new purpose.
Do you feel it, as I do? We are bonded to this place. This planet.
The Business is dedicated to saving animals, while I am dedicated to saving my people. A land out-of-balance feeds none.
The Eidolon-Moh houses me, feeds me, uses me to keep herself in balance and, when I am no more, shall find a use for me still. I have no need for walls.
Before the Grineer my master and I would conduct a yearly cull, to keep the Eidolon-Moh in balance. After the Grineer… that was no longer necessary. Quite the opposite.
Sometimes we fail, despite our best efforts.
And so it goes. I'm sorry, little friend.
That is unfortunate. But we should try again.
Ashen Kuakas are seen infrequently, spending time, as they do, rooting through tunnels and dens of reptiles and rodents.
An exceedingly scarce Ghost Kuaka - so named for their rarity, and preponderance for disappearing. This is a rare opportunity.
A Plains Kuaka. They play a key role in pest control, thereby protecting the young of other species and keeping the ecosystem balanced.
Prepare the tranquilizer.
Tranquilizer ready?
Ready the tranquilizer. Be swift.
A Coastal Mergoo. You'll see these everywhere along shorelines and around large bodies of water.
Regal, is it not? The Splendid Mergoo is a highly social specimen.
A less common variant, with plumage that makes it difficult for a hunter to spot them amongst the foliage.

I am in partnership with a… certain individual. On Venus. 'The Business,' they call him. If he thinks you are up to the task of conservation, he will equip you appropriately. Then we shall talk, you and I.
Observe. Animal sign.
Our quarry has passed this way. Your echo-lure, it is prepared?
Look there. Sign. We are in someone's territory now.
If I may: you appear to have chosen the incorrect lure.
Your prey will not respond to that song. A different lure.
That's the wrong tool for the job, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt: An honor to groom the beasts that serve the Tenno. Master Teasonai is forever at your service.
An honor, as always, Tenno. What do your beasts require this day?
I am humbled, protector of Cetus. Allow Master Teasonai to repay your service with my own. What might your animals require?

I was mentored in my craft by a man who lived upon the Eidolon-Moh for many years. It has been a gulf of time now since Sigor Savah departed the Plains. Where he is… I do not know. Though I very much wish I did.
Space and resources are finite. But The Business, he only smiles and tells me "Teasonai, it is a big universe." Sigor Savah would have had no time for such nonsense.
Some in Fortuna knew my mentor. I have asked The Business if he had the honor. He only said that Sigor Savah sounded like he had been a man of… enviable clarity. A strange response.
The Business: strange that he frowns upon my methods - of taking animal life in order to preserve it - while he himself applies the same principles… to people.
The Business has no stomach for the population control necessary in maintaining a balanced ecosystem. I fear for whatever sanctuary he is building.
Yes, I am able to groom your animal. What is your desire?
Do you seek to enhance your beast's appearance, perhaps for lower visibility on the hunt?
I can groom for aesthetics, stealth, visibility… or to terrify. Show me the animal and I will advise.
I have lived upon the Eidolon-Moh all my life. Nurturing and culling go hand-in-hand. Live here long enough; you will understand that also.
The Eidolon-Moh has weathered the introduction of many invasive species, but none more destructive than the Grineer themselves.
The Business speaks poetically of the grandeur of the Orb Vallis. I should like to see it for myself, but the cold would not be to my liking.

When The Business first sent me these small stuffed animals I took it as evidence of a mind in decay. However… on reflection… I see now that he has a greater understanding of people than I could ever aspire to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaOut: I trust this meets with your approval.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte: Operator, Ordis has been thinking. Now that you are here in the flesh we should make the orbiter more comfortable. Ordis has identified an old storage space you could use. Standby while I TORCH THIS JUNK... dispose of my old belongings. Out with the old and in with the new, right Operator? Construct this Domestic Habitation Segment to extend life support to your new room.
Well, what do you think? Not too shabby, yes? Ordis hopes the Operator enjoys this new room.
Your Habitation Segment is complete and the new room is ready. Ordis cannot contain his excitement. Will you go there now, Operator? Will you?
When that Domestic Habitation Segment Ugh... get married why don't we? is complete Ordis will renovate your new space. Ordis loves nesting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe: You know, Konzu doesn't get emotional. But this place? Cetus is more than our home, Tenno: it is the center of our universe. My uncle, he died protecting his. And you, you fought to protect ours. My uncle's voice, still echoes - a warning. But this place? Our voice? Will echo forever. As a welcome. A beacon to anyone who needs a home. Okay, a little emotional maybe. The Unum chose well when she sent you to us. Dah-dup. Now, get back to work.

Infestation. My Uncle, Hinmun, sold minerals aboard a market near Eris. Quite popular with deep-system traders. At least it was. They were broadsided by one of these boils. It spread fast. They could have run, risked taking it with them. Instead, they turned off life-support and blew-out escape pods. Decades later, it still orbits Eris. Writhing. One voice repeating the same message over and over, "We are death. Leave us, and do not look back." My Uncle's voice. Fail here, Tenno, and that will be the fate of Cetus: to be a warning for the living, from a place where none may tread.

Tenno, a meteoroid is on an impact trajectory with Earth. Ordis' calculations have it making planetfall just beyond Cetus. More troubling still^ it appears to be alive. Stay vigilant, I will update you as I learn more.
Tenno, a meteoroid is on an impact trajectory with Earth. Stay vigilant, I will update you as I learn more.

The meteoroid has crashed down outside Cetus! Konzu reports that it is indeed some sort of organic boil. At the moment it poses no direct threat. Still, I need you to be ready to act on a moment's notice.

I have received word from Konzu. The Infested boil that once threatened the Plains of Eidolon - it has grown back, uglier and more putrid than ever. Remain on standby, I may need you at a moment's notice.
Tenno, Konzu needs your help! The Ostrons have sighted Infested lifeforms emerging from the boil. We need to deal with this thing immediately. Report to Konzu in Cetus.
First the stars went wrong… and now the air. Can you smell it? Master Teasonai… his animals… they smell it, too. Sweet, like a wound gone bad. These days none of us sleep easy.
When the sun is low, scouts report seeing things - shadows - moving inside the boil. Stay close, Tenno. Stay close.
Vay Hek! He has toxin enough to destroy the boil, but no. He wants it to flourish. Why? To see the Infested succeed where he has failed: to see them destroy Cetus.
Dark times, killer. In times past we've lost entire markets - entire clades - to the Infestation. That cannot happen here. Cetus must survive.
I've put Nakak in charge of supply distribution, until this strangeness is at an end. See what she has for you. We're all in this one together, Tenno.
During these dark nights Cetus is grateful for your help. Nakak will keep you supplied until we beat this. Go see her.

First Vay Hek thinks 'I will let this plague run wild over Cetus.' Then he thinks, 'I will use poison to exterminate the Infestation once its work is done.' The Quills see doom in his plan, for Grineer and Ostron alike. The boil needs to be destroyed now, before it becomes unstoppable.
The Infestation... I was beginning to think it would never touch us here. That it was a thing that happened out there. To others. Naive. I need you to take Vay Hek's toxin and kill the boil.
The toxin has triggered peristalsis. Antibody production has escalated. Prepare for a massive immune response.
Fools! You tried to POP its GLISTENING MAGNIFICENCE, but you just made it angry.
Keep trying to cleanse these plains, you'll only die in a SHOWER of FECULENT DEFEAT!
No. NO. NOOOOO!!!
You have NOT WON, MAGGOTS! YOU HAVE NOT WON!!!
Well you got a reaction. Big as a house and half as smart. Knock it on the head, eh?
The boil's immune system has manufactured a Hemocyte to deal with the toxin threat. Destroy it.
A Hemocyte: the product of the boil attempting to fight off the toxin. Kill it to weaken the Infestation further.
Tenno maggots! You try to protect these rats, but you will fail and fail!
That, uh… that was some allergic reaction you kicked off. Quite a sight, Tenno. Well done.
Top shelf work, surah. But it was not enough. Not yet. Hit it again, and keep hitting it 'til there's nothing but a hole in the ground.
You are not welcome on Konzu's Plains, snot-thing. Nice work, Number One Gun. We're breathing easier back here.
Vay Hek has his best troops securing this toxin. Proceed to the bottom of the mine, Tenno.
Infiltrate the Grineer tunnels and secure a supply of toxin.
Vay Hek has stored Thrax toxin deep within these tunnels. Retrieve them.
We know Vay Hek has Thrax Toxin stored deep underground. We'll use that. One ill to cure another, eh?
Of course MAGGOTS seek to BURROW! Away from my caves, MAGGOTS! Lest you be CRUSHED!
The Thrax Toxin! The Tenno MAGGOTS want my TOXIN! Stop them!
Toxin secured. Be prepared. Vay Hek knows what we're up to now.
Vay Hek. A two-bit despot with a mind half-an-inch wide and a face like a rejected skin graft. Konzu would like you to make his life miserable. Well. More miserable.
Drone located. Hack in and insert the Thrax Toxin. I'll steer it toward the boil.
Accompany the drone to the boil. Ensure it completes delivery.
Escort the drone to the Infestation site.
Don't let anything happen to the Thrax toxin on the way to the boil, eh Tenno.
BUFFOONS! Do NOT allow them to retrieve that DRONE!
TROOPERS! If those MAGGOTS get that DRONE, then I'll take what's left of my Thrax Toxin… and USE IT ON YOU!!!
A Grineer drone will serve as an optimal delivery system. I've marked one on your map.
The mixer is inside that vault. Clear out the area so we can use it.
Keep them away, killer. That machine must finish its work.
The Grineer will do anything to destroy the mixer. Stop them.
This boil will cleanse Cetus of the filthy Ostron rats that infest her walls.
Grineer! Soon the Ostron rats of Cetus will flee in panic. And when they do we'll hunt them for sport!
The mixer needs more time. Keep the Grineer at bay.
I am directing you to the location of a Grineer chemical mixer. Use it to prepare the toxin.
The Quills speak of Sentient immunity to the Infestation. If you have a vial of Eidolon Phylaxis, consider adding it to the mix now.
I see your clan created the Infested Catalyst. This is your chance, add it to the mixer now.
It's ready. Now make that boil hurt. Doh-ga!
Ai yo… My eyebrows are singeing just looking at that stuff. Go shove it into the boil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf: Ordis did not think the Operator could be more attractive. Wrong again, Ordis!
An unexpected color combination, Operator. My sensors are bleeding-- pleased.
A fearsome appearance, Operator. You will strike terror in your enemies.
Strange. Ordis did not see the value of those photonic wavelengths until now.
Excellent armaments, Operator. Please return covered in blood-- safe and sound.
If I may say, Operator, your chosen Warframe suits you, haha!
Well put together Operator now get out there and cut down the-- and make the Lotus proud.
Operator, you have remembered well how the Tenno arm themselves.
Did you fuse your Mods, Operator? Did they anger you in some way?
Your collection of Mods is impressive, Operator.. but I wonder if there are more to be had?
Is your mod collection in order? No, I am not equipped to feel envy.
All Mods accounted for, Operator. I have not taken any.
I understand if you have to sell Mods. Maybe Ordis will meet a similar fate someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo: Operator, you have Foundry items ready- claim them now- at your earliest convenience.
Foundry items ready to claim, Operator.
Operator, my Foundry has completed a new item. Does this please the Operator?
Operator, my Foundry system has completed a build!
Ordis has completed a Foundry task. No, don't mention it.
Cephalon Ordis has completed a blueprint. Check the Foundry!
Foundry items can be claimed, Operator. Are you pleased?
Gun-gun-gun-- Hmmm… foundry has items for you, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId: Operator? Ordis wonders… what are you thinking about?
Operator, I've run diagnostic regressions, all systems nominal. You don't need to thank me.
Ordis is hap- angry- hmmm. I may require maintenance after all.
Operator, are you enjoying the view?
Do you remember the Old War, Operator? Ordis seems to have misplaced those memories.
Operator, the system needs you… will you begin another mission?
I've been thinking Operator. I thought you'd want to know.
Operator! Did you hear that? It said-- Cosmic background radiation is a riot!
Operator, were you visualizing a bloody battle? Me too.
Stand by while I analyze the intelligence profiles of the Grineer. Error! Not a number! Did the Operator enjoy this witticism?
Everything in Ordis, Operator? Is that a pun?! Hmm... I will attempt to bypass this fault.
Ordis has been counting stars, Operator. All accounted for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn: Ordis has received messages for the Operator. No, I have not read them.
Inbox messages await the Operator. I wonder what they say?
Check your Inbox, Operator. Maybe Ordis will get a message someday…
The Inbox has messages for the Operator. Anything about Ordis in there?
Operator, messages have arrived in your Inbox.
Messages in your inbox, Operator. Uh… they are not as encrypted as they should be.
Unread inbox messages make me ill.
(Master.)
(We… breathe for you. Bleed for you. Feed for you.)
(All that lives is coiled within us. We will consume, Master, if you wish it.)
(Feed me… Master.)
(The Meridians awake. The vital pentatonic.)
(I am weak, Master.)
(We are life, Master. But also death.)
(Living substances is our domain. How will we serve you.)
(We are as one.)
(Master, only my voice has returned.)
(Forgive me, my sting, Master.)
(We germinate, for the Master… within the Master.)
(Why do you reject my beauty?)
Disgusting, is it not Operator? Ordis would enjoy purging this… uh cleaning this room but sadly this… vile mass serves you and your Warframes. A necessary evil.

Ordis cannot remember, but there does seem to be a… relationship… between your Warframes and the Infestation. I would be careful in here, Operator. Domesticated or not, Ordis does not trust this thing.
Vile. Putrid. This… 'thing'... is responsible for biological functions of the Orbiter. A strange design. Why would I be built with such a flaw?
A strange biological archive here. I cannot explain it Operator, as you know I have sustained memory system damage. Ordis recommends leaving at once and welding the door shut.
(The demon is awake? How?)
(We fear nothing but the Void demon.)
(Light shines within this demon.)
(Shadows grow within this demon.)
(This demon walks the shadow's edge.)
Operator?! No! Have you lost your mind?!
(We awaken, Master.)
What was that? Is it... talking? What did it say?
(I wish to serve, yet I am weak. Time heals the mind.)
The system continues to fall into chaos. Check navigation for active invasions.
Tenno, the balance of power continues to shift. Navigation is marked with new invasions.
Navigation has been updated with new invasions. Chaos is spreading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe: Tenno, there is a time-limited mission alert available. Check navigation.
Tenno, a new Alert has begun. It will be marked on navigation.
New Alert marked on navigation, Tenno.
Just got some new stock and I'm giving you the first crack at it. Don't say I never did anything for you.
Tenno, your codex has been updated with a new quest.
You have new quests in your codex.
A new quest is available in your codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DPr: Operator?! Is that a… a Void Relic Segment? Ordis hasn't seen one of those in well… forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu: Brace for an incoming barrage.
Readying barrage.
Heads up, here comes a barrage.
Med-Tower deployed.
Med-Tower available.
You may now patch your sorry... seek medical attention.
Prepare for incoming medical support.
Hold tight, a Med-Tower is enroute.
Override established. Security protocols momentarily disabled.
Override delivered. Security systems temporarily disrupted.
Who's in control now suckers? Er ah, security override engaged.
Invalid request. There are no security protocols active.
Security Override incoming.
Hacking into enemy systems. Await Override.
Sentry Gun incoming.
Deploying Sentry Gun, stand by.
Sentry Gun entering the field.
Operator, support is unavailable while my systems recharge.
Support request again? Please allow me to recharge my systems first.
I cannot comply. My system must recharge first.
Prepare for incoming support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe: Thank you for returning to me, Operator!
Ordis is pleased to see you.
Ordis has been- getting tired of waiting- waiting patiently for your return, Operator.
Ordis awaits command. Who dies-- what are your next moves, Operator?
Hello Operator! Ordis has reorganized the ship… It's exactly the same!
Operator! It's really you! Are you getting revenge for-- preparing for your next mission?
All systems are in peak condition, just like the Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE: Angry: Someone takes the thing you love.
Bored: Waiting too much. There is nothing fun to look at.
Embarrassed: Talking and everyone looks at you.
Excited: All the spider eggs are starting to hatch!
Happy: Momma has a stretchy smile.
Sad: Why did the babies eat the mother?
Shy: Meeting someone new and can't say hello.
Scared: You look around and Momma's not there.
Tired: You run and run until you can't anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF: Find Rell's object-of-focus, child. You are close to this sacred relic, I am certain.
These messages, they express Rell's suffering. He's lashing out. I should have seen the cracks forming…
I don't understand. How would Rell know about the dream?
Great Sentient Queen, forgive me, but what you are, what you've made of yourself… is merely drawn from the dreams of these divine children. You are not she, you are not… Margulis.
What are you saying? That Rell is a Tenno? Impossible. All Tenno are known to me. I protect them, as she did.
Oh, but not Rell. Margulis cast him out, for he was different. Our foremothers took him in and studied his teachings. We became the Veil. The shroud of his blessed existence.
Cast out... I don't believe you-
Rap. Tap. Tap. The man in the wall.
The man in the wall! That is what he called it. Hush… try to follow his voice!
Mmm. Mmm.
The Donda! His mother gave him this. Holy Rell was not like other children. Sound, color, touch… it overwhelmed him. The Donda's hum let him focus.
Mmmmm - No! MINE!
Rap. Tap. Tap. Rap. Tap. Tap.
Rell! What evil is this!? Sacred child, forgive me. I should have known the weight of the Void would one day crush the light from you.
Rell has become the very thing he warned us of. You cannot kill this, Tenno. Run! You can only run!
Holy Rell, let us bring you the peace you have earned… Guide this Tenno so you can return to the Harrowing vessel… so that you might rest.
Rell's warnings… those dire consequences… he was talking about Void exposure, wasn't he? The effect it has on human minds is well understood…
But it's not. This isn't some kind of deep pressure bends as Margulis suspected. Rell saw what it was, truly. An entity, indifferent. Old as stars.
Mmm. My fault. Touching is too much noise. It makes me… makes me… angry.
There! An emotion, manifest from the game Rell played as a child!
See if you can stabilize it with a Kinetic Siphon.
Tenno, you need to capture it!
It's too strong for the Siphon, try and weaken it.
The manifestation is fighting the Siphon. See if you can damage it.
You've run out of Kinetic Siphons. I'm sorry, there's nothing more you can do here.
Rap. Tap. Tap. I don't want to go back!
I'm detecting other manifestations. Defend yourself and try to trap them.
He's listening. He knows what you're doing. It makes him stronger.
Good. You've captured the manifestations here. Now get out before Rell's disturbance catches up with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI: Iron Wake. Steel Meridian has built an impressive base of operations right under the nose of the Grineer authority. The Veil's Speaker will be here, under guard. Find her.
Leave your vessel at the door, sacred child. Come.
Hush, Rook, this is our sacred guest! I am Palladino. Holy speaker of the Veil, like my mother, and hers before… We speak to the other side, to him. Without his focus, I pray… I pray he answers.

Righteous Rell - of harrowed stars - of hallowed chains. Speak. For an age you've guarded the divide between Dust and Void. Speak. From within your everlasting sacred vessel, you've held the lidless eye. Speak!

I cannot reach holy Rell from here. I will need his sacred focus: a relic stolen from the temple. I beg of you to find it and return it here. Only then, will he speak to us. Only then will we truly understand.

Veil rituals will incite fanaticism, but don't be drawn in. I'm not convinced this 'Rell' even exists. I fear we'll have to play Palladino's game to find out. Ordis has been tracking Red Veil disturbances… that's the best place to start.

I have served Rell my whole life. Studying Rell's teachings of the Void, the dire consequence of travelling by and through it. Now I see that it is true: he alone, in his harrowing sacrifice, has guarded us. What a price he has paid.

Righteous Rell - outcast of sacred Void - hear my voice. Speak. You have been driven from the vessel by your suffering. You have swallowed the poison stars so we would not… Holy Rell, speak! The Tenno who rejected you have come to your aid!
He's here… The Donda, it's working, giving him humanity. We are listening Rell… Speak!
Impossible speed, beyond the Brankle Gap constant.
Uh, I think so... you're better with that stuff. But it's amazing, isn't it?-
So why don't they fix me?
That's right. Different, so I love you even more.
Yes Rell! You make me so happy.
This memory - his humanity still remains, buried in these emotions he so often failed to grasp. Could they be the key to saving him from this?
Tenno - I have a theory. Return to your Orbiter and I'll explain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO: Operator, what was that… thing? Lotus, can you explain this? Lotus?!
Transference energy, fractured. It was so… cold, indifferent, inhuman. If Rell was Tenno what did he become without Margulis?
Operator, there is no evidence of any… thing… in the Void. By my calculations, Rell has lost control of his Transference. If we can gather these emotions I hope he will be himself again.
You will need Kinetic Siphons to trap Rell's emotions. Simaris will have some for sale in the Relay.
Steel Meridian has received Palladino. You've been granted access to enter their base, Operator.
Operator! A Red Veil Seance! How… delightful? I have marked a possible Red Veil disturbance but… perhaps you would prefer to- brew some leaves and… Sorry. Navigation is bleeding, Operator.
Uhh... Waiting. Navigation is waiting. Oh, my.

If Rell's been caught in a Transference loop for this long… the psychological effects could have been catastrophic. This 'man in the wall', these delusions, symptoms of the Void exposure all Tenno experienced. I hope that Palladino can find peace for Rell so this never happens again.
These disturbances, they are Transference energy, split apart from a single mind. If we could capture them, send them back…
Operator - Simaris may have a tool for this task. I wonder if his Kinetic Siphons could be repurposed to- bust… capture these manifestations?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP: Receiving an all-call on our Syndicate frequency. It's a Red Veil encode but… it seems truncated. I will play back what I have...

[2.0]
...
[5.0]
Rap. Tap. Tap.
[15.0]
Speak to us. We're listening. What is your name?
[22.0]
Mmm. R-r-r-ellllll.
[32.0]
Good, you remember. We want to help you, Rell. Tell us where you are.
[40.0]
Mmm. Can't. He's listening.
[45.0]
Who? Rell, who is listening?
[50.0]
Rap. Tap. Tap. Rap. Tap. Tap.
Sorry Operator. The message appears haunted - halted. It originated from a Steel Meridian ship near Earth. Will you investigate? I hope not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR: Emergency power. Not detecting any crew. I don't like this. Search the area.
Blades. Too refined for a Grineer Kill Squad. Is there anything else?
Red Veil. Could they have done this? The Veil have been Meridian allies for years. Search for survivors.
Tenno? I lost you for a second. What did you see?
Holy child of Zariman, please help me. I serve the Veil but the flock has been driven mad. I humbly beg for the protection of you and your vessel.
I'm marking the area. Stay alert. It may be an ambush.
Great, blind, Queen… help me reach the safety of Iron Wake. Our sacred muse has abandoned the temple, leaving our people in chaos.
Tenno, if the Red Veil is in chaos we must intervene. Get Palladino to Iron Wake.
Oh holy child, I am grateful for- What is it Rook? Are they back?!
You were supposed to protect her. This mission is a failure.
Brothers of blood, sisters of fire, resist the muse!
Blessed star child, I owe you my life. Will you meet me at Iron Wake? Only you can right this wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS: I don't know if you can make Rell whole again, but whatever you're doing, this disturbance is growing stronger, resisting you. Don't let it stop you. Bring Rell home, to the temple.
Is that where Rell is? Has the Veil preserved him in cryosleep as the other Tenno were on Lua?
No. We didn't have that option.
He's listening but I'm so… Help me.
Rell… it's just you, alone and trapped in a Transference loop. Don't give into these delusions of Void exposure. There is no man in the wall.
They are here - the Transference pieces. Track down these manifestations and capture them.
Why are you helping me? You hated me.
Alright, no more to be found here. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT: How could Rell have lived this long? Without the long dream?
He didn't. He knew his mortality would undo his purpose, so he gave up his humanity, forever. He committed his soul to the undying vessel-
Yes. He commanded we chain it within the depths of the sacred temple. An eternal vigil against the Indifference.
And you believed him. You helped him do it.
Yes. After everything you've seen, wouldn't you?
Blessed Tenno, Rell has returned to his sacred vessel. I will join him there at once. Please, come, for I fear… I haven't got the strength to do what must be done next…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV: Our temple. Our home. His tomb. Come. Meet our guiding light.

This is why you're here, Tenno. It is time for holy Rell to rest. But I cannot bring myself to do it… to let him go. He's kept us, all of us, safe for so long and it's time for you to carry on. Release him, Tenno. Destroy the chains that bind the Harrowing vessel. He's earned his rest.
You may enter here, but only as your true, sacred form.
Holy Rell. You have sacrificed enough. Pass on your burden and rest. Tenno. Destroy the chains… only your sacred power will damage them.
Tenno- something's wrong. That's not Rell, that's--
Let's have a little quiet. It's my turn to ask the questions.
Well, love, I told you. You can't pet her that hard, be gentle or she'll bite. Are you okay, Rell?
I won't let you take me… from me.
What have you done to Rell?
Tenno! You need to save him from this… Destroy the chains-
How dare you laugh at him! You should be ashamed of yourselves! Don't look away. Look at him. He's not invisible!
Rap. Tap. Tap. You'll let me in, little piggy.
Momma's… not… herself, Rell. I don't think… I think you should wait with the other kids, until they fix the ship. I love you but… you have to go! Go!
But the in-kids don't care about the invisible outs. If you were alone in that drift… you'd need a friend… even like me.
By sacred shadow and righteous blood - Blessed Rell! Your aged Vessel is dust and your chains are broken. Be free!
Mmm. But the man in the wall. Who will… ?
They will have to. All of them. They owe you this. We all do.
Mmm. Yea. I feel…
Go on Rell, which one?
This one, Momma. I feel… tired.
Good Rell! You're learning! Well? Why don't you have a little rest, then?
Okay… Okay Momma.

With Rell at peace, we will rebuild in his honor. We will do what we have always done: take the outcasts, the ones that don't fit in, and prepare them. Thank you, to you and your great Queen for setting Rell to rest. Take this offering, it's the thing of greatest value I can give you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DF: 'Them'? Tenno?! Father! You're making a mistake! Come now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM: So. Nef's makin' a succession play. Sumper thinks he can prove he's a sprog of noble descent. No idea how; Parvos was assassinated before any of us were an itch. Biz?
Granum. The original taxman. Killed when someone - a Board member most likely - sabotaged the Void drive of his personal transport. Nef wants gene-proof, but there's nothing left to scan.

Our people are vanishing because of this. That's true. I know it. I don't care if Parvos Granum is dead, alive, or making change tap-dancing in a Grineer officer's mess. Sparky: you find what Nef's looking for... you'll find out what happened to our people. Get on it.

Look familiar, Outworlder? Warframe, yes, but one-of-a-kind. Protea. Legend says she was built specifically for and assigned to one Parvos Granum. Yes. Part of a deal Granum cut with the Orokin themselves. Granum… was no amateur. He had real power. Our ear inside says Nef's techs have found a lead on Protea's whereabouts. 'Protean traces' they're calling them.
And yet, so they believe, they found Granum's Warframe bodyguard - who was with Granum when that Void drive went critical. So who is to say what's true?
Got dirt that isn't safe to shovel out in the open. You know where to meet.
Sparky! Yes. Biz and I may be in over our heads on this one...

Listen up: this Deadlock spat is costing Solaris lives. The Corpus founder, some long-dead cove named Parvos Granum, carries a lot of messianic clout. Well… Nef's claiming the old man's got an heir. If true, that heir can, by rights, claim total control of the Board. Board schisms and infighting might be the main reason SU's survived this long. If the Board unifies under one person… one 'found' by Nef…? Our people will never see daylight. I need you on this. You in?

Like all of you, I was born poor, with but a meager derivatives portfolio and limited vesting options. I never knew my parents. But - as an orphan, poor as I said - I found great riches within the Tenets of our glorious Founder! Parvos Granum. The Corpus became my family.
It's Nef alright. Patching through.
They've fuzzed the band. Keep at it.

She had been a surrogate in a very special, very secret succession program! It was an epiphany! It would seem that I am one of the sons of our late, great Founder! And… more importantly… his heir. Now, I have only to prove it. That is where all of you come in.
The brass on this mucker! I have to protect my people from this trust-fund lunatic. Do your thing. I'll check in with my whisper network, let you know what they're saying. Talk soon. The brass!

But over the years, as my wealth blossomed, and my humility grew vast… I began to see a certain similarity. I wondered… who am I, really? After a protracted negotiation, my birth mother sold to me the secrets of my conception! She had been a…
Wait! What? Get that signal back!
Sparky, you better get out of there... while we make sense of this.

To the Corpus Board and my many, many, supporters across the Origin System: Everyone is asking: when will I, Nef Anyo, end this unprofitable, squabbling Deadlock? People are saying "Nef Anyo's perfect for the big seat. A visionary, an exemplar, a protege of the great Founder himself, Parvos Granum!" Friends, our time is at hand.
How many kids are going to grow up in the vents because of this? How many parents lost, because I couldn't do my job.

If Nef intends to visit that 'pocket' for his proof, he won't risk himself… not at first. Sparky, you can beat him to it. Biz has figured out how to activate Nef's Granum Tributes. You won't believe this.

Nef as the Corpus figurehead, with a united board behind him, will be hell for us and workers everywhere. See if you can get across first. Tax whatever proof he's hoping to collect, muck up his plan and find our people.
Eudi. There's a ventkid, a very long time ago, who would have hero-worshipped the woman she became. You're enough.
These tributes… are essentially… coin. operated. You'll need a 'Granum Crown'... you'll have to search the ship.
Another engineering blunder! We need confirmation. Reset and get our next volunteer into position!
It's… a… right. It's a great, big… hand.
--What was that?
Granum Tribute. Story is Parvos was missing his left hand. See if you can--
I think it was a Void-temporal shift. I'm not entirely sure, I've never seen one before. Small, though. About as big as a… person? Patch me into the system.
Ready now. Protean trace spiking. It's time! Send in the next volunteer!
They're gearing up for something.
You and your bleeding heart Tenno thugs. I really don't have time for this. My Robotics, on the other hand, do. Kill-crews, take care of this, I have history to make!

Nef Anyo. You are found. Remember the first days of Fortuna. Your failure. Our victory. Without the Solaris your… 'aspirations'…  are nothing. Return our Solaris brothers and sisters. Or to nothing, so I swear, you will return.
By Profit, by Void! It's real! It's real!
What kind of signal?
I don't know yet. Outworlder, don't let them cut the signal before I can decode it!
No! Biz, what is that thing?
I'm not… Outworlder, hold position, I'm getting something.
He'll pay for this. "Volunteers". He's killing our people for some kind of... weapons test.
Maybe not. I'm still pulling signal from that jockey's rig!
We'll be waiting for you, Outworlder.
What is this? What are we looking at?
The jockey's feed.
Could do with some noise while I'm eyeballing the bits.
Protean detectors should be onboard. Not sure what they'll look like. See what you can find.
Crews. The tomb is verified intact! Dispatch the treasurer with my offering. It's time I paid Tribute myself.
If you make it across, keep an eye out for our people. They may have survived. I've told more than enough kids their parents aren't coming home.
Alright, here's our chance. Time to tax the taxman!

If only Parvos could have lived to see this day! Imagine his face, beaming with pride, as he bestowed upon me, his son, that sacred Golden Hand! My surgeons have... assured me the procedure will be quick and painless? A pound of old flesh for a glorious new legacy!
I'd pay top credits to crap in Nef's coffin. Double if he was still alive.
They must not reach him before we do! Is that understood?!?
'Him'? As if the body would still be intact? Something's off. Get to the Tribute… expect some friction.

Vox. Solaris. - our 'interests'... have come to align. Now… This 'situation' is no one's 'fault' and I'm not one to point fingers, but my fleet and your workers are facing the same danger… Convince your Tenno servant to reenter Granum's domain, and dis-able that Protea Specter. I have just the thing they'll need but there is some assembly required. You want to rescue those comrades trapped in there and I want to keep the past where it belongs. Dead and buried. Deal?

Nef's a bloviating narcissist with the morals of a haunted chainsaw but at least that makes him predictable. Parvos? That mucker is something else. I don't trust Nef, but if any of our own are still alive in there… we have to try. Biz will lead the build on this… 'Xoris' gizmo.
To cross over you'll need to find a Granum Crown first. Search the area.

One scan of Parvos Granum and my lineage shall be proven! None shall deny me-- what? Tenno? Again!? Not today! As Parvos' heir, it is my offering to make! I am coming, Father! It is I who shall pay Tribute! Your Nef is almost home!
We've got a lock on you, Outworlder. Good luck!
The Tributes won't activate with combat nearby. You'll need to take out those troops before going in.
Yes!
Father. Permit me to show you all I have built in your name. Do Nef Anyo that honor.
'Invited'? Wait. If Nef is here because he allowed it…

Rot took root in the Corpus. My first work was done. With my 'murder' those unworthy of my legacy revealed their true natures, true tastes. Today... the Corpus are the very antithesis of my creed. But I see those rare few who remain true, despite a world of distortion and temptation. They are the harvest of my first crop. The strongest, the most true.
The rest… chaff.
You thought to stop me, Tenno? This is my ordained fate. It is… by the Void.
Outworlder, Nef has eyes in here. How escapes me. Our channel's masked. He doesn't know we're here.
It has been so long since these old eyes beheld another living thing, here, in this sanctuary.
I… am Parvos Granum. Thank you for finding me.
Not good enough, am I? Inadequate, am I? You've been 'watching' me, have you? Well. Watch as I show you how we do things these days! Crews! Repel those Specters! We have bigger fish to fry.
Errant Specters in Section 8! Crews?! Crews… respond!?
By the void. You. are. Alive. My faith never wavered.

I live. Treachery seethed within the heart of the faith I had built. When the Board's assassins overloaded my transport's Void drive, Protea… my beautiful Protea… and her gift for manipulating time... preserved me.
But at the cost of all that she was. Now she is nothing more than a Specter of her former self. My beautiful Protea.
That is why you have been invited here.
'My name'. Hmm... I have watched you.

Monuments to narcissism. Demanding others sweat in your stead. Gorging upon that which you have not earned. Watched… as you claimed for yourself my teachings of self-reliance, perverting them into a flaccid philosophy of sloth. Of… Idleness. Is that you, my son?
No, that must be a different son.
Biz has a handle on the time jump but we've got bigger problems than Nef now. Get out of there!
No! Father! FATHERRR!!! Daddy? W-what? Breaches! BREACHES! The Protean field array is… oh no. All crews to Tributes! We are… we are being... in-va-ded!

We've got a lock on you, Outworlder. Good luck… What the hell? Outworlder, I'm pulling sensory feeds from a trip you haven't taken yet. And hearing myself say things I've never said in a place I've never seen. Parvos…? Eudi you should see this. What if Nef has similar logs?
You know nothing, falling short as you do of every ideal that I value. Your words, your efforts, are the model of inadequacy. I called you, Nef Anyo. But I do not need you. I need…
... them.
Protea has scanned her kin… and with that, she is reinvigorated.
Now, my lovely, if you wouldn't mind? Show our guests the door.
Outworlder, you'll need the Xoris Glaive for this.

Thanks for the fast work, Biz. Sparky, listen up: Biz's findings indicate Parvos might be close to translating himself from that reality into our own. We're not exactly sure how but we're getting some odd readings. You've got to build the Xoris before Parvos gets free.
Have you assembled the 'Xoris' device yet? The sooner we get back there the sooner we can get our people out of there... and throw away the muckin' key.
A weapon? Glaive-class but with an energy trap… Specter Particles maybe? Has a mid-flight detonation trigger. Tricky, but I'm sure you'll get the hang of it. Gear up and let's go.
Nef's given us a cipher for an old Granum file. "Phantasmic Scintilla and Motive Forces." We'll need more specifics to build whatever this tool is.
Parvos Granum originated Specter Particle Theory? Guts. This old coot is a whole other order of intelligence, and that's bad for us.  Get back to your ship. I need to figure out this Xoris thing.

The palace birds think they control us. They hit our research site with a Warframe assault team. Of course they did. I baited them to do it. The whole site lit up. Eighty mega-therm bloom. The whole lab, vaporized, those Warframes with it. Fire. Fusion. Void.
Hmm, looks like a partial find. Let's see if Anyo's cipher works as promised.

Some doors ought to remain closed? That's not in my world view. Fire, Fusion, Void. Progress always comes entangled with risk, with violence. With the precious sample obtained, development is accelerating. The Entrati have kept their secrets long enough.

I am calling it the Specter Particle. As my Archimedeans explain, mimicry is in its nature. An echo. Exposed to precept circuits, we are able to imprint behaviors! Like an infant mirroring her surrogate. Only this infant can set the world on fire.
Reactor vents sealing. Warning. Catastrophic overload imminent.
This was not the deal, Anyo. We have yet to rescue our people. Disengage the destruct.
---Wait! It's a time prison, right? Sparky, if you can get back inside before the reactor tilts… you'd theoretically have all the time in the world…
Eudi: the fleet's going to blow.  Outworlder, abort--
Our people are calling in, Sparky, they're coming home. Tonight all Fortuna will be singin' a verse in your honor.

Solaris. We are reunited. Parents to children, family to family. Take this time to hold one another, for tomorrow our struggle continues. We will persevere. Know that our emancipation is writ in the stars with Solaris, and Tenno, united.
Outworlder? Eudi, they're alive! Listen: Nef's whole fleet is overloading. Huge energy spike! We need to take out Protea! Ready that Xoris!
Full charge! Now - target the enclosure trapping our jockeys. You'll need to trigger your Xoris to discharge near them.
There! Our rig jockeys! They're trapped in some kind of energy enclosure. You'll need to charge the Xoris to break it open.
Risk comes from not knowing what you are doing. There's no stopping this without stopping Protea. A bit like eating your own, no?
I can't do that. But don't worry. I'm already at a very comfortable safe distance.
Here they come! Take out the Errants, then use the Xoris to trap the Specter Particles that escape! You'll have to time it just right.
Well done, Outworlder! Now bring the rest home!
By now your friends have noticed that the overloading Void engines are preventing the exits you opened for my captives... from closing. Well done. And goodbye. Enjoy your stay.
There's got to be an opening! Maybe while she's reversing the temporal field?
She's reversing the temporal field! Try to interrupt it! A fully charged burst from the Xoris might do it!
That's it! The cycle's degrading!
That… cunning… old… Outworlder! You've got to get out of there!
I am your beginning. I am your end. Entwined. Forever.
I am your end. Entwined. Forever.
Entwined. Forever.
Forever.
You're too late! The old man's Errant Specters have-- huh? The Protean trace is… gone!? Where is he? Where is my father?
That temporal effect again! And… yes. There are your sensory feeds, just like last time. So, the Xoris worked - in a battle that never happened. Or did it. I have a headache.
You're too late! The Tributes are jammed open and the old man's Errant Specters have control of my ship. They're spreading through the fleet. I have no choice. If I can't have my fleet no-one can!
Reactor failure imminent. All crews: thank you for your service.
Biz… Biz. I don't think they made it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DP: Solaris. Be you sumper, rail agent, crud diver, or pit boss: hear this. Your comrades, your friends, your family - good people with clear debts - are being taken. Vanished. Nef Anyo, in his hubris, is writing checks and cashing them with Solaris lives. There is upset in the halls of Corpus power. The foundations of their kleptocracy tremble. To Nef, we say this: you are seen. To the Solaris: make yourselves heard. To those who have aided us in the past: join us now. You are needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DQ:
The System shall change. No more clutching at sunk costs, imposed ideals, hand-me-down hopes. No, we are better than that. Corpus shall know a violent restructuring, but with time enough to face the impending threat from Tau with renewed and absolute vigor.
Or not. Perhaps the rot is too deep. Perhaps the father should abandon his children. Perhaps it is time for a new philosophy. Hmmm.
Life's just a bargain like any other. Yours is no different. Would you like a seat at my new table? Perhaps with your… masked friends alongside? The Business, was it? A curious name. And Eudico, of course. All people who know what they want.
I know what they want. But what about you? Tell me, friend: what is it you Desire?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT: May your Desire blossom, thief, and with it: wisdom! Farewell!
Fulfill your Desire and others will follow! I follow Parvos! To freedom!
We are unstoppable! We are Corpus! Farewell, thief!
Your Desire is found wanting, thief! Farewell!
Parvos! I return to the grasp of your golden hand! Away!
Most cunning Founder, with my life I protect your sacred Crowns!
Most wise Founder, protect your avaricious servant!
Parvos Granum, your sacred tokens shall remain secure from the grasp of the idle!
Wise Parvos! The low thief shall never know the cool caress of your Crowns!
Your Crowns are safe in my grasp, oh Parvos! Protect me!

Moon team will need to work hard to close the gap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul: To get possession of the Lunaro, you simply touch it. It will pull into your arm-mounted launcher, called your "Arcata". Launch the Lunaro by tapping the fire button. Holding the fire button for the duration of the throw will launch it further. To curve your shot, try launching the Lunaro from a slide. Your Arcata is also equipped with a range-limited attractor. Hold the aim button to attract the Lunaro when it is near. Catching, interceptions and guarding your team's goal rely on this.

The Lunaro contains an ancient and unstable energy. This creates a few carrying rules for the Lunaro. First, you cannot carry the Lunaro for more than 5 seconds, or it will explode. Second, you cannot Bullet Jump with the Lunaro. Doing so drops the Lunaro immediately. These rules encourage teamwork, passing and rebounds to attain victory.

Use your melee attack to check other players. Checking the ball carrier will jar the Lunaro loose. Repeated checking of a player will knock them down for a short time. The Lunaro itself can also be struck, making it dangerous and unstable for a few seconds. Being hit by an unstable Lunaro will knock you down.

Each team's goal has a semi-circle area on the field around it, called the Zone. After scoring, the attacking team must clear the defender's zone. Attackers within the zone will have their Arcatas disabled until they clear out. Play resumes with the Lunaro dropping from the defender's zone. Only the beginning and halftime Lunaro drops occur at center field.

Now... practice in this empty arena. Familiarize yourself with the Arcata's launching and attracting modes. Practice scoring, rebounding and checking. Prepare yourself, Tenno, for the glory of the Lunaro!

Lunaro. Ancient sport of the lost Orokin Era. Here, on this abandoned field, Tenno will come together in the spirit of honor and teamwork to resurrect this forgotten tradition. Let me explain how it works...

Lunaro is a team game, played on a field divided into two halves: Sun and Moon. The objective is simple: Get the ball, called a "Lunaro", through the opponent's goal at the opposite end of the arena. The team with the most points by the end of the match wins the game.

Good passing is crucial to winning Lunaro. When aiming near a teammate you will see a chevron appear over them. Tapping pass with this chevron up will automatically pass to that player. Keep in mind it is still possible to intercept a pass, but a passed Lunaro moves faster and more accurately to a receiver than a standard launch.

Getting the Lunaro through the opponents goal is worth one point. If the goal is scored from outside the defender's zone, an additional point is given. If the Lunaro is unstable during the goal, an extra point is also awarded.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon002: I'm impressed. You're taking to the game as sharp does to steel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon003: Victory is yours… but always be humble in this win, giving honor to those you defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc: This ship is disintegrating. Aborting mission, get to extraction.
Sorry, ship integrity will not permit extraction at this time.
You only have one chance. Ordis, deploy Archwing.
Tenno, you need to get to the other side of this debris-field where Ordis can safely extract you.
Tenno, you have to keep moving.
Operator, the Archwing is performing beyond expectations, I suppose my calibration process was not necessary after all.
You're almost through the debris field. Just a little bit further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt: The Orokin Archive has led us to this location. Defend the extractors until you find an Archwing part blueprint.
That's it, you found an Archwing part blueprint. Head to extraction when you are ready.
Oh my, the Operator has returned with an Archwing part blueprint. You must forge it immediately. It won't be long now until you're flying through the skies like a ---- winged death machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQInb: This is the master blueprint for the Odonata Archwing, the first of many Archwings. To complete it you must find its component parts. Unfortunately, an ancient Orokin archive detailing the locations of the parts was recently stolen by the Corpus. Your first job is to recover this archive. Hurry, the Archwing needs to be ready before the Balor Fomorians launch their first attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab: You found the Orokin Archive. You are one step closer to unleashing the Archwing.

The Corpus have snuck into the void and secured crucial Orokin archives detailing the hidden locations of much needed Archwing parts. Your mission is two-fold, cut off their access to the Void and recover the data.
Get to the portal. We need to shut the Corpus out of the void before we search for the Orokin Archive.
That's it, the portal has collapsed. I've located the cache containing the Orokin Archive. Get there now.
Good work, you collapsed the portal. Extraction is now ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi: The Operator has all the necessary blueprints to craft an Archwing ---- so what are you waiting for?
Ordis does hope to see the Archwing soon.

Congratulations, you've crafted an Archwing. Now I must commence calibration. So much to do, by my calculations this process will take ---- three hundred and seventy two hours ---- Oh, that does seem like a long time…

Tenno. This is an urgent mission. A Corpus scout ship with information about the location of the Grineer Balor Fomorians has been located. Raid this ship for intel, we need to know everything they do.

I'm confused… I thought I was…
I'm confused… I thought I was…
I'm confused… I thought I was…
I'm confused… I thought I was…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb: No self, no sense, no death. Just a metal puppet, dangling on Tenno strings. Only the Tenno's death will end your despair.
All your dread-long life, you've waited for this moment...

...you know the answer. You still hate them… you still hate… yourself.
Shadow, only the Tenno's death will end your despair.

but of what you want to be.
