Welcome to the flotilla, Hotshot. Got a name for ya: Erra. Remember it. One of the primary Sentient intelligences from the Old War. Right now waves of his 'Murex' ships are massin' in the Veil. From there, those Murex launch swarms of info-gatherin' Condrix dropships: recon data for the main event. That's why you're here, mate. Fighting off a Sentient invasion is precisely what you were built for. We don't know how to kill one of those big bastards, but me and my network reckon we can give it a muckin' lobotomy. Gonna require a little coordination to work, real hand-in-glove, yeah? Ground teams to hit the Condrix and Railjack teams to mess up the Murex. OpLinks tie the whole lot together. So, buy and equip an OpLink. Then take your pick, mate: upstairs or down?

It's a two-prong attack. Ground team hits the Condrix and swipes their recon data before it beams back to the Murex. We take that friendly data and use it as a Trojan horse for toxic data - think of it as a Kill Code. The Railjack team boards the Murex and broadcasts those Kill Codes right into the Murex's noggin', muckin' up its thinker and making it wanna run home to Daddy. Threat neutralized. Clear as mud? Get to it.

I deal with all sorts: low-breeds and the high-born. Everyone wants somethin' they're not s'posed to have. But these days it's a buyer's market. And what's sellin' is stuff that'd get a girl buried. Sentient stuff. And it's been comin' in by the wagonload. My crowd had these Murex rumbled months ago. Back then old mate Teshin wasn't havin' it. Tried warnin' him, but... you know the type. But now? Oh, NOW it's all "tell me all that you know" and "your expertise is required" and "I'm a hoity-toity sod with a hat like a designer bedpan." Shoulda kept me trap shut. I'm no general. But, here we are and I know what I know. So you listen to what I have to say and we'll all be home in time for tea. Yeah… no worries.

Hey there hotshot. Look, I won't beat around the topiary: the Sentients are massing in the Veil. Zero doubt it's the tickle before the slap. Invasion, mate. I been set up with a relay. Don't ask me how. You've been recruited. Tell you why when you get here. And if you got anythin' you been meanin' to say to someone, maybe say it now.
No prisoners. The only interrogations will be autopsies.
Kill the Sentients. Kill the Tenno. Kill them all.
Trespassers? Die!
These Tau vermin are a Tenno ruse.
Grineer, make these Sentients wish they'd stayed in Tau.
Sentients and Tenno. Today we correct two Orokin mistakes.
Tenno, why have you brought these things here?
I blame the Tenno. I blame them for everything.
Tenno - we should set aside our differences and work together... HAHAHAHA NEVER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/: You… You escaped. But how?
Unreal. You survived. Come find me in the relay.
Tenno, you finished the canvases. Wow. Find me on the relay.
All of the Shadowgraphs have been painted. Just as Master Kozai once did.
Look at all that Atramentum.
With every trip you take into the Shadowgraph I learn so much.
You've freed the truth Tenno.
I will learn much with this Atramentum.
Master Kozai would be proud of you.
Did you… finish all the Shadowgraphs. I can hardly believe it.
I thought you were gone… but now you're back.
Good work. Come find me in the relay.
You survived. How do I thank you?
All done.
See how it shines?
I hope it's satisfactory.
As requested.
I think this turned out well!
I'm sorry, but I can't do anything without Chromatic Atramentum.
You'll need some Chromatic Atramentum to turn a mod into an Atragraph.
If you have any Chromatic Atramentum, I can turn your mods into Atragraphs. It won't change their function at all, but they'll look a lot different. Worthy of a Tenno.
Okay. Let's begin the inscribing process.
Make sure you paint within the frame. We don't want to be messy.
Relax. Paint what you feel.
The brush is a part of you. Don't fight it. Let it guide you.
There. No need to rush. Let it out a little at a time.
Do your feelings have a shape? Can you paint them a face?
Drip, drip, drip. That's right. Let the paint do the bleeding.
Just let your brush do what it wants. It might surprise you.
Round and round and up and down!
Breathe all of the bad into a big beautiful balloon and… let it go.
It won't do you any good to get cross.
If you don't fight me, then the paint won't fight you.
The paint doesn't care what's real or unreal. You can make it into whatever you need.
Whatever's scaring you, you can turn it into a picture. Then it won't ever be able to get out again, will it?
Breathe in, breathe out. Let the paint flow.
If we need to scream, we don't do it with our mouths. We do it with our pictures.
Fold it over and press, and look! Could that be a pretty Lepidrian, or perhaps a happy Thasmite?
Sometimes you don't know what it's going to be until you've finished.
Brushes are not for chewing. Paint is not for drinking.
No throwing. No flicking.
The smooth white page is listening. Can the paint tell it a story?
What do you see? Can you show me? Can you paint it for me?
There are no wrong answers. I want to see what you see. Just pick up the brush.
Do you feel happy? There are tears in your eyes. Are they happy tears?
You just need to paint. That's all. Everything will be made clear, in time.
Remember, the painting isn't real. Nothing can hurt you.
It's just balloons, nothing to be scared of.
You are seeing all of your bad qualities. Hate, anger, distrust. You are strangling them.
You say you're seeing faces? Whose faces? How many? How many of them have you killed?
Cast the bad thoughts out of your mind and on to the canvas. Out they go. Splish, splash, splosh.
There's no sense in hiding anything away. Secrets will just fester in your skull.
If we had ventured blindly into the Veil, we would never have found Tau. Only through memory can the path be made clear.
My father shattered the Solar Rail, and the Veil erupted in its wake. Whether by accident or design, I cannot know.
Blood will have its due. Every debt must be repaid.
One bears the light of Adis. The other, the hand of Natah. You are adapting to our ways.
Itzam foresaw a future where humans and Sentients would ultimately merge. It seems you have both begun the process.
For better or worse, both of you bear Sentient essence within your bodies. This may impress the denizens of Tau… or enrage them.
Using the Dark Refractory was only ever intended as a last resort. If there had been some other way…
I never intended any of this. I have only ever sought to protect my children.
That I might have been used to hurt my child, however falsely… It will not be forgiven, nor forgotten.
To relive the past… I believed in your strength, then. I still do.
When we find him, it will all be worth it. It cannot be otherwise.
I know I ask much of you. Yet you rise to the challenge, always. What sustains me… it is you.
Do not concern yourself with my fate. I have made peace with my past. Ballas… I no longer think of.
The truth must be faced, especially when it is difficult. I have never doubted you.
Through what we have endured together, I have found singularity of purpose. I trust you will find yours too, in time.
I fear we have only begun to reckon the cost of what has been done.
She would have been proud. She is proud. We are proud.
I'm sure that feels wonderful.
Don't smudge it!
Leave it alone, now. Let it dry.
Such earnest brushwork!
You should feel proud of yourself.
Good, just like that. Let the paint guide you.
You're making progress. I can see it in your brushwork.
There. You can follow instructions. Well done.
Don't forget to take a big breath.
Rinse the brush, now. We need to be clean, don't we?
A moment. Something has come up.
You are still under scrutiny. Make no mistake about that.
I don't know how I'm expected to deal with all of you at once.
We'll just take a little time out, I think.
I'll deal with you later.
Good. Recover your focus.
That's right. Breathe slowly. It was only a hallucination.
Can you please co-operate for longer than two minutes this time?
Let's start over. We have plenty of fresh materials and plenty of time.
You didn't think I'd let a little reject like you get under my skin, did you?
I'll deal with you presently.
You're too old for tantrums.
I am willing to de-escalate if you are.
We will not be requiring the soporific vapours after all.
I will not permit one refractory subject to occupy my entire attention.
I simply do not have the time for this.
Don't let it happen again.
I think you've learned the value of willing co-operation.
Back to your brushwork you go!
Your record is accumulating a lot of nasty blots.
Tenno… What happened?
I see nothing… where are you??
Death must not be the end…
Failure? For you? How?
Disaster.
Tenno… NO!
When we are bad, there are consequences!
I shall call for the Custodians. Then you'll be sorry.
Of all the thoughtless, beastly things you could have done…
The paint is not supposed to go on you.
Oh, you filthy little…
I've been looking everywhere for you!
Did you really think I wouldn't find out? I know everything.
I'm not sure you are worth keeping after all.
If you are not gentle with your implements, do not expect them to be gentle with you.
Let your fear disappear in the strokes of your brush. Watch it run down the canvas. Faster... Faster...
Why are you being so difficult? I'm just trying to help you. You just need to let go.
I know what you've done. The painting makes it clear. I know you better than anyone.
You say they were attacking you? So you killed them all?
And where exactly are you planning to hide?
Very well. We have other, less gentle, methods.
What's wrong? Is it the voices again?
Nothing is coming to hurt you. You are safe.
This absurd behaviour simply has to stop.
If I were in your position I'd be extremely cautious with my behaviour.
I can have you put back in your capsule like that.
You can't run from a guilty conscience. It's in there with you.
Well. You've upset the apple-cart now.
The common factor behind all of your problems is you.
You wanted to provoke a reaction, and now you have. Good for you.
I think we need a reminder of the boundaries.
Now, now. You know this is not how we behave. Try. Again.
Resist all you like. This only ends when I say so.
Now look at what a mess you've made. You'll have to clean this up, you know.
I've been looking everywhere for you!
Where are you going? Therapy is in session.
I have experience dealing with difficult subjects.
You need to be open with me, or we'll never get anywhere.
You'll open up one way or another.
Yes yes, everything must go back to its proper place once we finish. Even the paint.
See? That wasn't so hard. There's nothing to be afraid of.
You can go when you've finished painting. Just relax. It takes as long as it takes.
How does that make you feel? You're becoming quite agitated. Good. We're getting somewhere.
You're further gone than I thought. Quite a severe case.
I am not above resorting to physical restraint.
I think you are being far too exuberant.
Let's get you calmed down.
That did not need to happen.
Never mind. Pick yourself up and try again.
How did that make you feel?
If it's not hurting it's not working.
This is a development you will have to process in your own time.
Nobody has any sympathy for you.
Oh yeah? I can scream just as loudly as you.
Oh no you don't.
I know what you're capable of. So I am taking no chances.
I am the Archimedean. You are the subject.

Five sealed letters. That's all Arbiter Kozai left me in the world. Why would he do that, when he knows I can't read? He promised to teach me the sacred script of Hexis. But he never did. And now he's gone.
I can read the first letter now! It's really short. Here goes. 'Work hard. Study… far? No. Study long. Good Zorba. Happy Kozai.'
Letter number two. 'Zorba. Kozai has work to do. Teach… I don't know this word. Teach… blobby thing? …truth. Learn truth too. Much change. Big surprise.' Ah… okay?

Third letter. 'Follie is not evil. Follie is… a teller of truths. I taught her Hexis stories. You are learning and she is learning. She makes my stories into… pictures. You must make her ink into words.'

'I have learned something of Follie's own truth. She was not always as you see her now. Once she was a painter of hidden truths, bringing secrets to light for healing's sake. But others sought to… um… crooked line… warp? Twist? Pervert her gifts. She was put in service to cruel masters.'

'The… sky-ogres? Wait. Fomorians. The Fomorians will be here soon. I will give these letters to our Preceptory Cephalon. We shall not meet again, my student, my friend. I must keep Follie safe. If you are reading this, you will understand why, and with what reason we should revere Follie as a Holy Fool, one of the Saints of Truth. I am confident you will be a just and wise Arbiter of Hexis.'
There, Follie's Shadowgraph, a window into a dark soul that my Master only barely escaped from. Do you understand, Tenno, I am asking you to venture into its darkness?

Vesper Relay! Not as it was, but how my Master described it when he ventured into Follie's art. Kozai said he was only able to escape by finishing the stories. Did he mean the Shadowgraphs? I don't know.
Master Kozai told of being pulled into Follie's Shadowgraph… Of being hunted by truth unvarnished. Now I ask you to submit yourself to the very same Shadowgraph.
This is it, by some Void madness Follie's Shadowgraph survived Vesper's annihilation. Confront its shadows.
This Shadowgraph may have gotten my Master killed, but with its Atramentum…  I can finally read a few characters of the Hexis script. I ask you once again, confront Follie, and find more Atramentum.
Instead of teaching how to read the sacred Hexis script, my Master stared into the Shadowgraph all day. Why? What insights do you have?
This wretched 'Shadowgraph' and whatever lies within are responsible for my Master's disappearance. See what you can do.
You return to brave the Shadowgraph again! If only I had your courage…
You've returned to Follie. The Arbiters have never doubted your resolve, Tenno.
I grow weary of the prospect of finding my Master alive. I take solace in deciphering his letters with the Atramentum hidden within the Shadowgraph. You will find more for me, yes?
Master Kozai said he communed with Follie's work daily. I am starting to understand that he was communicating with Follie herself, telling her his story. Uncover it.
When I see Follie I see anger, confusion, disarray. What possible virtue could my Master Kozai have seen in this monster?
With each trip you take into the Shadowgraph I understand the old script more and more.
Just as it takes many strokes to fell a tree, it may take many inquiries to reach the truth. I salute your persistence.
What does all this matter when my Master is gone? No, I must not entertain such thoughts, Kozai would not encourage that.

Every time you stare into the Shadowgraph you see something new. It's the same with my Masters letters, I keep rereading and I keep finding new insights. Don't stop now, Tenno. I need to read them all.
Master Kozai always said that before I could learn the sacred script, I had to learn to see. I think the Atramentum is helping me see.
Back again? Careful Tenno, my Master also couldn't refuse the Shadowgraphs pull. And we know where that left him.
Once more you prove your tenacity. I will be just as persistent in my own studies!
Why does Follie not want her canvas finished? Why does she protect those stories?
The Shadowgraph cannot be conquered, it can only be escaped.
I understand now. Kozai told Follie his story, she saw his truth, and now she protects it. Forgive her. She knows not your noble intentions.
Back again, Tenno? Because you know, like I now do, that there is no truth without struggle.
You are drawn to the Shadowgraph, aren't you? To Follie? That's why you keep coming back.
The Shadowgraph, you can't look away, can you? Just like Master Kozai. Please, Tenno, be more careful than he.
You need to enter the painting. There is no going back now, Tenno.
The painting is truth, face it.
How did Follie's painting ever survive?
The Arbiters of Hexis will never forgive Vay Hek for his desecration of Vesper Relay.
Vesper Relay took a direct hit from a Fomorian, how did that Shadowgraph even survive?!
So, devil, you choose the harder path. As always.
Hurry, find paint and finish the Shadow-
Go now. Before she finds you-
There are three canvases waiting to-
The canvases are the way out, find paint and finish them.
Move now, time is of the essence-
Follie's on the hunt-
Follie is here, you cannot kill her, but you can outsmart her. Finish her canvases-

Tenno. This ink… it's forming letters by itself! I make words in my head, and it just flows, and next minute I'm looking at the sacred script of Hexis! Every time I think of the same word it makes the same shapes. All I have to do is remember what it's showing me!

Tenno, I'm sorry, but I'm going to need you to bring me a lot more ink. I went a little crazy thinking of different things and the ink made words every time but I don't remember them now and the ink's all gone. I'm going to try copying what it shows me. That way it might stay in my head.

It's working, Tenno. I've got all these different words in my head now and I can write them down any time I like. Could you keep bringing me ink? I don't think Follie minds. I think… she meant this to happen.

Did you know you can write the same thing in totally different ways? Like, if you're writing to someone important you're meant to put these extra curls and lines on the word to show respect? I think I only need a little more ink, Tenno. I'm almost done.
Tenno… it's done. I can read it all now. Even the fragments from the years before the Ordering. Now I can finally read what Kozai wanted to tell me. Thank Follie for me, would you?

Revered Tenno, my mentor, Arbiter Kozai, is gone. They tell me he is dead, but I reject these lies. Kozai faced down the Wolf of Saturn Six alone! Such a man does not just perish like a dog.

You must think this strange, but I beg you: travel to the wreckage of Vesper Relay. There we will search for the Truth.

Aspirant Zorba

Revered Tenno, I can't go to the wreck of Vesper Relay, it's too dangerous for a mere aspirant like me, but I want… no, I need to see Follie's Shadowgraph again. 

To make that happen, I need Nightmare Tatters. Find them on Vesper Relay and also in what you call Nightmare missions. These shreds are remnants of Follie's art. I think if we collect enough of those, we can reproduce a copy of her work right here in the relay. Then everyone can safely see it.

Will you help me do that?

I must tell you a difficult Truth. Arbiter Kozai left an important task undone. It was his duty to teach me the sacred script of Hexis, but he never did, despite my struggles. So you see, we must find him. How else am I to read the letters he sent?
The Red Veil think they are senior to us! What do they know of what we know?
Arbitration is a privilege reserved for developed minds. Senseless beasts do not deserve it.
Forgive me if I tremble in your presence, Tenno.
I have seen you walking these Relays so many times. To think you would one day speak to me!
The Arbiters know well that the Tenno are not their Warframes. You are noble. They are beasts.
I cannot be certain that asking for your aid was the right thing to do. But Kozai always said the first step to becoming an Arbiter is to credit your own judgement.
Other relays have been rebuilt, but never Vesper. I wonder what they knew.

There are many forms of Arbitration! You probably know those in which we test your fitness through combat, but you might also be tested in poetic composition or the serving of the Bitter Tea! Please forgive my enthusiasm. I forgot my place.

"And the voice cried out in pride, saying: who are you mites, that you presume to judge an Executor? But the company of Hexis answered and said: we are kin to those millions you have oppressed, and before tomorrow dawns we shall see justice done."
I would read to you from the Pronouncements of Hexis, as tradition demands, but I am, uh, unable to at present.
I wanted to be an Arbiter from the day I first saw one.
Arbiters walk the dust road. We mediate between any who seek our counsel.
We are more than a Syndicate. Our inmost circles hold truths hidden even from the Tenno.
The Tenno of old entrusted the first Arbiters with their secrets, to guard them during the Long Sleep. We have been comrades for lifetimes.
We have always known that you Tenno were more than weapons.
If the Lotus had ever failed you, if her nature had betrayed her, we Arbiters would have stood ready to guide you.
The Orokin only saw your usefulness. We saw your humanity.
The Arbiters were not always as we are now. At times we were little more than a cult who dreamed the Tenno would return and rule as god-kings. It is an ugly truth, but it must be spoken.
The world is told that we go masked because justice is impartial. To you we may speak the truth: we hide our true faces because we follow the Tenno example.

And it is written: "The Tenno shall in time rule in place of the Orokin, but despite their great honour they shall be like unto youths, immature and driven by intemperate passions. Such princelings shall have sore need of seasoned adults to mediate between them. Be ye then Arbiters, bound by the covenant of Hexis."
Kozai was telling Follie our sacred parables. And she understood them.
"In his compassion, worthy Malloc allowed his beloved Kubrows to devour him, knowing that his greatest gift was his own self."
The Hawk and the Snake is one of our oldest tales. The mouse tricks them into arguing over which has the greater right to eat him.
I rushed to judgement without reflection, Tenno. A blunder as foolish as rushing into combat without armor.
Master Kozai must have known I would come looking for him. He meant this to be a lesson.
Kozai and Follie weren't trying to kill one another. They were both learning. Observing.
I feel like I have stared and stared at a meaningless mess of ink until I suddenly saw a picture.
Every culture has a name for them. The Ostrons have the Kapush-Ri, the dustbelters the Magroons, perhaps even the Jesters of the Grineer. Sacred fools who may speak truths which others cannot.
Tenno, I believe I have misjudged Follie. If I am wrong, then chances are I am sending you to join Master Kozai in death. But I cannot deny what I see.
I wanted Kozai to be a hero. I wanted Follie to be a monster. But the Truth does not care about what we want, does it?
Kozai always promised he would teach me my letters. I thought he had forgotten.
To hold the Pronouncements of Hexis in my hand, to read the words that were written down thousands of years ago… it is a gift.
Every day I write to my brothers at the Preceptory and dust down the page with the sacred sands, just as all Aspirants before me have done.
One day I may preside over your Arbitration, and grant you temporary mortality! What an honor that would be!
You have granted me an honor rare even among Arbiters: to know the true face of a Tenno.
Kozai said that truth is like salt, bringing both pain and cleansing. I used to think that was why tears are salty.
I admit I was afraid to begin our journey together, Tenno. Now I am afraid for it to end. Would you like me to write to you?
You're still visiting Follie? Good, good. It must be lonely on that wreckage.
I wonder why we so often see monsters and terrors in the random noise of an inkblot? I suppose it has something to do with how we evolved. We are built to fear.
The day Vesper Relay died… she must have been so scared. I mean no disrespect, Tenno, but I wish more of you had fought against Vay Hek that day.
This is what we've salvaged from the wreckage of the Relay.
Maybe these offerings will help.
I wish I could offer you more.
I hope these help our search for Truth.
Here, Tenno. For what it may be worth.
I wish I could be of more help.
Kozai wanted that Shadowgraph preserved. I wish I knew why.
The Arbiters wish to express their thanks.
I hope this is suitable compensation.
I am seeing details in the Shadowgraph I never knew were there.

By some miracle I can only attribute to lua or the Void, Follie's Shadowgraph survived the destruction of Vesper Relay. Only, the blast left the work in desperate need of restoration. That's where you come in, Tenno, all of you. With every trip the Tenno take into the Shadowgraph, you do your part in restoring the work to its former glory. However horrifying that may be.
Go and deliver judgement.
Make that creature bleed.
No mercy.
Please, make haste.
Thank you, Tenno, once again.
We will find him. I know it.
For the Truth!
I am in your debt.
We have much left to discover.
The search continues.
Thank you.
I wish I could go with you.
What possessed Kozai to seek Truth in a clown's playground?
Together, we will find a way to kill that thing.
The teachings of Hexis tell of how strong Warframes were. You are proving them true.
Kozai is alive somewhere in that madhouse. We must persist!
Slaying that 'Follie' monstrosity will be a mercy, Tenno.
Kozai communed with that Shadowgraph every day. You must find out why.
If that grotesque Orokin mistake somehow overcame Kozai, we shall make an example of it.
You have returned alive, Tenno! Praise the Void!
Keep bringing me the Atramentum, friend Tenno. She has no right to it.
I can hear her filthy laughter in my dreams. Well, we shall see who laughs last.
The Orokin were cruel indeed, to make such a wicked joke of a Warframe.
Be wary, Tenno. With her ink she will blind you to the Truth, like some squalid, stinking creature of the deep.
Tenno! I was afraid you had abandoned me. Deservedly.
Kozai knew better than I, didn't he? Perhaps it is I who have been blind.
The truth we are uncovering is not what I hoped to find, Tenno. But what does truth care for hope?
I had thought Follie a monster. But Kozai called her a teller of truths.
I hated Follie from the outset, Tenno. I should have been honest about why.
The other aspirants threw ink over me when I could not learn my letters. I was certain Follie knew, and she was mocking me.
I sent you in to kill a monster, Tenno. Thank the Void that you did not.
Can there really be eternal Truth… in a joke?
Kozai is dead, Tenno, and it is for the best. For he shall never see my shame.
I was so certain of my own judgement. I could not have been more wrong!
One hunts another, round and around, forever. I thought it was a nightmare, but it was only ever meant to be a game.
I was blinded by pride, Tenno. Thank the Void we have another chance.
Are you ready for another dip into the merry maze, Tenno?
And what drops of Follie's wisdom do you bring me today?
It is always good to see you, my steadfast friend.
Let us hope her ink never runs dry.
They will tell my tale in years to come. Zorba the Fool, and Follie the Wise.
I was staring at the truth with open eyes, and yet I could not see it.
We Arbiters think our judgement is so perfect. We need a little more humility.
Very well.
I shall wait.
If you are sure.
Ah. Understood.
Right now I'm just an aspirant, but someday… Someday I'll be an Arbiter. And my feet will tread the sacred ground of the Preceptory.
The search continues.
Master Kozai wouldn't just sit around, I need to think, what would he do.
If only I could go to Vesper Relay.
Tenno? Did you make it to Vesper Relay?
Some people say that all these relays look the same… but not to me. They all have their quirks.
Another day, another relay.
Tenno, do you have a moment to hear about the Arbiters of Hexis?
Master Kozai spent years as an aspirant, standing outside this door, studying his letters. I will learn how to read the ancient script, one way or another.
The Tenno are so much more than merely warriors! Do you want to learn more?
Hey Tenno, did you know my Master? If you have time, I have stories.
Master Kozai always said, being an Aspirant is a beginning, not an end. I hope he was right.
If I could just get some more Atramentum…
Excellent.
A fair exchange.
Done.
As you wish.
Jolly good! Another facet of yourself committed to ink.
Yes, I can see now. I can see you. Keep painting. We need to go deeper.
See? That wasn't so hard. There's nothing to be afraid of.
Is this really what you see? Fascinating. Go on.
You think the paint looks like blood? Look deeper. Tell me more.
You're seeing vibrations. The ones between everything. Excellent.
Wonderful. Painting by painting, we grow closer to your truth.
Keep drawing it to the surface. All of it. Every feeling you have ever felt.
You might not understand what you have painted… but I do.
You just keep on painting. I shall tell you what it all means.
And there it all is, laid out as plain as day.
Look at what you did. Just look.
I think you're beginning to understand.
Yes, you had better rest now.
Take this one back to storage. We're done for now.
Subject is stabilised. Return to cryo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC: My bags are packed, I'm all set to leave. I can't believe I'll be working with one of my childhood heroes, Archimedean Margulis! On comms she said she needed the best Infestation biologist there was… I think my knees almost gave out!

As I log this, I'm looking out the stained plastic of my field tent into the dead-yellow sky of Earth. I smell the vague sulphur and toxins leaking through the seals, yet somehow I'm going to miss this place. Leaving her feels like I'm giving up on my dream. My dream to see green and blue return to this sick and dying mother of us all.

But I'm frustrated with my lack of progress. I've tried everything to accelerate the ailing vegetation, to guide and nurture the soil, but nothing comes of it. I need a change. Now I have that opportunity… and thanks to Margulis, I'm relieved I won't be drafted into some Orokin War Project.

My childhood dream has become a nightmare. I don't blame Margulis, she's as much a victim as the children we're working with. At first, the project seemed therapeutic and nurturing. I was myself. But now… Transference therapy is being turned into a weapon. Now I build these vile weapons called "Warframes" all for one purpose: death. I've become everything I hate.
I long for the discomfort of my damp tent. The sick, aimless trees… the barren soil… I know I left my soul behind back there.

Titania is the next Warframe I've been commanded to build, but in secret I've been siphoning resources from the project. I have an idea. A way back to that wounded land I call home. A way for me to forget this war and remember what I was.

Ballas is beyond pleased… but when I look at what I've built… at Titania, I feel sick creep up my throat. I hate her, a killer made by a healer. No more. I'm going back to where I belong, no matter the cost. I'm going back to the trees to find myself again.

These past weeks, I've been secretly testing Transference on myself. I can only survive short bursts - linking to Titania the way only Tenno can stand. I've never felt anything like it. A tortured presence, like an evil ink, staining my mind. But… it worked. I'm going to use this wrong to make right.

I'll stowaway with Earth-bound cargo. Just my Apothics and these slapdash Somatics I've stolen. By nightfall I'll be home again in a my tent under those bitter, acid skies. This time I'm going to fix it. I will seed a mighty forest, stronger than history… and by my will, use it to bring life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI: Do you know of the Silver Grove, Earth's oldest and most pure forest? It is home to our most sacred shrine. We've learned that the Grineer, those twisted abominations, are planning to build a factory on it. Grineer Scorch units have been deployed, intent on turning our blessed Silver Grove to ash. Generations ago we recovered an Apothic recipe at the Shrine… we believe it will reawaken the forest's legendary defenses. Gather the ingredients and deliver the Apothic to the heart of the shrine. You are the only hope for the Silver Grove and the natural purity it represents.
Are you ready to help our Silver Grove? We need the Apothic to awaken its defenses! Scour the System and find the plants we need.
Apothics? Forest defenses? - typical New Loka Kavat-sh- I suppose anything is possible… I've inspected this Apothic, there's an encoded message attached.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP: The ingredients you seek will not be easy to come by. They grow in some of the System's most hostile environments. You can see why we turned to you for help.
Frostleaf, a delightful herb with many healing properties, too bad it only grows on the iciest of planets, you're likely to catch pneumonia trying to forage it.
Have you found any Vestan Moss? Neither have we, but our scholars theorize that it could thrive in damp, cold rocks, away from the light of the sun.
Ruk's Claw, we had one of these plants in our greenhouse once, but a new recruit overwatered it. We haven't found any since.
The Dusklight Sarracenia grows best in absolute filth. I mean, one-hundred percent pollution. Poisonous air and water. Really, what kind of plant thrives in those conditions? Lovely name, though.
Ah, Lunar Pitcher, a flower that thrives on moonlight but alas, without any moon, we fear it went extinct long ago. We've searched everywhere on Earth for it, where else would it grow?
You must hurry, Tenno, Grineer fires burn ever closer to the Shrine.

Earth's oldest forest is populated with the first trees that evolved a resistance to Orokin bondage. The rest of Earth is polluted with the monstrosities of their genetic tinkering, but these trees are pure. When we finally reseed Earth, it will be with these specimens.
The Silver Grove, in all the Operator's missions on Earth, Ordis has not scanned an area quite so- magical, - unique.
You have created the second Apothic, this is the path to an Earth unmarred by exploitation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS: How is it that a Specter came to be in this most sacred Shrine? Could this be a vestige of some earlier Orokin incursion?
Operator, the Codex system just pulled another voice entry from that Apothic. Allow Ordis to display it for you.
The Silver Grove is a pure and sacred force, why would it be vandalized with such a message?
This new Codex message. This changes everything.

I… I can't believe this. The Silver Grove isn't natural at all… It's just another abomination, made by some delusional Archimedean. It was lies. I'm ashamed our ancestors worshipped such impurity. This can never get out. I'm done here. If the Grineer want to destroy the Silver Grove, let them.

What a dogmatic, - idiot - perspective! Operator, you are a product of similar meddling and yet you are good. Your actions have meant more than your origins. Ordis believes we must complete our mission.
Trapped by Transference inside a tree… hmm… I guess she loved trees so much that she became one! Did the Operator enjoy this witticism?
Trapped by Transference inside a tree? Saved by the one you hate… Operator, that was kind of a… a… sappy story. Another pun? How humiliating.

The Silver Grove was planted with the rotted seeds of the Orokin, corrupt in the eyes of our doctrine. Our tenets command us to reject it, but how can we? Silvana longed to restore Earth's former glory, just as we do. 
 
 If we are to see Earth restored, perhaps New Loka itself must change? I will convince them to see Silvana's creation for the miracle it is. Some will call that heresy, but it is true, and truth is the purest thing we have.
Ahhhhh, the Silver Grove. Can you feel the purity? Beyond, all is contaminated, toxic. But here, everything is pure, original. That's why your mission is so important. Can we risk losing this?
Our Shrine is nearby. Search around, I'll let you know when I can feel its energy.
Here! You're close. I can feel it, can you see any narrow openings?
I think this is… Yes, yes, you're very close now, look for a small opening in the rocks.
You're almost there. Look for a passageway.
I can't sense the Shrine any longer, you have moved too far away.
You're moving further from the Shrine.
Here, can you feel it? You found the Shrine. Anoint it with your Apothic.
Silver Grove, forgive this Warframe on your sacred soil? By water, by sky, by holy humanity, bless our mission to defend you.
No disrespect, Tenno, but I had to ask forgiveness from the Grove. Carrying out this mission with a Warframe is a bit of a… contradiction for us.
What... do... you... think... you're... doing?
The sun in my skin… my voice is the wind. I'm lost… in this soil. Why?
Did you hear that? Unbelievable, the Grove, it speaks! My heart… Wait… a new Apothic! We will learn its recipe, forage its ingredients. The Grove needs this. New Loka needs this. It's time to… Wait-
Intruder! You should not be here.
We are pure and true! Forgive our intrusion. Will you accept our protection?
The Silver Grove must be confused about our pure and holy intentions. This new object may hold the key to making it understand.
You're just in time. They're choking the forest with their flames. You must reach the Shrine before they do. Oh, Tenno, why do they hate everything not born of their disgusting flesh factories?
There is something different about this place, but Ordis is not quite sure what it is.
You… hateful abomination. Get. Out. Now.
Titania, is that you? Where have you been… I'm… fading… please, wake me again.
This is not right! Get out now. We don't know what we're dealing with anymore. This could be some sort of Orokin sentry.
Who is this creature we've woken? The Silver Grove is timeless, this voice seems… human.
Titania? Have you returned to protect me once more? The last Apothic, quickly, please.
The fire infects me, I am fueling my own destruction. Titania, stop them!
A mind within the forest? This is an abomination. Let it burn!
Child of truth, you reject me but are blind to our shared purpose. Would you rather this world, a wasteland, in spite of me?
I… I don't know. This goes against everything I believe.
Truth has a way of doing that.
Give me the final Apothic, I need clarity to fight back.
There, that's it, the clarity… And now I realize you're not my beloved Titania, but another like her that has come to protect me.
Beware! Titania's old guardians will still attack. I have no will over them.
I am grateful, but the workers are here with their torches and violence. I will fight them the best I can… You have just a moment to escape.
No. We won't leave you. Tenno, ready yourself. I was wrong. We can't let this beautiful place burn.
You, you fight with the same determination she did.
I'm… I'm getting control. Hold on. I can help too.
That's… that's it… Thank you, whoever you are. I am Silvana, welcome to my forest.
Forgive me, Silvana, I doubted you. I thought you were just another Orokin poison.

I once thought the same of Warframes. When the Orokin found out what I had done here, they sent their Dax upon the great trees. Upon me. As the skies grew hot and my roots split into cinder, I let out a deep earthen-scream. I was dying. And then suddenly I felt a familiar presence…

One by one, the mighty Dax began to fall, swatting hopelessly at some unseen menace. Others were snared, drifting upward in a mesmerizing light and then, all at once, shredded by that unseen force. When the fires subsided, I knew what it was.

Titania. My shamed creation. I felt her beating wings through my branches. I felt her mortal wounds, her weeping burns as she fell beneath my canopy. And so it was here, within this grove, that she died to save me. Me, the one who had hated her most.
Silvana, by the strength of this Tenno, she will fly again. I swear it.
The forest and myself are in debt to both of you.
Tenno, my readings indicate an increasingly dense neural-network beneath the forest floor. This can only mean one thing^ the Silver Grove is nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc: … got me mixed up with someone…! Wait a minute.
Uuugh. Finally. And with that…
I am in your debt. Now, let's… oh what now?
Thanks. Time for me t'go.
I'm gonna kill all a ya fridge-faced…! Wait a minute.
Right. Let's crack some… hang about…
AAAH!  AAAH!
… wait, wait, wait, wait! Wait.
Agh, thank the Void! You're the best, Tenno! THE BEST!
Charmed.
Ha HA! NO PRISON CAN HOLD ME!
For a horrible moment that looked like becoming a career. Thanks.
Whenever we get off this tub I owe you a drink.
Hey, I know you. One of Eudico's crew? Cheers.
Handily done. Now, for the hard part.
Much obliged.
Ah, lovely.
And not a moment too soon. Right. Now to get off this tub.
Thanks. Need to adjust a few things, then I'm goin' after these hosers widebore.
Never caught your name but I never forget a face. I'll owe you one, pal.
Now for phase 2. I assume there's a phase 2?
Solaris United forever, me old mate!
Much obliged.
Thanks, old mate. I owe you one.
Lucky me. Front row seat to watch you work. Do lead on, mate.
Let's party.
Oh yes. Still on the right side of the grass. MMM'WAH.
Thank the Void. So, uh, now what?
Now to get out of here. How do I get out of here?
I'm allergic to lead. Pain. Death.
Free! I should probably surrender.
Free! Now what do I do?
Welp, no going back now...
Aah! Oh crud! Thank you! I thought I was gonna die here!
Well. This isn't exactly how I imagined going out.
Guts. No worries. We've gotten out of worse. Noooo worries.

Let's be jovial
Fill our glasses!
Madness 'tis for us to think
How the world is ruled by asses
Nef could drive a saint to drink!
HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY!
I am so bored.
A little help?
Easy repayments they said...
Well… here's hoping one of Ticker's angels cast their eyes this way. Or I am boned.
I always said I'd give a lung to get off Fortuna. Looks like someone was listening.
Well. I've been left hanging before but this is ridiculous.
I knew I should have invested in quick-release joints.
Well, this is a hell of a time to develop an itch.
Hm. Reinforced duranium bindings.
I'm gettin' outta here. And when I do? Oh mate. When I do...
Heh. Yeah. Scared 'em real good.
These clowns are one mistake away from me doing something they'll regret… for about two seconds.
Emptying my kit was a mistake, lads. Just gives me something to carry your heads in!
The next one a you bastards comes in here is leavin' with a new nickname!
Info? Oh I'll give ya info. Info ya never wanted. Like knowin' the taste a yer own spleen!
No-good low-down fridge-faced pack a mother-lovin' muck-suckin' dump-humpers.
Right. If I'm outta here in 30 seconds yer all dead. If I'm not outta here in 30 seconds you'll all wish you were!
I'm sure an opportunity to escape will come along any second now.
Oh. We are really adrift this time. Okay. O-kay. Stay calm. Stay calm.
Heeey… Hey? Listen. I think there's been a mistake?
I knew I shouldn't have left my section this morning. I knew it. I knew it.
It's repo for me for sure. Uh. Um. Ah crap.
Uuuuuh. Aaah.
Happy place. Happy place. I don't have a happy place!
All I can think about is all the things I'll never do. Like… NOT GETTING CAPTURED! HEEEELP!
Look. I'm no hero, okay! I'll talk! I'll never stop talking! Just try and shut me up!
Hey! You seem reasonable. I am reasonable. Let's be reasonable!
Oh! Hey. Hey! Mate? Would you mind? The restraints? Little help?
Hey. Hey! Pop these locks, yeah? Escape a the century, mate! Escape a the century!
Oi! While you're rubbernecking think maybe you could pop these locks? I need to be havin' a word with me "loyal" crew.
Psst! Reckon you could see your way towards y'know? Locks?
Well met! Intros later. Controls are over there.
Oh! Well. This is a little awkward, but... would you mind helping a lady down from here?
Oh. Hello. Move along, nothing to see here. Ha! I'm kidding, of course. Get me the hell down.
Ah! About time! So what are you? Ticker, Solaris U, my crew hired you or am I just a lucky, lucky girl?
Oh at last! I feel like I was born in this thing. The controls are over there.
What? Who are you? Clearly not Corpus. Good enough for me. Get me the hell off this thing.
Hey, old mate. Let a cove down, yeah?
Tenno. 'Bout time. Let's wreck the joint. You an' me!
Nice. Switch is over there. Let's do this.
You're a sight for dodgy optics. Pop that lock and let's take some heads.
Hey. Howsabout you pop these locks and let a brother stretch his… fists?
Ha! Ah yeah. Here we go. Control's over there, Tenno.
Oi. Pop these locks sharpish, chek?
I never take charity but if Ticker sent ya… I'll make an exception this once.
Hm. Nice ta meet a fellow soldier. Control's over there.
Oi! Tenno. Here on business or pleasure? Pop these locks wouldja?
Hey. HEY! Ya gotta let me down so I can clear this up, chekchek?
Don't hurt me! Oh, wait.
Ah! I can explain everything! Wait, you're not Corpus. Did Ticker send you?
Hey, I'll do whatever you want, okay? Just flick that switch over there.
Hey! Listen. They're gonna do somethin' REAL bad to me. You gotta get me outta here.
Hey! HEY! Pleasepleaseplease just get me down from here, okay? They could be back at any moment!
Hey! Friend? Me old cove? Let a fella down, would you? Switch over there?
Oh! OH! A Tenno. Oh I'm glad to see you! You gotta get me down from here, me ol' mucker! You gotta get me down!
Tenno? TENNO?! Oh yes! YES! Help me. Helpmehelpmehelpmehelpme! Help me. HELP ME!
Oh! Oh thank the Void! Thank the Voooooid…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D: Welcome aboard, Operator! --Operators?! This is a Sigma Series RailJack… a multi-crew Interceptor! Engineering, Tactical, Weapon systems all await your command.
I have locked on to an Obelisk in Orbit… high above the Vallis… Awaiting launch sequence. Are you ready for this?

There are many emergency exits aboard this spacecraft, Operator! Please take note of the one nearest you. In the unlikely event of a violent decompression, safety lights will illuminate in the floor to guide you.
Rough air ahead, we're in for some chop.
Ascent complete, Operator, you have the helm.
Enemy Capital in this sector. Be advised: They have alerted the fleet. Reinforcements are inbound.
Hull damage! Get them off us!
Operator, fleet reinforcements converging on this sector. We must complete the mission before they arrive.
Fleet reinforcements are imminent! T-minus 2 minutes!
1 minute until reinforcements arrive. We need to get out of here!
Shield coil located, you will need to infiltrate and disable it from within.
My interceptors will take good care of you Tenno.
They're onboard??? In the name of profit, cast them to oblivion!
Ready my emergency skiff. The Void still has plans for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu: This Sacred Rail must be protected.
Leave this place or be returned to the Void.
I am a Warden of the Solar Rails. I am your death.
Only the sacred may pass. Heathens will perish.
How dare you enter my home? I guard the Rail with my shadow-life.
The Solar Rails bind our System. I will not see it undone.
Are you seeking a return to the Void? Challenge me and find destruction.
I am entrusted to protect this most sacred temple. A pathway into the Void. Flee or be consumed.
I have pledged my shadow-life to defend the Solar Rails.
I will purge your weakness from my Rail.
Another intruder… another corpse for the Void.
Only those worthy may enter. You face certain death to oppose me.
I am a being of the Void. Created to oppose you. Leave now.
Come no further if you value your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla: Oh hello Tenno... why the long face? Worried about your friends? Hmm... it is true that they were unwilling, but rest assured, participation in the Zanuka project is a very prestigious honor.
Are you sure you can't just let this go? We would make great partners you know. Produce great profits. Hmm... not interested? That's too bad. For you.
Tenno, look. I believe so strongly in my Zanuka prototype that I'm willing to give you a demo. It will be quite the opportunity, most people don't get to see the future... before they die.
With Alad V taken care of, no more Tenno will be sacrificed in the name of his progress. Our operatives are recovering those still held within V's labs. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard: We've got two families: biological and logical. Roky taught me that one. Star Day is for both those families... and anyone else besides.

'Star Day' is a Ticker tradition... begun for just one special person. Now... I give it to the world. If you want to know the story, you'll find it scattered across the Vallis. Today is too happy a day to tell it.

Two Ostrons are freed during a daring operation, marry, have a child. I'm sure you'll be pleased to know that the young 'Tenno' Helnung is doing quite well and taking after their mother on the scaffolds.
It's trite, but it has to be said: be brave with that heart of yours, Stardust. At the end of the day, those we love are what matters. Don't leave things unsaid.
The only family that extraordinary creatures such as we are permitted is the family whom we choose - and a fine family that is. Here's to us, Stardust.

You raised yourself. You'll have questions, and nobody will be there to answer them. I want you to know: I'm here, Stardust. I won't always have the answer, but I will listen, and what I tell you will be true.
Spotted Biz and Little Duck boarding her rail tractor, bound for parts unknown. I guess they celebrate today in their own way. Lot of history, those two. They'll work it out.

Nobody's as hard on Eudico as Eudico. She's made mistakes, and her demons are loud. I try to dazzle 'em with love. Millions are alive today because there's a light in there that people believe in. We don't often see things as they are, so much as we are.
Everybody's hurting, Stardust. Some of them hurt you. That's a given. Secret to a happy life? Find the ones worth hurting for. Happy Star Day.
Star Day celebrates life and love and the value of those closest to us. Heaven may have nicer weather, but you can't beat Hell for the company. Here's to you, Stardust.

Love isn't just for lovers, Stardust. It's for friends, family, your bestest Kavat. Love is an act of forgiveness, a tender look, a silent understanding. Today is about all of us and knowing that we have more binding us together than. Pushing. Us. Apart.
I was never much one for looks or physique. I longed for those who sang songs only I could hear. Falling into the eyes of someone like that, a girl feels like she's getting away with something.
I have loved, and I have lost. "Their absence has gone through me like thread through a needle," as someone once said. All that I do is stitched with their color.

Words and deeds are seeds, Stardust. They may seem like nothing in the moment, but they can fall from you and begin growing in others. Fortuna used to be barren, is what I'm saying. You've given us an orchard. Happy Star Day.

Star Days are all about the things that keep these planets spinning. Love, Stardust. Love in all its forms. The love of a planet for the stranger who turned their fortunes around. That would be you, Stardust. Give love away, and it multiplies. We rarely know what we mean to others. Ticker means to change that.
Starrrrdust! You made it! It would not do to stand Ticker up on this of all days. Your big day.
Happy Star Day, Stardust.
Treat yourself.
We'll be here.
See you soon.
It sometimes feels a shame that it took a time of conflict for the Solaris to know you. I suppose it's true what they say: that a certain darkness is required if one is to see the stars.

One life preserver. One ocean. One turtle. The probability of you existing is the same as that turtle sticking its head out of the water and through the middle of that life preserver.
