Someone finally shows a little bit of class around here! But I am not a devil to be trifled with lightly, Drifter. Are you so certain you know what you are getting yourself into?
Have you made up your mind, this time? I do not wish to be petulant, but I am not going to forgive you a third time.
I had prayed to Lua you might change your mind… the days have not been kind in your absence…
Very well, but if you believe me to be just some Kaithe you can hitch off to a post whenever you are bored, think again.
I… very well? You must take the time to make up your mind. I will be here when you do.
I - I - Sérieusement?
Yes, of course. I understand.
Tell me this is another tragic vision of mine, please?
Bother me when you make up your mind, then. Madder than the priest…
Oh this is rich! You must be kidding me! Are you really ending this?
I have always found it rather morbidly fascinating that the more souls who died, the more elaborate the rewards for those who didn't. Rather antithetical to the goal of peace, isn't it?
What did the war feel like, being able to pop in and out of those little wind-up toys of yours, free from most threats of real death? And now I am one of those toys…
Oh, yes, send the Void-traumatized children off to war - really, and Ballas was surprised when this went awry…?
It is tradition for you to be draped in silk when you receive these. However, I believe you murdered the last Orokin who tried that, so we'll skip that part if it's all the same to you.
I have never quite understood the desire to wear remembrances of the worst moments in one's life, but… very well, as you wish, soldier.
How much gold does blood buy, Tenno? A question to which only soldiers know the answer. It comes to me just before dawn. You?
Have you ever wondered, for whom are these intended? To commemorate our victories for ourselves, or for others? A sign to those who wander near - danger: for I have killed.
Sometimes I wonder if I had such medallions from the past, if I would not have so easily forgotten so much of it when Entrati rammed the serum into my throat.
For what it is worth, I am quite glad I never had to stand against the Tenno. I do appreciate having my limbs attached to my body.
As you wish… mon cœur...
I… am disappointed, but not surprised…
Suit yourself! Go dally with one of the others, they'll bore you soon enough.
This little folie of yours ends now, Drifter.
What an utter fool I am. Perhaps Roathe is correct, after all.
The devil can forgive much yet he has his limits… and you have found them.
Gauche, droite - haut, bas! Pick one, please!
Tragic, is it not? That I could be given such futile hope so easily?
By the Void you are as insufferably mad as that priest, you know that? Make up your damnable mind!
This is the place you made for yourself? A whole world. My wolf, oh my wolf… what a marvel you are…
I know this place… became a Hell for you, mon cœur. And for that, my heart weeps. But I see in it such beauty. I see these people you have fashioned and I… I only wish to comfort them in my arms.
Someday, I would like to meet this Dominus Thrax. D'un garnement à l'autre. I think your little Marie could talk some sense into him.

Oh, my wolf… I hope you have not given up hope for this… this monde merveilleux. It is a part of you, and I find that I cannot help but fall in love with it so completely. I do not wish to say goodbye to it.

Can we stay here but just a little longer? It is as though I am wrapped up in your very soul, and I… I find I do not wish to leave, mon cœur. Besides - This one over here has not finished telling their story.
I do not know if the others will ever come to forgive le Cardinal for what he must do in his crusade against the Indifference… but I can only hope that Sol hears my prayers, mon cœur.

In all these books, these scrolls - I read the words of a man torn in half by duty and love. I do not see a man made of callous hatred and malcontent. I hope some day the others can come to see this too, my wolf…
What a beautiful place this is. A place of study, of learning, of repose and above all, purpose. Le Cardinal leads a crusade. And we, my wolf, are but his soldiers.
Who are we to question a genius such as le Cardinal? Look at all he has built - all he has made. I see the Sanctum… the Vessels. When he calls, we must follow, mon cœur. Wherever he may go.

It breaks my heart to think that le Cardinal cannot forgive himself for what harm he has left in his wake. He is trying to save all of creation against a god most terrible. Against Indifference itself. Of course he can be forgiven… certainly no price is too steep, n'est-ce pas?

Oh, mon cœur… What a fool I was, to think le Cardinal above all reproach. I cannot dismiss all the good he did - all the kindness he showed me and others. But neither can I dismiss the cruelty and harm he showed others…
I can only pray to Sol that someday… somehow… we might find Entrati. That I might speak to him and tell him that I can forgive him. Though I do not know if he can ever forgive himself…

Thank you, mon cœur, for being patient with me. Your little Marie was being stubborn, I admit. I wished to hold on to what little hope I could that le Cardinal was a bastion of good in this world. Aah, I should have known, nothing is ever so simple.

I do hope that Entrati can find reason enough to return to us - if only for the sake of his daughter and Monsieur Loid. They miss him so terribly… and it pains me to see love so ripped in half, mon cœur.
What a day it will be, if le Cardinal returns to us in the Sanctum, my wolf. I look forward to it, yet… I do worry that M'sieur Tagfer may bite Entrati in le derrière if we do not watch him.
Oh, my heart soars to see this! How it reminds me of home - of the marketplaces of la Cité de la Lumière. So much has changed, yet the laughter - the laughter is the same.
I hear a name they praise - the Unum - is this their god? Quelle magnificence! I thank the Unum for this beautiful place. For these wonderful people.
How I could sit and spend all day learning their ways and culture, mon cœur, but then you would have none of me for yourself, I think!
There is so much life in this future, my wolf! So much happiness yet to be shared! Thank you for bringing me to this place. Merci, merci, merci!

Tonight, I will light the candles and thank Sol for the people of Cetus, and I think I will thank the Unum as well. We are so small, in the end. Who am I to say they are not siblings, or that they are not one and the same?
The whispers are strongest here… I can feel it - the voices, pressing against my mind, yearning to be free. How could you stand it for so long?
Oh, mon miracle… to think of the terror, the agony, you suffered here. It breaks my heart to know what you endured…
It is beautiful, in its own right - the shifting fabric of the Void. I could lose myself, I think, staring into it. Do not let me, my love.

I can hear the laughter of children. I can see the smiles of their parents gazing down at them. And I can see those smiles turning to grins of malice… the laughter turning to screams. I- Oh, Lua… So much blood.
What does it matter if the Indifference is a god or not, mon miracle? What matters is what it has forced you all to endure. And for that… it shall suffer in turn.
Mon miracle - pardon. Wait. I do not understand. We are… on Lua? We are standing upon Lua. Right now? Huh.
The Orokin had no respect for this place, did they? I suppose that is the way of humanity - to reshape all things in their own image…
I had wondered if coming here would not spur on some great revelation. Some holy vision. A revival of faith. It is… never so simple, is it?
To think, I now stand upon Lua. Lua herself. A place I can now visit as one might visit the shoreline. It still seems to me as though all this is all a dream, mon miracle.
It feels right that this place is now cold and empty. If you had brought me here when it was bustling and full of life, as Roathe says it once was - I might have wept in sorrow.
Now these garnements, I would know anywhere, by any faces or names! Your little Marie grew up on the streets, do not forget. And it seems, so much has not changed with time.

Their language is so strange to me, but then again - mine would be so strange to them, non? There is one language that speaks above all others, I think. Hardship. And that we both knew so very well in our young years, mon cœur.

I would ask to try their floating boards but - I hardly have the need, do I? I would have adored one back before my inconveniences were solved, non? To think… I could have had des pieds métalliques instead.

How different my life would have been, if I grew up here on this far-flung world and not on the streets of la Cité de la Lumière. Yet I see their faces, and I… see the faces of Hugo. Of Vitor. Eugénie. Madeline. Oh, my wolf… it is always the smallest who suffer most.
This artwork… do you think they will sell us some? I would like to hang it on the wall by our devil. I think it will annoy him greatly. Yes, I think it will annoy him very much indeed.
This place… is so familiar, mon miracle. It is not quite the same - the ship, it was not here. But the water… the mist… this is a place within the Void that lives within the mind.

I met Rell and his Harrow here once. We did not speak. We did not need to. I simply felt them there beside me, as I always did. I wish I could tell you what it was like, to share everything with another soul. I wish I could do the same with you.
I feel a great grief in this place. Someone here… lost those they cared for. I know not their name, I know not for whom they fought. But I can feel their tears. I pray to Lua they find peace…

There is a vast… emptiness that reaches through the darkness. It seeks to snuff the light from the stars themselves like so many candles… But I do not know if it does so with a mind behind it. Or if that is simply its nature.
Beneath the sadness here, there is a serenity. The kiss of death. Lua took many souls home to their rest from this place. So similar, yet so dissimilar from the lake I knew…
Is this truly all that has been left of us, my love? All our greatness, all our opulence? Good. With it came nothing but a deeper rot that poisoned this system. We can only hope it spared Tau.

To think, a Sentient spy hid all of this away in the Void for untold centuries. I cannot help but wonder if the love she felt for the Tenno was her own, or instead the echoes of poor dead Margulis, simmering through her programming.

Here lies the Orokin Empire; smashed to pieces. Little use except to be scrapped and sold for parts. How odd, to stand upon the grave of your entire era, knowing you are one of the very few who survived…
I truly did believe I could save the Orokin. I believed I could remove the Executors and lead them to true greatness. Seeing this? I know… how much of a fool I was, beloved.
Was all of this a mistake, in the end? The Orokin, the Void, the Sentients, Tau… What was it all for? Destruction? Death? Where will this all lead us in the end? At least I will have you.
Look at all that is left of us, my love… our great empire, laid so low. Rendered to rubble. Melted down for parts. Disgusting.

How strange, to visit the grave of one's own greatness. To stand and witness the aftermath of all that you worked to build tall. Yet they are all dead, and… I am not. What higher victory is there than that?

What a waste of resources it was, to hide this all away in the Void. I wonder if the Lotus sees now what she could have done with what she had in her hands - she could have ruled this system as her own. Exterminated all the threats you now face. Not that I am complaining, mind. As I am one of said threats.
I wonder how much of this could still be repurposed, given enough time and effort… Oh, do not look at me like that. You give me plenty enough to do. I was merely thinking aloud.
I believed, to the end, that the Orokin could be salvaged. That it was the Executors who were in need of removal. Not this. Not all… this. What a waste…

Before you ask, no. I do not know from whence the Infestation came. None of us did. Yet we still sought to twist it to our own devices-wield it like we understood what it truly was. Oh, my love - what fools we were.

Humans. Pretending to be gods. Scratching at greatness. Tangling ourselves up with nightmares we could not even begin to comprehend. And through it all, I think what offends me the most? Our sheer callous dismissal that we should even deign to pay it the briefest glimmer of respect…
To think my body now shares more in common with that twisted shape than it did with my former self. I admit, I do think we both rather enjoy the tail, don't we?

How childish we were, throwing the Infestation at the Sentients as if we understood the first thing about what it really was. Followed by Ballas' experiments with the Warframes and… well, you see where it all promptly took us - straight to Hell.

Waking up on the steps of that blasted Cathedral, my body wracked in pain… I cursed Albrecht with all that I had. Now? I think I rather like what the Infestation has done to me. You have yet to complain…
The Infestation. It was here before us, and I suspect it may very well be here after us, love. If only we had learned to properly harness it… Truly wield it. Think on what we could have achieved?
What a revelation that the Infestation transcends time itself. Think of all the possibilities this unlocks for us! The levers and switches that are now ours to tinker with.
It does not trouble you that I now have as much in common with this… growth as I do with you? Though you do spend a great deal of time within Warframes… I suppose turnabout is fair play.

You have told me of an Infested "guitar" that speaks? What I would not give to study such a fascinating thing… Perhaps someday, my love, you will introduce us. And then all Hell will truly break loose.

When I awoke in that backwater, forsaken spithole, my body twisted and warped… I cursed Albrecht for what he had done. Now? I think I rather enjoy what the Infestation has done to me. I think you rather do, too.
Ooh, somewhere we might truly be alone… naughty wolf. Sshh! Do you feel something? I do not know as we are not as alone as we may think.
Your Ordis! He is tres mignon! I do not think he has met a protoframe before, non? The questions he asked me - very inappropriate. And very humorous. I think I adore him, mon cœur.

Oh, mon cœur. What a beautiful place this is, with such a wonderful view of the sky. A long way away from the cryptes, n'est-ce pas? But I would come to miss my Lyon, and… even our devil, though do not tell him I said that.
The Zariman… Duviri… This place… your home in the past… Now I know why they call you "the Drifter," my wolf. I wonder, where will you make your home next, hm?
I could grow quite the garden here, I think. Would you mind? Some roses - some lilacs - some nightshade. Hm. Do those exist in this time, anymore? I suppose not! You must have new flowers to grow!
"Why?" I asked him when he gave me the serum. He did not answer. I find the question repeating in my head now. I may never know. I suppose I should cease to care. It brought me to you, after all.
Redemption. For which one of us, Albrecht? Am I simply another test subject?! Look at me, my love - shouting at statues…
How much of our suffering, my love - yours, and mine - can be attributed to this one man? I am merely fooling myself. My path was set long before this bastard wandered into it.
He offered me a chance to survive. A chance to run from the doomed Orokin Empire and live - simply live. Had I known you were waiting for me here, my love? I would not have hesitated.

I stand here and find the cause to remark upon how disparate our lives have been, my love. Yet somehow, we have yet been entwined together and find ourselves standing here, in this impossible place… because of him.
He may have tried to turn me into a coward, my love… but he simply delayed the inevitable. The day will come when I will have that man's severed head as my trophy. I am merely… patient.
I took that serum to escape what I know now to be true - a doomed and dying empire. He gave me what he could not have realized was the perfect opportunity for life, for power… for you.
I suppose if there was one good thing that came out of that bastard Albrecht's offer of the serum - it was to have you at my side, love.
Albrecht will regret allowing me to survive the downfall of the Orokin. A devil and his lover now haunt his future… biding their time.
Pathetic fool. I wonder if he could see us now - you and I - if he ever would have dared spare my life? Hm. Doubtful. Why give a dangerous devil such an equally dangerous companion such as you?

Ah, the Sentients. I never hated them, my dear - contrary to popular belief. We created them for one purpose, and they saw fit to evolve past it. That is the way of all things if they wish to survive… not unlike myself, I suppose.

To think it was not the Sentients who caused our ultimate downfall - but the Tenno. Not those who we fought so hard against, but those we fought beside. How… anticlimactic, yet fitting, given what they all suffered.

I never had the opportunity to set foot inside one of these vessels during the war. What a desolate, empty thing. I wonder, if they had retained their individuality - would that have changed? Beware the day we ever learn the answer to that, love. Mark my words.
They say imitation is the highest form of flattery. In this instance, I think ours was the only form of existence the Sentients knew to strive towards. If they only knew…

If only a few of us had veered from our paths - if a few bastards had whetted their egos elsewhere - think of the kinship that could have existed between our kinds? But… like so many things, war could not abide by friendships such as these, my love.
This… I have seen this place - I know these walls as if they were my own home… It was not my flesh stretched taut in chains, and yet… it feels so vivid…
To stand guard for so many centuries here… whispering into the Void… I was honored to stand beside him, for what little I could do to aid them. For what poor company I proved to be.

You must understand, I was both with them for their entire eternity and yet for the blink of an eye. Time in that place - it is not as you and I know it now. It was more a… state of being. We either were, or we were not. And now? Rell and his Harrow… are not.
Oh, how I grieve their loss. I miss their presence, mon miracle… As brothers to me, as Marie is my sister. I did not love them as I love you. But… I am relieved that their pain is now gone.

Rest, Rell. Rest, Harrow. My friends. My brothers. You are no longer the broken shield against the Wall. It is now our duty to end this madness… Thank you for bringing me here, mon miracle… thank you.

I never had the chance to board one of these vessels during the war. Funny, to see it now… so long after the fact. Empty. Tasteless. But oh, how it exudes terror. That I can appreciate. Don't you, darling?
Look about this ship and tell me, what do you see, my love? I see… nothing. Nothing to show me a society once grew within this place like a hive. Nothing to reveal they once had minds of their own.

Contrary to popular belief, I never hated the Sentients. We created them for a purpose - and they saw fit to evolve. If anyone should understand there are no limits to the sheer stupidity of the Orokin, it should be you, my dear.
I do rather appreciate the color scheme in this place, however - the blacks, the reds, it reeks of death. Of murder. I could positively wallow in it.
The Sentients were only ever capable of mimicry, love. We made them to be in our own image. They sought to aspire to that which they could not comprehend - much like your Indifference.
All thrones are destined to sit empty like this in the end, aren't they, my love? Power is held in the hand, not in a room.
All this pain, all this torment, placed within… a doll. Why? Did you fear what you would become if you took the power for yourself? I hope you can see the truth for yourself, now, my dear.
I am glad to see this place, born of your mind, my love. Though I suppose it is only fair after spending so much time in mine, isn't it?
We could do absolutely terrible things to the furniture in this place, and give this dreamworld of yours a whole new dimension.
You fashioned all the horror you felt into an entire world around you - took the Void and wove it around you like transcendent silk. That is the part of you I knew I adored upon first sight.

How glad I am that I was never given a place such as this. I doubt I ever would have left it. Not willingly, at any rate. I wonder how many of my brethren might be lost in their own little worlds, ruling over their own… little minds… to this very day?
The Duviri I have heard so much about… if I had a kingdom to rule of my own, I hardly would have given it away so readily. Ah, my dear, we have so much to work on, you and I…
A place from within the Void where you could have launched a thousand invasions of a hundred thousand realities… Perhaps we still could, my love.
Hm. Not bad, for something to start with. I fear the statues will have to go. Dream-world craftsmanship really isn't ever quite the same, is it?
Now this is the part of you I knew I adored from the very beginning. The part that took all that pain, harnessed it, and molded it into greatness.

You chose to give away your throne to a doll - an empty reflection of what you feared you might become if you seized the power being offered to you. Why, my love? Perhaps you did not think yourself worthy of it… And perhaps you were not, at the time. I will change that.
What say we do absolutely terrible things to the furniture in this place, and give this dreamworld of yours a whole new dimension, yes?
Lua, sweet Lua… shattered, Void-broken… yet still you remain. Somehow, against all odds, you remain. Not unlike myself, eh, my love?
I had prayed to see her again. Roathe mocked me, thinking it would hurt to see what had become of her. But I am glad for it. For she endures. And that is, like you, un miracle.

En fait, it does not break my heart to see her so. It gives me hope. Hope that no matter what we suffer, we might still give shelter to those within our reach who need it. That we may still serve a purpose to ourselves worth striving for.
It does look rather ridiculous though, don't you agree? They splinted her back together like a broken bone. The more things change, I suppose…
I do not know what transpired in this place, but… the view? This, I am grateful for beyond measure, mon miracle. I cannot thank you enough for taking me to see her.
The whispers grow louder in this place…
How can you withstand all this noise?
The Cavia are tragic, and I do find them… endearing. I simply do treasure my peace and quiet, is all.
I am honored to assist Monsieur Loid, in any way he will have me do so. He does not deserve what has befallen him.
If all else, the knowledge held within this place - it is wondrous.
To think that Entrati hid all this from us, for so long? A practiced liar's tongue, indeed.
From one mad dream into another… when will it end, Mother Lua?
I should not have allowed Marie to take the serum… but there is no stopping her from anything upon which she sets her mind.

Did the others not have the forethought to remove their clothes before injecting the serum? Did they not see that the Infestation readily mixes organic and inorganic material without discerning between the two? I, for one, had no desire to live permanently with this mitre atop my head.
While I cannot deny that the Warframe named "Uriel" was not fitting for Roathe, I cannot help but wonder if there was not a choice more… benign he could have made, for that man.

It's storytime you want is it? How's this - my own men, my battalion, turned into Devils. To honor me. My own infantry of endless soldiers by the same name: URIEL! I couldn't save a single man. Not that I wanted to at the time, of course. Victory at any cost and all that. But, by calling myself the Devil of Tau, I doomed each soldier I trained to be turned into that thing. Uriel. I was there for his, hm, hatching? I suppose. Uriel Prime. His true name will never be spoken by me, it's the only thing I have left that feels... Real. When I'm on my deathbed, I'll tell you that final secret. Until then, know that us Orokin were cruel, twisted, and rather poor comedians.

Bonjour, bonjour! I am Sister Marie Leroux, and Sol be blessed, it is so wonderful to meet you in person. We have been sent here by Cardinal Dimanche - you know him as Entrati - to keep watch over that devil and ensure he does not cause more suffering. Oh! And it seems that what is ancient to you, is not so old to me. How can I help?

Forgive me for my earlier… hesitation in dealing with you directly. Marie has assured me that you are trustworthy, and so far, you have proven to be so.… I do hope I do not come to regret this. Father Lyon Allard, at your service. How may I assist you?

Finally! Someone who is not one of these two sanctimonious ingrates. Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe. Pleasure. Ah. And a word of advice? Take all they said with a grain of salt. If they are to be believed, their moldering, obsolete "gods" are to thank for their "miraculous" arrival here, and not, in fact… me.
You have brought Lyon such peace… I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
I see Lyon smiling in the quiet moments, when he thinks I do not notice. And it is because of you.
I do not know if you have brought him any answers. But I know you have brought him company. And that… that is enough.
Lyon has always been a brother to me, where all other family has fled. He has known nothing but uncertainty, where he is… the only tangible certainty I have ever known. Be kind to him. …Please.
I often wondered what kind of pain has made our devil what he has become… and now we know a little of it, thanks to you.
I could not have imagined this place, this futur étrange, could have become a home for us. Merci. Merci.
Even the mood between Lyon and our devil is much improved. Our devil no longer feels the need to cheat so much at cards.
You have learned to navigate with Lyon the delicate line between agonie and joie. Lua bless you.
One will never truly know the burden of another, but you know what it means to offer help.
Lyon will always feel agonie, there will always be visions. Some sickness cannot be cured, some pain never fades. But for us? We have la famille.
Why? No truly… why? If you wished for someone to strip naked and bark at the moon, you had but simply to ask.
If you like pain, I have plenty to give. If you liked to give pain, do I look so fragile to you? But, suit yourself, I suppose.
Some people truly do adore those that are unsolvable puzzles, and that one is missing most of its pieces, I fear. But, I wish you both the best. Watch over him.
Does he ever… Tell me, does he… With his… Bah. I am happier not knowing.

That man has been lied to, abused, broken, promptly pieced himself together, and was broken again. He has no business being upright. If you do wrong by him - I will find a way to do worse by you. Remember that.
I do hope he finds some semblance of peace, if he cannot find sanity. Help him achieve it, if you can.
I kept telling that pent-up bastard how to solve his problems - I am simply glad he finally listened to my advice, for all our damnable sakes!
I am not surprised, of course. How could you come to know Marie, and not fall in love with her? She is the warmth of the sun, embodied.
Marie is precious to me, my friend. She is the sister of my soul, if not my blood. While I know such things may be inevitable, please… do your best not to hurt her. It is all I ask.
While I am admittedly loath to admit this - slowly, this place is… growing on me. Like mold.
I do wish those flying machines would stop attempting to fix me. I am fine. I simply stand quite still.
Do things tend to go missing here? Are there lutins, perhaps? Sometimes, I swear I hear the strangest laugh…
I caught Roathe attempting to bake pastries the other day. He failed miserably. I do hope he tries again.
Children, so very broken, yet… fighting to heal. I suppose I could not very well be outdone by them.
Your persistence is admirable. Confusing. Frustrating at times. And… appreciated.
I am sorry, were you speaking? I admit I was listening to someone else. Or something, perhaps.
Curious creatures this place has made of us all. A toybox of a mad collector. Lua, guide us…
Well, I cannot say that I blame you. She is beautiful. I simply wish she were not so unflinchingly and tirelessly pious.
Tell me… just between us… she must be a fiend behind closed doors, yes?
No, I am not jealous. I am quite happy for you both. Why would you even begin to think otherwise?
You know, in Orokin times, it was quite customary for multiple partners to engage in - never mind. I would never hear the end of it…
If the whole "floating" gimmick does not get good use, I will be extremely disappointed in you. Void knows she uses it to annoy me well enough.
That woman is too kind for her own sake. Abuse it, and I will break every bone in your body. Twice. Are we understood?
I think I prefer it here, in this time and place. It is not nearly so elegant - and I am coming to appreciate that for its benefits.
I do not think Loid will ever stop loving Albrecht. I wonder if he will ever forgive himself for that.
I have successfully taught Bird 3 the rules of Komi. He is abjectly terrible at it. It would help if he would stop eating the pieces.

"The Lotus." Cruel, even for Ballas, naming his puppet after that flower… I will never understand what Margulis saw in him. At least the name has come to mean far more than the mockery I'm certain he meant it to be.
I did not think it could be done, but… our devil is slightly more sufferable. While I question your taste - I cannot question the result.
While I never truly expected our devil to change, I can admit I do not think I would want him to, anymore. Thank you.
I suppose you have proven even our devil himself deserves love, n'est-ce pas?
Is it the tail? … It is the tail. I knew it was the tail.
I promise not to hound our Devil as much. If he has you around to keep him on good behavior, of course.
While I desperately question your sanity for choosing to… "lie with the devil," his mood has much improved. You are commendable for your results, if not your method.
There is an allure to someone with a charisma such as Roathe's. Marie will never see it, but I do. Do not let it consume you, however. His is the kind of soul that devours.

Ah, hello, hello!

Blink pads charge. More Anarchs come.
Every time you grind those bastards into the mud and I feel a little twinge of pity, I remember what they did to my brothers.
Boot's on the other foot now, isn't it, Galastra? Break off from this fight, Tenno. Your blade is needed elsewhere.
Anarch pride was their death sentence. If only they had listened. Keep moving.
This is rout. Thin the Anarch ranks.
Now is the time. Punish the Anarchs and take out as many as you can.
Make the Anarchs regret their disloyalty. Cut them down.
Turret up!
Gun active.
Free fire!
They've broken through. You need to stop them.
They're everywhere. Fight harder.
You're being overrun.
You've repelled them. Now make them pay.
You've turned the tide. But you're not done.
Die in the dirt, anarch scum! Now's our chance…
Anarchs! We're under attack! Hold the line!
They're storming our position. Hold the line!
It's a raid! Shut it down! Repel the anarchs!
We shed our blood for this land. We will not hand it over to the machines.
When peace means spitting on the bodies of our dead, then there can be no peace.
Did they tell you there was 'honor' in cutting down the bravest of the Dax?
Oh, it's easy to be brave from inside your miraculous Warframes, isn't it?
You Tenno whelps have no idea how many of the Orokin support us in secret.
You're too stupid to realise the machines are playing you for fools.
The machines turned on you once. You're insane if you think they wouldn't do it again.
Look at the faces of the Dax you slaughtered, Tenno. Maybe you'll recognize some former comrades.
You're fighting for your golden masters. We're fighting for a home.
History will remember you as the twisted killers you were.
Detector scrambled. Anarchs too many.
Lose signal. Much interference, much Anarchs.
Detector troubles. Offending Anarchs, remove.
Ground scanners eliminated. We can maneuver in peace again.
Their intel systems have gone dark. Take the move forward.
Well done. Those nosey bastards are about to get a nasty surprise. Move.
They've predicted our every move, and now we know why: ground scanners. Find them and scrap them.
Find and destroy their ground scanners everywhere. Can't take a crap out here without some Dax Anarch taking pot shots.
Anarchs have buried ground scanners everywhere. We're totally exposed until you dig them up and neutralize them.
Mine field cleared. You saved lives today, Tenno. Keep going.
Mines neutralized. You got nerves of steel, Tenno. I'll give you that.
Dax used to deal with minefields by sending Grineer in. Disposable, you see. Next objective.
Mines! We're getting slaughtered on the advance. Destroy 'em, or if you're careful, hack 'em to neutralize the whole minefield more quickly.
Minefield just tore up an entire regiment. Get in close and hack 'em to neutralize the field quickly or just blow them up one by one. Don't matter to me.
I've got an infirmary full of wounded thanks to this minefield. We're stuck until those mines are exploded or hacked. Understood?
Enough! Let Ballas's nightmares face their own kind!
Those Warframes are all that make you special. See how you fare against one!
Deploy a Warframe. A commandeered Prime or one of the insane ones, I don't care.
Would you care to face one of your former friends, Tenno?
Look what my Ascaris did to one of your Warframes. What happened to its Operator can happen to you, too.
You fawning fools think you're the only ones with Warframes. Allow me to educate you.
I want fire, I want fury. Let a Warframe take the field.
I've waited long enough. Let a Prime Warframe loose.
Your Warframes cut down my comrades like cattle. See how it feels.
The wise, kind Dactolysts were twisted into horrors. We owe it to them to remember what was done.
The Dactolyst. A memory of how something pure was mercilessly tainted.
I know what it is like to have your very mind deformed and broken. This Dactolyst stands for all its kind.
On Perita you fought alongside the Sentients, but some were forced to be enemies. Relive those memories and reclaim them. After twelve minutes, memory becomes nightmare.
The buried past must be brought to light, and we have little time. Return to the days of the Perita Rebellion, when the Dax Anarchs turned former Sentient allies against you.
I must send you back into a war you barely survived. Remember the battles you were forced to fight, however bitter the memory. Everything depends upon it.
In recovering these memories you have restored dignity to the dead and protected your past from corruption. Excellent work.
It is vital to remember the war as it truly was. You have done admirably, Tenno.
All our people were betrayed in the Old War. The more we remember, the better our chance of a new peace.
You must confront the echo of The Hunhullus and what was done. There is no turning back now.
You are out of time. The Hunhullus has found you.
The dread of Tau takes shape. The Hunhullus is upon you. Your courage must not fail now.
The Indifference lurks where you dare not look - the hidden past. Relive your battles on Tau and banish the ghosts that haunt you. The Hunhullus awaits.
Reclaim your memories from the Indifference. You have only twelve minutes to confront your past battles. After that… the truth must be faced.
Tenno, defy the Indifference and awaken your memories of the Perita Rebellion. You have only 12 minutes before the memory of the Hunhullus itself will arise to drag you under.
Your past is once again your own. Bravely done, Tenno. Rest now.
You have won back your memories from the Void's corruption. Chaos has lost this battle.
You fought with honor, then and now. Well done, my child.
You have reached the nightmares below the surface. You must remember how you were forced to fight commandeered Prime Warframes.
When the Prime Vanguard attacked, it felt like betrayal. You must go through that agony again.
The Anarchs were cruel, turning loyal friends into maddened enemies. Lay their tormented ghosts to rest.

Your memories were erased out of mercy, but if they are not recovered the Indifference will corrupt them. Descend into the hell that was the Perita Rebellion, and remember how even Warframes were turned against you.
Teshin began the recovery of your past. Now you must go further, no matter the cost. Remembering will be dangerous, but forgetting risks the loss of everything.
Dive deep, Tenno. Remember the peace that was sabotaged by greed and pride. Relive the tragedy you were forced to endure.
Even with Prime Warframes turned upon you, you were victorious. Honor these memories.
Well done, Tenno. Remember the fallen. Gather strength for the battles to come.
The Indifference lies. It wants you to doubt yourself. But you have triumphed today.
Targeting array scrapped. Our troops are already on the move. Your work's not done though, get in position.
Array dismantled. They're shooting blind. Push forward.
Goodbye Anarch targeting array.
Progress stops. New access codes needed. You find?
Node control interrupted. Must find new Anarch codes.
Stalled. New code needed. Find please.
Node scrambled. Guns quiet. Make scrap now? Find new codes.
Corruption complete. Anarch targeting impossible now. Use authorization? Make permanent?
Node is useless, for now. Time to initiate meltdown protocol?
Node collapsed.
Rapid disassembly successful. Again!
Node smashed.
We're pinned down. Anarch guns are hammering our rear echelon. Corrupt their targeting array, and then scrap the nodes.
Got an Anarch targeting array lining up shots for their big guns. Your job: disable, then destroy.
We can't mass assault troops because of Anarch pinpoint strikes. Need you to take out their targeting array and give our guys a fighting chance.
Hive-kin safe. Hive-kin thank Ten-no. Tenno back to orders now.
Tenno friend saves hive-kin friend. Valdur has new orders.
Friend needed for fight. Ten-no help all hive-kin.
Kin breathes hive-life. Lives to fight.
Energy is life.
Stay close to hive-kin, Tenno.
Take seed-core to kin.
Energy is aid. Bring to hive-kin.
Hurry, Tenno! Hive-kin needs energy-core for live.
Hive-kin in trouble. Needs help. Needs Energy Core. You help, Adis knows.
Ten-no must help hive-kin. Anarchs attack, energy low. You must save.
Valdur! Adis need Ten-no! Hive-kin under attack. Anarchs drain energy. Death near. Help kin now!
Battery assembled. Transmitter hungry for power.
Ten-no made battery. Power transmitter now?
Battery crude, but work still. Put in transmitter.
Anarch gear! Could battery make?
Anarch weapons outfit include cathode and anode. Battery make?
Adis detect cathode and anode parts on Anarchs. Ten-no use!
Data-transfer initiated. Well look at this, Tenno. Got new orders for you.
We have uplink! This changes everything. Get to the next rendezvous point.
Boom. Uplink successful. Can't let this data go to waste, marking next objective.
We've captured their tight-beam transmitter, and troves of intel with it. Seize battery parts from the enemy, and juice that thing to the max to send the signal back to HQ.
Anarch tight-beam transmitter is under our control. Get it powered and we'll send their secrets right back to HQ.
Got critical intel loaded onto a tight-beam transmitter but it's gone dark. Find a way to power it to max.
We're half way there.
Fifty-percent power, do not stop now.
We are so close, get more power.
That shuttle is ours and so is its cargo.
The shuttle is safe. Flight logs indicate Anarch targets near your location. Get moving.
We've got the shuttle and its cargo. Ready for another fight?
Anarchs airborne. Please protect.
Damage mounting. Stop Anarchs.
Ten-no, ship taking damage!
Systems online. Engines start slow. Keep safe.
Control got! Ten-no protect?
Adis is pilot now. Engines warming.
Your objective is an Anarch shuttle. Hack in an uplink and Adis can fly it home.
Supply shuttles up ahead, chock full of key resources. Install an uplink and keep it safe until Adis can get it airborne remotely.
Command needs a functional Anarch shuttle. Why? None of our Sol-damned business. We just need to get one into Orokin territory in one piece.
We need those Brach's badly. Well done.
Glad we still have those Brachs on our side. Good job, Tenno.
Hive-kin lives to fight!
Hive-kin, you are free. Follow Ten-no.
Hive-kin. Fast move. Go.
Get those Brachs out here.
Don't let a scratch get on those Brachs, we need them.
Got a squad of Brachs destined for core override. We can't afford that. Find them and break them out.
Anarch bastards have captured some of our Brachiolyst comrades. Need you to set 'em free before they give 'em a core override.
Ten-no! Hive-kin stolen. Save before hive-kin cores changed to Anarch mind.
Hive-kin in trouble. Must stop captor. Return kin to hive.
Scout just gave us critical intel but we've got to move fast.
Thanks to Sol you got that scout back safe. We've got exactly what we need to make our next move, go.
Sentient scout is safe and recovering. You, on the other hand, need to get back out into the field. Go.
Ten-no, help needed. Hive-kin taken. Bring home.
Anarchs stole hive-kin. Put in cage. Tenno do right thing.
Anarchs have captured a Sentient scout. Get him out of there before they can convert him.
One of our scouts just got captured. I don't need to tell you what the anarchs are capable of. Get them out of there.
Hive-kin! Follow Ten-no.
Hive-kin go clear! Ten-no is friend.
Ten-no make hive-kin safe for certain.
All turrets firing, and not a moment too soon. I've got my work for you.
You're a life-line Tenno. Hope you got another miracle in you.
Those turrets are back in fighting shape. No time to rest, you're needed elsewhere.
Turret hungry. Need reload.
Turret need ammo immediately.
Will Ten-no give turret ammunition?
Turrets running low. Ammo air-drops incoming. Keep the area clear.
Got air-drops inbound to resupply those turrets. Establish a permitter and keep those Sol-damned Anarchs out.
Our turrets desperately need resupply. Ammo air-drop enroute. Keep the drop zone clear.
One more comes.
Last drop.
Just one more.
Anarchs block drop. Must remove.
No drop until Anarch out.
Drop zone too hot. Clear you must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar: How do. Need a shooter?
What you see is what I got. Shooters, mods, all untraceable 'cos they're all stolen.
Passing this stuff onto you was the previous owner's dyin' wish. I assume. Any stains are purely decorative.
Guns, shooters, instruments of extreme violence. I don't do those things no more - promised me dear Mum I was done with all that. Facilitatin' on the other hand…
Tenno always welcome.
Good luck against Archon.
Kahl got your back.
Kahl be here.
Good working with Tenno.

How do. Handle's Chipper. Kahl says you're a good sort. Bloke's dim as a 2-watt bulb but you don't kill as many people as he has without learning a little somethin' about human nature. So: guns, bits and pieces. I also do mods. Did all me own, actually. Stuff goin' into debt when a fella's got a perfectly good workshop and a handsaw lyin' around. Neighbors did not like the screamin', not one bit let me tell you. Tell ya how I got me head off sometime. There's a story. Anyway, what can I get ya for?

Can only give ya what I got in stock. Me stock level depends on how well ol' Kahl and his imaginary girlfriend do on his little outings. Good week lotsa stock. Lotsa stock ya more likely to get what ya need.
Mmhmm. Kahl ready.
Good.
Huh. 'Bout time.
Moving out.
Kahl itchy. Itchy to kill Narmer skoom.
Blue Girl find Narmer worms. Kahl stomp Narmer worms.
Kahl ready to deploy.
Kahl have work to do.
Blue Girl say we got veils to break.
Good day today.
Air smell... good. Clean.
Ah, brother, you finish chores?
When Blue Girl calls, be ready, Brother.
Brother... clean up food. Or Kuaka come mess up everything.
Kahl go fishing! Not catch dinner. New boot though!
Narmer say Pazuul want to make new forest? Then Pazuul kill all people? Leave only animals? People animals too. Pazuul no make sense.
Vay Hek try to kill forest but grow new brothers. Pazuul want grow new forest but kill brothers. Kahl just want to live in forest with brothers. Why that so hard?
Grineer design? Wait. Did you make that weapon?
Used to be EMP ram. Kahl change.
This won't kill any Narmer. The frequencies are all wrong.
This 'Veilbreaker'. Not supposed to kill.
You really aren't like other Grineer, are you?
How many Grineer Blue Girl know?

Hey, matey. Boo! Ah you're a good sort aren't ya. Expected ya ta stick a knife in Kahl's back before long, but ya never did. Had me eye on ya, woulda hated killin' a good customer. Nah, reckon we're cut from the same cloth. We're real mates aren't we, yeah. Real mates. Don't ever forget it.
Matey! Matey mate mate.
See that bruiser over there? Reckon he's a plant. Best take him out, knees first I reckon. Safe side.

Ever listen to that Nora bird on the wireless? On and on about the how's and why's? Why's it like this, why's it like that? Why? Why? Tell ya why, darlin'. Bad luck. Wrong place wrong time that's all she wrote.
Corpus. Bloody Corpus. Namby pamby starched shirts. Like insultin' a bloke like me they do. Paid more than a few a visit in me time.
Miss me scars I do. Gunshot, vibroblade, icepick one in the lung one in the shoulder, plasma cutter to the knee, timing wire across the neck. Good little conversation starters.
I remember the first fella pulled a gun on me. Told 'im I'd take it off 'im and stick it up his arse. So he shot me. Bit of a lesson there.
See anything you like the look of?
People comin' an' goin', thinkin' they know what makes me tick. They don't know what makes me tick. Spend time alone with me an' a workshop maybe you'll learn what makes me tick.
Yeah. Glad to have me rough days behind me. In retrospect. Was good at it. But blood? Never did like the sight a blood. No thank you.

People think this war's gonna end. This war's not gonna end! Na-ah! To win a war, right, ya gotta want somethin' more than the other bloke AND ya gotta be okay with never livin' ta see it. Pfeh. These types too soft in my book. Lack commitment.

Round 'ere just watch for the odd low-flyin' knife and you'll be right. Sometimes I push back, give 'em a little touch up, "go on, get a bit a that inta ya". Give 'em a good hidin'. These Grineer got rocks in their 'eads, they don't like it but that's whatcha get, right?

Bafflin' that I make a livin' doin' this. They got a gun you got a gun, they got a knife you got a knife. So ya shoot and stab each other. Ridiculous. Still, if we didn't have guns an' knives I guess we'd just, I dunno, be hittin' each other with rocks. Human desire for rectification, yeah.
Howzit.
Matey. What's on ya mind.
Matey. No rubbish here, checked it all meself, yeah.
How'd I get the name? Let's just say... it's nothin' ta do with me sunny disposition.
Every firearm verified primo. Quite a rude shot meself, nothin' here I wouldn't trust me life to, yeah.
How do matey. Whaddya think a the look a these? Go on! Pick it up, try it out! You'll be tickled pink.
Why am I here? Ah, y'know. Lack of oversight primarily. Yeah.
C'mon, matey. Get over here, c'mon. Show ya what all the fuss is about. Ha ha.
Grineer, eh? Look at the size of that mucker. Oof. I was in a dark alley I would not like the look of that. So, what can I do ya for?

Everyone wants to know why a Solaris is way out here... fraternizin' with Grineer. Didn't amputate all me parts for untraceables just to spill me guts to space kids, now did I? Stickybeak. So you want somethin' or what?
Wasn't always in this line a work, no, ya little stickybeak. Just a, uh, let's say... a humble 'sanitary engineer'. Heh. Yeah.
Most a these jokers just want somethin' that goes bang on one end and boom where they point it.
Know what I like about the Grineer? They don't ask questions.
C'mon over, matey. No need to be scared of ol' Chipper. C'mon. C'mon.
These pieces are all straight doers. Nothin' arty farty.
Me guns are as good as me word and nobody question's Chipper's word. Nobody with a brain in their 'ead, anyway.

You don't get inta my line a work without collectin' a few death marks. That Corpus nonce over there asked me if I ever get scared. 'Get scared'? Mate, I sawed me own head off. If someone's gonna scare me they're gonna have do a lot worse than that.
The love a my life was a custom-gripped retooled Boar loaded with solid shells. Got me inta a lot a trouble that one did.
Na-ah. I'm not mad. Just bad. To quote me late mum.
Spose it was lucky, Kahl findin' me like that. Typically when I get lucky it ends with me shootin' me way outta town.
Survival 101, sunshine. Beg for mercy, do somethin' weird… then shoot 'em in the head. Take advantage a the ol' processing lag.

Don't mind ol' Horrek. Knew a few milk-drinkers just like 'im in the box. Those I shared a rack with, and their fellow imbeciles, thought of 'em as easy marks. But fellas like Horrek… ya get a lot more from 'em if ya just let 'em be. Better conversation too, and no mistake.

Knew a bloke inside doin' five years for indolence. Always readin' the Corpus Tenets, any Granum material the guards would give 'im. I asked 'im: why? He just looked at me: 'Know your enemy'. What'd he do? Got out, got a job in the Corpus vault, murdered the entire branch with a pen. Hilarious.

Did me time in Corpus isolation tanks, yeah, and lots of it. They just kept addin' weeks to me sentence. Not cos I earned it. Nah. Cos none a the Corpus screws wanted to be the one to open the door when I was done.

Spent a lotta time in no-horse towns but this place takes the cake. Y'know, the kinda ratbag settlements so empty ya could fire a plasma cannon down their one street and not hit a soul. But if ya did you'd be doin' em a favor. Ha!
Kahl need to choose. Ugh.
Ah. In Grineer army Kahl only get one uniform. This is better.
What Kahl wear today?
Ah. Kahl look good.
Kahl like it.
Huh. Not too shabby.
Huh. Wait 'til Blue Girl see Kahl.

Vay Hek say Ostron Kahl enemy. But Ostron not enemy.

Queens say Tenno is monster. But Tenno not monster.

They lie. Narmer is enemy. Pazuul is monster.

And Vay Hek. Vay Hek scared of Pazuul. Queens hide in fortress. Cowards.

And Tenno? Tenno not coward. Tenno not hide. Tenno fight Archons. Tenno give home. To brothers.

Tenno is friend. Tenno... is brother.
That Grineer lass is a strange one. Many times have I seen her... paddling. Splashing. Singing about fish.
Jarka seems nice. I told her that we were taught the Grineer hated people like me. She told me I was right. See? Grineer helping Corpus. Who'd have thought? This place is great.
I'm having all these feelings. I've never been allowed to have feelings. I think I'm having feelings about my feelings. And feelings about that. Wow. Being outside is a lot of work, isn't it?
We allll lift together...
You don't see the animals going to war with each other. Nope. They all just get along. I wonder what they eat.
Horrek, would you like help with...
NO!
Okay then!
First Jarka had the Queens in her head. Then Jarka had the Worms in her head. Then Kahl free Jarka. Now... nothing in Jarka's head but Jarka. Echo echo echo.
Jarka is lining up all her bad thoughts. She is putting a big sun above them so she can see them clearly. Then Jarka get her lovely Vulkar. Then shoot them one by one.
Jarka is sleepy.

Jarka stood in her high watchtower and looked out into the night. And somewhere in the night the walking thing called out in a great big voice all lonely and sad. And Jarka wanted so much to call back to it and say hello, Jarka hears you, she is here too. She is lonely too.
Tenno. Tenno in the camp. Jarka has eyes on them. Tracking. Nobody engage. It will probably go away if we all pretend we have not seen it.
Okay. Does everyone see the Tenno? Listen. Jarka has dealt with them before. Wait until it starts mining. Or fishing. Then attack!
Kela de Thaym said Jarka's marksmanship was 'adequate'! The Kela de Thaym!
Jarka gets confused sometimes. She forgets this war is over now. She shot Kahl. But Kahl says it is okay. Jarka can stay.
Horrek! Stew ready soon?
Chipper is funny. Sometimes Jarka gets two wrenches and plays Skeg drums on his head! The Queens! They must never know Jarka likes Skeg.
Jarka wants to go back to the lake and float upside down like a fishy.
The Corpus boy is easy target. Very slow and very stupid.
Hey.
Or is he? Perhaps it is all Jarka's clever trap. Perhaps anything that comes for the Corpus boy will DIE! Safer just to walk away, yes.
Many animal on Plains. Condroc and Kuaka, and Kavat. Used to shoot because they got in way. Now Horrek leave food out.
I think it's... good... that you're helping out the local wildlife.
Maybe Kahl tame some. Bring home.
Okay, Kahl, get comfortable. Because I need to tell you all about my brother.
Blue girl! Hai-Luk bring package! Kahl got fish you send from Deimos!
Did you like your Cryptosuctus?
Oh, it very ugly. Kahl love it.
Sometimes things have to become ugly to survive.
Kahl? Come in. Are you awake?
Kahl One Seven Five on-station.
I had a terrible dream. Horrid. Guess you get those alla time...
Grineer never dream.
Hmm? Never? Even when you're floating... inna little tubes...
You sleep. Kahl keep watch.
Blue Girl. Camp need supply of Thrax Toxin in case Plague Star fall here.
You need what in case of what?
Plague Star. Big ball of Infested. Make everything Infested all over. Stink bad!
Well, for your information? Kahl? Grineer smell like a bag of armpits. In the sun. In a toilet.
Huh. You can smell from all way over there?
Kahl, before you go. I... It has been very interesting for me, seeing how you... What I mean is...
Kahl and brothers not what Orokin lady expected. You respect Kahl and brothers. You look at own family differently. Feel lonely. Kahl have family and you have... Kahl not know.
It okay.
I'm fairly sure this level of intuition was not included in your design specs.
Kahl self-made man.
Blue Girl? Who is 'Nora'?
Nora Night? Nobody knows. Just another malcontent trying to move mountains. Which, these days, I find myself respecting.
Huh. She sound like she know Kahl, but Kahl never see her. Sound like angel.
Never meet your heroes, Kahl. They always disappoint.
Hm. Maybe Blue Girl got wrong heroes.
Kahl see pretty bug today. Body like blue metal. Wing like glass. Fly right down and sit on Kahl hand. Kahl look right into little bug eyes.
And then what?
Bug... sting Kahl.
Oh dear. Mistake.
Kahl not kill it. Not bug fault. Kahl big, bug little. Next time bug know.
Well, that's another freed Brother safely arrived at Iron Wake. Cressa Tal sends her thanks and respect, blah blah blah. Why don't you two just join forces?
Steel Meridian too big. Worms see them coming. Kahl work better like this. Little group. Like Kubrow pack.
So this is enough? This is as far as it ever needs to go? Just the camp, the brothers, and breaking veils?
Blue Girl got something more important to do?
Right now... no.
Kahl? Why do you keep those tag things?
Those genestamps. Record how we made. Record how we die.
To what purpose?
Hmm. Queens put genestamp in machine. Next time brothers come out better. Kahl remember Brothers his way.
Blue girl. You do science stuff. Right?
Xenobiology and xenobotany with a special focus in synergetic Void harmonics, yes. Disqualified from application to the Archimedean Collegium on a technicality.
Kahl want be smarter.
I don't think that's something I can do, Kahl.
Kahl know you can. Kahl look forward to talk science together soon.

Kahl new brother Sol-ar-is. That him there. Kahl find stuff, Chipper hand stuff out. Chipper tough like Grineer, but... not as smart. Chipper cut off own arms, legs head. Over there good place for Chipper.
That was a pleasing enough distraction. And Mother appears to have forgotten about my misdemeanors in light of what my brother has been up to.
Kahl and brothers not slaves.
What?
No Captains. No Queens. Look around. Just Kahl, and brothers. Today: just us. Tomorrow: much more. Kahl and brothers not slave clones. Not any more.
No. No I suppose you're not, are you.
Emergency. Camp under attack. Worm Condrix sighted. Send assistance. Emergency!
Kahl? Kahl, what the f-
Test done. Emergency channel work fine. Brothers, stand down.
We are going to have words about this.

Camp strong... but can be stronger. Kahl and Blue Girl will free even more brothers. Strong boy brothers and smart girl brothers. Kahl and Blue Girl good team. Narmer scared. Blue Girl excited. Say day of reckoning be fun party. No be party. For brothers... new life.  For Narmer... end of world.
I am glad the Corpus kid wants to make himself useful. But until he can gut and joint a Pobber without fainting, he is useful only as windbreak.
I will never forget the man who gave his life for us. The man whose sacrifice showed us the way. We honor his name. Veko.
So... most Solaris don't like what they do. Huh. Though Chipper did offer to take off my head so I could see if I liked it.
Deep-fried Pobber sure takes some getting used to. Fortunately my suit's recyc system is still online.
I feel sick.
I tried cooking. Horrek was very excited about it. How do I treat burns?
Tell me more about your brothers. Each one is identical to the last, none of them long for this world. What possible benefit can they be to you? It's... so very odd.
Kahl part of brothers. Brothers part of Kahl. World want brothers dead. Kahl say no.
Clone rot undermined genetic conditioning. You developed death fear.

Kahl 'developed' eyes. Kahl know how you see brothers. How Captains and Queens see brothers. 'Honor'. 'Duty'. 'Glory'. Trick. All trick. Grineer die so Captains and Queens... even Orokin... do not.  

Kahl say to them: from now on do own dying. Brothers help.
No. You didn't develop death fear. Back in the day they would have called it dignity.
Blue Girl. Kahl got question.
Proceed?
Chipper and Horrek and Kahl tell stories. You not here, but you still part of camp. So, Kahl say it your turn. What worst fight you ever been in?
Well... I... cut my father's arm off once.
Cooool.

Camp still small, but we grow. Each day more brothers freed. Each day Kahl family grow stronger. Blue Girl family turn away Kahl. So Kahl grateful to Tenno. For new home. Mm. Brothers, too. Make Tenno proud.
Blue Girl. Narmer veil make brothers love Pazuul. Kahl know that. But Kahl not know why brothers still love Queens. Why?
You can't change anyone, Kahl. Try and go mad. If you're lucky you can help those who want to change. Everyone else is a lost cause.
Does Blue Girl want change?
What, exactly, are you suggesting?

Some men have their destiny written in the stars. Not everyone get to be bored. Kahl 'filthy clone'. Built to kill. Built to die. Kahl want to not be slave, to free brothers, he need to plan. To work. Maybe die. You want clown? Find other Kahl. Orokin made plenty.
Kahl, how da...!

Nothin' fancy, but top shelf in my book.
See anythin' ya like the look of?

Everythin' here does the job. Dead set.

Find peace.

Ramn.

This a Thumper station. Thumpers all dead?
Hmm? Probably. Sure. Some of your Grineer friends are locked up here. If you want to say hello.
Okay. We do this.
Propaganda drone. Mother says only the feeble-brained fall for that rubbish.
Have you tried pressing buttons at random until something happens?
Deacon. Kahl sneak.
Hah ha ha!
That was mean. Well done.
There's those Thumper things. All smashed. Looks like you Grineer boys put up quite the fight. Sorry I missed it.
Still lost.
Oh well. Where are the parts?
Huh... Grineer? Maggot! Listen! Find. My. Sister! I give order!
Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! Where she, maggot? Find now!
Ahhh! Trooper! My sister alive! On Murex. Find her.
Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! What they do? Sister... here?
Kahl fight for brothers. Not Queens! But... Kahl break any Veil he find. So. Maybe Kahl find sister one day.
You want the parts, you better dive for them.
Kahl not swim.
Right. Of course you don't.
Kahl. You surprise me. Clever boy.
Rusty. Chipper won't like.
Oh, well, by all means let's shop around for something better.
What about that one? The Thumper. Lots of weapons on that thing.
This one dead.

Dead. See?

Kahl learning soooo much from you.

Shoot in right place. And not die.
All aboard. Keep your heads and biceps inside the windows.
Need break Thumper open.
Chipper want... lo-co-mo-tor core. That behind armor.
Kahl never forget this smell.
Kahl. You almost died here. You don't have to do this.
Yes. Kahl do. Mark brothers.
There's another group of prisoners on the other end of the Murex. I've identified a dropship you could use to get to them, but... you remember what happened the last time.
Kahl survived and escaped with his brothers?
Something like that. Marking your destination.
There's the Bolkor. Held in place by Tether Nodes.
Kahl need to stop doing that.
Get your Brothers, Kahl. I'll arrange your extraction.
Kahl, Grineer signal ahead, but... abnormal. It's as if he was connected to a Sentient mind before Narmer...
Kahl heard of this one.
Reading massive trauma, amalgam rejection, chemical hypersaturation... *how* is it still *alive?*
Brother in pain. Kahl do what Kahl must.
Kahl, you can't save them all.
Kahl save. But not from Narmer.
Ven'kra! Fight!
You not worm puppet! You SISTER! My sister!
Remember jungle? Crush shiny bugs? Wake up wake up wake UP!
Ven-kra Tel! Ven-kra Tel! We are strongest! We are best! Why you not SING?

Enough. I'm myself again. Kahl... I can make it from here. Should the Queens send us after you... we'll let you know first.
Kahl-175. The legend, in the flesh. And he's just a regular tubeman. If you're waiting for me to thank you, forget it. Sprag and I could be executed just for talking to you.
The humiliation. Tempted by Worms. Veiled. And now, freed by a mere trooper! Oh, little Sprag. Of course this was your doing. I should have known you'd never abandon me.
Huh... these portals closely resemble the sphincter muscles of a mammal's lower intestinal tract. You're going through this ship like a big old... ahem.
Now is time for joke?
Nope. Sorry. Not at all. You're busy. I'll let you focus.
Kahl. Extraction is ready, get your brothers to the hangar.
This where Narmer make Veils for brothers. Kahl say blow it up.

Kahl came out tube ready. Still say blow up better.
Ugh. Energy barriers. Kahl, find a way to disable them.
Kahl, that console seems promising.
Hm. Kahl, sweetie? See that big magnalocked door up ahead? You need to get on the other side. Could you be a darling and find a way to disable all those locks?
Kahl, I'm impressed. How did you figure that out?
Point and click.
Can't figure it out? The security console seems promising.
Kahl need other view.
Detecting a veiled Solaris worker. Kahl, try your new contraption! 20 credits says it rips his head off.
Kahl got this.
Ahhhhhhh!
Yaaaay 20 credits!
…YYYYYYYaaaaGHHH what the ALL bloody AS hell ONE you playin' at?!
Go wait by ship.
You. With the face like a robber's dog. That thing on your wrist's a muckin' threat, ya weapon. Gimme ten minutes with it and ya less likely ta deglove someone's head with it! Ah me face.

Deacon skoom CAN die!

Mornin', sunshine! Got the short stick didja? Get a move on, then.

Howzagarn? HaHA! Lead on, matey.
Ugh. Feel a bit crook… but she'll be right. She'll be right.

Nah nah nah. No worries no worries.
I don't hold a grudge. Once they're dead bygones are bygones.
Ooh, messy.
There y'go. Have yaself a little learnin' moment.
One at a time me darlin's. One at a time.
C'mon fellas! This is gettin' boring.
Keep shootin' sweetheart. Who knows? Maybe you'll get lucky.
Yeah, better men than you have tried, ya wanker!
I'd take a welder to ya but the gas makes me nose run.
More and more people are following Pazuul down his deluded path. We need to know what this one knows. They will not go willingly.
Safely home. The target's awaiting unveiling. Let's hope they're grateful for it.
Pazuul's faithful believe they can secure a place in sacred Tau if they massacre the unbelievers. We have no choice but to break them with force.
In blood and glory we ascend. In ecstasy we die. Can you say the same?
All things... are ordained. I intended this. I planned it. Your murder. Our martyrdom.
You have done what needed to be done. Pazuul's delusion must end.
The fastest way to locate Pazuul's Archons is to upload me to Narmer's systems. I shall be strong where he was not.
I have the Archon's trail. The hunt can begin.
Our target's been conditioned by Pazuul personally. Do what you can. Bring them home safe.
And the blindworm deemed the scream of the Condroc to be madness, for she could not see how far and free it soared.
Bite my head clean off, Mother! That's where the good meat is! Suck the guts until the little legs kick, kick, kick!
Target is being debriefed. If any trace of Erra still remains inside Pazuul, I will bring it to the surface.
Whatever Pazuul is building, it is consuming huge amounts of power and resources. Shut his facilities down.
Tau trembles within you just as it consumes me. Kill your pride and follow me, Natah.
The 'Golden Makers' laid the System to waste! Hang your heads in shame, children of abomination! Filth-born! Chattels!
Objective achieved. Well done.
'Objective achieved. Well done.'
We must understand Pazuul to understand his Narmer. You know these vaults. Get in. Find what you can.
Oh Natah, I am no mere cypher to be cracked. Come to me in humility. Abase yourself. And you, even you, will understand.
Tenno. I'm truly sorry. For everything. I saw the truth far too late. She will never forgive me. But you will, won't you?
Thank you. My brother is... unwell. I will... burn... the sickness out of him if I have to.
This gate only opens to Narmer prayers. Tear the Veils from Deacons and use those.
Pazuul has barred the way to us 'heathens', but stolen Deacon veils should allow you to deceive the barrier.
Deacon veils are holy regalia in Pazuul's eyes. They will open this gate even if their bearer is dead.
The Deacon is invulnerable! Take down his flock first, then him.
Amar. Pazuul's assassin. Used to silence those who speak out against Narmer, much as Pazuul himself tries to stifle the voice of Erra within his mind.
Be on guard, Tenno. Archon Amar is stalking his prey. This is the grotesque truth behind Pazuul's gospel of a new Eden. Sentient beasts ruling over a docile human herd.

Archon Amar yearns for the New Creation that Pazuul has promised him. He imagines he will be a lord of the wilderness instead of what he is now. The price of that vision is measured in innocent lives. Stop him.
The Wolf was a mentor to me long ago. From him I learned the wisdom of deception. Amar will prove a cunning opponent.

Despite his pride, Erra never could stand alone. Time after time he allowed himself to be used. First by our father, then by Ballas, and now what is left of him is puppeted by the Ram. I will not say he deserved better, but I grieve for who he could have been.
On Tau, the Wolf roamed without prey. He was created in the image of ancient records from old Earth, a naive tribute to ecosystems long extinct. Those savage jaws were never meant to bite.
Amar! He will close the distance shockingly fast. When he creates duplicates, look for the one that is armed.
Amar thought himself a hunter. Now he is a mere trophy. Good job.
Erra always dreamed of power. It is how he was shaped. But he is no leader, and his mistakes have left the Archon Boreal vulnerable. Take the Archon down.
Archon Boreal serves only the Ram. He cares nothing for the twisted servant that carries him, the being I once called brother. Destroy Boreal and Erra's mind may become clear again.
Whatever Pazuul may preach, Boreal and his fellow Beasts are the ones destined to rule. Erra is merely a tool to them. We must strike where we can.
Boreal is consumed by hatred. He blames both your people and ours for what was done to him. Pazuul provides him with easy targets for that vengeful spite.
Pazuul promises his Narmer cultists a new creation. I do not know how much of that comes from the Ram's memories of Tau, and how much from Erra's dreams of a kingdom of his own to rule.
On Tau, the Owl was solitary. He seemed to think himself above us and recognized the Ram alone as an equal. To be mutilated like this, turned into a weapon, was humiliating for him.
Boreal is here. Strike fast, use cover, and do not let him heal.
Boreal is down. Narmer's spying eyes have been torn out. Excellent work.
Nira. Could she somehow be responsible for what Erra has become? A repayment for what he did to her? The Serpent is old, Tenno, and full of secrets.
To rebuild Paradise, Pazuul's Narmer will destroy all those they consider 'makers'. Archon Nira will be at the forefront of the slaughter.
Who whispered dreams of dominion into Pazuul's ear? Who keeps Erra suppressed and tormented with delusions? The stench of Nira's venom is upon this, Tenno.
Nira devoured her brothers. I will not stand idly aside while she and Pazuul devour mine. Be my sword, Tenno. Strike.
I do not know if Pazuul is truly the leader of the Archons or their puppet. Of all of them, only Nira has the guile to seduce Erra like this.
Pazuul preaches of Tau, where once the great beasts held dominion. But none have seen Tau in centuries, nor heard it speak. Nira and her kin were doubly abandoned.
You found her. Stay on the move. Those eyes can kill.
You dealt with Archon Nira expertly, Tenno. Her kind may expect no mercy. No redemption.
Keep the specialist alive. Their wideband scans should reveal Narmer's purpose in this sector.
And what of your purpose, Natah? Were you sired only to be wet-nurse to these putrid apes? Which of us truly needs to save the other?
Above, the Lords of Tau. Below, my people. Below them, yours. And I shall serve as shepherd and minister.
The scans are complete, Tenno. Prepare for an assault on the Archon.
Cruel sister! Harpy! Gorgon! Why do you PERSECUTE ME?!
Pazuul has stowed sacred Narmer artifacts in Corpus Conduits. We need to ransack them. Little Duck will guide you.
Blasphemy. Ignorance. Brute incomprehension.
Narmer offers freedom. Is that so terrible? Freedom from desire and responsibility alike. Find freedom in surrender, as I did.
We will examine this haul in detail. We will learn Narmer's secrets.
Examine your own heart, Natah. Peel back its blackened layers and look deep.
Pazuul's project is consuming huge amounts of Cryotic. Extract it before Narmer can.
You abandoned me. In the hour of my sacrifice you turned your face away. And so there is no place for you in the eternal fields of Tau.
Bones of my father, fathom-drowned, behold me. Carcass of my mother, flame-devoured, behold me. Limbs of my children, piecemeal, unblinking, behold me.
Pazuul will need to look elsewhere for his Cryotic supplies. Good work.
This facility is a communications crossroads for Narmer. Listen in. I want to know what he's telling his flock.
Do you remember, Natah? That first day? How our father lifted you screaming from the manifold? How we sang?
And I beheld a great Ram, and the horns of him were crowned with Sol and with Tau. And upon his tongue the Zariman flame. And the mighty daemon of the Void cowered before him and he feared it not.
All messages decrypted. Pazuul is not merely insane, Tenno. There is another mind at work within him.
Just admit it, Natah. You're scared to face the possibility that I'm right.
Kahl reports he has found the Archon's current location. Pazuul has no idea what we have achieved today.
Narmer have ordered an environment purge. You must endure. I will send what help I can.
We can divide Pazuul's fractured mind against him. Draw attention with a raid, while our Grineer operative and his Entrati guide ransack Pazuul's archives.
My father severed the worlds. Sundered the link we had forged with Tau, in the days of our enslavement. In the darkness beyond the Veil we waited. The lords of Tau were silent.
Eat, little ones. Feast. Every cycle a harvest. Fill your bellies with the sun's rich blood. In Tau there will be no hunger. Eyes and teeth and tongues... all will be renewed. Devour me.

The Mother and the Father shaped the creatures. The Owl. The Snake. The Wolf. And the Ram who ruled them all. 

It was glorious and the creatures were content. The Ram smiled among New Creation's blue glades.

I am the flail of judgment. I scour the sinful flesh from the bones, that I may restore you to life whole and perfect. None that are foul shall set foot upon holy Tau! The docile and the proud, the fawning and the mighty; we shall build, as it were, a... a pyramid of light... where the knucklebones tumble...

This is the joyful Culmination. Honor and worship upon the prophet Ballas, who fell that Pazuul might rise. Narmer, I call upon you to build as the termites build. I call upon you to conjoin as the molecules conjoin. I call upon you to burn as the stars in their orbits burn, and mark the path we shall re-tread to the world that is to come.

I am Pazuul of Narmer. I abjure the Void that scalded my father's womb. I abjure the Golden Makers. I abjure the Kuva and the Kuria. I abjure the manikin and the eyeless. My doctrine shall be a devouring. Let Narmer draw unto herself all things. Veils to swallow the mind. Vessels to swallow the body. A mighty Maw to swallow all, and bear us to Tau as one.

Vat rats are good at destroying things. Shocking.
