Railjack just up ahead.
Tenno? Hmmm. Brothers trust Kahl, and Kahl trust you. Brothers, get in!
Save teleport for wounded. Kahl walk.
No teleport! Kahl go old fashioned way.
Blue Girl bring brothers aboard. Kahl check everything safe.
We fight for no Queens. We fight for Brothers!
Hold tight, Kahl. Just a little bit longer.
Need to bomb node thing.
Can brother bomb node thing?
Blue Girl, where others?
Grineer have a lot of brothers, Kahl. They're not all going to fit aboard my friend's lander.
Get bigger ship.
Scans show what appears to be a Grineer Dropship, but it might not even be operational.
Kahl make work. First find all brothers.
This one's just a Corpus.
I as ttee. I as it yout petp!
Ugh.
Kahl know what Veil like. Nobody deserve Veil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer: Dead or alive. My Queens care not.
Have you come to submit, or must I make you kneel?
The Void has called you here. Called you to glory, for the Sister Queens, and for me.
Not so frightening now.
A trophy for my Queens!
Another prize for the Grineer.
Alert the Queens! My prize has returned to me. What's mine shall soon be theirs.
Aaah, I knew you couldn't resist your destiny.
About time you recognized your purpose. I, Vor, shall deliver your lifeless husk to my Queens.
Captain Vor and his Grineer clones will be dangerous foes, Tenno. Proceed with caution.
Vor has not forgotten the last time you faced him. Be careful.
Vor is a dangerous threat to the Origin System - and to you. He must be stopped.
Tenno - well done. We can only hope this is the last we will see of Captain Vor…
Finally, Captain Vor is no longer a threat to the Origin System. You have done well, Tenno. Head to extraction.
Good work. Vor has plagued this system for too long.
We end this now!
You fight for no one, Tenno! I fight for my Queens!
You and I were destined for this moment, Tenno!
Come, little Tenno! Show me what you remember of the Old War.
You are ready for what comes next, Tenno!
You will be my trophy! My glory!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DSta: Foolish Tenno, do you realize your Lotus has sent you to die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPH: Tenno, The Grineer rule the Origin System now. You are a walking relic. Pretty, but useless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM: Come for revenge? Arrogant fool. You could have been free.
Tenno. Be careful. Even with the Ascaris Bolt's interference disabled, Captain Vor is a dangerous threat.
NO! This is not over, Tenno! I will have your corpse for my Queens!
Tenno - the Ascaris Bolt. It seems to have gone inert the moment Vor vanished. You have defended Earth from a dangerous threat. Well done. Head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS: You went to sleep in a system of Grineer slaves. You wake to Grineer warriors!
Let us see how you dance, Tenno!
Asleep for so long, you will be no match for my defenses!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor: This is where you die, Tenno!
You have shamed me for the last time!
I want to watch you die, Tenno!
My clone brothers will cheer your death!
I will wear your head as a trophy, Tenno!
Soon, all Tenno will be memories, and the Grineer will triumph!
You will serve us, dead or alive!
I will rip your limbs from your metal corpse!
I look forward to seeing what beats inside your ribcage!
Your corpse will be my glory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DCom: We need to figure out what Captain Vor has done to you and stop him. But we'll need help - I've found a communication segment we might salvage for your ship. When you are ready - activate your Navigation system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DInt: The Grineer are ravenous for this old technology, it is superior to theirs. Perhaps there are systems left in the Orbiter compartment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis: You've done it Tenno. Vor's Ascaris is gone. You are free now.
But your work has just begun. The Origin System is in chaos and it needs you, Tenno.
Vor was just a part of the Grineer machine… and we have seen that the Corpus have begun amassing weapons of their own. It is a dangerous time.
Ordis will gladly assist the Operator in cutting a bloody path- in whatever mission they choose.
We will be at your side. There will be others too. It is time for the Tenno to return. So… what mission will you do next?
Your Foundry Segment is ready for installation, Operator- Will the Operator build a Cephalon to replace me?
Foundry restored! Here the Operator will craft many powerful weapons and tools to- exact revenge for dismantling me- to expand your arsenal.
Oh, no. Operator our component storage has been looted as well...
Typical Corpus, sure the blueprint is free but jack up the components! Operator, we will need resources in order to build the countermeasure blueprint.
Tenno I just received a very explicit message from your ship Cephalon. If you're looking for resources, why didn't you just say so?
I know just the place but I demand an apology… my mother is no gymnast and she would never eat those things.
You can go straight to- Operator, I am sorry.
Wow. You may want to get a new ship Cephalon, when you can afford it… that one seems glitched. I've marked your Navigation with a place I know… good for resources… if you can stand the cold.
The detonator is charging up. You need to bring Vor down. He thinks he can capture you again. Don't worry. I will be with you. Let us show him how much you have learned.
Are you ready Tenno? Facing Vor is the only way to rid yourself of him permanently.
Operator, are you alright?
This part of your journey is over Tenno. I admire you for your struggle but now… I am part of you.
Lotus, do something! Help the Operator!
We Grineer are millions strong, but with a flaw. We are diseased, rotting, sterile, but now we have you.
Operator, do not abandon me again. Build the countermeasure!
I did this for my love, my Queens! They will forgive my insubordination when I deliver you to them.
Our love will be reborn as we feed on your divine blood and our children will flourish without disease. And I will die, at last, at peace. Father. Grandfather.
What do you think you are you doing?
What a waste.
Tenno. Tenno.. Good! You managed to disarm Vor's Ascaris! I thought… I thought I lost you.
Oh no. The Ascaris had a tampering failsafe, its burrowed into you and armed itself. We'll need to find Vor before it detonates.
Get to Navigation - boarding a Grineer ship to access their personnel records will be the fastest way to find Vor.
Operator, what are you waiting for?
Ordis assumes 'finding' Vor implies violence?
Hello Operator, may I suggest you access Navigation and save your life? For my sake.
Thanks for helping me out back there. I'm in your debt... and I often pay my debts.
I recognize that device on your Frame… it's a restraint. We Corpus use something similar to keep our Robotics in line.
So to settle my debt I'll give you a very expensive blueprint… for free! Because I like you… and well, a lot of my customers don't live long with these Grineer dogs chewing up the system.
Here. Use your Foundry to build the countermeasure device from this blueprint. Good luck!
Vor's Ascaris is burrowing into your Warframe, I'm worried it will affect your mind… I can't lose you Tenno. We must restore the ship's Foundry immediately.
A nearby ore extraction colony will have the Foundry technology you need. I am certain they will share it with you. Its location has been added to your navigation console.
Tenno, we may have a problem, the colony is unresponsive. Get to the surface so we can see what's going on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DMis: When you are ready, proceed to the navigation console.
Operator, there is much to be done, please consult the navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd: Operator, you have returned! I am Ordis, ship Cephalon. A shadow of my former self. I cannot serve the Operator in such condition. Order me to self-destruct. I will understand.
Look at this mess. Those savages! Components have been removed. The lower Orbiter compartments have no life-support. Why did the Operator abandon me?
Arsenal management could be restored, if the Operator wishes it.
You honor Ordis! Now I can supply the Operator with better modded firepower... Oh the violation! Those have been looted as well.
Ordis hopes the Operator will punish the Grineer for dismantling it.
Orbiter void cloak engaging… Welcome back, Operator.
The Operator has recovered a segment! Install it now- Ordis patiently awaits its installation.
Get communications online. I must analyze what Vor's Ascaris is doing to your Warframe. This technology is beyond the Grineer, it must be Corpus in origin.
Systems engaging. I suppose this will do- Ordis is grateful.
The Operator is now connected with other Tenno in the system. The Operator may now contact black market scumbags- contact arms-dealers.
Excellent idea Ordis. Tenno, we need to make contact with a Corpus defector sympathetic to the Tenno cause. They will of course, require compensation.
You see what Ordis is referring to, Operator?
In this case compensation will not be credits… it will be freedom. I've updated Navigation. You will need to break him out of a Grineer Gulag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut: I could have saved the Grineer but they cast me out. Maybe its not too late to draw your divine blood.
I will put you down like a rabid Kubrow.
This is our chance. Vor has been stripped of his elite guard, he is vulnerable. Take him out.
Tenno, look! The Ascaris detonator has just disintegrated, it's as if it was directly connected to Vor. You're done here, go to extraction.
Good, your ship is one step closer to completion.
Soon the worm will be in your spine and I will control this Warframe of yours… I will purge your doting mother and bring you home.
You killed the last Grineer. If there are any colonists left, they will know justice has been done for their families. Time for extraction.
I was afraid of this, the Grineer are here and I cannot find any signs of living colonists. You still have a job to do, find that Foundry Segment.
You located the Foundry Segment, now pick it up.
Tenno, you need to pick up the Foundry Segment before we can continue.
Now there is one more thing you need to do. Eliminate all Grineer and provide justice for the colonists.
This was once a prosperous independent colony, until the Grineer arrived...
The Queens fear you, but I will show them. My love will return when I deliver you to them.
Tenno are you there? The signal cannot be boosted any further. Hurry, you are running out of time.
It's ready - take the segment.
A nearby communication tower coordinates Grineer attacks on the colonies. It will have the segment we need.
The segment you need is in a nearby data vault. Infiltrate the vault and retrieve the segment.
As every moment passes, the Ascaris burrows deeper. Revealing you.
This data-vault is equipped with a variety of security measures. How you defeat those measures is up to you.
Activate the console so I can decouple the Communication Segment we need.
You must protect the tower from Grineer until the decoupling finishes.
Do not let the Grineer regain control of the tower.
The Ascaris is working… breaking through. I see the shadows of your mind.
Good work we have what we... wait...
Tenno, coordinates in this nav segment put the Galleon on a direct course to a convoy of colonists.
You have a choice, you can extract now or you can disable this galleon and save the colonists.
Saving the colonists could jeopardize this mission. I recommend you head straight to extraction but the choice is yours.
The navigation segment is in the vicinity. Take it.
You've reached the ships power systems. Destroy the reactor.
That should take the pressure off the colonist ship but you need to get out of there! Get to extraction before the reactor goes critical.
The systems on this Grineer Galleon can be made compatible with your ship. Find and extract a navigation segment.
You have murdered my sons and disgraced me before my Queens. But soon the Ascaris will complete its task and bring you to me.
The Ascaris failsafe is attacking your systems. Your shield capacity has just been halved.
You're wasting precious time, Tenno.
This outpost belongs to The Corpus, a secretive but extremely powerful Merchant Cult known to be working with the Grineer. Darvo will fill you in.
Legions of robots, mindless automatons, freaking lasers! These guys are bad news, but they're also loaded, which is why you're here.
Technically this is stealing but don't let that bother you. The Corpus aren't exactly beacons of moral fortitude either. They sell anything to anyone.
Don't get me wrong, I like profit… a lot, but I don't sell my wares to the damned Grineer. That's unforgivable.
Keep moving there is more here.
Good work but you're not done yet.
Find the next cache, you almost have what you need.
Darvo's intel suggests that this outpost is host to several rich supply caches, raid the caches and take what you need.
Time for extract…
The Ascaris has reached your mind and rendered Lotus mute. You will return to me… over your own free will.
You have murdered my sons and disgraced me before my Queens. But soon the Ascaris will complete its task and bring you to me.
A Tenno! Darvo may live a few more hours!
The Lotus must be desperate to send you fetching greedy fools from the Corpus.
Now the Ascaris has burrowed deep enough to give me influence. Shall we see how your shields work?
The Ascaris is letting Vor control your shield! We must figure out how to remove it. Avoid taking damage while I try and block him.
Bypass the security so we can enter.
This is the prison block. If you can avoid detection by the Warden it may be easier to get Darvo out.
I owe you for this Tenno. I will get my entourage to meet us in orbit once we're clear of this mess.
Tenno, help me! I'm feeling actual, physical pain. Do something!
It wasn't supposed to end this way. Tenno, please, do something.
You can't leave Darvo behind, Tenno. Using your Warframe's revive system should get him moving again.
Tenno! This really hurts, I ain't kidding around. Do your thing!
Hey, is somebody out there? Listen, whatever you think I did, I swear, it wasn't me.
Oh, thank you. I thought I was a goner. Let's keep moving.
Search these cells for Darvo. He has to be here somewhere.
The arms dealer is named Darvo. He's being held in the prison block on the other side of this factory complex.
Darvo is out for himself, but he is sympathetic toward the Tenno. The Grineer must have found out.
How many Grineer slaves died to build this place?
Don't let Vor distract you. Focus on the mission, it's our only hope of figuring out this link with him.
Extraction is ready. Remember your success here depends on getting Darvo out of there… alive.
You've been spotted. Get ready for a fight.
I see the Lotus has tried to wake you… pity she's too late!
You're my prize now, Tenno.
No!
We are taking this one with us.
What has he done to you? I can't lose another Tenno. I'm surging your Warframe's power systems.
Quick. Use your power. Defend yourself.
Use your power, now!
Keep moving.
Salvage team, why have you not reported in?
An extraction ship is waiting for you. But the Grineer will be hunting you. Arm yourself.
Quick, choose a weapon.
A Tenno's melee weapon honors their warrior tradition. When technology was turned against them, they adapted.
There's a cache of weapons ahead. Grab what you can.
Tenno. Pick up a weapon. You are running out of time.
Good. The extraction point is up ahead. Hurry before Vor finds out you've escaped.
You made it. There's the extraction ship!
My decrepit heart is pounding! This one is stronger than the rest. Lock the area down! This Tenno is mine!
Get out of there Tenno, you will have to face Vor another time… when you're fully restored.
Grineer, my sons, prepare the reinforcements. We need that Tenno.
The Queens want to destroy you, but I need to know more
Tenno, you cannot survive without arming yourself. Choose a weapon before we continue.
I'm not sure what Vor has done to your Warframe but we cannot remove it now. Just keep going, your ship is up ahead.
There it is, your ship. Hurry, Vor's reinforcements must be on their way.
Escape will only be possible with a primary weapon. Choose now.
Your Parazon is a versatile tool. Use it to breach this panel and restart the ship.
Stop touching me you - what? Are my sensors deceiving me? Operator, is that you?
Enemy reinforcements are here! Ship Cephalon, we require immediate extraction.
The Operator is in danger? I will need a few moments to cycle the engines!
Tenno, the ship is ready, it's time to leave
Tenno, are you afraid? You cannot hide from these old eyes. I've marked you. You will return to me.
There's the ship. It will require power. Activate it.
Quick, get to the console, and release the lockdown. Do that, and I will guide you to your old ship. It's your only chance.
Tenno, you need to go to the console to release the lockdown.
I've marked the console on your map. You need to access it to release the lockdown.

The segment is yours. Head to extraction.

Who waits for the shadow?
Vosphene glyphs. Hm. That takes me back.
I see you, you bastard. I see you.
Contact Parvos Granum immediately. Get me authorization for multiphasic ordnance. Tell him I've found that damned ghost!
Evasive! Focus shields!
Isolating escape corridor. All hands: evasive maneuvers.
Corpus Salvage team headed for debris field.
Salvage team eliminated.
Alert. Void storm imminent. Corpus reinforcements imminent. Obligatory withdrawal imminent. This escalated quickly.

[12.3]

[15.7]

Commence salvage. Void storm resurgence probable. Get the lead out.
Target out of phase. Weapons ineffective.
Escape corridor locked. Grab something.
Crew: sensor glitch is back. Stay sharp. This may not be a bug.
Potential catastrophic sensor glitch. Visual confirmation required. Crew: did you see that?
Gunfight not an option. Isolating escape corridor. Anomaly detected.
Archive loaded. Our vessel was called The Tempestarii. Void rescue craft. Missing since the Old War.
Captain Glarios knows something about that vessel. Crew: infiltrate and recover Orokin-era naval records. Our ghost ship has a name. I want it.
Duty lingers. Like pain in a phantom limb. Like the voices of a crew long-dead. The Tempestarii is suffering, searching for one final rescue. Saving us may enable her to complete her duty.
Exemplary service record. Rescue total: two-thousand-and-seventeen souls. Cited for bravery in the second and third Tharsis engagements. Multiple commendations. A legend.

Lost during a Void-storm of unprecedented magnitude. Interesting. Final mission contains a black mark. Refusal to withdraw. Logs record final transmissions. Calling into the Void. Before being engulfed. She has been calling ever since. The Tempestarii went down saving lives. She still waits for an answer.
You have been invited into an unknown realm. Tread lightly.
The 'Shadow.' Concentrated Void energy. He is: not conventionally alive.
Their final rescue. The location data is corrupted. He cannot retrieve it. We can help.
Data restored. Downloading coordinates.
Brace. Brace. Brace.
Their shields are down! Oh, sweet Tenno. You went and lulled the beast to sleep for me! How kind.
Balls.

I was working in an exosuit when the Tempestarii destroyed Lucretia Platform. I drifted for days among the frozen fragments of my crew. My Sisters. I dreamed their dead, gaping mouths were singing with me yet.
My kind are all the only monsters this System needs, Tenno. We have no time for old ghosts. I shall rip that ship to pieces and eat its heart.
Forget capture! We'll sift through the wreckage instead. Tracers locked. Engage.
Back to the Tempestarii. Now.
Objective: Collapse the anchor field.
Countermeasures charged. On your mark, unleash the storm.
Multiphasic beams have the Tempestarii imprisoned. Solution: junk the beam generator.
Transmitting Orokin-era distress signal. Here goes nothing.
Who waits for the shadow?
Your golden masters.
Countersign: unsatisfactory. Evasive maneuvers. Attempting to reopen communications.
Comms channel reopened.
Who waits for the shadow?
We, the lost souls.
She hears us.
Tempestarii. All aboard are safe. Your mission: complete.
The Tempestarii has lowered shields.
Crew. Your presence is requested aboard the Tempestarii.
"Who waits for the shadow?" Possibility: friend-foe identification protocol. Loading Orokin-era distress countersigns. Prepare to disengage void-drive.
We are part of this story. We have a duty. Enter the Void. Search and rescue. We must complete the Shadow's final mission, together.
Tempestarii is charging unidentified countermeasures. Stay in range. Swat down pests.
Sisters! Hear me! Hound them to hell and back. By the hand of Parvos himself!
I wait for the shadow.
Your shadow has come.
Sevagoth. A Warframe believed lost to the Void forever. His energy almost extinct. With his last spark of life, Sevagoth embraced his Shadow once again. And both were at peace.
With full honors, we committed the body of Sevagoth to that distant horizon.
He waited. We came. Here is to clearer skies. Record sealed.
Sister...
Cephalon Cy's report. Tempestarii. Final voyage.
Today a centuries-long journey ended.
Together we braved a turbulent Void.
Deep within, he who had been lost was found.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY: Fam! Scope this! Glinty brought Yareli here! Didn't I tell you she was free now?
Klokkit, Yareli! Here. In our Vents. You a real one, Glinty.

When I was just a sprog, I smashed meself up something awful. Near ripped the servos clean out of me knees. Wasn't expected to heal. But Roky stayed there by me cot, tellin' stories of the Waverider. Some traditional, some I'm pretty sure she made up. Don't think I'd be here today if it weren't for her and her daft Yareli stories. Those feats, they're not for us; they're for someone like you, Glinty. Help me. Give me a story to tell her? A good one.

We found her crashed hard at the base of the Harindi Gap. Board in bits. If her neuro conduit stays dark... she won't wake up. Only Nef's Augmentors got the skill to replug a neuro. And there ain't no hope of his help. Ah, sis, what were you doing?? We found this Graphica on her. No idea what it is. Locked it is. Can't read a lick of it.
Time's up, kiddlywinks. You can still save your... 'home'... and fix young Roky. Augmentors are standing by. Just transmit the unlocked Graphica.
Can't believe you gone and did it, Glinty. Gave us her story. Y'know... Roky always said it'd be trouble the day I started thinking. If Nef wants that Graphica so bad? He can have it.
Oh, children. I understand your friend recklessly damaged her neuro-conduit? Uncle Nef can fix her right up, free of charge. If... you fulfill her end of the deal.

See Roky, Yareli didn't give in. She fought Vulgran. Her fam stuck together too, didn't stab each other in the back. That mucker Nef's got the older sprogs mouthing off. Saying you 'tight with the taxman'. Saying you 'betrayed your logical fam.' Younger sprogs are listening too. If they wanna go, they can go. We'll be a fam of two, Roky. You 'n' me. Logical.

Page one, unlocked! Can't wait to read the first-ever Yareli story! The one Roky could never tell me because nobody ever seen it. Roky? Dunno if you can hear me. But I'm gonna read you this. I hope you're listening, sis.

So that's who Vulgran was! A mucking slave-driver! This ain't just some comic, Glinty. The legend of Yareli's been keeping orphans like us going for generations. It's our story. Roky must have wanted us all to have it. She was always the storyteller of the fam. Keep cracking those pages, Glinty.
Hurry and klok that new page, Glinty. Roky's conduit's still ain't sparked, but I wanna show her Yareli's story the second her eyes are open.

Tick tock, lovable orphans. I haven't heard from that skip-diver Roky in quite some time. Is she not done unlocking my Graphica yet? So excitable. I do hope nothing happened to her. Your reward is waiting, child. My buyer is eager, and what she offers is worth more than mere credits to me.

Shammin' mucker! My sis was never in his pocket! Yareli's our fam, and Roky wouldn't sell her - especially not to the likes of him! Sis, don't matter how you got that Graphica, to the sumps with Nef. Roky, we stand by you. But... How did you get it?
Boom, did you hear that, Roky? Glinty did it. Can't wait to read the next page to you. Can't believe you had Waverider #1, and you didn't tell me.

Always been this way, innit. Muckers rakin' in dosh on the backs of regular coves. I reckon Roky nicked this from Nef somehow. Didn't tell us cause she didn't want heat on the whole fam. Well - Yareli's ours, our fam, not his. And we protect our own.

Deal's off. Something's spooked my buyer, and now I'm stuck with a useless Graphica I can't sell! Fortunately for me, the same buyer was interested in purchasing a controlling share of the rental rights to your vents. You piss-rats are her problem now. And... as for your broken little friend? Might I suggest selling her parts as salvage? You'll need the credits to pay your new landlady.
Boom! Made that look easy! Roky's gonna lose it when she hears this.
Just like Yareli, riding fancy. Getting chills thinkin' about it.
Glinty's kickin' it terminal! Do it for Roky.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul: Citizens. Colonists. In our name, you venture forth. In our honor, you will build. By our will, you are chosen. Our love is absolute.

I, Executor Tuvul, would never condemn a mere citizen for being afraid. You stand upon the precipice. It is natural to tremble. But see that you set your jaws and hold your tongues. Do not infect others with your shameful misgivings.
We do not gamble with the lives of our beloved citizens. The jump will be over in a mere moment. Within this mighty metal heart, all of you are as safe as babes in arms.

Since you citizens cannot be brave, since you refuse to stifle your infantile urges, howling and whining like ungrateful children, you shall be punished. Food is hereby restricted to one meal per day.
We can see you, citizens. That is our burden. Our constant duty. We deserve to see your gratitude. Write it in smiles upon your upturned faces. Leave us in no doubt of your loyalty.

Hear me, if you still can. Microscopic creatures live upon your skin, and yet you are oblivious to their existence. So it shall be with the Seven and yourselves. We wash our hands of you. The Zariman project is no more.

We stretched forth our Great Hands, shaped to match our generosity, and we gave. Such abundance! You citizens were to be the first to settle a new system! And now your bestial defiance has cast you into the pit. Come to those hands again, and you will find them closed to you.
We are deathless, above you citizens as the mountain is above the ant, and yet we envy you, little people. How marvelous a thing it will be to dwell under an alien sun.
Whispers are the currency of the petty mind. Citizens who walk upright have no time for them. Root out treachery as you would root out a malignancy in your child.
On the eve of this great adventure, the first Void Jump beyond the cradle of the Origin System, we - the Orokin Seven - salute you, our brave citizen colonists.

We have learned that some of you consider the jump too dangerous. Remember, citizens. The air you breathe aboard the Zariman is not free. It is a luxury you are permitted to indulge in, and like any privilege, it can be revoked. Be aware of this danger, too.

The future of the Origin system is... uncertain. Some think it is destined to burn. I still have faith, and you fortunate colonists are the reason. With your help. We will outgrow this crowded nest, spread our wings to the cosmos, and take flight.

Those citizens who follow after you, secure in the comfort of an extrasolar Rail, will wish they had shared in your hardship. How reverently they will speak of those who blazed the trail! How prized your simple genetic stock will be!

Citizens, be aware. You will never be out of our reach. If you squander this venture, you will know no forgiveness. We have your names; our loyal servants stand ready to punish your families at our word.

How dare you fear? What do you imagine you have to lose? You citizens are born to die; such is your lot! But even such a death as yours may be meaningful if it serves Us. In this alone is your salvation.

Pop her out, and we'd see Void Storms from here to Mercury. Which would be fascinating, if memorably horrible. Anyway. Feel free to bring me anything you think I might be interested in. That's all!
Objects that have affected one another continue to affect one another even when they're separated. I've missed you.
I wonder if I'll still be here at the heat death of the Universe, pondering the blue twilight.
You've seen things in the Deep Void too, haven't you? Lashing like dragons and bellowing like giants?
There will never be another Archimedean Symposium. No more waiting, petrified, to find out if it's you the Golden Lords are singling out this time.
I think you'd have liked me, back when I was human. I mean, I hope you would.
Rydal and Mohler, Kazirei, Suda, Tylan, Halako and Vrenn. All the shining Archimedeans. Where are they all now?
I'd figured it out! How the Zariman could jump all the way to Tau in one big bold leap, disabling the safeties in sequence. If I had it to do again, we could make it.
I never liked to stay too long in the Reliquary Drive chamber, even when I was alive. I kept thinking I could see myself out the corner of my eye, grinning.
I had the Albrecht Entrati dream again. It's always the same. I ask him where he's gone, and he says 'Everywhere'. Then... he tears himself in half.
There are whole decks, empty except for the Angels. They're singing, like something big is coming. So that's good.
The hours I spent struggling to understand Eternalism, and here you are, embodying it.
This place is like an embassy. Playing host to misfit realities that were never chosen.
So many intersections. Planes and possibilities. Hazard and luck and intent.
They hunt you, don't they? The Angels? Do they ever say anything to you?
It's funny how we're both Void constructs, sort of. Difference being that I'm dead. Not your fault.
Do you ever just wish you were a Cephalon, so you could switch bits of you off?
Please be kind. My head is very noisy right now.
Somewhere there's a version of me who stayed behind on Lua, and I hate her.
Sharded causalities piled up in the Heilbronn margin, singularity refusing to play with any of them... oh, the Universe is a messy place.
It's worth it. All of the headaches and frustration and being wrong over and over is worth it.

This... is the first time being alive has really felt like being alive, for me. I'm intact. Recovered. Like some complicated, fragile relic gently lifted up from the earth and brushed clean of all the dirt. If I'm not careful, I could end up saying something very stupid and rash. So I won't. I'll just say thank you.
I suppose you could always come back when you have something?
Very well. Keep your secrets.
My patience is almost endless.
Fascinating!
Ah, thank you.
Let's open this up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr: Good. Now it'll stay hurt.
That's the way. Break it down, body and soul.
Yes! It won't be shrugging that off.
You weren't fast enough. Now it's healed.
The Angel has almost recovered! Hurry this up!
Grubber. The Angel is trying to retreat into the Void so it can heal. Follow it and stop it.
Confirming a Void Angel at your location!
Reading Void Angel signature, heading right for the Reliquary!
A Void Angel just woke up and is looking to snack on the Relic!
You can't hurt it while those dimensional orbs are out. Use your Void body to absorb them.
You got some Argozene. Go build.
The more Argozene you have, the more armaments you can construct.
Dropping off an Argozene canister.
Topping up nearby Argozene.
Reckon you could use more Argozene.
Argozene canister inbound.
Resupplying.
More Argozene. Don't waste it.
Exodamper down. You just gave them a clear path to the drive.
Exodamper disabled. Do a better job protecting the drive.
Exodamper out of action. Watch that flank!
Took down an Exodamper. Gettin' stronger.
One less Exodamper. That's a boost to the enemy.
Exodamper clear of hostile forces.
You kept that Exodamper standing. Good work.
The Exodamper made it. But they'll be back.
Do not let this wave of scum take out that Exodamper.
They're hitting an Exodamper. Hit them first.
Exodamper under threat.
Get ready. Enemies inbound.
They're throwing more losers at ya.
Don't let up. More no-marks incoming.
Brace for a fresh wave.
Protect your Exodampers!
Angels feeding off the drive.
Stop that Angel now or we're all finished!
Stop that Void Angel from feeding, Grubber!
That Angel is full up. It's over. Get out of there.
That Angel compromised the Reliquary. Retreat and regroup.
It's over, damnit. The Angel has fed. This is my fault.
They are ripping that Relic wide open!
Relic's barely hanging on, Grubber. Hope you got a miracle in ya.
Relic is almost destabilized. This is not sustainable.
The Relic's taking a pounding, Grubber! You're meant to stop that!
The Relic cannot endure this amount of punishment! Do better!
If they destabilize the Relic, this mission's a failure. It cannot defend itself.
They destabilized the Relic. We're done.
Reliquary compromised. Get your stuff and clear out. We failed.
Guess it was all too much for ya. They won; we lost. Go lick your wounds.
You let them destabilize the Relic, but it'll recover with time. Get out of there while you still have your skin.
Reliquary compromised. Nothing more you can do. Find self-extraction.
It's over. Nothing more you can do right now. Self-extract and regroup.
Squad incoming. Defend the Reliquary!
Reliquary is exposed! Enemies inbound!
Enemy have exposed our Reliquary. Get it defended!
Another wave incoming. Reliquary is vulnerable.
Not done yet. More coming. Prioritize the Reliquary.
You'll need Argozene. I'm sending you a canister now.
Good work, grubber. Here's where we divide the spoils. Extract if you want, or hold out for more.
You won us some breathing space and a share of what we were able to loot from them. Extract when you're ready.
They committed so many troops to this attack, they forgot to defend their crewships. Here's your share. You're clear to extract.
Corpus attack inbound. They're targeting the Reliquary, and the Angels will take notice. Build armaments, safeguard the Exodampers, and keep the drive stable.
Grineer are attacking the Reliquary Drive again. That's waking the Angels. Deploy Armaments and keep the Exodampers online. Protect that Drive.
The longer you hold the fort, the more we can loot from our would-be boarders. Hope you're having as much fun as I am.
While you're keeping them busy, we're helping ourselves to their stuff. You get a cut, of course.
All the fighting down there in Oro Works is one hell of a useful distraction.
Look what uncle Cavalero found.
I'll put this on the pile.
Don't let success go to your head.
Don't even think of throwing in the towel now!
Well, look at you.
You gotta wonder what possessed these goons, thinking they could gain mastery over the Void. Heh. Maybe some of them are possessed.
There's some kind of a fire in these no-hopers, pushing them. I can't work it out.
These wasters are fighting like their lives don't matter. They're driven. I've seen that kind of fury on this ship before... once.
Don't give these fools you're slaughtering a second thought. The Void's already starting to take them. I can feel it.
Reliquary ahead. Exodampers blunt enemy capability. They'll target them first.
Enemies will hit our Exodampers first, so they can fight unimpeded. Then they'll target the Reliquary Drive.
Defend the Reliquary, but don't neglect the Exodampers. Their fields keep enemies on the back foot.
Armaments in position.
Defensive ordnance complete.
Armaments constructed.
Construction complete.
Deployable defenses in place.
Reliquary is secure. You did good, Grubber.
Reliquary is safe. Don't go looking all smug about it.
Not bad. Room for improvement, but not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa: Void Cascade is nearing the tipping point. You are about to face irreversible contamination.
Cascade is approaching critical levels. Your time is running out.
The enemy has triggered the release of a Possessed Exolizer. Purge it before it pumps out even more Void Contamination.
Possessed Exolizer located. Purge it and make it work for us.
Marking a possessed Exolizer. Deal with it while you still can.
The Void Cascade has just hit a new level of intensity. Be careful. We have no idea what it could manifest.
Contamination just spiked. Keep your wits about you.
Readings are off the charts. I don't know what sort of nightmares you might encounter.
Void Contamination critical. Do these invaders have any idea what demons they have invoked upon us all?
Spent Exolizer has been retired.
Exolizer spent.
We are down an Exolizer. Working on backups.
You're cleared to self-extract when you're ready.
I've opened an Extraction route. Your choice when to use it.
Extract yourself when you need to.
The Void Cascade has surpassed the tipping point. It's lethal now. Leave the area while you still can.
Kid? Tenno? Say something. Can you hear me? KID!
Hey. Talk to me! Oh no...
Hey... kid... you can't give up on me now. KID?!
That Possessed Exolizer is spitting out contamination. Use your Void power to purge it!
Our enemy has abandoned valuable supplies. This is yours now.

The Corpus have triggered the deployment of Thrax Possessed Exolizers. Deployed altogether, they will cause an instant Void Cascade. I can stagger their deployment, give you time to purge them, so they can cleanse the ship instead of corrupting it.
Grineer meddling with the Reliquary Drive has triggered a Void Cascade. Purge our Exolizers and keep them purged, so they can stop the Cascade getting out of hand.
Any nearby attackers will degrade the Exolizer's performance. Clear them out to get the system working full-steam.
If you can kill Grineer close to the Exolizer, it'll pull the Void contamination right off of them!
Now the Exolizer's purged, any casualties you inflict within its field will bring the contamination level down.
Contamination subsiding.
Void Cascade losing steam.
Void contamination dropping.
Cascade receding.
Exolizer purged.
That Exolizer is working for us now.
Exolizer is ours.
Exolizer online.
Exolizer suppressed. Purge it before it makes the contamination worse.
We just lost an Exolizer to possession. Get it back.
Contamination spreading.
Cascade intensifying.
Contamination levels going in the wrong direction.
This cascade is growing out of control.
This discovery might interest you.
Enemy bounty secured.
Struggle has its benefits.
Ah. The Void has manifested something other than a nightmare.
Our enemy's folly is your gain.
See what you make of this.
That got their attention. Enemy forces moving to your location.
Destabilizing the Zariman is a foolhardy strategy. The Void has already started to degrade our enemies' judgment. You did well to stop them.
You did everything you could. I've secured enough cleansed Exolizers to keep the cascade at bay for now.
Good work. You did all you could out there.
A Void manifestation is possessing an Exolizer. Stop it before it feeds the cascade.
Exolizer succumbing to Void possession.
Exolizer under assault.
Keep those manifestations away from the Exolizers.
Those Void nightmares are hellbent on one thing: manifesting more nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx: Don't slow down now. Body count can go way higher.
So long as they keep coming, you keep killing.
No flagging. You're my favorite little meat grinder.
Don't let your weapons cool down. Lots more fighting to do.
Greedy, plundering Corpus bastards have come aboard without permission. Mow them down without a second thought.
These Corpus ain't here to trade. They're looking to steal, from us. Give 'em hell.
We got a bunch of Granum clowns looking for easy salvage. We are nobody's free lunch. Bust some heads.
These Grineer grunts are hunting for Kuva on our ship. Get in there and carve 'em up.
Boarding party. Grineer clones. Half rotten already. Wipe 'em out.
Grineer only understand violence. Show them they don't belong in our home.
Granum can mark this one down as a net loss. Corpus forces retreating. You did good.
Corpus goons are going back to daddy Parvos empty-handed. You sent 'em running.
Busted helmets and boots full of blood, all over the deck. Corpus are broken. I'm kind of impressed.
Ahh, they finally got the message. Grineer are backing off. Good work.
You broke 'em. Nice. Keep hitting 'em hard enough and eventually they get it.
They wanted to do things the hard way, and now they're done. Grineer are pulling out. Great job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl: I designed this system to deliver Vitoplast directly to Void Ruptures. Would have been nice if that design worked in practice.
Vitoplast is everywhere except for where it should be. Grab some and stuff it in a rupture.
For more Vitoplast, try looking up.
In retrospect, engineering Vitoplast to float was a mistake.
Collect every bit of Vitoplast you can find.
Did you... have a chance to ask it where it came from before you killed it?
Interesting. They can be destroyed!
Well. That's one less Void abomination to worry about.
I do not know where that thing came from but it will not be going back.
Void Floods have a tendency to wash in terrible things. One of those things is approaching. Do be careful.
You may notice your combat conditions worsening.
Something just changed. Any fighting difficulties to report?
Void Saturation causing further complications.
Should you need a break, self-extract at the marked location.
You can always do more. But if you can't, I have marked an extraction point.
I have opened an escape lift for you. Use it... when you need it.
Damn the Void. Not another one.
Oh. If we had an ethics board, I would definitely get written up for this.
Tenno. Are you... oh dear.
I said get to extraction... Why does no one ever listen to me.
The Angels have torn open another rupture. Fill it with Vitoplast before this whole ship goes topsy-turvy.
Oh look. You sealed a rupture. Not bad.
Wow. Vitoplast sealed that rupture! Just as I knew it would.
Ruptured sealed. On to the next.
Rupture closed.
I think you're carrying enough, don't you? Bring it to a rupture.
Don't get greedy. Take all that Vitoplast to a rupture.
Don't think you can carry anymore.
Think you got enough for now. Maybe feed it to a Rupture.
That should keep Skittergirl away for a bit.
She's gone. For now.
Think you taught Skittergirl a lesson? She never learns.
Scratch one anxiety fueled poltergeist.
You've strayed from your squad and Skittergirl has taken notice. Watch your stuff.
Skittergirl likes to target stragglers. Like you. Right now.
Observation: Skittergirl is stalking you.
You lost Skittergirl. Wish I could do the same.
Skittergirl has disappeared back to whatever corner of the Void she emerged from.
Wish I could shake my anxieties as easily as you shook off Skittergirl.
I'm so very sorry about this. One of the fears the Void likes to manifest is childhood anxiety. Meet the repressed fears of teenage Yonta. I call her Skittergirl. She's a thief.
The Angels are clawing at the Albrecht membrane, creating Ruptures that will saturate the area with Void.
Enemy activity has enraged the Void Angels. They're ripping the Albrecht membrane, exposing this entire ship to a Void Flood.
Void saturation is approaching critical levels. Critical levels can kill you. Shall I explain further?
The Void Flood has completely saturated this area. Failure to seal those ruptures immediately will result in... Well... Total failure. Not good.
You have reached maximum Void Saturation. This typically results in death.
Maximum Void Saturation! Seal some ruptures or get out of there.
Void manifestations coming your way.
Watch out. The rupture has birthed something terrible.
Gather up nearby Vitoplast and bring it to the ruptures.
Skittergirl, you little twit. Get away from them.
Skittergirl. Stop. Oh. You are insufferable.
Hey, Skittergirl! Stop. They're helping. More than I can say for you.
Well. Look at you. Saving the Zariman. Again.
Not bad for a day's work.
Ship saved, enemies overcome, research notes updated. What more could an Archimedean want?

Welcome to Everview Arc. Ensure that children are supervised at all times.

Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Archives may be consulted by appointment.
Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Agri-biome access has been temporarily disabled.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Please remember to salute any dignitaries you meet.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Aesthetic standards are being actively enforced.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Gaze upon what the favor of the Orokin may bring.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons. To witness the wisdom of our masters, simply look around you.
Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Mastery of protocol is expected.
Welcome to The Greenway.
Welcome to The Greenway. By the will of the Seven do all things grow.
Welcome to The Greenway. We shall never comprehend how great are their gifts.
Welcome to The Greenway. Admission to public poetry recitals is strictly limited.
Welcome to The Greenway. Cephalons are on duty in all zones.
Welcome to The Greenway. The success of our voyage depends on you.
Welcome to Oro Works.

Welcome to Oro Works. Labour, and do not inquire.

Kira's almost recovered. You need to put her down.
Those orbs will redirect any damage you can do! Try throwing yourself through them.

The Orokin only wanted ceremonial weapons on the Zariman, but for something as important as the Reliquary Drive, they built in two little security guarantees: auto-fabricating Armaments and Exodampers. Exodampers suppress enemy combat ability. We need to defend our Exodampers and our Reliquary with Armaments. Got that?
Don't bother trying to hurt Kira's Angel form now. She's pulled her essence back into the Void. You're gonna have to follow her in there.
We use Argozene to build the Armaments. I marked an Argozene drop on your radar. Think you can manage to find it?

You're a natural. Now, I'm sure you want to go crazy building armaments all over, but you cannot do that. You need to use sockets. Go find the socket that appeals to you most - your socket, the socket that was meant for you -  and build something dangerous in it.

Mercy me, I do believe you've got the hang of this, Grubber. One more thing. Enemies coming through Oro Works are always helping themselves to our Argozene, so feel free to take it from their cold dead hands.

Listen, kid. Hombask here. Quinn means well but... there ain't no stopping this. We're hungry. Just like Kira was. Only a matter of time. Sooner Quinn admits that to himself. The better.

So remember, like we remember Kira. There was a place in this park where she used to love to sit. I think perhaps it would suit a memorial.

Aren't you a fascinating anomaly. Anomalies? Right! Explanations. When consciousness and Void come together, it makes a thing. For example, me! Not nearly as fascinating as you, though.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityA: Coil Horizon Augment: Gyratory Sphere can be recalled. Enemies in its radius suffer |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage and chain other enemies. Enemies pulled into detonation suffer additional discharges.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityD: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSystemsCompone: Systems component of the Gyre Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthAmmoEffici: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthCompanionD: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthEnergyShar: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthHackDescri: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthMaxStatusD: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthProcBlockD: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthShieldArmo: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStatusRush: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStrengthDe: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStunDescri: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthTreasureDe: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelpRecipeSentient: Component blueprints can be acquired from Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and the Orb Vallis (Venus) after completing The New War quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltBHelmetD: Love the light of dawn even as you know the shadow of death. A distinguished helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltCHelmetD: Show bravery in the service of justice. An esteemed helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltHelmetDe: Remember your courage with each step. An elite helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteArmyAbility: Final Stand Augment: Each javelin that damages an enemy grants |OVERGUARD| Overguard to Styanax and |ALLY| Overguard to his allies within Affinity Range.
Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBashAbility: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBash_Abilit: Tharros Strike Augment: Increases Critical Damage by |CRITICAL|% on enemies you hit. Critical Damage bonus is doubled for Spearguns.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteFrameDesc: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Styanax Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteImpaleAbili: Axios Javelin Augment: A pair of Styanax Specters spawn to throw javelins, creating vortexes on impact. Impale an enemy to increase vortex duration by |VAL|s.
Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HoplitePassiveAbil: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRallyAbilit: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRecipeHelpT: Acquire Styanax blueprint and component blueprints from Chipper in the Drifter's Camp after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidDesc: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidPassiveAbil: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityAugm: Ice Wave Augment: Create a frozen trail for |DURATION| seconds. Enemies that touch it are inflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status every second.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityBoos: Boost the distance your Ice Wave travels
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityDesc: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityAug: Hall of Mirrors Augment: The damage of your doppelgangers is increased by |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% every time you kill an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityDes: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosDesc: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosPassiveAbili: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityAugme: Ravenous Augment: Nidus has a chance for additional Mutation stacks while in the infestation. The base |CHANCE|% chance increases with power strength, and multiple stacks are possible above 100%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityDesc: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityA: Parasitic Link Augment: Nidus and any ally he's bound to gain |HEALTH|% Max Health per Mutation during Parasitic Link.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityD: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAugmentB: Temporarily maintain Health increase from Parasitic Vitality
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAbili: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAugme: Passive Augment: Nidus gains an additional |STACKS| max stacks of Mutation. Undying has a |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationAltHelm: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Nidus.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationDesc: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationHelmetD: The standard issue helmet for the Nidus Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotAltHelmetDe: This alternate helmet for Follie blends colors the way Follie blends reality.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotDesc: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotFestivities: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotGouacheDesc: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Follie Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintChange: Shadowgraph has been modified. Save changes before exiting?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintClearC: This will delete all layers. Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintContra:
You are saving a custom Shadowgraph. Showcasing your talent and creativity is important, but not at the expense of others. Your creations must adhere to the Warframe Community Guidelines.

Type '|WORD|' to agree.
Your creations must adhere to the Warframe Community Guidlines.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintCopy: Copy layer color and opacity into currently selected layer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintDescDr: <WARNING> Click and drag to swap the Shadowgraphs of two abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetA: Cannot have an empty canvas. Reset to default and close?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetC: This will reset the canvas back to its default state. Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintShapes: <WARNING> Drag brush strokes onto the canvas to create new layers
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPassiveDesc: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by |SLOW|% for |DURATION|s. Afflicted enemies have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA: Provides ammo for any weapon type.
Three Amphors of random elemental affinity to use as grenades or for Alchemy.
Disrupts and controls enemies with Electricity Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookC: A random conduit key to speed up Disruption missions.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD: [PH] Paint a Dargyn vehicle into the world that you can use for navigation and damage.
Inflicts Radiation status and damages enemies.

Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookL: Provides extra support during Survival missions.
Surges those who use it with Void power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookR: [PH] Paint a Rampart into the world that you can use to mow down your enemies with scaling damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookT: Ensnares enemies and slows them down.
Points the way to nearby treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSkinDesc: The standard issue skin for the Follie Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotTrompeLoeil:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Damage Reduction cap at 75%, and Inkblot will not be applied on enemies.

Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotWheelSwapDe: This will swap a default Shadowgraph to an unrelated item, are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit: Invisibility Augment: Weapon noise is reduced by |NOISE_REDUC|% while invisible.
Boosting this ability increases its duration.
Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies. Camouflage is broken on receiving or dealing damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameAuraAbili: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlastAbil: Balefire Augment: Fully charged direct hits restore |SHIELD| Shield to Hildryn. Impact with Nullifier Shields will destroy them and restore |NULLIFIER_SHIELD| Shield.
Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlasterDe: Charges up and releases bolts of Balefire.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameDesc: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameEruptionA: Aegis Storm Augment: Balefire has an Alternate Fire during Aegis Storm. The blast deals |PERCENT|% of Hildryn's Max Shield as additional damage.

Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameHelmetDes: The standard issue helmet for the Hildryn Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFramePassiveAb: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameStripAbil: Pillage Augment: Enemies affected by Haven will be set ablaze for |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and restore |SHIELD| additional <SHIELD>Shields to Hildryn.
Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityAug: Iron Skin Augment: Recasting Iron Skin will cause it to detonate, dealing |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% of its remaining Health as <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage, and knocking down enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityBoo: Boosting this ability increases the damage negated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityDes: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IvaraDesc: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityAu: Strangledome Augment: Enemies held in Strangledome have a |DROP_CHANCE|% chance of dropping additional loot.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityDe: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityA: Whipclaw Augment: Hitting |ENEMY_TARGETS| enemies will grant a |DAMAGE|% stacking Damage Bonus to subsequent Whipclaws. Bonus will decay after |DECAY_PAUSE|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityD: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraDesc: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityA: Venari Augment: Venari dies in Khora's place. Recovery timer increased to |TIMER|s. Killing enemies decreases the timer by |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityD: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatDesc: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraPassiveAbilit: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraTwirlAbilityD: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraWhipclawWeapo: Khora's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
Khora Prime's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiBlockAbility:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Gain between 10 to 20 Omamori Charms but cannot gain the invulnerability.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiChassisCompo: Chassis component of the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiDefaultSkinD: The standard issue skin for the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiDesc: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiFortuneAbili: Omikuji Augment: Reduce Omikuji's Cooldown by |COOLDOWN|s when you kill an enemy with the weapon affected by Koumei's Passive.

Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiHelmetCompon: Neuroptics component of the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiInstantRewar: Destiny aligns. Koumei seizes a Decree.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveAbili: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveMelee: Melee hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassivePrima: Primary Weapon hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveSecon: Secondary Weapon hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPuppetsAbili:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiStringsAbili: Kumihimo Augment: <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|KILLAMOUNT| kills with weapons affected by Koumei's Passive give a loaded die that always rolls 6. Hold to cast empowered Kumihimo and consume all dice.

Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiSystemsCompo: Systems component of the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityAugme: Tentacle Swarm Augment: Enemies held by tentacles have a |DROP_CHANCE|% chance at additional drops.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityDesc: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu: Hysteria Augment: Attack with Valkyr's Talons to leap onto targeted enemies up to |RANGE|m away. Gain +|PARKOUR_BOOST_PCT|% Parkour Velocity and +|SPRINT_BOOST_PCT|% Sprint Speed for |DURATION|s.
Hysteria Augment: While Hysteria is active, each kill restores |SHIELD_PCT|% Maximum Shields.
Hysteria Augment: Damage increased by |DAMAGE|%, Critical Chance increased by |CRIT|%. Hysteria lasts for |DURATION|s, and receives a matching cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityDe: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandHysteriaA: Bonus Armor to Warcry during Hysteria
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandStanceDes: Valkyr is imbued with energy and becomes a ball of vicious rage, capable of unleashing a torrent of deadly claw attacks on unsuspecting foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavoPassiveAbility:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosChassisCompon: Chassis component of the Lavos Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosHelmetCompone: Neuroptics component of the Lavos Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosSystemsCompon: Systems component of the Lavos Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityAugm: Bastille Augment: Killing an enemy in Bastille extends the duration by 2s. Vortex's duration is increased by |DURATION_INC|% of its Maximum Duration for each additional Vortex thrown into it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityDesc:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityPvPD: Creates an energy-based containment field that slows down any opponents who enter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboDesc: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboPassiveAbilit: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityAugment: Link Augment: Reduces Armor Rating by |ARMOR_REDUCTION|% on enemies targeted by Link.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityBoost: Boosting this ability increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityDesc: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityAugm: Undertow Augment: Allies can stand in the pool to regain |HEALTH_PERCENT|% Health every |HEAL_TICK|s. Hydroid will restore |SELF_HEAL|% Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityDesc: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityPvPD: Become a water trap, opponents that come into contact will be knocked down if they attempt to jump.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquifyAbilityAugm: Plunder Augment: Plunder gains |ARMOUR|% max <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage and Armor, and heals allies within Affinity range for |HEALTH| Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiDesc: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiPassiveAbility: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LuckyDragonAbility: Elemental Ward Augment: Allies that leave the radius will retain the effect for |DURATION_PCT|% of the remaining duration.
Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagDesc: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityDesc: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityPvPD: Creates a whirling mass of energy that knocks down and damages nearby opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagPassiveAbility: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MerulinaDeluxeDesc: Call upon Yareli Pandea’s faithful companion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaDesc: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaPassiveAbility: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility: Mind Control Augment: Controlled target inflicts +|DAMAGE_INCREASE|% Damage and gains +|MOVEMENT_SPEED|% Movement and Attack Speed.

Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
Nyx invades the psyche of a target, making opponents appear as teammates and teammates as opponents. Target also cannot damage Nyx.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MirageDesc: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MiragePassiveAbili: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MolecularPrimeAbil: Molecular Prime Augment: Enemies hit by Null Stars are primed. When killed, primed enemies will restore a Null Star charge and have a |CHANCE|% chance of restoring two.
Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudAbility: Cloud Walker Augment: Allies within |RANGE|m of the cloud become invisible to enemies for |DURATION|s.
Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudReworkA: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathAbility: [PH] Defy Augment: While invulnerable, Wukong taunts nearby enemies. When the invulnerability ends, enemies within |RANGE|m are blinded for |DURATION|s.
Escape death by receiving a boost of health when killed.
