/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityAugmen: Speed Augment: While moving under the effects of Speed, enemies within |RADIUS|m will take |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage with guaranteed Status effect.
Speed Augment: Running into an opponent increases the duration of Speed by |DURATION_INC|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityBoost: Boosting this ability increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityDesc: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityPvPDes: Gain a brief boost of movement and Melee attack speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StairwayToHeavenAb:
Hallowed Ground Augment: Reactivate to deal all Remaining Damage and <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
Passive: +|DURATION|% Hallowed Ground Duration.
Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerAbsorbAbili: Absorb incoming damage and cast it back at enemies in a barrage of energy projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerPassiveAbil: Stalker's attacks have +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance against enemies who do not see him.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerSmokeScreen: Cast a shadow that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, briefly making Stalker invisible.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerStunDescrip: Stun a target. When a target dies, a portion of damage dealt to the target is dealt to other nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerTeleportDes: Teleport to a target and perform a finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Stalker regains a portion of the energy spent.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StatisAbilityDesc: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxChassisComp: Chassis component of the Styanax Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxHelmetCompo: Neuroptics component of the Styanax Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxSystemsComp: Systems component of the Styanax Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwitchTeleportAbil: Switch Teleport Augment: Switch with an enemy for |DURATION|s invulnerability. Switch with an ally to give ally |ALLYDURATION|s invulnerability. Switch also removes negative status effects on Loki and allies.
Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwordOfDoomAbility: Exalted Blade Augment: Exalted Blade's Damage Type changes depending on Excalibur's Emissive Color, and Status Chance is increased by |PROC|%.
Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TearInSpaceAbility: Cataclysm Augment: Duration increased by |DURATION|s for each enemy killed.
A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityA: Teleport Augment: Using Teleport increases Parkour Velocity by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s. Executing a target with Teleport extends Smoke Screen's duration by |INCREMENT|s. Teleport Mercy Kills fully refresh the duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityB: Boosting this ability increases its range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityD: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityP: Ash teleports towards the target, bringing him into melee range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleAltHelmetDes: A spike-studded alternative helmet for the Temple Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleDefaultSkinD: The standard issue skin for the Temple Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleExaltedGuita:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
Add <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to Lizzie, Temple's exalted guitar.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Temple Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveAugme: Passive Augment: Gain |OVERGUARD| Overguard when using an Ability on the Backbeat. Amount doubles up to |MAXGAIN| per Beat, but resets if the Beat is missed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveDesc: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleRecipeHelpTe: Temple's main and component blueprints are acquired from the Solstice Square Defense mission in Höllvania, or can be purchased from Flare Varleon in Höllvania Central Mall. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleShredAbility:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.

<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Backbeat synergy is unavailable.

Shred violently your guitar to spawn several <DT_FIRE_COLOR>fire pillars on enemies where you are aiming.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSoloAbilityD:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSpeakersAbil:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSuitDesc: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityAug: Larva Augment: Reactivate Larva to detonate and deal |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage in a |RANGE|m radius. This damage and Status Effect stacks for every enemy grabbed by the Larva.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityDes: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.

<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Range
Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies, and pulls them in.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility: Terrify Augment: Affected enemies have |SLOW_PCT|% reduced Movement Speed.
Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them deal less damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityAu: Tidal Surge Augment: Clears Status Effects and grants |DURATION|s of Status Immunity for yourself and allies that come in contact with it. Reduces Tidal Surge's Energy cost to |ECOST|.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityDe: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaDesc: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaPassiveAbil: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperMultinadeAb:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperStrikeAbili: Photon Strike Augment: If Photon Strike hits at least <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COUNT| enemies, the next cast will cost no Energy and fire two additional strikes.
Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityDesc: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveAbil: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveBuff: Increased Health based on Trinity's Max Energy
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityWellOfLifeA:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Increased the Immortality Cooldown to 120 seconds.
Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
Cooldown on death prevention from Trinity's Well of Life
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrDesc: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrPassiveAbili: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanDesc: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanPassiveAbili: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityAug: Rift Surge Augment: Limbo deals |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% Extra Damage for each enemy affected by Rift Surge while in the rift.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityDes: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltDesc: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltPassiveAbility: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit: Toxic Lash Augment: Melee kills create |RADIUS|m toxic clouds, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin/s for |DURATION|s.
Toxic Lash Augment: Create |RADIUS|m toxic clouds, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage/s for |DURATION|s with every kill. Damage is twice as strong for Melee kills.
When active, melee strikes burst spores causing them to spread to nearby enemies.
While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityA: Well of Life Augment: On death, marked enemies will drop |HEALTH_ORBS| Health Orbs with a |ENERGY_ORB_CHANCE|% chance of dropping an Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityB: Boosting this ability increases its duration and the health leech percentage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityD: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfAltHelmetD: The Yuvan Clerisy presented this ceremonial helmet to Voruna, their guardian of stray souls and attendant to the dead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfBiteAbilit:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDefaultArm: Default armor set for the Voruna Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDefaultSki: The standard skin for the Voruna Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDesc: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Voruna Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHowlAbilit: Ulfrun's Descent Augment: During Ulfrun’s attack, enemies that die from <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status within |RADIUS|m restore Voruna’s charges.

(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfLeapAbilit:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Passive Removed
There is a chance for enemies killed by melee attacks to drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots to drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's Hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfPassiveAbi: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfRecipeHelp: Voruna's main and component blueprints are acquired from Yuvarium and Circulus (Lua) after completing The War Within quest. They can also be purchased via Archimedean Yonta on the Zariman after completing the Angels of the Zariman quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfShroudAbil: Shroud of Dynar Augment: Increase an enemy’s Damage Vulnerability by |DAMAGE|%. Using Fang of Raksh on that enemy increases its spread radius by |AMOUNT|%.

(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameDesc: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameHarnessAb: Breach Surge Augment: Teleporting to a Reservoir costs |ENERGY|% Energy and grants |CRIT|% Critical Chance to Primary Weapons per meter traveled for |DURATION|s. Maximum |CAP|% Critical Chance.

Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameLightAbil: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFramePassiveDe: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameReservoir: Reservoirs Augment: Adds a fourth reservoir that gives the effects of all three. Costs <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY_PCT|% more Energy.

Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameSunAbilit: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Wisp Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispSunAbilityAugm: Sol Gate Augment : Wisp and 2 spectral images cast a single blast of Sol Gate, leaving an area with |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage / Second with guaranteed Heat and Radiation Status Effects for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility: World On Fire Augment: Enemies hit have a |KNOCKDOWN|% chance of being knocked down.
Boosting this ability increases the duration and area of effect.
Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityAug: Worm Hole Augment: Allies that travel through wormhole gain a |SPEED|% Speed bonus for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityDes: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithAltHelmetDes: A macabre alternate helmet for Sevagoth, the Warframe who harbors the Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithChassisCompo: Chassis component of the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithDefaultSkinD: The standard issue skin for the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithDesc: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithGloomAbility: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithHelmetCompon: Neuroptics component of the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithPassiveAbili: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityA: Reap Augment: Increase Critical Chance by |CRIT|% on enemies inflicted with Death Harvest. A new Shadow emerges from those enemies when they perish. Limit of |COUNT| Shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityD: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperAbilit: When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperDefaul: The standard issue skin for Sevagoth's Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperHelmet: The standard issue helmet for Sevagoth's Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityAu: Sow Augment: Enemies killed while inflicted with Sow spread its effect in a |RANGE|m radius. Shadow's Death Harvest also inflicts Sow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityDe: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSystemsCompo: Systems component of the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongDesc: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongPassiveAbili: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliAltHelmetDes: Emerge from the depths with this alternative helmet for Yareli.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility: Merulina Augment: Enemies eliminated during Sea Snares heal |HEAL|% of Merulina's health. Upon healing, gain +|SPEED|% Reload Speed and Fire Rate on Secondary weapons for |DURATION|s.
Merulina Augment: Yareli no longer rides Merulina. Instead, Merulina follows her and casts Sea Snare on nearby enemies. |VAL|s cooldown.
Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBubbleAbilit:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliChassisCompo: Chassis component of the Yareli Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDeluxeSkinDe: With the fall of the Orokin, Yareli Pandea drifted into the ocean's depths where Hunhow rediscovered her. Now, she ascends to fight once more.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDisksAbility: Aquablades Augment: Activate Aquablades when the ability is in use or cooldown to throw one blade. Blades gain |PCT|% damage when any Aquablade hits an enemy. No cost to throw with Merulina.
Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameDesc: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameRecipeH: Yareli's main blueprint is awarded from the Waverider quest. Component blueprints can be researched in the Ventkids' Bash Lab Dojo Room in any Clan.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliHelmetCompon: Neuroptics component of the Yareli Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliHelmetDesc: The standard issue helmet for the Yareli Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliPassiveAbili: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliSpoutAbility: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliSystemsCompo: Systems component of the Yareli Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangAuraAbility: Pacify & Provoke Augment: Pacify converts damage done to allies into an aura that slows enemies by |SLOW|%. Provoke converts damage done to enemies into |STRENGTH|% extra Ability Strength.
In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangBurstAbilit: Mend & Maim Augment: |CONSERVATION|% of charge is conserved when switching between forms.

In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili: Metamorphosis Augment: Equinox's other half breaks free for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE_MULT|% Damage.
Metamorphosis Augment: Switching to Day-form staggers enemies within |RADIUS|m and knocks them down when switching to Night-form.
Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili: Rest & Rage Augment: Killing an affected enemy causes the effect to spread to enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DURATION_PCT|% of the remaining duration.
In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.

<HELMINTH> ALTERED
If your Emissive color is dark, targets are put to sleep. If your Emissive color is bright, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityAugm: Tesla Nervos Augment: Enemy health when a Nervos is first attached is converted into |RANGE|m burst of <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityDesc: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrBurstAbility: Airburst Augment: Each enemy hit by Airburst increases secondary damage by |DAMAGE|% for |DURATION|s.
Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrDesc: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrPassiveAbili: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAbil: Tail Wind Augment: Casting Tail Wind resets Zephyr’s bullet jump. Each enemy hit increases Tail Wind Damage by |PERCENT|%. Damage resets upon being on the ground for 2s.
Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAugm: Tail Wind Damage increased. Resets after being on ground for 2s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTornadoAbili: Tornado Augment: Creates |NUM_TORNADOES| additional tornadoes. All tornadoes are |SIZE_MULT|% their original size and won't pick up enemies.

Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTurbulenceAb: Turbulence Augment: Turbulence increases Movement Speed by |MOVEMENT_SPEED|% and Projectile Speed by |PROJECTILE_SPEED|% for Zephyr and her allies.
Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle2D: The Quills reserve some attention for you. They appear willing to involve you in their mysterious efforts.

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisDesc: Indentured workers to the Corpus; the indispensable backbone of the Corpus business model on Venus. Manning factories, rail tractors and mines they work to pay off the artificial bodies (rigs) they bought in order to work.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisSecret: Risen from the ashes, Solaris United returns to free the Solaris people from their mental shackles and physical servitude. No being should have to work to own their own mind, their own body, their own future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle1: Solaris United don’t trust easy, Outworlder. Talk to Eudico.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle2: You get things done, but your loyalties are still unproven.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle3: You seem a solid mucker. The locals are happy to sort you out with odds and ends.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle4: You’re the go-to gun for the risky stuff. Word is bond.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle5: Inner circle, mate. Eudico’s right hand. You and SU: one and the same.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisUnited: Solaris United works from the shadows to free Solaris workers from the yoke of Corpus debt-slavery, to secure the right of every Solaris to own their body and control their future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian: Led by a battle-hardened Grineer deserter, the Steel Meridian fight a guerrilla war against a vast enemy. They are sworn protectors of what little remains of the colonies.

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsDesc: Hangin' with their logical fam in the ducts of Fortuna, the Ventkids get by stealing parts from the Corpus and running K-Drive races out on the Vallis. At night the ventways bang to the sound of skeg - to the chagrin of the locals.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle: No dings, never taken a hit, wouldn't know ya ta look at ya. Have you even ridden a K-Drive?
Nice enough; wouldn’t last five minutes in a vent.
Solid sorta mucker and you ride a K-Drive like it's stolen. ‘Cause it is.
Stand-up cove and vouched for, this one. Chekchek?
Had no say in your biological fam, but this crew's your logical fam. Ventkids are logical; got no time for muckers who ain't.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolDesc: Solaris United's core personnel operating under the name of that group's enigmatic and anonymous figurehead. SU is the public face of the struggle. Vox Solaris is something else entirely; something known only to Eudico... and the Quills.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle1D: We watch, we anticipate, we intercede. We're just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle2D: Got a good feeling about you, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle3D: Glad to have you with us. We say, you do. We have been waiting for you, to deliver upon them a terrible ruin.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle4D: The best of our best. Your acts are legendary. Your acts can never be known.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle5D: You are one of us. Together we reach from the darkness to reclaim our future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanDesc: Granted a second existence through the mysterious power of the Void, the four Holdfasts struggle to keep their sanity and their vessel intact. The return of the Tenno may turn the tide.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle1: The Holdfasts are now more than strangers to you... and to themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle2: With memory comes remorse... but also responsibility.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle3: Trust has taken root and begun to grow, even in this desolate place.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle4: You have undone the worst that the Void could do, and humanity is within reach.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle5: You have become the savior both of the Zariman and of her last remaining crew.

Greetings, Child. 

Infuriating, is it not? To one day wake up and find holes poked in what was formerly a perfectly retentive mind. 

I have no interest in commiseration of your War stories; you did what you did. Instead I come to offer you an incentive, if only for a short while.

You know of the Dark Refractory, yes? It allows one to traverse their memories, no matter how inaccessible they may have been rendered. 

Use it. Explore the deepest depths of your war-torn psyche. Show me the limits of the Device. Do so and you will earn my very own Marks of Valiance. But act with haste Operator, for my magnanimity sets like Sol itself. Come visit me within "La Cathédrale" afterwards, and I shall show you what being in the good graces of an Orokin can buy you.  

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe

Greetings once more, Child.  

Regrettably, for myself at least, this vein of the Dark Refractory has exhausted its gold. As delightful as it has been to watch you trade your mental faculties for the dregs of my once-enviable treasury, it seems there is nothing of any more value for me to glean from that machine. Yes, that means there will be no more Marks of Valiance. 

Don't stop your mental flagellation on my account, however! I am sure that there is still much for you to gain from your little Tenno war therapy sessions. I already know we lost, after all.

Yours,

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/TradingRule:
Welcome to Warframe's Trading system! Here you can trade in-game items and Platinum with other Tenno.

The first rule of trading in Warframe is to only trade in-game items that are available in the trade window.

Attempting to trade items outside of the game is considered a violation of the Terms of Service/EULA.

To learn more about safe trading practices, hover over the tips icon in the trade window.

Hitting "Accept" means you have read and understood the above.

Happy safe trading, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_0: Both players are responsible for reviewing and confirming that what they will be receiving in the Trade is what was agreed upon before accepting.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_1: Any changes that occur while Trading requires confirmation from both players before proceeding. Take note of each change before accepting!
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_2: Platinum purchased through unauthorized third-party sites or individuals is not permitted. All official and supported payment options are available through the in-game Market.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_3: A Warframe account may only be accessed by its original creator. The transfer, sale or purchase of a Warframe account is not permitted.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_4: The breed and visual qualities of a Kubrow or Kavat Imprint can be seen in the "VIEW OFFERED IMPRINTS" button in the Trade menu. Review the Imprints you are receiving before completing trade!

/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmShor:

WARNING: By skipping ahead you will encounter many story spoilers, and face extremely difficult gameplay intended for experienced players with fully modded, max rank weapons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmed: To access The Descendia and The Perita Rebellion use the |BOLD_START|Dark Refractory|BOLD_END| option at the Navigation Console in your Base of Operations.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Desc:
The hunt for Albrecht Entrati continues.

The Hex are vying to protect their city from the Scaldra and Techrot alike. It's a race against the clock to save Höllvania — don't be late, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli:
Höllvania's a mess, the Hex are even messier. Meet our newest Syndicate, a motley crew of Protoframes trying to keep their world from falling apart. 

Bonds can be forged in even the most dire of circumstances —  with the new Romance & Relationship system, you can connect with Syndicate members like never before. Chat and play with Hex members to increase your Chemistry, expand their lore, and maybe even earn yourself a kiss. 

Access this context after completing The Hex Quest!

A new time, a new place —  explore all that Höllvania has to offer, featuring new enemy factions and mission types. 
• Compete against your foes and fellow Tenno in the new Faceoff game mode! 
• Hunt down Legacytes in an endless capture style mission featuring Kalymos. 
• Take on Scaldra's ultimate weapon in the H-09 Efervon Tank Assassination mission. 

Access this new content (and more!) by completing The Hex Quest in your Codex.

Cruise through your mission objectives in style with the new Atomicycle! Aided by its 4 unique abilities, you can burn rubber with your new ride in Höllvania and Open Landscape missions. 

Unlock your Atomicycle via the Hex Quest and adorn it with new Liveries via the Market.

Assemble the Hex into your Arsenal with new Gemini Skins. Use the corresponding Gemini emote to swap your fashion frame on the fly —  from Warframe to Protoframe, and back again! 

Embody your favourite Protoframe with these fully customizable skins featuring unique voice lines that respond to your actions in-mission.

Move like a shadow, strike with force. This Warframe marries damage and stealth to tackle even the most difficult situations. Take aim at your enemies with the ultimate sharpshooter: Cyte-09.

Earn Cyte-09 via Höllvania Bounties or from Amir in Höllvania Central Mall after completing The Hex Quest.

We've freshened up both Nyx and Trinity's kits! Whether you're playing as their default, Prime, or Protoframe, these Warframes bring quality of life improvements and updated mechanics to the battlefield. 

Nyx embraces chaos with changes that increase the lethality of her Mind Control Target and improve synergy with Radiation status effects across all of her abilities. Use Psychic Bolts to strip enemy defenses and Nyx will now retain a portion of what you've stripped.

Trinity is her squad's saving grace with the ability to negate lethal damage via Well of Life. Energy Vampire now benefits from positive duration, and Link scales with strength to tether to more foes. 

For a full rundown of their changes, check out our patch notes!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999HowToP: Turn back the clock to 1999! Venture into the world of Höllvania in our new story expansion: The Hex. Access this Quest via your Codex after completing The Lotus Eaters and The Duviri Paradox.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat:
A cosmic conflict stretches through time and space.

Discover what fuels this fiery battle and come to understand the Stalker's role in this follow-up to Jade Shadows.

Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

Sirius & Orion are customized and upgraded separately, but can be swapped between in-mission by hold-casting Abilities. Swap between the Sons to build up Constellation Stars, which are used to generate their ultimate Celestial Clash.

Earn our latest Warframe via the new Railjack missions in the Uranus Proxima after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.

When a great Sentient summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future, Sirius and Orion, have come calling in this new cinematic quest, and they are not alone.

Mentors who have raised Sirius and Orion in their respective futures, Ryoku (Ash) and Vena (Garuda) share a rivalry of their own. Where Ryoku drives home his pride at the tip of an assassin's blade, Vena soaks in the endless acceptance of wrath.

Venture to the Uranus Proxima and choose which Protoframe to aid in battle. These new Railjack missions become available after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.

Nidus' kit has received a refresh, featuring various quality of life changes to help him grow his Mutation Stacks more quickly. Highlights include:

• Increased Mutation Stacks cap to 200. 
• Virulence does Damage Over Time that also generates Mutation Stacks. 
• Larva can now be recast.
• Ravenous' radius scales with Range. 
• Improved Maggot targeting. 

For full details on this change, check out the official patch notes.

Jade Shadows: Constellations brings a variety of quality-of-life changes to existing content:

• Corpus Ship tileset remaster
• Knockdown unification from enemy attacks
• Damage Over Time Preview on healthbars
• New Camera Position setting in User Interface settings
• and more!

Learn more about these Quality of Life changes, and more, in our official patch notes.

New Incarnon Genesis have been added to the Circuit for the Obex, Stug, Vectis, Ballistica, and Destreza! Enhance your Arsenal even further with new Arcanes (available from Uranus Proxima missions) and new Warframe Augments. 
 
Choose the path of wisdom with the new Dante Tytonis Collection, or flaunt the new Vena and Ryoku Gemini skins for Garuda and Ash!

A furiously destructive conflict across the stars stretches through time and space. Discover what fuels this fiery battle and come to understand the Stalker's role in this follow-up to Jade Shadows.

The new Jade Shadows: Constellations quest is available to those who have played its prequel, Jade Shadows.

Once complete, gain access to new Railjack missions in the Uranus Proxima!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathDesc:
The time has come, the day turns into night,
And the one called Dagath will finally take flight. 

A doomed mission calls for Tenno aid aboard a drifting Galleon. Answer the cry for help and be rewarded for your efforts!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Meet our newest Warframe, Dagath! Her signature melee weapon, Dorrclave, heals her slightly with each active Status Effect.

The Syndicates need help to finish a doomed mission to recover Orokin Era Defixios from a Galleon of Grineer raiders adrift in the Abyssal Zone near Ceres. Defixios are known to contain a new Resource, Vainthorns.

Resurrect a Naberus legend with the new Dojo Room, Dagath's Hollow! Here you can customize your Kaithe, acquire the Blueprints for Dagath and Dorrclave, and listen to Grandmother's new Naberus legend about Dagath.

The king of the sea has received a Rework! Hydroid's <DT_IMPACT>Impact and <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic Damage have been changed to <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage and Status; Charge Mechanics have been removed; Undertow has been replaced with a new Ability titled Plunder, and much more!

Your furry, robotic, fleshy, and everything-in-between pals have received a rework and can no longer die! How you use, Mod, and interact with your Companions has changed in this first phase of the Companion system overhaul.
A NEW WAY OF LIFE FOR COMPANIONS

New accouterments await you in the Market. Scare the pants off your enemies with the Awlspan Syandana, traverse Duviri in style with the Aumen Kaithe Gear, and take your fashion to the next level with Voidshell Skins for Protea, Nidus, and Mirage! All that and more is available.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHowT: Purchase an Abyssal Beacon from any Syndicate to reveal the Abyssal Zone ship adrift on Ceres. Collect the new Resource Vainthorn needed to craft Dagath and the Dorrclave in the new Dojo Room, Dagath's Hollow.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteDesc:
Author the story of the Leverian with the help of Dante and his Exalted Tome, Noctua!

Defend the Leverian from the avaricious clutches of Parvos Granum and the Corpus! Master Dante's Abilities as you take on new Missions like Murmur focused Disruption and greater challenges than ever before.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.

Awaken the king of the desert once more and command the sands with far more ferocity than ever before! Inaros has been reworked, featuring a new bleedout mechanic, and completely refreshed Second, Third, and Fourth Abilities.

This update brings some of the most difficult missions yet: Deep Archimedea. Only those with Rank 5 in the Cavia Syndicate are trusted to walk this challenging path, but with great reward waiting for them at the end. Necraloid in the Sanctum Anatomica will be your guide!

Fuse base Shards into Tauforged variants with this new Helminth expansion! Those with the Helminth Coalescent Segment installed can now fuse three of the same Color Shard into one Tauforged Shard. Earn this Segment via the Cavia Syndicate after completing the Whispers in the Walls Quest.
Two new Incarnon weapons can be yours: the Ruvox and the Onos! Earn these via the new Disruption mission on Deimos (after completing Whispers in the Walls), or grab them in the Market!

Styanax's warrior spirit is reimagined with the Styanax Tonatiuh Collection! This update also includes new TennoGen creations from community artists Ventralhound, Erneix, and Goosmo in our TennoGen Unbound release!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHowTo:
Visit the Cavia in Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to play the new Deep Archimedea mode, or help Drusus save the Leverian in Armatus, Deimos' newest Disruption mission! 

Complete Whispers in the Walls to gain access to Deep Archimedea, and complete both Whispers in the Walls and The Deadlock Protocol to play Armatus!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver:
A familiar face, an unlikely ally. 

Dominus Thrax calls for aid —  the Murmur have invaded the Kingdom of Duviri, led by the newly resurfaced Major Neci Rusalka. 

Step into Isleweaver and face off against Oraxia as you work to unravel Rusalka’s latest web.

Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Draw foes into your ever-tightening web with our 61st Warframe, Oraxia! 

Oraxia can be obtained from the new Isleweaver node in Duviri after completing The Hex Quest. Complete the spiral and defeat The Fragmented to earn Scuttler Husks (a new currency), and a chance at Oraxia's blueprints.

Stand aside, Drifter. Warframes take the spotlight in the new Isleweaver node — with Dominus Thrax's permission, of course. 

Select your loadout from the available equipment in Teshin's Cave, and gain access to them immediately upon stepping foot into Duviri. For a limited time, play Isleweaver to earn progress and rewards for Operation: Eight Claw.

The Isleweaver node brings you into a new story: the tale of The Triumph of Dust. 

Rusalka aims to write a new ending in her favor —  one that twists Duviri’s fate. Isleweaver mirrors The Lone Story mission structure, but with a twist: play through six objectives and face a formidable foe at the end. Many of your objectives will feel familiar, but are corrupted by Rusalka’s touch. 

Fight through the Murmur and put a stop to her plot, at any cost.

A berserker’s fury fills the air. Corpus, Grineer, Infested: torn pare by pare.

Valkyr’s rework focuses on her core identity: the rage of a berserker. She’s received a top-to-bottom ability refresh, including an updated Passive that leans into a new mechanic: Rage. With this, we intend to capture the essence of reckless commitment. No breaks allowed.

Learn all about the Valkyr rework in our Patch Notes, or simply unleash her in-mission to see it in-action.

Captain Vor, master of the Janus Key, has received a rework. New and returning players can face off against this iconic foe in a dynamic new fight. While he’s not too punishing for new players, he may have a few more tricks up his sleeve if you fight him in a more difficult setting.

Junctions in the Star Chart have also received refreshed Tasks and Rewards, with the goal of streamlining the path to completing the Main Story quest line.

Embrace the eternal bond between love and war with Citrine Aphrodita. 

Isleweaver also brings a slew of new community-created customizations with TennoGen Isleweaver, and familiar hairstyles for your Operator and Drifter.

Journey to the new Isleweaver node in Duviri to face off against Oraxia and Major Neci Rusalka’s forces!

Unlock Isleweaver by completing The Hex Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeDesc:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Jade Shadows brings our newest Warframe, Jade, a glorious herald of both life and death. 

Delve into long-held secrets of the Origin System with our new Ascension Game mode, and latest cinematic Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli: Evoking the solemn — yet melodic — hymns of a choir, the newest Warframe sings songs of devastation as she heralds both life and death across the Origin System’s many battlefields. Through her, the Jade Light can be a source of destruction or a source of support.

Introducing our newest mission type: Ascension! Stalker’s stronghold is under intensive assault from marauding Corpus forces, but what they’re after must remain safe. 

Bring your Warframe gameplay to new heights with this game mode, available on Uranus after completing the Jade Shadows quest.
ASCEND INTO A NEW GAME MODE

Uncover Stalker’s oldest secret in our newest cinematic quest: Jade Shadows. Venture into his lair to uncover the truth, and deal with the aftermath that unfolds from it. 

Complete The New War quest to access this content.

Find these new Eximus variants wherever Eximus spawn, but be wary of their Jade Light. These foes summon a beam that deals increasing damage the longer it touches you, so you better be quick. 

Dispatch your enemy quickly or outmaneuver them to survive!

Review your Arsenal with new Enemy Scaling and Status changes. Armor stripping has been improved with our Armor scaling rework. Simplified Enemy vulnerabilities can be viewed on any node to help optimize builds. Revisit Cold, Blast, and Magnetic damage with changes to these status types — and much more.

Check out our patch notes for full details.

Strike forth from the watery depths with the power of Yareli Pandea in her new Deluxe Skin collection! 

This update also features new TennoGen creations from community artists Rekkou, Lubox, LostEpoch, DasterCreations, Ventralhound, and CERF.
A FRESH WAVE OF FASHION FRAME
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHowToP: Complete The New War to unlock access to the Jade Shadows quest and venture into Stalker’s Lair!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiDesc:
Seize the threads of destiny with Koumei.

The Dice-Maiden warns that Infested horrors lurk in the shores of Cetus. Venture into her Fate Dream to save the Ostrons from a terrible future.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh:
Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.

Earn Koumei via the new Saya's Visions node on Earth. Learn how to access this mission via the "How to Play" button in the Update History screen.

Terrible horrors have been foretold in a Fate Dream, and danger darkens the Ostron’s shores. Together, Saya and the Tenno can weave a brighter future for Cetus.

Venture into the new Shrine Defense mission to protect Koumei’s shrine and ferry her offerings to help ward off the Infested threat. Access the new Saya’s Visions node on Earth by talking to Saya after completing the Saya’s Vigil and Once Awake Quests.

Caliban has received both a rework and a stunning Deluxe Skin with this update. Command your Sentient Wrath with an updated kit, including new Sentients to summon via Lethal Progeny. Then venture into the Otherworld with the new Caliban Orfeo Skin, and carry the spirits back with you.

The second half of our Companion Rework has dropped! Visit your Arsenal to mod the new weapons for Beasts. Review your builds to see new and updated Precepts and Mods! And of course, take your companions in-mission to see new AI changes on the battlefield.

Bolster your loadouts with new Incarnons and Warframe Augments! Incarnon Genesis Adapters for Dera, Sybaris, Cestra, Sicarus, and Okina have been added to the Steel Path Circuit Rotation (and to Cavalero's wares during that same rotation). 

Visit the Syndicate Panel in your Orbiter to unlock Augments for Hildryn, Voruna, Grendel, and Gyre.
Embody chaos or elegance with the new Volt Raijin and Nova Aozukura Deluxe skins! This update also brings a new series of TennoGen featuring creations from community artists.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHowT: Play the new Shrine Defense mission type via the Saya’s Visions node on Earth. Unlock access to this node by talking to Saya in Cetus after completing the Saya’s Vigil and Once Awake Quests!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiPlay:
Play the Warframe: 1999 Demo?

This is a single-player mission that must be completed alone. You will leave your current squad if you choose to launch it now.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoDe:
Dare to face The Seven Crimes of Kullervo. Few are strong enough to bear the brunt of vengeance that awaits.

The new Warframe has been locked away in Duviri. Do you have the strength to confront this vengeful warrior?
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi: The newest Warframe, Kullervo, answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. His signature shotgun, Rauta boasts melee synergy. Seize the power of treachery to slake Kullervo's thirst for revenge.

The new island, Kullervo's Hold, is located just off Duviri's mainland. Duviri citizens fear the monstrous Warframe imprisoned there. Only a ruthless warden and sympathetic children dare visit. Hear their stories. Fight the monster. Perhaps you can discern the truth about Kullervo's nature.

Kaithe races, Paragrimm tomes, and lost belongings offer new experiences in Duviri. Meet Brimon, Duviri's top Kaithe rider, who will challenge you to a race. See through the eyes of a wise Paragrimm that needs your help to recover mysterious tomes. Retrieve Duviri citizens' lost belongings. They will reward your success handsomely.

Become a formidable force in Duviri with new Decrees and strengthen Warframes, Primary Weapons, and Secondary Weapons with new Arcanes. The king's Spiteful Decrees have complicated consequences. They offer great strength to those who are willing to make a sacrifice. Choose wisely.
The SPROUT system has powered up in Teshin's Cave. It offers a new set of Duviri plants to harvest every twenty hours. The timer resets with each harvest, so the astute will check back regularly.

New accouterments await you in the Market. Go full throttle with the fiery Gauss Kresnik Collection, invite good fortune with Drifter and Operator Orizu Suits, and support other player creations with the latest TennoGen. All that and more is available.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHo: Kullervo's Hold appears in Duviri during Anger, Fear, or Sorrow Spirals. Go there and speak to The Warden to engage in combat with Kullervo. Once you defeat both him and the Spiral's Orowyrm, you will receive Kullervo's Bane, a new Resource you can use to buy Kullervo Warframe Blueprints from Acrithis.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinDesc:
Entropy threatens the Zariman. 

Cephalon Melica has raised the alarms. Entropic Kuva seeps into the ship, twisting enemies into new Entropic Eximus. 

Find answers on Yuvan's Peak, the home of Narin's Crest. Visit this new hub to learn its secrets and stop the flow.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl:
Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to heal and defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.

Earn our latest Warframe from missions on the Zariman Ten Zero, or by acquiring Entropic Kuva from Entropic Eximus on the Zariman, and exchange it for her blueprints via Cephalon Melica. Find Cephalon Melica in the Chrysalith (Zariman) or on Yuvan's Peak (Earth) after completing the Angels of the Zariman Quest.

Attention students! It's time for a field trip.

Cephalon Melica has been summoned to Yuvan's Peak on Earth, where Narin's Crest glitters against the snow. Marvel at its wonder and attempt to pull Narin's Iceblade free. 

This trip is not all fun, however. Entropy threatens the Zariman, and Narin's influence on the Peak is key to stopping its spread. Collect Entropic Kuva from Entropic Eximus found on the Zariman, and exchange it with Melica to contain it. In doing so, you'll receive items from her wares, including Narin's blueprints!

As you hunt these new Eximus on the Zariman, you may find more than just Kuva — Melica has a history, and there is much for you to uncover.

Ten years after Rivens were introduced, we're expanding on the Riven system! 
 
When cycling Rivens, a new "Lock Trait" button has been added to the screen. Here, players can choose one Trait to lock when cycling their Mod with Kuva. 

Cycling a Riven Mod with a Locked Trait will double the Kuva cost. Players can swap which Traits to lock or unlock as they continue to cycle their Rivens!

We've updated Banshee's kit to make her lethality easier to master, in addition to some general quality of life and synergistic changes. 

Here's a quick overview of her key changes:
• Sonic Boom now strips armor, and the Augment now gives Banshee armor 
• Sonar's Weak Spots are now considered Weak Points 
• Silence can now be recast 
• Sound Quake is no longer a channelled ability
• Sound Quake's Augment is now channelled, and its damage is multiplied every second during casting

For full details, be sure to check our patch notes!

Iceblade of Narin also brings some general quality of life changes, including:

• Part 1 of Converting "On Headshot" triggers to be "On Weak Point"
• Archimedea Research Point and Modifier changes
• Vitiligo complexion changes
• Hair and metal shader improvements
• Improved mine mechanics in The Perita Rebellion missions

And more! Check out our official patch notes for more information!

Make a hush fall across the battlefield as you step out in the new Banshee Threnodia Skin, or strike terror into the hearts of your foes with the Qorvex Basilica Skin. 

Iceblade of Narin also brings a new TennoGen: Iceblade collection featuring community-made cosmetics. Flaunt more community artwork with brand new Atragraph Mods for the Savage Silence and Reactive Storm Augments. 

Finally, this update also brings new Augment Mods for Oraxia, Uriel, Frost, and Grendel!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHowTo:
The Zariman is threatened by a flow of Entropic Kuva, causing new Entropic Eximus to appear on the ship. Killing them will release the Entropic Kuva, which can be exchanged via Cephalon Melica for Narin's blueprints.

Find Cephalon Melica in the Chrysalith (Zariman) after completing the Angels of the Zariman quest. Melica can also be found on Yuvan's Peak (Earth) after completing both the Angels of the Zariman and Whispers in the Walls quests.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceDesc:
Face the past. Shape the future.

Return to the battlefields of old and relive your experiences on Tau with our latest cinematic Quest. Uncover another batch of Protoframes with The Devil's Triad. 

Tenno — can you bear the weight of what the past remembers?
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl:
Delve into memories thought lost to time, memories of Tau, and the fragile peace brokered between Orokin and Sentient. What happened in the past to make such bitter enemies in the present? With the help of your friend, Adis Truth-bloom, only the Tenno can uncover the real story of Tau.

The Old Peace quest requires completion of The Lotus Eaters to unlock.

Slip deep into memories of another time with Albrecht's Dark Refractory… 

Master Roathe's mind in the new Descendia gamemode: 21 Infernums to conquer, each with a challenge and penance that rotates every week.

Return to the battlefields of old and relive your experiences on Tau with The Perita Rebellion, accomplishing all you can within a 12 minute limit.
To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.

Venture back to XX99 to see Albrecht's influence in a distant alternate past! 

After completing The Old Peace quest, you're introduced to three new Protoframes: Marie, Lyon, and the first Orokin Protoframe, Roathe. Visit them in La Cathédrale in the Sanctum Anatomica, and chat via the expanded KIM system to learn why Albrecht brought them all together.

With the rediscovery of knowledge from the Tauron Academy, new branches grow on your Focus School tree. Take full advantage of this new system to bring your Operator and Drifter's power to new peaks with the new Tauron Strikes, which allow you to wield Tektolyst Artifacts with great devastation.

Complete The Old Peace quest to gain access to this Focus Expansion!

The first of its kind, the Vinquibus bayonet is both a Primary and Melee Weapon and can be modded distinctly for each slot. 

Not adverse to dispatching enemies at range or up close and personal, the Vinquibus is a Weapon from a forgotten war, finding itself in Tenno hands once again.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHowTo:
Before you can step into the past with The Old Peace quest, players must have completed The Lotus Eaters.

Dip your toe into Dark Refractory missions using the "Dark Refractory Preview" feature in the Update Screen. Jump into the Dark Refractory missions and play with your friends, with restricted public matchmaking for those below Mastery Rank 10. 

Previewing will not complete Quests — you will need to play The Old Peace to gain access to vendors and other quest-locked content.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap:
Look at the blood. Look at the ink. 
Watch it drip, drip. 

Something— no, someone haunts the ruins of the Vesper Relay. Come face-to-face with Follie, the Shadowgrapher, and complete her canvases to uncover the Truth.

Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.

Earn our latest Warframe from the new Follie's Hunt game mode on Venus!

A mysterious painting in the ruined Vesper Relay casts a shadowy pall across the Origin System, and it falls to you to investigate. Return to the wreckage of Vesper Relay and enter a canvas of chaos, where a tragic history long lost to the shadows is waiting to be illuminated.

Visit Aspirant Zorba outside the Arbiters of Hexis enclave on any active Relay to exchange earned Atramentum.

Gain access to the Follie's Hunt mode after completing the Chains of Harrow quest!

Whether you are stepping into Warframe anew, or continuing your journey, The Shadowgrapher update brings some changes to familiar missions:

• Warframe Mantle improvements, which can be seen as you parkour in any mission. 
• Awakening Quest Remaster
• New Survival Security Bypass mechanic, which allows you to speed up Survival missions!
• Improved Excavator survivability, including shield-gating and health increases to help them scale in harder missions. 

For full details, check out our patch notes.

The Shadowgrapher brings a variety of quality of life changes to existing content — maybe Follie's influence isn't so terrifying after all:

• Revamped Requiem Eterna Relic, to make it easier to farm Requiem Mods. 
• Additions to Palladino's store in The Iron Wake!
• Acquisition improvements for Equinox, Nidus, Ivara, Khora, and various older weapons. 
• Player Cold Status and Arctic Eximus changes, meaning players experience reduced slowdown from Cold Status.

For full information on these quality of life changes, get all the details in our official patch notes.

There's never been a better time to play together! This update brings a new Clan Cooperation System, which incentivizes you to squad up with your Clan.

This system includes:
• New Clan & Alliance Matchmaking
• Bonus Clan Vault resources when playing with a Clan Member
• Personal Rewards for earning Bonus Resources 
• Clan Emblem Prism

And more! Check out our patch notes for full information.

Your Adversaries have uncovered new weapons —  time to make them your own. Hunt down your very own Kuva Ghoulsaw, Tenet Quanta, and Coda Bubonico!

Venture into battle in-style with a variety of new cosmetics, including TennoGen creations from the community, and the new Gauss and Grendel deluxe skins!

Add holographic flair to Upgrade Screens with Atragraph Mods, a purely visual upgrade accessible via Aspirant Zorba in the Relays.

Access the new Follie's Hunt game mode on Venus after completing the Chains of Harrow quest.

Earned Atramentum can be exchanged with Aspirant Zorba outside the Arbiters of Hexis enclave on any active Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotDes:
New Protoframes have emerged, each with their own questions to answer and problems to solve. 

Techrot Encore also brings new Adversaries with the Technocyte Coda, new Temporal Archimedea and Stage Defense game modes, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig:
Turn up the volume and get ready to rock with Temple! Our 60th Warframe arrives in a glamorous blaze, wielding an Exalted (and talking!) guitar named Lizzie. Vanquish your foes with the power of song and light the flames of revolution.

Earn Temple from Stage Defense missions in Höllvania after completing The Hex quest and reaching Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate.

New Protoframes have assembled in a previously undiscovered section of Höllvania Central Mall. Relax and take a load off in The Round Table, a pub inhabited by Minerva (Saryn Protoframe), Velimir (Frost Protoframe), Kaya (Nova Protoframe), and Flare (Temple Protoframe).

Each of them grants access to new content or new wares, so be sure to stop by once you’ve reached Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate.

On-lyne's tour has officially kicked off, but our boys are looking a little more… infested than usual. In this new variant of the Adversary system, hunt down Technocyte Coda in Höllvania once you've completed The Hex Quest.

Increase the virality of the boyband virus in Höllvania with Antivirus and Potency Mods until they're ready for a showdown on the big stage. Defeating your Technocyte Coda will reward you with guaranteed cosmetics, in addition to Live Heartcells to trade with Eleanor for Coda Weapons.

Techrot Encore comes with two game mode variants: Stage Defense and Temporal Archimedea.

It's Flare's time in the spotlight, and you must protect them from an onslaught of enemies in Stage Defense. This game mode benefits from the game-wide Defense mission change, reducing rotations from 5 to 3 waves. Earn Temple's Blueprints and learn the fate of Flare's bandmates in this new mission, accessible in 1999 once you reach Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate. 

Visit Kaya in Höllvania Central Mall to dive into Temporal Archimedea —  Deep Archimedea set in Höllvania, with a twist. Equip Peely Pix to apply buffs to your Temporal Archimedea missions, and see what deviations and risk variables 1999 has in store. Unlock this content at Rank 5 in the Hex Syndicate

Exalted Weapons are receiving a refresh —  and Atlas, Gara, Khora, and Ash are getting their own Exalted Weapons to boot. While these changes are extensive, here's a brief overview of some core changes:

• Exalted Weapons can now equip Arcanes and a variety of previously unusable Mods 
• Exalted Melee earn capacity from their Stance Mods
• Exalted Blade and Serene Storm now build combo via their Ranged attacks
• Whipclaw, Shattered Lash, Bladestorm, and Landslide now have moddable Exalted Weapons that benefit from a unique Combo Counter

Beyond that, we've retouched Ash's kit to overall improve his effectiveness in-mission. For full details, check out our Update Notes.

Amp up your fashion frame with the new Gyre Vortengeist Collection, or don community-made creations with TennoGen Encore featuring cosmetics made by fellow Tenno! Reach the height of Höllvania style with new Hairstyles and Suits for your Operator and Drifter.

Techrot Encore also brings new Warframe Augments, Arcanes, Scaldra Weapons, and much more.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHow: Complete The Hex quest to get the most out of Techrot Encore — including the Technocyte Coda, a new Adversary to take on in Höllvania! Additional game modes and vendors are revealed once you reach Rank 4 and 5 in the Hex Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindD:
Nef Anyo's influence has expanded beyond the Orb Vallis —  to its hidden depths. 

Explore the Deepmines, a new subterranean tileset, and safeguard this ecosystem from Corpus defilement.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH:
Spread decay and regeneration in equal measure with Nokko! This childlike trickster ensures fungus blooms in every environment.

Earn Nokko’s Blueprints by completing Deepmines Bounties or trading with Nightcap in Fortuna.

The Deepmines is a new tileset expanding beneath the surface of the Orb Vallis. Work with Nightcap, the spore-loving member of Solaris United, to take on new Deepmine Bounties and thwart Nef Anyo's plans.

Access to this content requires completion of The New War Quest.

Study is the first step towards mastery. The Teacher is a new tutorial Quest that introduces players to both the Modding System and to Teshin Dax. 

Learn the basics of Modding and earn the new Thornbak Rifle in this new quest, which can be accessed immediately after completing Vor’s Prize.
Oberon, the honorable Paladin, has received a light rework! Featuring a brand new Passive and enhanced Abilities, he is capable of offering both support and destruction on the battlefield.

The Vallis Undermind is packed to the gills with new cosmetics —  bringing both the Wukong Qitian and Lavos Khymia Deluxe Skins. 

Flaunt community-made fashions with new TennoGen pieces in the TennoGen Undermind Collection, including our first TennoGen cosmetics for Qorvex, Citrine, and Dagath.

With this update, we’ve also slipped in a few Quality of Life changes, including:
• Damage Attenuation scaling changes, bringing a standardized Damage Attenuation to most bosses, which now scales better with enemy level.
• Improved Screen Shake and Recoil toggles
• Signas on Drifters
• Relighting in Relays and the Grineer Asteroid Tileset
• and more!

For more details, be sure to check the official patch notes.
Access the Deepmines by visiting Nightcap in The Airlock —  his secret hideout in the bowels of Fortuna! The Airlock becomes available after completing The New War Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersDe:
Uncover mysteries left behind by the brilliant Albrecht Entrati. What exactly is the encroaching Indifference... and what are the Vessels that Albrecht created?

Once you have conquered the New War, open your Codex and select 'Whispers in the Walls' to begin Warframe's next chapter.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi: This brutalist, concrete-like Warframe features a unique design courtesy of Albrecht Entrati. Created to serve as a bulwark against terrifying forces, Qorvex functions as a new guardian to the Tenno.

Warframe's next narrative chapter, Whispers in the Walls, is now available! Deep within the Necralisk, a dormant precept known as The Kalymos Sequence has been activated. Return to Deimos and investigate Albrecht's hidden, subterranean laboratory for any clues he may have left behind.

Recall the ancient art of Tennokai with new Tennokai Mods for your Melee Weapons. Make the most out of your Heavy attacks when Tennokai Procs — properly timed blows will unleash a Tennokai Heavy Attack, costing no combo counter and offering a faster wind-up speed.

Introducing a new Secondary Weapon Type: Tomes! Earn your very own Tome weapon — the Grimoire — upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest. Equip specialized Tome Mods on this new weapon type to enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat.
EMBRACE THE POWER OF THE TOME

Unlock Melee Arcanes and Melee Exilus with the new Melee Upgrade Segment, earned upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest! Enhance your Melee combat with Arcanes acquired via the new Netracells mission on Deimos, or via the new Cavia Syndicate in Sanctum Anatomica.

Reveal new permanent bonuses for your Warframes with Violet, Topaz, and Emerald Archon Shards. Your existing Archon Shards can be fused to create new possibilities, using the Coalescent Fusion system available upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHo: Players must have completed The New War to access the Whispers in the Walls Quest. Once unlocked, visit your Codex to embark on Warframe's next chapter.

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief:
Break Narmer missions rotate based on your personal progress in the following order;
Sneaky Sabotage, Junk Run, Prison Break. The current active mission persists each week until its objectives are completed and you extract, at which point the next mission will become available at the weekly reset.
The Break Narmer mission of the week can be replayed as many times as needed to complete its challenges.
Progress on Break Narmer challenges persist between mission runs! Challenge progress can be checked in the “View Mission Progress” screen in-mission or by visiting Kahl in Kahl's Garrison.
Narmer Deacons are invulnerable to regular attacks but can be stunned with Kahl's Veilbreaker ability.
Veilbreaking can be done by Tapping or Holding the context action. You can change your preference in the Accessibility category of your Settings menu.
Somachord Tones can be found throughout Break Narmer missions. Interact with them to unlock new songs for the Somachord in your Orbiter.
Your Rank within Kahl's Garrison increases with every Break Narmer mission you complete, up to the max rank of Home (Rank 5).

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_: Elemental Damage types can be combined and imbued into Lavos’ abilities in two ways: Hold two abilities together, or hold a single ability and then another to create the desired combined Elemental Damage type.
Clear the current imbued Elemental Damage type by casting any of Lavos' abilities.
Recasting Transmutation Probe as it is moving will pause the Probe in place.
Since Lavos does not require Energy, Ability Efficiency mods only change the effectiveness of Transmutation Probe's cooldown reduction.
Catalyze's damage is doubled for each unique Status Effect applied to the target. Take advantage of Catalyze's exponential damage scaling by teaming up with Warframes like Saryn or Ember.
All of Lavos' abilities can deal two Status Effects at once: the base element tied to the  ability itself, as well as whatever element you choose to imbue.
Imbued elements are added on top of the base ability, doubling the damage. It is always better to imbue an element before casting your abilities!
Non-damaging Status Effects will apply multiple stacks at once when imbued into Lavos' abilities.
Increased Ability Duration will also increase the Duration of Status Effects caused by Lavos' abilities.
Combined with his high Armor stat, Ophidian Bite makes Lavos a tough Warframe to kill. The healing scales based on total damage dealt, so try to hit multiple enemies at once.
Vial Rush can be interrupted by casting the ability again or by jumping.
The number of Vial Rush charges is affected by Range mods.
Effective use of Lavos’ abilities requires mastery of Transmutation Probe. Cast into a group once all abilities are on cooldown for greatest effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter: Nova's passive applies to all slow effects, not just Molecular Prime. Pair her with weapons that inflict <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effects or other Warframes that slow enemies to maximize the benefits.
Null Star grants a slight Damage Reduction to Nova for each antimatter particle orbiting her. Increase the number of Null Stars with Ability Duration for more Damage Reduction!
Killing enemies Primed by Molecular Prime has a 20% chance to inflict <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast Status Effects on nearby foes.
Null Star can recast while active to refresh the number of antimatter particles, which helps maintain high Damage Reduction.
Null Star's Damage Reduction can be prolonged with low Ability Range and maintaining a safe distance from enemies to keep the particles orbiting Nova.
Nova and allies can shoot Antimatter Drop's orb to increase its detonation damage. Directing Antimatter Drop through a Wormhole also partially charges the detonation.
Antimatter Drop will travel quickly to its target once it is fully charged, or if the ability is cast again while in flight.
Guide Antimatter Drop away from objects it can collide with until it has been charged with gunfire, then drop into a crowd for a devastating impact.
Wormhole is great for closing both horizontal and vertical distance. Consider casting upwards and jumping to gain elevation quickly.

Consider the combat situation when casting Molecular Prime. Slow enemies when you are overwhelmed, and speed them up when you want to kill more enemies quickly (but be aware that their attacks are sped up as well!)
Increase the distance that Molecular Prime's wave travels with Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Appearance: Look Link does not apply sigils.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_0: The Arsenal is used to equip, mod, and customize Warframes, Weapons, Companions, Gear, and more to prepare for your next mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_1: Select the Loadout name at the top left of your Arsenal options to switch between your preset Loadouts. These can be updated at any time and additional Loadout Slots can be purchased for Platinum.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_2: The Upgrade option allows you to equip Mods, which increases your equipment's power. Multiple Configuration tabs are available at the top to save your various Mod combinations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_3: The Appearance option allows total visual customization on any equipment, including color changes, equipping skins, attachments, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_4: You can zoom in and out while customizing your Warframe’s Appearance to get a closer look at the details.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_5: In the Appearance menu, using the Randomize button in the bottom right will mix and match colors, attachments, and more!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_6: In the Appearance menu, the camera icon at the top-right opens Captura. You can take screenshots and videos using various camera tools, scenes, lighting, and more to create your masterpiece.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_7: In the Appearance menu, the Look Link button in the top right allows you to share your customization as a chat message for others to enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_8: The Parazon is a special blade used by Warframes for hacking, Mercy kills against weakened enemies, and the Adversaries system. It can be upgraded and customized in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_9: Different Arsenal categories are unlocked as you earn Companions and Vehicles for your journey.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_0: Banshee's passive suppresses all of hers and her Robotic Companions' weapons, offering a unique advantage in stealth situations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_1: Sonic Boom pushes enemies and inflicts <DT_IMPACT_COLOR> Impact Status Effect. Use this to unbalance important targets such as Disruption Demolishers to save precious time!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_2: Sonic Boom's guaranteed <DT_IMPACT_COLOR> Impact Status Effect can also make priority targets more vulnerable to Mercy kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_3: Highlighted weak points from recasting Sonar can overlap, increasing the Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_4: Weak points created by Sonar are treated the same as regular enemy weak points, meaning they can charge Incarnon weapons, and trigger other abilities related to weak points. Weapons can also be modded for additional weak point damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_5: Enemies stunned by Silence are affected by the Stealth bonus for the duration of the stun!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_6: Recasting Silence while active will stun enemies who are already in range of the effect, while also resetting the ability's duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_7: Sound Quake continuously stuns enemies, providing excellent crowd control on a specific area you want to defend.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_8: Recasting Sound Quake will reset the duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_0: Customize Octavia's music using the Mandachord! Find it in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_1: Share Mandachord songs with other players by linking the title in chat!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_2: Change up Octavia's sound by choosing themed instrument packs in the Mandachord Instruments selection window.
