/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_3: Mallet plays the Percussion track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_4: Resonator plays the Bass track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_5: Metronome plays the Melody track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_6: Metronome buffs are much easier to maintain with a high Duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_7: Metronome passively grants an Armor bonus to all allies in the radius of its aura and scales with Ability Strength Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_8: The damage and effect buildup of Octavia's abilities are influenced by the number of notes per measure on the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_9: Cast Mallet in the path of approaching enemies to ensure they attack it first.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_: Valkyr is immune to heavy landings, meaning there is no delay when landing on the ground from great heights.
Perform frequent Melee Attacks to keep Valkyr's Rage Meter from decreasing.
Temporarily deactivate Hysteria by switching to Valkyr's Primary or Secondary weapon. Reactivate it by attacking with Valkyr's Talons.
Finisher Kills grant a greater increase to the Rage Meter.
Cast Rip Line in quick succession to increase its damage and greatly reduce its Energy cost after each successful cast.
Use Rip Line strategically by using Melee Attacks to cancel the pull while maintaining momentum, or jump for a speed boost.
Warcry affects all allies that are within the Shared Affinity Radius. Use the Player List to see who is within range.
Warcry also applies to friendly NPCs, such as rescue targets and specters.
Warcry grants significantly more Armor while Hysteria is active.
The stagger from Paralysis briefly opens enemies to Melee Finishers, allowing a faster increase of Valkyr's Rage Meter.
Valkyr's Hysteria Talons can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_0: Atlas is immune to damage during Landslide attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_1: Land successful Landslide punches back to back to deal more damage to the next enemy and send them flying on every third punch in the chain!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_2: Petrified enemies drop Rubble when killed that can restore Atlas' Health on pickup or increase his Armor if Health is full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_3: Landslide's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it, as well as the Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_4: Petrified enemies killed by Landslide drop Rubble that restore more Health and Armor than the average drops.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_5: Bulwarks summoned by Tectonics can be used to block doors, pathways, and even protect objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_6: Aiming Petrify at Atlas' Rumblers instantly heals them back to Max Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_7: Aiming Petrify at Atlas' Bulwarks increases their rolling Speed, Distance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_8: Recast Rumblers to detonate Atlas' brawlers, deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage to nearby enemies, and create Rubble.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_9: Rumblers' brawlers durability is influenced by Atlas' Health, Shields, Armor, and Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram: Xaku is the only Warframe that can deal <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage, which makes them effective against Sentient enemies with the exception of Eidolons.
Xata's Whisper can be recast at any time to refresh the duration.
Xaku's passive increases to 75% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to evade projectile, hitscan, and Melee Attacks while The Vast Untime is active.
Cast Xata's Whisper to devastate enemies hit by The Vast Untime who are now more susceptible to <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage.
Grasp of Lohk can be recast up to the max number of targets to add to the batch of active stolen weapons. Each weapon has its own independent duration from those that were stolen in a separate cast.

Accuse can be recast up to the max number of affected targets to add to the current batch of corrupted enemies. Each corrupted enemy has its own independent duration from those that were corrupted in a separate cast.
Cast Xata's Whisper while fighting Sentient enemies to clear any damage resistances they have developed.

<DT_RADIANT>Void Damage's Status Effect creates a field around enemies that absorbs and redirects all projectiles back onto the target. Projectiles are redirected to the specific area on the target where the Status Effect occurred. Use weapons with high Status Chance to increase the effect while Xata's Whisper is active.
Enemies that have had their ranged weapons stolen by Grasp of Lohk will resort to melee attacking.
Casting Grasp of Lohk on enemies that do not have weapons will manifest Void entity objects to attack with Xaku.
The amount of targets that can be affected by Accuse is increased by Ability Strength mods.
Enemies who enter the radius of enemies locked in place by Gaze have their Armor and Shields reduced. At 100% Defense Reduction, they are stripped completely.
Enemies that survive Deny’s Void beam attack are suspended in the air for a limited time.
The Vast Untime can be recast at any time to bring Xaku back together.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_0: Enemies with Judgments take additional damage. Judgments can be applied by Light's Judgment and your primary fire during Glory on High.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_1: Aim Light's Judgment at large groups or chokepoints to maximize the amount of Judgments being applied.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_10: Judgments can be detonated by using Glory on High alternate-fire and that detonation is stronger when the enemies are within Light's Judgment radius. This also includes Judgments applied by other Jade squadmates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_2: Symphony of Mercy can be maintained by killing enemies affected by Judgments. Make use of Jade's abilities to spread the Judgments far and wide!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_3: Defeating enemies with Judgments will increase the duration of Jade's current Symphony of Mercy aura, regardless of who gets the kill.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_4: Symphony of Mercy auras are applied to squadmates currently within Shared Affinity Range. Use the Player List to see who is currently within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_5: Jade’s current Symphony of Mercy aura can be switched while the ability is active, depending on her squad’s current needs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_6: Enemies leaving the effects of Ophanim Eyes will gradually recover their movement speed, but will not recover their Shield or Armor. They will also suffer a <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effect when their Armor or Shield breaks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_7: Ophanim Eyes can revive multiple allies at once, even at long distances.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_8: Tap to recast Ophanim Eyes while the ability is active to refresh the duration, or hold to cancel the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_9: All of Jade's other abilities can be used while in flight during Glory on High. Her elevated position makes it much easier to spread Light's Judgment and affect enemies with Ophanim Eyes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr: Prioritize upgrading Qorvex's exceptionally high Health and Armor stats to maximize his rigid defenses.
Take advantage of Qorvex's passive by equipping weapons that don't already have innate Punch Through. Consider single target weapons to tear through groups of enemies in one shot!
Chyrinka Pillars will become Empowered after using Containment Wall or Crucible Blast on the pillar, pulsing faster and spreading more <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Damage and Status Effects.
Chyrinka Pillar pulses do not travel through walls. Deploy in open areas for maximum effect.

Containment Wall gathers enemies in a long line, making it most effective in corridors and narrow spaces. Utilize the additional Punch Through from Qorvex’s passive to clear out targets after casting.
Disometric Guard immediately removes Status Effects from Allies within Affinity Range on cast, as well as preventing future Status Effects.
On cast, Disometric Guard can knockdown and apply <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Status Effect to enemies within a small area around Qorvex.
Crucible Blast grants invulnerability while casting, making it great for emergencies.
Spread <DT_RADIATION>Radiation using weapons, Chyrinka Pillars or Containment Walls to increase Disometric Guard's stacks and Crucible Blast's explosive volatility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_0: Cast Ballistic Battery before entering Peacemaker to store Mesa's Regulators damage and recast to release it all into a single shot.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_1: Shooting Gallery not only jams guns from nearby enemies but also temporarily stuns Melee units!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_2: In addition to reducing the damage from enemy fire, Shatter Shield also reflects Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_3: Protect Mesa from incoming fire and Melee attacks by keeping Shatter Shield and Shooting Gallery active at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_4: Refresh Shooting Gallery's gun jamming effect on enemies who have recovered from it by passing by them again while it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_5: Hold fire while Peacemaker is active to rapidly fire Mesa's Regulators, targeting all enemies currently within her reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_6: Cast Peacemaker in short bursts while in the air or sliding along the ground to maintain damage without sacrificing mobility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_7: Continuous fire shrinks Peacemaker's focus ring, but increases its damage! Recast the ability to reset the ring and target more enemies or maintain fire to take down tougher targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_8: Cast Mesa's defensive abilities before entering Peacemaker to protect her while she's unable to move freely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_9: Mesa's Waltz is an Augment Mod for Peacemaker which allows Mesa to move, roll, and backflip while it's active!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_0: Consider equipping upgrades that generate additional Health and Energy Orbs to maximize Dagath's Passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_1: Dagath’s Wyrd Scythes inflict the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect, causing enemies to take more health damage from all sources, including Doom. Take advantage of this by equipping weapons that deal other Status Effects
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_2: Wyrd Scythes are great for inflicting or extending Doom on large groups, since they punch through multiple enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_3: Doom inflicts its scythes in a wide cone, so position Dagath in front of as many enemies as possible before casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_4: Equip Dagath with high Critical Chance weapons to maximize Grave Spirit’s devastating damage potential.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_5: Upon dying with Grave Spirit active, Dagath will enter an invulnerable spectral form, knocking down nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_6: In Dagath's spectral form, every kill generates a Health Orb. Be aggressive during Dagath’s invulnerability to ensure a safe return to life.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_7: Rakhali's Cavalry travels in the direction you cast it, and runs along the ground. Try casting in the air for a better view of the stampede's warpath.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_8: Rakhali's Cavalry can hit enemies multiple times near the start of its cast, which can be very effective for rapidly stripping defenses.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_9: Rakhali's Cavalry grants invulnerability while casting. When in mortal peril, call in the cavalry!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame: Uriel’s demons are proficient at drawing fire to protect their master. Keep all three alive to ensure Uriel’s survival.
Each minion will resurrect automatically after being downed for a full 60 seconds.
The next Brimstone cast can be charged while the ability is currently active. Sow enough chaos to unleash an unending wave of fire and Brimstone.
Each squadmate can collect a copy of the demonic runes created by Vythelas.
Hold <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> to cancel Infernalis while it is active.
Enemies ignited by Infernalis will panic, reducing incoming damage.
Many combat actions cancel Infernalis flight, such as attacking with Melee or aimgliding, allowing Uriel to weave in and out of his destructive form.
Infernalis flight speed is affected by Parkour Velocity upgrades.
Infernalis also lights Uriel’s demons ablaze. Activate before using Demonium to launch burning souls and create chaos.
Remedium restores Shields if Uriel is already at max Health, including Overshield.
Brimstone gains charge upon killing enemies attacked by Uriel's demons, by picking up Vythelas' Runes or by striking enemies with Demonium.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_0: Devour multiple enemies at once with Feast by moving the reticle back and forth across desired targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_1: Feast can hold up to five enemies in Grendel's gut, so selectively dine on high priority targets to remove them from the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_2: Nourish deals damage to enemies within Grendel's gut and can kill them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_3: Enemies attacking Nourished allies at close range are inflicted with the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect, weakening their defense and enabling quick retaliatory kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_4: Use Sprint to travel faster in Pulverize, at the cost of steering control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_5: Pulverize's Heal starts to decay to half its original start value 5 seconds after cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_6: Grendel can break the Armor of enemies he rolls over while in Pulverize form.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_7: Pulverize does not cost Energy if you have enemies in your gut! Use Feast while rolling to suck in enemies on the move and stay full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_8: Feast's damage-over-time on vomited enemies and damage on Regurgitated enemies scale based on the level of enemies Grendel devours.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_9: Focus on consuming enemies with a lot of Health - it will significantly increase the damage output when Grendel spits them out with Regurgitate!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_0: Chroma's Effigy benefits from Vex Armor's Fury damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_1: <DT_FIRE>Heat Elemental Ward heals allies within range by increasing their base Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_2: <DT_POISON>Toxin Elemental Ward surrounds Chroma with toxic fumes that have a chance of afflicting <DT_POISON>Toxin Status Effect on nearby enemies. It also grants nearby allies a Reload Speed and Holster Speed increase.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_3: <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electric Elemental Ward increases allies' base Shields and converts incoming damage into lightning arc discharges.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_4: <DT_FREEZE>Cold Elemental Ward increases allies base Armor and creates a shield that deflects damage back to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_5: Recast Vex Armor before its duration ends to maintain Chroma's Scorn and Fury buffs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_6: Vex Armor is triggered by damage to Chroma's Shields and Health or kills with melee, Abilities, and ranged weapons. To optimize Vex Armor, equip Mods that increase Health and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_7: Vex Armor's Scorn buff scales with Armor mods like Steel Fiber, while the Fury buff scales with base damage Mods like Serration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_8: Vex Armor's Fury increases Spectral Scream's damage!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_9: While Effigy is active, Chroma receives a Movement Speed increase and Armor Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_0: Neote builds Ice quickly even if very few targets are hit, making it useful against priority targets, even without other enemies around.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_1: Casting Naraemagi removes <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effects from enemies to fuel Narin's defenses. Be prepared to counter attack or re-freeze enemies quickly once they thaw!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_2: Narin is invulnerable during Hakchum, allowing her to escape danger and reassess the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_3: Fine-tune Narin's height during Hakchum by using the Move Up and Move Down bindings.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_4: While Narin requires full Ice to use Nurinarim, she doesn't have to spend it all at once. Deactivate Nurinarim early to conserve Ice for later conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_5: Nurinarim is most effective against <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Frozen enemies, causing radial explosions on attack. Maximize this effect by getting close enough for her aura to freeze enemies faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_6: Nurinarim's Armor and Shield reduction multiplies with the number of <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effects applied to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_7: Ice drains at a constant rate during Nurinarim, whether Narin is attacking or not. Only missed attacks will cause Ice to drain at an increased rate. Strike fast and true for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_8: Narin can dodge and jump during Nurinarim, or use Hakchum for more significant repositioning.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_9: Extra <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage from Narin's passive will also apply to her abilities while active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil: Each new Spiral resets the Warframe and Weapon options available, granting you new opportunities to take on whatever Dominus Thrax throws at you.

The most powerful version of the Warframe and Weapon variants you own are prioritized when randomly selected! For example, if you own the base and Prime version of a Warframe, the Prime will take priority.
Default Mods are preset combinations of Mods provided for Warframes and Weapons. Equipment you do not own uses these presets exclusively.
To customize Mod Configs for owned equipment, return to your Orbiter to access your Arsenal. Changes applied to the Mod Configs in your Arsenal will appear in Teshin's Cave.
Mod Configs with 40+ used Mod Capacity appear first, instead of the Default Mod Config.
The Opportunity Rank 4 and Rank 8 Drifter Intrinsics each grant you one additional Warframe option once unlocked, for a total of 5 choices.
The Opportunity Rank 2 and Rank 7 Drifter Intrinsics each grant you two additional Weapon options once unlocked, for a total of 8 choices.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_0: Fireball gains increased damage when cast on enemies with <DT_FIRE>Heat Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_1: Cast multiple Fireballs in quick succession to increase their damage output.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_2: Cast Fireball to ignite and stagger groups of enemies gathered together in doorways or near objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_3: Immolation's Damage Reduction increases based on current self-Immolation levels. Increase the meter gain rate by casting Fireball or Inferno.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_4: If Ember reaches max Immolation, she will overheat, slowly losing Energy. Use Fire Blast to reduce Immolation levels, or recast the ability to reset meter gain.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_5: Fire Blast sends enemies flying if they are nearby when the ability is cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_6: Fire Blast costs less Energy when Immolation level is high. Alternate between abilities that increase and reduce Immolation to maximize damage and minimize Energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_7: Fire Blast's Armor Reduction scales based on Ember's current Immolation levels.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_8: All enemies struck by Inferno get a personal ring of fire, expanding over time and spreading to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_9: Inferno's fire ring damage increases based on current Immolation levels.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU: Excalibur Umbra is immune to damage for the duration of Slash Dash.
Radial Howl can temporarily deactivate Laser Barriers and Security Cameras.
Cast Radial Howl to get a Stealth bonus on enemies that are open to Finishers.
Radial Howl strips Sentient enemies of any active damage resistances!
Perform a Melee Spin Attack with Exalted Blade to create a small Radial Howl for half the Energy cost!
Cast Slash Dash while Exalted Blade is active to launch energy waves towards an enemy and any behind them.
While Exalted Blade is active, Slash Dash is granted a small bonus to its base damage.
Exalted Blade's innate Punch Through allows its waves to traverse through obstacles to enemies.
Build up Bonus Damage for Exalted Blade's energy waves and Excalibur Umbra's Melee Combo Counter by striking enemies at close range with the sword itself.
Excalibur Umbra's Exalted Umbra Blade can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_: Excalibur is immune to damage for the duration of Slash Dash.
Radial Blind can temporarily deactivate Laser Barriers and Security Cameras.
Cast Radial Blind to open enemies to Finishers. Blinding also grants a Stealth bonus to all Melee strikes, including Exalted Blade!
Each enemy hit with Slash Dash adds to Excalibur's Melee Combo Counter.
Perform a Melee Spin Attack with Exalted Blade to create a small Radial Blind for half the Energy cost!
Cast Slash Dash on an enemy while Exalted Blade is active to launch energy waves.
While Exalted Blade is active, Slash Dash is granted a small bonus to its base damage.
Exalted Blade's innate Punch Through allows its waves to traverse through obstacles to enemies.
Build up Bonus Damage for Exalted Blade's energy waves and Excalibur's Melee Combo Counter by striking enemies at close range with the sword itself.
Excalibur's Exalted Blade can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_0: Refresh Spellbind's Status Effect immunity by recasting it on Titania or allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_1: Allies’ Companions within range of Tribute’s Full Moon buff also benefit from its damage increase.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_10: Titania's small size while in Razorwing combined with Tribute's Dust buff greatly increases her evasion chances!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_11: Cast Razorwing while in the air to shorten the casting time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_2: Allies within range of Tribute’s Thorns buff also benefit from its damage reduction and reflection!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_3: Enemies that survive any of Titania’s Tribute buffs have their attacks weakened.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_4: Titania gains one additional Razorfly for each Tribute buff active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_5: Refresh the Duration of Titania's active Tribute by casting and collecting the same Aura from an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_6: Lantern can be cast on multiple enemies, and affected enemies can be detonated by charging the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_7: Enemies attacked by Razorwing's Razorflies have increased vulnerability to damage from your attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_8: Titania's Razorwing weapons, the Dex Pixia pistols, and Diwata blade, can be modded separately in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_9: Titania can cast her other abilities while in Razorwing!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_0: Pair Frost with weapons that deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status to Freeze enemies quicker. Spreading Cold to nearby enemies with weapons also increases the Armor Frost gains from his passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_1: Cast Freeze on the ground to create an icy path, adding <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status Effect to the enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_2: Cast Freeze on the outside of a Snow Globe to shatter it and deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage to nearby enemies, this can also be used to remove Globes from undesirable locations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_3: Cast Snow Globe on top of enemies to freeze and launch them out of the area!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_4: Increase the max Health of Snow Globes with Ability Strength and Armor Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_5: Frost can cast up to four Snow Globes to cover more ground.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_6: Snow Globes absorb damage and convert it to Health within the first few seconds after cast. Cast them while taking heavy damage to convert high levels of damage into its total Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_7: Reset the damage absorption period and invulnerability window for an existing Snow Globe by casting a new one inside of it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_8: Enemies frozen by Avalanche have Reduced Armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_9: Enemies affected by <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status Effects also take additional Critical Damage. Pair Frost with high Critical Chance weapons to maximize the damage on targets affected by Cold.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari: Enemies scanned by Seek are also marked in the minimap.
Evade removes all Status Effects on Cyte-09.
Evade bypasses Cyte-09’s Shield Regen Delay, meaning his Shields start regenerating immediately after casting.
Cyte-09 and allies all have their own instance of the Resupply Ammo Packs, meaning no one can take them from him or each other.
Cyte-09's Primary, Secondary and Neutralize Exalted Weapon can each pick up their own Resupply Ammo Pack, meaning you can have up to three different elemental damage types on each to swap between.

Resupply Ammo Packs last until collected, and Cyte-09 can deploy up to six at a time. Arrange a wide variety of elements near stationary objectives to give allies a stockpile of munitions to choose from.
Resupply will retain the last used Elemental ammo type for easy recasting until a new type is selected.
Neutralizer also benefits from Resupply and applies the chosen Status Effects onto its ricochet shots, on top of the <DT_COLD_COLOR>Cold Damage from its alt-fire attack.
Seek uses Cyte-09's Energy color to mark enemy weak spots. Use a bright color to help you target them better!
Each bullet that ricochets off of enemy weak points from Cyte-09's passive contributes to Neutralize's Shot Combo Counter. Combine this with its Zoom multiplier for massive damage potential!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_0: Garuda's passive applies Bonus Damage to both abilities and Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_1: Cast Dread Mirror on multiple enemies to collect their life force into a single projectile, which lasts indefinitely until launched.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_10: Seeking Talons can be charged in the air while hovering over enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_2: Hold Dread Mirror to channel Energy into damage for its projectile, causing a more impactful explosion upon release!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_3: Cast Blood Altar and Bloodletting back to back to trade Energy for Health and Health for Energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_4: Roll into enemies with Dread Mirror to knock them away and clear a path!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_5: Blood Altar's effects can be stacked by overlapping the healing circles, allowing for potent defensive zones using the impaled enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_6: Seeking Talons can pierce the same enemy multiple times if they are the only one in the reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_7: Cast Seeking Talons multiple times on a single target to make quick work of them with the <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect from its Slash Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_8: Unequipping Garuda's Melee Weapon in the Arsenal equips her Talons instead, which can be modded separately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_9: Unleash a highly charged projectile from Dread Mirror onto targets affected by Seeking Talons for a devastating enemy bloodbath!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_0: Enemies hit with Fractured Blast will have a Crystal floating above their head to indicate they are affected by the <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect. Killing them while this Slash Status is active will result in an increased drop chance of a Health or Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_1: Prioritize killing enemies affected by Fractured Blast to increase the amount of health restored over time by Citrine's passive. The more Health Orbs Citrine picks up, the more her passive will heal!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_2: Preserving Shell is applied to all allies within Shared Affinity Range. Allies gain or lose this protection based on their current distance, so stay close together to maximize the Ability’s effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_3: The total Damage Resistance applied by Preserving Shell has a special indicator in the HUD while active. Citrine can increase the Resistance by getting kills or assists while it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_4: Prismatic Gem will only target one enemy at a time. Focus its attack by using weapons against priority targets, as it will not attack foes harmed by Abilities only (with the exception of Fractured Blast).
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_5: Prismatic Gem’s area of effect for Ally Status Effect and Duration buffs is indicated by a prismatic aura in the air. Enemies are targeted by Prismatic Gem as long as Citrine or the enemy are inside the aura when struck.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_6: Each attack from Prismatic Gem will apply one stack of all its Status Effects (<DT_FIRE>Heat, <DT_FREEZE>Cold, <DT_POISON>Toxin and <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity). Harm the target with rapid fire weapons to apply multiple stacks of these Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_7: Enemies with Overguard will not be immobilized by Crystalize, but will still grow Crystals! Shoot the Crystal Growths to take down their Overguard faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_8: Casting Crystallize will generate fractals for every enemy within Range and Line of Sight. If an enemy was just out of range, Citrine can reposition and immediately cast again without removing the effect on already-Crystallized foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_9: Casting Preserving Shell also staggers nearby enemies. The Damage Resistance is maintained upon recast, so Citrine can use this functionality to get out of a pinch.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_0: Tap Shattered Lash to stab enemies with <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage, or hold to sweep enemies with <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_1: Shattered Lash's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it and her Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_2: Splinter Storm can be cast on allies and Defense objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_3: Gara and her allies can refresh Splinter Storm's duration by passing through Mass Vitrify's ring while it is expanding.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_4: Splinter Storm's damage is increased when Spectrorage's mirrors shatter within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_5: Destroy Mass Vitrify's ring with Shattered Lash when standing near of it to increase Splinter Storm's damage!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_6: Cast Splinter Storm on an enemy to damage surrounding foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_7: Mass Vitrify's ring gains durability based on the Health and Shields of the enemies crystallized during the cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_8: Increase the vertical height of Mass Vitrify's ring by casting it from a high point or by casting it mid-air.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_0: Most of Gyre’s abilities inflict <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Status, which her passive converts into additional Critical Chance on subsequent damage. High-Status Chance weapons modded with <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage can maximize this effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_1: The <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Status from Gyre's abilities makes her strong at crowd control thanks to its stun effect. Use abilities strategically to protect yourself and allies by keeping enemies locked down.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_2: Gather enemies using Coil Horizon before tossing Arcsphere, making it easier to hit multiple enemies and trigger Arcsphere’s damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_3: Coil Horizon will knock enemies down if it hits them directly on cast. Since the suction effect is not immediate, use this to incapacitate nearby targets in a pinch.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_4: Cathode Grace works best when there are many targets to kill. Modding for increased Ability Duration coupled with a steady stream of kills helps maximize uptime before the casting cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_5: Cathode Grace stacks with Gyre’s passive ability, up to a maximum of 300% combined Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_6: Gyre’s excellent critical hit potential makes it easy to trigger Rotorswell's discharge frequently. Maximize her passive, use Cathode Grace, or equip a weapon with high Critical Chance stats to take advantage. Does not apply to Helminth abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_: Only a couple of the Mirror clones fire with Mirage, but all of them perform melee attacks!
Hall of Mirrors' clones mimic different weapon attacks, including alt-fires and Melee Heavy Attacks.
Cast Hall of Mirrors to draw enemy fire to Mirage's clones instead of her.
Equip Mirage with area of effect weapons to quickly clear rooms of enemies with the help of her Hall of Mirror's clones.
Sleight of Hand turns Security Cameras into allies, keeping them from activating Laser Barriers when detected.
Cast Sleight of Hand when there is a large amount of Ammo Pickups on the ground for a chance that they'll randomly explode and deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage to nearby enemies.
Total Eclipse is an Augment Mod for Eclipse that grants allies in range its benefits.
Sleight of Hand is especially useful in Spy and Rescue missions, cast it when enemies are rushing to consoles to cause an explosion.
Prism bounces off of surfaces and can be especially useful in narrow pathways.
With the Solar Eclipse buff active, Prism deals double damage. With the Lunar Eclipse buff active, Prism's casting cost is halved.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_0: Styanax’s Passive increase to critical chance is based on total Shields, including Overshields. Equip mods that increase Shield capacity, and generate Overshields with Rally Point or other Warframe abilities for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_1: Axios Javelin can be thrown in rapid succession to create multiple vortex points, helping to control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_2: If an enemy is not near any walls, throw an Axios Javelin from above and pin them to the floor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_3: Gather enemies using Axios Javelin and cast Tharros Strike against the group to effectively strip them of their defenses and heal Styanax. Final Stand can also be cast to smite the remaining foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_4: Rally Point draws enemy attention to Styanax. Cast near teammates while drawing fire, and quickly bring down the enemy to regenerate allies’ Shields and hold the line.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_5: Rally Point's bonuses apply to each teammate in range at the time of casting. Teammates do not need to stay near Styanax to continue regenerating Energy and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_6: Styanax is vulnerable during Final Stand. Cast it from a safe distance or combine it with Rally Point for added Shield protection.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_7: Styanax’s airborne position can be shifted slightly during Final Stand using movement inputs. Combine with the spears’ explosion to hunt down enemies behind cover.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio: Hold Virulence to highlight the area it will travel before casting!
Cast Larva close to the ground so that Virulence can reach enemies caught by the tendrils for easy Mutation Stacks.
The more Mutation Stacks Nidus has, the more damage Virulence and detonated Maggots deal!
Standing in Ravenous' area regenerates Health over time and scales with Ability Strength Mods.
Ravenous use Mutation Stacks instead of Energy to cast. The ability icon light up when there are enough stacks to cast.

For each enemy hit by the first pulse of damage, Virulence refunds a portion of its casting cost. This means lower Ability Efficiency can actually return more energy overall when striking groups larger than four!
Hold Parasitic Link to cast on the nearest ally.
Parasitic Link will flash and play a sound when it's about to break to let you know you're too far from your target!
Link to an ally or enemy with Parasitic Link and cast Virulence to create a second growth from the linked unit.
Use Parasitic Link on free-moving companions and Specters to buff Nidus and the companion or Specter.
Enemy heavy units can withstand more damage which makes them ideal Parasitic Link targets.
Cast Virulence into Ravenous' infested area to detonate Maggots and deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage to nearby enemies.
While Ravenous is active, hold Virulence to mark the location of its Maggots and release to cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_0: Forced Perspective can allow Follie to traverse great distances quickly, while also bypassing some obstacles and traps.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_1: Forced Perspective clears Status Effects and grants brief invincibility, making it great for both aggressive advances and tactical retreats.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_2: A Shadowgraph's beauty is in the eye of the beholder. Many objects are only useful in certain mission types, and require proper awareness and knowledge to be used effectively!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_3: Each individual Shadowgraph has its own cooldown, tracked in the bottom right corner of the screen.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_4: Shadowgraph creates objects as they are in the world, meaning they do not scale with mods, but instead scale with enemy level in the current mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_5: Self Portrait reduces damage taken by all nearby allies, including companions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_6: Plein Air can be recast to capture new enemies, without releasing enemies that are already in flight.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_7: Enemies falling out of Plein Air will cause a radial explosion of ink on impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_8: Equip precision weaponry to pop certain balloons, or to shoot enemies without releasing them from flying captivity. Conversely, use explosive Shadowgraphs like Thermian RPGs and Amphors to make them all fall down!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_9: Plein Air balloons can be bounced upon from above, popping them and refreshing expended double jumps.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_0: Invasions pit enemy factions against each other. You may choose to support Grineer or Corpus forces as they fight against the Infested, or even against each other.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_1: To earn the reward, you must complete three missions for one side on that mission node. Items are only awarded once the Invasion has ended; the reward is then sent to your inbox, regardless of who won the conflict.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_2: Certain weapons can only be built using parts earned from Invasions. Other rewards may include Orokin Catalysts and Reactors, Forma, or Exilus Adapters - so check back often!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_3: Depending on who loses control over the sector, the Corpus Zanuka Hunter or The Grineer Grustrag Three will have their sights on you and may ambush you in future missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_4: You may participate in multiple mission nodes for a single invasion. Keep in mind you may only earn one reward from each node.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_5: You may assist both sides of a conflict on different mission nodes. To change which side is supported on a specific node, you will need to play enough missions to undo assistance given to the other faction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_: Blueprints are used to build items in the Foundry. They can be obtained from the Market with Credits, by completing various missions, and more. Unlock the Foundry by completing the Vor’s Prize Quest.
Inventory Slots are used to store your Warframes, Weapons and other equipment. Additional Slots can be purchased for Platinum or earned via Nightwave rewards.
The amount of Open Inventory Slots you own for each equipment type is viewable by selecting the equipment’s category in your Inventory. Additional Slots can be purchased here as well!
The Mastery earned from leveling equipment to Max Rank remains even after selling the Mastered item - meaning it can be sold to vacate Slots for new equipment!
Once something is sold, it cannot be returned to your inventory - always double check before confirming.
The Mods you own can be viewed and upgraded after unlocking the Mod Segment via the Vor’s Prize Quest.
Preview an item to learn more about it. View its tradability, stats, description, Mastery Rank requirement, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_: Overshields prevent Health damage from Status Effects!
Hildryn's abilities consume Shields instead of Energy! Equip her with Mods that increase Shield Capacity and Shield Recharge to maximize that pool.
Balefire's Charger can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
Increase Hildryn's Movement Speed while Aegis Storm is active by Dodging.
Hildryn's Balefire uses her Shields to fire its shots - The longer you charge the attack, the more Shields are consumed.
Cast Pillage to replenish Hildryn's Shields and Overshields so that they can be used to cast her other abilities.
Haven can be cast on friendly NPCs.
The Shield bars of Hildryn and allies affected by Haven have a special visual effect that indicates when her passive is ready to be activated.
Cast Haven while Hildryn is in Aegis Storm to grant allies its protective aura while on high.
Hold jump to float up or hold crouch to float down while Hildryn is in Aegis Storm.
Recast Aegis Storm to send Hildryn flying down onto enemies, dealing damage on impact.
Aegis Storm drains Hildryn's Shields over time. Watch her Shields carefully and cast Pillage to refuel.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_0: Mind Controlled enemies visually react before turning on their allies. Damage dealt to them during this window will increase their damage output while they are under Nyx’s control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_1: Cast Mind Control on Shield Ospreys so that Nyx and allies can benefit from their Shield regenerating effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_10: Recast Absorb while active to detonate the bubble early.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_2: Mind Controlled enemies will attack aggressively with little regard for self-preservation, prioritizing enemies that Nyx is currently targeting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_3: Cast Psychic Bolts to temporarily disable Auras from Ancients.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_4: Psychic Bolts can be recast any time to engage new targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_5: Psychic Bolts siphons enemies’ defenses onto Nyx. This applies to Shields, Armor and Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_6: Casting Absorb while airborne allows Nyx to float above the battlefield. Hold jump to float upwards or crouch to float down, drawing as much fire as possible.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_7: Absorb also converts damage received from allies. Coordinate with allies to build up a more powerful explosion!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_8: Damage that enemies do to each other is added to Absorb’s detonation if the ability is active. Create mass confusion with Mind Control and Chaos before casting Absorb to maximize damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_9: Nyx is completely invulnerable during Absorb, making it a great last resort when under heavy fire.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_0: Enemies bound by Ensnare are dealt more damage from Whipclaw and Venari attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_1: Cast Whipclaw on an enemy trapped in Strangledome to hit all held enemies at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_10: Whipclaw's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it and her Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_11: Khora can cast up to two Strangledomes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_2: Cast Strangledome on Defense objectives to protect them from approaching enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_3: Venari Tail Whip's enemies in her Protect posture to knock them down and disarm them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_4: Command Venari to stay in place by marking her while she's in her Heal posture.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_5: Command Venari in her Heal posture to revitalize Khora by recasting the ability while enemies are not in the reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_6: Venari Snares a target temporarily in her Attack posture. Choose a new target for Venari to Snare by casting the ability on an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_7: Venari's Heal posture can heal Defense objectives when marked!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_8: Venari grants Khora a permanent buff to her Movement Speed which scales with Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_9: Khora can have both Venari and another Companion with her in a mission!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_0: One weapon type will always be affected by Koumei’s passive, causing it to inflict additional Status Effects. Pay attention to your currently buffed weapon type, and swap weapons accordingly!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_1: Each ability cast rolls all five of Koumei’s Dice. The total value rolled changes the effectiveness of the ability you cast. Rolling three sixes at once unleashes a powerful effect unique to each ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_2: Kumihimo's threads cover a wide area in whatever direction the ability is cast. Block off narrow corridors and chokepoints, or increase Ability Range to inflict many Status Effects across larger open areas with many enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_3: Your current Omikuji challenge is displayed on-screen at all times, along with the progress towards completion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_4: Each cast of Omikuji permanently increases the cooldown for the duration of the mission before it can be cast again.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_5: Hold Omikuji to cancel your current challenge. Be aware that a canceled Omikuji will still increase the cooldown timer.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_6: A full list of all Decrees earned through Omikuji during your mission can be found on the pause menu.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_7: Consider pairing Koumei with weapons that are good for completing Omikuji challenges, such as those that apply each of the four base Status Effects, or weapons that excel at long range or headshot kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_8: Omamori’s defensive charms cannot be refreshed until you have almost run out. Watch your charges and recast Omamori when you get low.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_9: Bunraku affects enemies that Koumei can see within range. Size up large groups of enemies and watch them dance!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_0: Escape danger by casting Decoy at a distance and Switch Teleporting to it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_1: Cast Decoy before Invisibility expires to draw fire away from Loki for the brief period he is visible before recasting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_2: Cast Decoy in the middle of large groups to take advantage of the scaling health and shield absorbed from nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_3: Cast Invisibility to stealthily revive fallen allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_4: Stay out of the line of fire while Invisibility is active and retreat when the ability is about to expire for a safer recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_5: Switch Teleport can be used on friendly characters like rescue targets, escort drones, and downed allies. Use to re-position high priority targets to safer locations!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_6: Cast Switch Teleport on priority and nearby targets to confuse them, leaving them open to attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_7: Switch Teleport with Dargyn Pilots on the Plains of Eidolon to steal their vehicle!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_8: Unlike other factions, Infested enemies are knocked down by Radial Disarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_9: Irradiating Disarm is an Augment Mod for Radial Disarm that puts enemies into a frenzy with the <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_0: Cast Polarize to strip enemy Armor and Shields before casting Crush for more effective destruction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_1: Cast Pull to draw enemies away from allies that are at risk of being downed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_2: Cast Magnetize on high priority enemy units to keep them at bay and inflict continuous damage onto them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_3: Magnetize targets take increased damage from Pull and Polarize.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_4: Projectile weapons with punch through are especially devastating inside Magnetize bubbles, circling through enemies multiple times.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_5: Multiple Magnetize bubbles can be placed on different enemies at once. If the limit is reached, the first bubble will detonate if the target is no longer alive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_6: Magnetize bubbles explode and deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage if the originating target dies before the ability has ended.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_7: Cast Polarize to replenish the Shields of Defense objectives if they are getting low.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_8: Crush grants Shields to nearby allies including Companions when cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_0: The Rift provides cover from hazards, like Grineer Arc Traps and Laser Barriers.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1: Allies can roll to leave the Rift when Banished!
Damaging Status Effects like <DT_SLASH>Slash, <DT_GAS>Gas or <DT_POISON>Toxin will continue dealing damage while enemies are affected by Stasis.
Allies inside the Rift can still damage enemies using their Warframe abilities.
Cast Rift Surge before Cataclysm expires in order to keep all enemies in the Rift between casts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_2: Banish can be used to protect vulnerable allies, including friendly NPCs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_3: Limbo must be on the same plane as his target to push them out of their current Rift plane using Banish.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_4: Stasis' Duration is half as long as Cataclysm. Recast Stasis frequently to ensure any enemies caught by Cataclysm remain frozen and vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_5: Stasis freezes enemies who enter the Rift. Combine it with Cataclysm to protect Defense objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_6: Cast Stasis before Banish or Cataclysm to instantly freeze enemies in place!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_7: Cast Cataclysm on Defense Objectives to keep them safe inside the Rift.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_8: Cataclysm deals more damage to enemies within it when detonated at its minimum size.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_9: Detonating Cataclysm by recasting does less damage to the same target for every subsequent use.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MegaPrimeV: Stay tuned for future Prime Vault details!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing: Change the focus of Wukong's Celestial Twin by recasting the ability on an enemy. Doing so increases the damage dealt by the Twin and can be especially useful when dealing with higher priority targets.
Hold Celestial Twin to dismiss the existing twin.
Melee while holding aim with Primal Fury active to perform area of effect attacks that stagger enemies.
Melee while holding aim and moving forward to perform high range and gap closing attacks.

Wukong's passive has 5 possible survival techniques: 
<MINI_ARROW> Primal Forces: Triple Elemental Damage for 60 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Heavenly Cloak: Invisibility for 30 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Cosmic Armor: Invulnerable for 30 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Monkey Luck: Extra Loot Drops for 60 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Sly Alchemy: Orbs 4x more effective for 60 seconds
Cast Cloud Walker to bypass Security Cameras and traverse through Laser Barriers.
Cloud Walker heals Wukong based on distance moved in cloud form. Escape and reposition during tough combat encounters, re-emerging ready to fight!
Cloud Walker's heal and invulnerability also apply to Celestial Twin, if active.
Celestial Twin remains active during Cloud Walker and teleports to Wukong once deactivated.
Defy is cast in sync with Wukong's Celestial Twin - damage absorbed by both is combined into a single value, affecting the strength of their retaliatory strikes, as well as their shared Armor bonus.
Primal Fury's Iron Staff can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
Melee with Primal Fury active to perform frontal attacks with high damage multipliers.
Melee while moving forward with Primal Fury active to perform fast sweeping attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_0: Soul Punch heals existing Shadows of the Dead if the max number of enemies affected are active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_1: Soul Survivor is an Augment Mod for Soul Punch that consumes all of Nekros' Energy to revive downed allies instantly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_10: Enemies that are below 25% Health are instantly killed by Soul Punch and turned into a Shadow of the Dead up until the max amount of enemies affected.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_2: Terrify reduces enemy Armor and can be stacked multiple times when recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_3: Creeping Terrify is an Augment Mod for Terrify that reduces the Movement Speed of enemies affected by the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_4: Cast Desecrate in Survival and Excavation missions to increase the drop chance of Life Support and Power Cells.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_5: Combine <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage weapons with Desecrate to create more enemy parts for loot to drop from.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_6: Despoil is an Augment Mod for Desecrate that fuels the ability with Nekros' Health instead of Energy. With it, Nekros can better utilize Health orbs created by Desecrate, opening up synergies with powerful Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_7: Enemies that spawn additional units continue to do so even after they are summoned as a Shadow of the Dead.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_8: Recast Shadows of the Dead to fully heal them for less time than a regular cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_9: Decrease the rate at which Shadows lose Health over time with Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_0: Use Fire Walker to lock down strategic areas, such as narrow pathways or objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_1: Fire Walker removes Status Effects from allies when they cross its path!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_2: Recast Blazing Chakram to teleport Nezha to the Chakram. If Fire Walker is active, a ring of fire will also appear wherever he lands.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_3: Cast Blazing Chakram on an enemy impaled by Divine Spears to spawn a second Chakram!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_4: Charge Nezha's Blazing Chakram before launching it to increase its damage and  cause it to fly straight ahead, instead of locking onto enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_5: After Warding Halo's Health depletes, a wave of <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage ignites surrounding enemies, and a brief invulnerability phase gives Nezha time to recast his Halo safely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_6: Warding Halo prevents Status Effects such as <DT_SLASH>Slash and Knockdowns.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_7: Safeguard is an Augment Mod for Warding Halo that allows Nezha to cast Halos onto allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_8: Cast Warding Halo when under heavy fire to briefly prevent damage, and increase the durability of the resulting Halo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_9: Recast Divine Spears while the ability is active to retract the spears, dealing additional damage to impaled enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_: Not all challenges need to be completed in order to hit the max Reward Tier by the end of a Series. Complete as many as you can!
If enough Acts are completed in a single week, Acts missed earlier in the Series will reappear for another chance to earn Standing. No Weekly Act is lost forever!
Cred Offerings rotate every week and may bring new items. A timer in the shop will tell you when you can expect new Offerings to arrive.
Nightwave Creds do not persist between Series, so be sure to visit the Offerings store before the current Series ends.
The News Panel in your Orbiter will notify you a few weeks before the end of a Series.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_0: Weapons that inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage deal more damage over time with Ash's increased <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_1: Shuriken can seek and destroy nearby Security Cameras.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_10: Ash can Teleport to any enemy in his line of sight. Use this to bypass windows, Laser Barriers, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_11: The Bladestorm ability input can be held to target enemies, and activates upon release, instead of tapping the ability input twice.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_2: Shuriken hits contribute to Ash’s Melee Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_3: Smoke Screen's invisibility also applies to Ash's Companions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_4: Cast Smoke Screen before activating Blade Storm to mark enemies under cover safely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_5: Use Teleport to reach allies, Rescue Targets, Cryopods, Excavators, and more!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_6: Casting Teleport on a marked enemy, while Ash's Shadow Clones are attacking, does not consume Energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_7: Ash is immune to damage when teleporting to an enemy during Shadow Clones attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_8: Blade Storm's damage scales with Mods equipped on Shadow Clones, as well as the Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_9: Any source of invisibility reduces the cost of Blade Storm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_0: There’s safety in mushrooms! Always keep a Stinkbrain or Brightbonnet nearby when things get dangerous to take advantage of Nokko’s passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_1: Use Stinkbrain mushrooms to soften up enemies with lots of Health using <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects, then focus fire with weapons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_10: Nokko can unleash up to three Sporespring mushrooms at a time for maximum chaos! Don’t forget to use Brightbonnet to help sustain the cost of frequent casting, while also increasing Sporespring damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_2: Brightbonnets increase Nokko’s Energy and Ability Strength, in addition to his allies’. It’s always a good idea to deploy one before casting other Abilities!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_3: You don't need to stay inside the radius of a Brightbonnet to keep the Ability Strength increase. Each pulse will refresh the buff's duration, so simply return when the Ability Strength increase expires.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_4: Nokko is fragile, but resilient. Use Reroot when under fire to regenerate Health and Shields while repositioning.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_5: Stinkbrain and Brightbonnet mushrooms can be bounced on to gain upwards momentum. It even works in Sprodling form!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_6: Stinkbrain and Brightbonnet mushrooms appear on the minimap, making them easier to track down for Nokko and his allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_7: Sprodling form can roll to dash forward quickly, and also has a 'triple jump', for when you need some extra propulsion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_8: Sporespring mushrooms bounce more erratically based on Ability Range upgrades.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_9: Sporespring will attempt to strike high priority targets (like Eximus units) when flying into crowds. They will also bounce off of stationary mushrooms that are nearby.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_0: Protea's passive applies to every 4th ability cast before resetting. Plan ahead by using abilities with low Energy cost to strengthen those with larger costs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_1: Allies can collect Shield Satellites by walking near them. Throw them at squadmates’ feet or in their path to apply its effects immediately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_2: Blaze Artillery has a short duration, but gets stronger with every target it hits. Cast in areas with tightly packed enemies for maximum firepower.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_3: Cast Dispensary with Protea's passive active to generate more pickups.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_4: Rewinding through Temporal Anchor does not reset Protea’s other active abilities, cast as many as you can before time runs out.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_5: Recast Temporal Anchor after casting Protea’s other abilities to have the Energy spent returned in a pinch!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_6: Holding Temporal Anchor while it's active will cancel the ability entirely without the implosion, rewind, or Energy refund.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_0: The Predator's Lurk passive effect can be refreshed while active, allowing Oraxia to remain invisible as she weaves around the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_1: Enemies below 50% health will have a marker above them, indicating they can be instantly killed by Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_2: Mercy’s Kiss instant kill also applies to any enemy vulnerable to a Mercy Kill. Use <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects to raise the Mercy Kill threshold.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_3: Scuttler bites also deal <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects with added duration, increasing the Mercy Kill threshold and making enemies more vulnerable to Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_4: Scuttlers increase in level to match the mission, making them increasingly deadly against harder foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_5: Use the Dodge input to web sling to any surface during Silken Stride. Oraxia can also jump while being pulled or Wall Latching for increased mobility options.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_6: During Silken Stride, Oraxia's jump height and Bullet Jump velocity is increased. She also cannot be staggered or knocked down, nor will she experience hard landings.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_7: Oraxia can remain Wall Latched indefinitely during Silken Stride for very little Energy. Unleash chaos with her Scuttlers, weaken enemies from above, then strike with Mercy's Kiss when the time is right!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_8: The <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage explosion on death during Silken Stride also applies to assists, as long as damage was done by Oraxia or her Scuttlers shortly before the kill.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_9: While using Silken Stride, Oraxia's Melee Weapon is disabled, but can instead be used to trigger Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_0: Increase Elude's evasion angle with Ability Range Mods. At 360°, Baruuk avoids attacks from all directions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_1: Baruuk can Elude both gunfire and melee attacks, but cannot evade splash damage - be wary against explosive-wielding enemies.
Serene Storm's energy waves punch through enemies and increase the Melee Combo Counter for each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_2: Unlike other sleep Abilities, enemies affected by Lull awaken with their alert levels reset.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_3: Baruuk can give an ally up to half of his maximum Desolate Hands charges, granting Damage Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_4: Ability Strength increases the maximum number of Desolate Hands charges upon cast - this also increases maximum for sharing with other players!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_5: Enemies sent flying by Serene Storm attacks will be disarmed! Baruuk's Ground Slam and Spin Attacks are great for achieving this effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_6: Serene Storm's energy waves can deflect enemy projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_7: Baruuk blocks a majority of all frontal damage with Serene Storm active, even while attacking or performing other actions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_8: Keep Baruuk's Restraint meter low while Serene Storm is active using Elude, Lull, and Desolate Hands.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_9: Baruuk's Desert Wind can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster: When encountering new and dangerous enemies, use Noctua or other Codex scanning tools to complete their Codex entry quickly and benefit from Dante’s passive going forward.
Noctua can equip any number of Tome Mods, making it a versatile tool for both utility and destruction.
Noctua’s projectile spreads into four fragments upon impact. Fire into large groups to hit multiple enemies and charge the Alternate Fire quickly.
Light Verse and Final Verse’s Triumph grants Dante invulnerability during cast, offering immediate protection when you need it most.
Protect allies in range by combining the Overguard granted from Light Verse and Final Verse's Triumph.
Noctua’s clones created by Wordwarden use the same damage types as the mods equipped on Noctua. Consider which Status Effects would be most beneficial to your allies when modding the Noctua.
The Paragrimms summoned by Final Verse’s Pageflight draw fire from enemies, offering crowd control while attacking.

Final Verse’s Tragedy applies all damage from Status Effects on an enemy instantly. Take advantage of this by applying <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects with Dark Verse and Pageflight, then cast Tragedy to wipe out heavy targets!

Increased Status Chance from Dante’s passive and Pageflight with Status Vulnerability and Status Damage can be used to stack <DT_SLASH>Slash, <DT_FIRE>Heat, and <DT_POISON>Toxin Status Effects from other sources, dramatically increasing the damage of Tragedy.
Final Verse is based on the last two Verses cast. If you’ve set up the wrong combination, keep casting to replace your pending Verses.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_0: Oberon's Righteous Negation passive can be activated using Health Orbs from Reckoning or any other source. This also includes Universal Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_1: Smite removes Overguard and Armor from the initial target, and also scales based on the target's Health and Shield values. Eximus units are prioritized when casting into large groups of enemies, since they're the ideal target.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_2: Enemies targeted by Smite are vulnerable to Melee Finishers for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_3: Up to three Hallowed Ground fields can be active at once. Spread them across the battlefield to boost Renewal healing for allies, and to sow chaos with <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_4: Enter Oberon’s Affinity Range while Renewal is active to gain the buff. The effects of Renewal continue to benefit allies for as long as the ability is active, even if they move out of the initial range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_5: Summoned allies, such as Specters and Nekros' Shadows, also benefit from Renewal's various positive effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_6: Renewal will negate Status Effects when the target is at maximum Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_7: Renewal grants additional Armor for allies with each target hit by Reckoning. This Armor increase will remain as long as Renewal remains active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_8: Cast Renewal to increase the bleed out timer for downed allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_9: Reckoning deals significantly more damage to enemies already affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effects. Weaken enemies with Hallowed Ground, then strike them down!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric: Wrathful Advance attacks benefit from the melee combo counter. Cast Kullervo's other abilities to help build the combo counter with their dagger hits.
Using Wrathful Advance to teleport forward refreshes Kullervo’s double jump.
Collective Curse circulates damage from large singular attacks like Wrathful Advance and from rapid strikes like Storm of Ukko.
Wrathful Advance can teleport Kullervo in any direction. Aim the reticle above to jump out of dicey situations or to reach high up locations.
Holding Wrathful Advance and releasing while aiming at an enemy will lock Kullervo onto and attack the target the same way tapping the ability does.
Cast Recompense before entering the fray with Wrathful Advance, so that the daggers target enemies immediately upon teleporting.
Once Recompense is cast there is a 5 second window before its daggers turn on Kullervo. Find as many enemies as you can before casting to avoid taking that damage.
Each enemy can be hit by up to 3 Recompense daggers. Reposition yourself near a cluster of enemies to launch each of those daggers before they turn on Kullervo!
Recompense grants Overguard which is a mechanism that grants additional Health protection and provides Knockdown Immunity while active.
Collective Curse can be cast multiple times to create a longer chain of shared enemy suffering.
Melee attacks and dagger hits spread to chained enemies by Collective Curse add to the melee combo counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_0: Once Hydroid damages an enemy, his passive applies to Corrosive Status Effects from any source, even those applied by allies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_1: Cast Tempest Barrage on Corpus Nullifiers to shrink and burst their bubbles!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_2: Tempest Barrage can be recast to create multiple barrage areas.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_3: Cast Tidal Surge to get out of tough situations quickly with brief invulnerability while cleansing negative Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_4: Casting Plunder removes any <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Status Effects currently affecting enemies, permanently reducing their maximum Armor based on the Corrosive Status removed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_5: Stack up Corrosive Status with Hydroid's abilities before casting Plunder to maximize its effect. Reach 100% Armor reduction with Hydroid's Passive to permanently remove all of their Armor!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_6: Bring weapons with <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Status to bolster Hydroid’s abilities, or bring weapons with <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage to take full advantage of their lack of Armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_7: Tidal Surge can drag enemies into an area locked down by Tempest Barrage and Tentacle Swarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_8: Tentacle Swarm’s Tentacles will automatically find a new target if their current target dies - No need to recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_9: Use the Pilfering Swarm Augment to gain extra loot from enemies that die while held by Tentacle Swarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_0: Harrow's increased Overshield Capacity benefits from Shield Restores and other Shield regenerating Warframe abilities!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_1: Condemn's chains expand outward the further they travel, covering a wide conical area.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_2: Cast Condemn to generate more Shields for Penance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_3: Condemned enemies allow for easy headshots that can help achieve Thurible's energy burst faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_4: Cast Condemn when Harrow is at max Shields for Overshields!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_5: Recast Penance to increase its duration!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_6: Energy generated by Thurible and the Critical Chance bonus from Covenant are both significantly stronger on Weak Points.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_7: Use Covenant's invulnerability effect as an opportunity to charge up Thurible.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_8: Harrow can move freely while Thurible is active - stay agile to avoid enemy fire while it is charging.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_9: Both Penance and Covenant affect all allies that are within the Shared Affinity Radius. Use the Player List to see who is within range at the time of casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_0: Stack Ivara's radar passive with Mods like Enemy Radar.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_1: Use Alt-Fire with Artemis Bow to instantly shoot the currently selected Quiver Arrow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_10: Alarming weapons temporarily drop Prowl's invisibility when fired. Silent weapons allow invisibility to be maintained.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_11: Navigator can apply to a projectile that is already in flight. If no projectiles are active, it will apply to the next one that is fired.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_2: Fire a Cloak Arrow from Ivara's Quiver onto allies to temporarily grant them invisibility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_3: Ivara can create multiple ziplines using the Dashwire Arrow from Quiver.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_4: Increase the alert radius of Noise Arrow from Ivara's Quiver with Ability Range Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_5: Navigator can be used with Quiver's arrows to direct the chosen arrow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_6: Increase the Projectile Speed of Navigator by holding fire or holding aim to decrease.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_7: A single arrow shot from Ivara's Artemis Bow can be controlled using Navigator!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_8: Roll while Prowl is active to cover more ground without breaking Ivara's cloaked state.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_9: Avoid the Energy drain and movement restrictions from Prowl by traveling on Ziplines!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_0: Open Void Relics by equipping them during a Void Fissure mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_1: A Relic's quality can be improved by spending Void Traces, earned in Void Fissures. Higher quality Relics have a better chance of rare items.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_2: If you reach your full capacity of stored Void Traces, any extra Traces earned from Void Fissure missions will be lost. Increase the capacity by earning more Mastery Rank.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_3: Got extra Prime Parts? Visit the Ducat Kiosk in the Relays to trade them for Ducats, used to purchase Offerings from Baro Ki'Teer when he visits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_4: Earn Aya in Open World Bounties and missions in the Void, while Regal Aya can be purchased directly from Varzia.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_5: Varzia’s wares rotate on a regular basis.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_6: Use Aya to purchase the exact Relics you want from Varzia.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_7: Regal Aya lets you purchase Prime Warframes, Weapons, and Accessories from Varzia’s wares.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_8: Save your Regal Aya and Aya for the next rotation of Varzia’s wares if she doesn’t have what you’re looking for!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_9: Varzia’s wares contain Prime items and Relics not often available in the drop tables.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_0: Revenant is immune to the <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic waters in the Plains of Eidolon at night.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_1: Enthralled enemies can still be damaged by Revenant and his allies. Cull the herd to keep enthralling new enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_2: Enthralled enemies do not benefit from other enemy buffs while under control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_3: Cast Enthrall on an enemy that has been stunned by Mesmer Skin at no Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_4: Cast Mesmer Skin when reviving allies to prevent damage and stun any enemies who attempt to interrupt.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_5: Cast Reave while Danse Macabre is active to halve its Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_6: Increase Reave's travel distance with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_7: Cast Reave onto an ally while Mesmer Skin is active to share a single charge with them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_8: Cast Reave on Enthralled enemies to restore Mesmer Skin charges.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_9: Danse Macabre's beams detonate energy pillars left by Revenant's thralls. Cast Enthrall first to set up an explosive combo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_0: Rhino is immune to damage during Rhino Charge.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_1: Cast Rhino Charge on enemies that have been stunned by Stomp for more damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_2: Cast Iron Skin before Rhino Charge to increase the <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage dealt to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_3: Cast Rhino Charge in quick succession to reduce its Energy cost and double its damage and range!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_4: Iron Skin prevents Status Effects such as <DT_SLASH>Slash and Knockdowns!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_5: Iron Skin scales off both Ability Strength and Armor mods, and the damage absorbed when cast determines its Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_6: Cast Iron Skin when taking heavy damage to convert more damage into its total Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_7: Iron Skin's remaining Overguard total is displayed next to Rhino's Health bar, watch for when it gets low to recast when it runs out.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_8: Cast Roar when allies are within the Ability Radius, to ensure they do not miss out on its damage increasing benefits.
