/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_9: Keep enemies affected by Stomp suspended in the air longer with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_0: Mach Rush's impact shockwave causes <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage and a <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect when Kinetic Plating is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_1: Mach Rush will absorb the elements of Thermal Sunder fields it crosses through, adding damage to both the dash and impact shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_2: Using Thermal Sunder to chill enemies causes those already affected by <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status to become frozen solid.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_3: Using Thermal Sunder to heat enemies causes those already affected by <DT_FIRE>Heat Status to take further damage over time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_4: Casting the opposite Thermal Sunder effect on an enemy suffering <DT_FIRE>Heat or <DT_FREEZE>Cold cancels the old Status, deals <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage, and inflicts the new Status.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_5: Mach Rush consumes half as much Energy when Redlining.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_6: When Redlining with Kinetic Plating active, Melee Attacks inflict Extra Damage and stagger enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_7: Thermal Sunder gains additional properties when Redline is active. <DT_FREEZE>Cold freezes enemies solid, <DT_FIRE>Heat does additional damage, and the combined <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast will strip armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_8: Easily maintain Mach Rush's momentum by switching to the move forward button, then releasing the held ability button.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_9: Gauss can jump from the ground while running in Mach Rush without cancelling the dash.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_0: The more Inaros dies, the more hits on enemies are required to revive him. Staying alive will reduce that number over time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_1: When downed, find an enemy that can survive multiple hits to revive Inaros quickly!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_2: Attacks from Inaros’ Swarm Kavats contribute to his revival progress.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_3: Cast Desiccation while enemies are facing Inaros to blind them, then use a melee Finisher to regain health!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_4: Sandstorm is a great way to get out of desperate situations, healing Inaros and making him invulnerable while active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_5: Sandstorm can be ended early by casting it a second time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_6: Each Status Effect absorbed by Scarab Shell drains 5% of the charged Armor.  Rebuild this protection by recasting the ability!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_7: Regain Health consumed by Scarab Shell by casting Sandstorm on a large group of enemies, or using finishers enabled by Desiccation.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_0: Saryn can spread Spores by killing enemies under the effects of Miasma, killing enemies with Molt's explosion, or attacking them while Toxic Lash is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_1: Combine Toxic Lash with area of effect weapons to spread Spores effectively.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_2: Cast Molt to give Saryn a brief Movement Speed boost to escape danger or catch up to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_3: Increase Molt's Movement Speed boost and initial Health with Ability Strength Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_4: Recast Molt to detonate it and deal <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage to nearby enemies and spread Spores if the explosion kills them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_5: Cast Molt while under heavy fire to convert incoming damage to Health for Saryn's decoy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_6: Cast Molt to protect Saryn from enemy fire while reviving fallen teammates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_7: Maximize Spores' <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage by inflicting enemies with multiple casts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_8: Recast Miasma to refresh the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect on previously affected enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_9: Cast Molt to strip Saryn of all Status Effects and any attack that can latch onto her like latchers from Grineer Seekers and Nox's toxic sludge.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_0: Caliban’s abilities can inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effects, which increases Status Chance Vulnerability on the enemy by 10% and up to 10 times. Each Status Effect lasts for 8s.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_1: When Caliban is at max Health, Razor Gyre will convert any additional Health into Shields. If Shields are at max, he gains Overshields!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_2: Razor Gyre will refund 25% of its Energy cost for each enemy hit. Make sure to hit as many enemies as possible while using it!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_3: Cast Sentient Wrath to hold surviving enemies in place before aiming Fusion Strike’s beams at them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_4: Sentient Wrath can be recast while already active to reset the ability duration on affected enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_5: Ortholysts’ default weapon has 100% Status Chance, guaranteeing <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effects. Take advantage of its Status Chance Vulnerability and shower affected enemies with damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_6: Summulyst and its Choralyst summons have high target prioritization, meaning enemies target them whenever possible. Use this to protect yourself and allies when a mission gets overwhelming.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_7: Conculysts will also Fusion Strike when the ability is cast by Caliban. Paired with their offensive capabilities, these Sentients are the best choice for stripping defenses and clearing rooms with sheer force.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_8: Caliban is invulnerable while casting Fusion Strike.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio: Sirius & Orion are modded separately and benefit from different stats.
Whichever of the two you are not controlling will continue to fight and cast abilities independently.
You can swap whether Sirius or Orion is your default Warframe at the crib in Pontis Tower, after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
Gravitic Slash can be aimed up or down to hit enemies above and below Orion.
Coronal Ejection, Gravitic Slash, and Celestial Clash will fire Jade Stars for each enemy hit, making them deadlier to use!
Jade Stars and Astral Shell are applied to both Sirius and Orion when casted.
Recasting Light's Sanctuary in the well of light will refresh the duration without changing the well's position.
Redirecting Orion's Event Horizon with his Gravitic Slash or Sirius' Coronal Ejection also increases its duration.

Swapping back and forth in Celestial Clash significantly increases Sirius & Orion's Critical Chance. Successfully matching all 7 Constellation Stars while using Celestial Clash will result in a special final attack.
Tap Dodge during Celestial Clash to teleport in the direction you are moving.
There is a brief moment of invulnerability when swapping between Sirius & Orion. Use this to avoid dangerous attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_: Use the Pledge button to choose a Syndicate to gain 15% Standing while playing missions.

Syndicates have a unique relationship between one another - they can be allied, opposed, or enemies. Supporting one Syndicate will affect Standing with related Syndicates. Join multiple Syndicates that work together for faster Standing gain.
Search Syndicate missions carefully for Medallions unique to each faction; these can be turned in for additional standing at any Relay.
Most Syndicate Offerings, such as faction-modified weapons, can be traded with players from other Syndicates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_0: Try casting all of Temple's abilities on the Backbeat to gain bonus effects and conserve Energy during a live performance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_1: Pyrotechnics will detonate in a radius from where you are currently aiming. The <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat pillars can reach enemies behind Temple if your target is close by.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_2: Each new <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effect will cause the enemy to panic. Chain Pyrotechnics casts to keep the room locked down while stacking damage and charging your Exalted Solo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_3: Overdrive affects enemies in front of Temple, making it ideal for high priority targets you want taken down quickly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_4: Overdrive’s Critical Chance Vulnerability is not dependent on the Critical Chance of the weapon, making it best paired with any weapon that has a high Critical Damage multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_5: Temple is invulnerable while casting Ripper’s Wail, giving you time to reassess the situation in an emergency.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_6: Casting abilities to damage enemies on the Backbeat while Ripper’s Wail is active will increase the <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage it offers, while also extending the duration of the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_7: Ripper’s Wail buff decays slowly when the ability expires. Recast while the buff is active to refresh the duration and retain your accumulated <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_8: Exalted Solo is charged by casting abilities on the Backbeat. It can even be recharged while active - for when the show must go on!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_9: When aiming with Lizzie during Exalted Solo, Temple’s ability inputs will shoot solid walls of sound, inflicting guaranteed Status Effects depending on the input.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_0: While using Tail Wind's flight mode, you can stay airborne as long as you have energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_1: Cast Tail Wind in short burst to quickly travel across the Plains of Eidolon and the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_2: Cast Tail Wind's Dive bomb at greater heights to increase the damage dealt on impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_3: Cast Tail Wind and Airburst while Zephyr is Airborne to decrease their Energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_4: Tornadoes transfer allied Weapon Damage to each enemy held in Zephyr's Tornadoes. Fire powerful weapons into them to deal massive damage to the group of captured enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_5: Cast Turbulence while hovering above enemies to attack them with added protection from their projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_6: Hold to cast a wandering Tornado and command the direction it travels by aiming down sights at it and then moving the reticle to a desired location.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_7: Zephyr's Tornadoes inflict the Elemental damage type based on which type is in the majority of the damage absorbed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_8: Each of Zephyr's Tornados can have different Elemental damage types.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_0: Vauban's Abilities travel in an arc, aim higher to throw farther!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_1: Deploy multiple Tesla Nervos drones at once by fully charging the ability cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_2: Each Tesla Nervos drone has a limited number of charges before it must be replaced.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_3: Minelayer's Tether-Flechette orb can be attached to walls and ceilings. Use this to create clever traps for your enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_4: Use Vector-Overdrive pads to give allies a burst of speed or to push enemies away from important mission objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_5: Photon Strike works best when enemies are grouped together by abilities like Bastille's Vortex and the Tether-Flechette orb.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_6: Cast Bastille around Defense objectives and downed allies to protect them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_7: Hold cast Bastille to deploy a vortex instead, or to collapse all Bastilles that have already been deployed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_8: Stand inside Bastille to gain Armor from trapped enemies. Gain an increased amount when stripping Armor from enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_9: Damage from both Minelayer and Photon Strike scale with enemy level.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_0: Cast Well of Life or Energy Vampire on high priority targets to take them out of battle by suspending them in the air.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_1: Recasting Well of Life releases the oldest enemy when at max targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_2: Kill an enemy marked by Energy Vampire to immediately transfer all of its remaining Energy reserves to nearby allies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_3: Increasing Ability Duration will cause Energy Vampire targets to release additional pulses, granting more total Energy from each target.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_4: Cast Energy Vampire to replenish Trinity's Energy pool before casting her other abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_5: Link redirects enemy Status Effects back towards linked enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_6: Use Link tethers to track down nearby enemies through walls!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_7: Blessing applies to Drones and other non-player allies within Affinity range. Healing also applies to Defense objectives, Excavators and other defendable objects, at a diminished rate.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_8: Cast Blessing within the Shared Affinity Range to benefit all allies. Use the Player List to see who is currently within range at the time of casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_0: Cast Speed to cover distance quickly and rapidly build Damage for Volt's passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_1: Cast Shock on priority target to temporarily stun them and open an opportunity for attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_10: Cast Shock on an Electric Shield to electrify it, causing it to deal <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage to enemies that pass through it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_11: Allies within range of Volt when Speed is cast will also benefit, but can backflip if they wish to opt-out of its effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_2: Cast Shock on an enemy affected by Discharge to release an electric burst to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_3: Electric Shield increases the Critical Damage of weapons fired through it!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_4: Cast and shoot through multiple Electric Shields to stack the <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage from each shield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_5: Cast multiple Electric Shields around a defense point to protect it from all angles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_6: Pick up Volt's Electric Shield to be used as mobile cover while on the move. Sprint into enemies to knock them over!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_7: Cast Shock and Discharge on a tightly packed group of enemies to chain the stun from <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity's Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_8: Stun enemies affected by Discharge longer with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_0: Each of Voruna's wolves provide a specific passive when the respective ability button is held. Swap effects depending on the combat situation.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1: Use Shroud of Dynar's invisibility to reposition Voruna before starting her deadly offense.
Recasting Ulfrun's Descent to cancel the ability early will provide a partial Energy refund.
Voruna gains a Movement Speed increase while using Ulfrun's Descent to help hunt her prey.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_2: Shroud of Dynar's melee buff is extended upon melee kill. Stalk a weak target and strike with lethal force for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_3: Fangs of Raksh can help weaken a specific target to guarantee a quick kill, which is useful for triggering Shroud of Dynar's melee buff.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_4: Shroud of Dynar's buff will only be extended if you earn a Melee kill within 3 seconds of exiting invisibility. Be precise and strike true.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_5: Take advantage of Fangs of Raksh's Status Effects by equipping Voruna with weapons and Mods that do more damage to enemies inflicted with several Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_6: Lycath's Hunt provides ample Health orbs when utilizing Voruna's vicious melee expertise. Equip her with upgrades (Mods, Arcanes, etc.) that offer bonuses from these orbs to maximize the ability's effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_7: More precise hunters may want to choose pinpoint weapons that can easily land headshots, and upgrades (Mods, Arcanes, etc.) that utilize orbs for buffs to maximize Lycath's Hunt Energy orb production.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_8: All of Voruna's abilities can be cast while Ulfrun's Descent is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_9: Attacks using Ulfrun's Descent do not break the stealth provided by Shroud of Dynar.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_0: Six Reservoirs of any type can be active at a time. Summoning a Reservoir while at max will replace the oldest one.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_1: Only one of each Mote is capable of attaching to Wisp and her allies at any given time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_2: Reset the duration of a Mote by stepping into the area surrounding a Reservoir of the same type - stay within it to keep it active for longer!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_3: Cast Breach Surge while Wil-O-Wisp is active to trigger another surge at its location.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_4: Increase Wil-O-Wisp's travel distance with Duration mods!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_5: Motes attached to Wisp alter the power of Sol Gate! Vitality and Shock Motes increase its damage by 25% each, and Haste adds a Corrosive Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_6: Cast Wil-O-Wisp while Sol Gate is active to draw enemies away from Wisp and allow for a strategic repositioning of the beam.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_7: Attacking enemies while in the air makes Wisp visible again, regardless of her passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_8: Increase Wisp's Movement Speed while Sol Gate is active by Dodging.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_0: Sevagoth’s Shadow has a limited amount of time to revive Sevagoth when he is downed. Shadow’s Consume ability becomes far more deadly during this time to collect the required souls to revive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_1: Aim down sights after casting Reap to direct Sevagoth’s Shadow for the duration it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_10: Reuniting Sevagoth's Shadow with Sevagoth restores some of his Health. The longer they are separated, the greater the healing from Reunite.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_2: The slowing effect of Gloom scales with Ability Strength mods and stacks with other slowing effects, like <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage's Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_3: Sevagoth's Shadow can perform all Melee attacks and uses both the Melee and Fire Weapon inputs to do so.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_4: Sevagoth's Shadow can be activated once the Death Well is at least 75% full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_5: Sevagoth's Shadow will remain active until it is killed, the Death Well drains completely, or when Reunite is cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_6: Sevagoth's Shadow and its weapon can be separately modded in the Arsenal. Auras, Arcanes, and Set Mods equipped on Sevagoth do not apply to his Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_7: Cast Embrace with Sevagoth's Shadow to set up group melee kills or to pull enemies into range for Death's Harvest.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_8: Cast Consume in Sevagoth's Shadow without a target for added horizontal mobility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_9: Minimize Sevagoth Shadow’s downtime by casting Death’s Harvest to infect enemies before switching back to Sevagoth to kill affected enemies and fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_0: Yareli's Passive activates both on foot and when riding Merulina. Equip a Secondary weapon with high Critical stats to maximize the bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_1: Yareli can have up to 15 Sea Snare globules active at a time. Casting more than 15 causes the earliest globules to pop.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_2: Sea Snare globules can be cast without a target and will linger for a limited amount of time until enemies are in range. This can be used to set up traps for unsuspecting enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_3: Merulina is key to Yareli's survival, reducing incoming damage and keeping her mobile. The ability lasts until it runs out of health or until you dismount by recasting the ability or pressing the melee button.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_4: Merulina can perform double jumps that can reach great heights and does not ragdoll Yareli if she’s knocked off.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_5: Aquablades inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects to clear out weaker enemies. Stronger enemies that are not taken down are staggered by Aquablades, making it ideal for crowd control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_6: Riptide can temporarily incapacitate many enemies while also grouping them together for follow-up attacks or melee finishers!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_7: Casting Sea Snares on enemies before Riptide will keep them trapped in globules if they survive the blow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_8: Recasting Riptide while the ability is active will detonate it early. Holding the initial cast will detonate it immediately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_0: Select bright Emissive Colors to default Equinox to her Day Form when entering missions, or dark Emissive Colors for her Night Form.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_1: Metamorphosis to Equinox's Day Form to receive increased Weapon Damage and Movement Speed!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_2: Metamorphosis' buffs decay over time. Switch forms often to maximize their effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_3: In Equinox's Night Form, Rest's sleeping effect makes it easier to pick off enemies while Mend is active, increasing its regenerating effect to allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_4: Switch to Equinox's Night Form with Metamorphosis for a quick burst of Shield replenishing!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_5: Cast Rage while Provoke is active to increase enemy damage vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_6: Enemies closest to Equinox while Pacify is active receive higher Damage Reduction!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_7: Metamorphosis to Equinox's Night Form, while Provoke is active to apply its bonus Ability Strength to the temporary Armor and Shield, gained from switching forms!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_8: Pacify and Provoke drain Equinox's Energy only when enemies are within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_9: Recast Maim and discharge all stored damage to break nearby containers and resource deposits.
